Chapter Title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عِدّةٍ مِنْ أَصْحَابِنَا عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ ٱلْمُخْتَارِ عَنْ
أَبِي بَصِيرٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ يَقُولُ: «مَا طَلَعَتِ الشَّمْسُ بِيَوْمٍ أَفْضَلَ مِنْ يَوْمِ الْجُمُعَةِ ».
الا ٦٢
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ya‘qub, from a number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Hammad
ibn Isa, from al-Husayn ibn al-Mukhtar, from Abu Basir, who said:
Abu Basir heard Abu Ja’far {a.s} say: “The sun has not risen on a day better than the day
of Friday.”
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.413 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.421 • Al-Muqni’ah, Vol.1 p.154 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.2 • Jamal Al-Usbu’, Vol.1 p.221 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1081 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.375 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.382 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.86 p.352 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.86 p.352

Chapter Title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND
arabic_text:
وَعَنَهُ عَنْ عَلِيَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ سَهْلٍ بْنِ زِيَادٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي نَصْرٍ عَنْ أَبِي الْحَسَنِ ٱلرَّضَا عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَلامُ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ
اللّه صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ : «إِنَّ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ سَيِّدُ الْأَيَّامِ يُضَاعِفُ فِيهِ الْحَسَنَاتِ وَ يَمْحُو فِيهِ السَّيِّئَاتِ وَ يَرْفَعُ فِيهِ
اَلدَّرَجَاتِ وَ يَسْتَجِيبُ فِيهِ الدَّعَوَاتِ وَ يَكْشِفُ فِيهِ الْكُرُبَاتِ وَ يَقْضِي فِيهِ الْحَاجَاتِ ٱلْعِظَامَ وَ هُوَ يَوْمُ ٱلْمَزِيدِ لِلْهِ
فِيهِ عُتَقَاءُ وَ طُلَقَاءُ مِنَ ٱلنَّارِ مَا دَعَا اللَّهَ فِيهِ أَحَدٌ مِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ وَ عَرَفَ حَقَّهُ وَ حُرْمَتَهُ إِلَّ كَانَ حَقَاً عَلَى اللّهِ عَزَّ وَ
جَلَّ أَنْ يَجْعَلَهُ مِنْ عُتَقَائِهِ وَ طُلَقَائِهِ مِنَ النَّارِ وَ إِنْ مَاتَ فِي يَوْمِهِ أَوْ لَيْلَتِهِ مَاتَ شَهِيداً وَ بُعِثَ آمِناً وَ مَا اِسْتَخَفِّ
أَحَدٌ بِحُزْمَتِهِ وَ ضَيَّعَ حَقَّهُ إِلاَّ كَانَ حَقّاً عَلَى اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ أَنْ يُصْلِيَهُ نَارَ جَهَنَّمَ إِلَّ أَنْ يَتُوبَ».
english_text:
From him, from Ali ibn Muhammad, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ibn Abi Nasr, from Abu al-Hasan al-Ridha {a.s},
peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Ridha {a.s} said: “The Messenger of Allah {SWT}, peace and blessings be upon him
and his family, said:
‘Indeed, the day of Friday is the master of days. Good deeds are multiplied in it, and
evil deeds are erased in it, and ranks are elevated in it, and supplications are answered
in it, and afflictions are removed in it, and great needs are fulfilled in it. It is the Day of
Increase.
In it, Allah {SWT} has freed ones and released ones from the Fire. No one among the
people supplicates to Allah {SWT} on that day, while recognizing its right and sanctity,
except that it is an obligation upon Allah {SWT}, the Mighty and Majestic, to make him
among those He {AZJ} has freed and released from the Fire.
And if he dies on its day or its night, he dies as a martyr and is raised secure. And no
one treats its sanctity lightly or neglects its right except that it becomes an obligation
upon Allah {SWT}, the Mighty and Majestic, to make him enter the Fire of Hell, unless he
repents.’”
source: Abu al-Qasim Prophet Muhammad ibn Abdullah {saws} & Abu al-Hasan Imam Ali Musa al-Ridha {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.2 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.86 p.274

Chapter Title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
arabic_text:
وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ عَبْدِ اللّهِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ عَنْ أَبَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ
قَالَ: «إِنَّ لِلْجُمُعَةِ حَقَاً وَ حُرْمَةً فَإِيَّاكَ أَنْ تُضَيَّعَ أَوْ تُقَصِّرَ فِي شَيْء مِنْ عِبَادَةِ اللّهِ تَعَالَى وَ التَّقَرْبِ إِلَيْهِ بِالْعَمَلِ
الصَّالِحٍ وَ تَرْكِ الْمَحَارِمِ كُلَّهَا فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ يُضَاعِفُ فِيهِ الْحَسَنَاتِ وَ يَمْحُو فِيهِ السِّيّئَاتِ وَ يَرْفَعُ فِيهِ الدَّرَجَاتِ» قَالَ وَ
ذَكَرَ «أَنَّ يَوْمَهُ مِثلُ لَيْلَتِهِ» قَالَ «فَإِنِ اِسْتَطَعْتَ أَنْ تُحِيِيَهُ بِالصَّلاةِ وَ الدُعَاءِ فَافْعَلْ فَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَنْزِلُ مِنْ أَوّلِ لَيْلَةٍ
الْجُمُعَةِ إِلَى سَمَاءِ الدُّنْيَا فَيُضَاعِفُ فِيهِ الْحَسَنَاتِ وَ يَمْحُو فِيهِ السَّيِّئَاتِ فَإِنَّ اللهَ وَاسِعٌ كَرِيمٌ».
english_text:
From him, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Abdillah ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Aban,
from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “Indeed, Friday has a right and a sanctity, so beware that you
waste it or fall short in anything from the worship of Allah {SWT}, the Exalted, and in
drawing near to Him {AZJ} through righteous deeds and complete abandonment of all
forbidden things. For indeed, Allah {SWT} multiplies good deeds in it, and erases evil
deeds in it, and elevates ranks in it.”
He (Aban) said that Imam {a.s} mentioned: “Indeed, its day is like its night.”
Imam {a.s} said: “So if you are able to enliven it with prayer and supplication, then do so.
For indeed, your Lord {AZJ} descends from the beginning of the night of Friday to the
heaven of the world, and He {AZJ} multiplies good deeds in it and erases evil deeds in it.
Verily, Allah {SWT} is All-Encompassing, Generous.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.414 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.3 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1082 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.375

Chapter Title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
arabic_text:
وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُوسَى عَنِ الْعَبَّاسِ بْنِ مَعْرُوفٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي نَجْرَانَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ
سِنَانٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي يَعْفُورٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ قَالَ: قَالَ لَهُ رَجُلْ كَيْفَ سُمَّيَتِ الْجُمُعَةُ بِالْجُمْعَةِ قَالَ «إِنَّ
اَللهَ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ جَمَعَ فِيهَا خَلْقَهُ لِوَلَايَةِ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلهِ وَ وَصِيِّهِ فِي الْمِيتَاقِ فَسَمَّاهُ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ لِجَمْعِهِ
فِيهِ خَلْقَهُ».
english_text:
From him, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn Musa, from al-Abbas ibn Maruf, from Ibn Abi
Najran, from Abdillah ibn Sinan, from Ibn Abi Yafur, from Abu Ja’far {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
A man asked Imam al-Baqir {a.s}: “Why was Friday named ‘al-Jumu’ah’ (the gathering)?”
Imam {a.s} said: “Indeed, Allah {SWT}, the Mighty and Majestic, gathered His {AZJ} creation
on that day for the allegiance (wilayah) of Muhammad {saws}, peace be upon him and his
family, and his successor (Imam Ali {a.s}), during the covenant (al-mithaq).
So He {AZJ} named it the ‘Day of Gathering’ (Yawm al-Jumu’ah) because He {AZJ} gathered
His {AZJ} creation on it.”
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.415 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.3 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1082 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.377 • Tafsir Al-Burhan, Vol.5 p.379 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.55 p.370 • Tafsir Nur Al-Thaqalayn, Vol.2 p.97 • Tafsir Nur Al-Thaqalayn, Vol.5 p.325 • Tafsir Kanz Al-Daqaiq, Vol.5 p.239 • Tafsir Kanz Al-Daqaiq, Vol.13 p.249

Chapter Title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
arabic_text:
وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ النُّعْمَانِ عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ عَنْ جَابِرٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَدِ
عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سُيِلَ عَنْ يَوْمِ الْجُمُعَةِ وَ لَيْلَتِهَا فَقَالَ «لَيْلَتُهَا لَيْلَةٌ غَرَّاءُ وَ يَوْمُهَا يَوْمٌ أزْهَرُ وَ لَيْسَ عَلَى وَجِهِ
الْأَرْضِ يَوْمٌ تَغْرُبُ فِيهِ الشَّمْسُ أَكْثَرَ مُعَافِّى مِنَ النَّارِ مَنْ مَاتَ يَوْمَ ٱلْجُمُعَةِ عَارِفاً بِحَقُّ أَهْلِ هَذَا الْبَيْتِ كَتَبَ اَللَّهُ
لَهُ بَرَاءَةً مِنَ اَلنَّارِ وَ بَرَاءَةً مِنْ عَذَابِ اَلْقَبْرِ وَ مَنْ مَاتَ لَيْلَةَ الْجُمُعَةِ عَتَقَ مِنَ النَّارِ».
english_text:
From him, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Ali ibn al-Numan, from Umar
ibn Yazid, from Jabir, from Abu Ja’far {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Baqir {a.s} was asked about the day of Friday and its night.
Imam {a.s} said: “Its night is a radiant night, and its day is a luminous day. There is no
day on the face of the earth in which the sun sets with more people being spared from
the Fire than on the day of Friday.
Whoever dies on the day of Friday, while recognizing the right of the people of this
House (Ahlulbayt {a.s}), Allah {SWT} will write for him a release from the Fire and a release
from the punishment of the grave.
And whoever dies on the night of Friday will be freed from the Fire.”
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.3 • Jamal Al-Usbu’, Vol.1 p.183 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1083 • Bihar Al- Anwar, Vol.86 p.272

Chapter Title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
arabic_text:
وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ عَنِ النَّضْرِ بْنِ سُوَيْدٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ
قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلامُ: «فَضَّلَ ٱللَّهُ اَلْجُمُعَةَ عَلَى غَيْرِهَا مِنَ الأَيَامِ وَ إِنَّ الْحِنَانَ لَتُزَخْرَفَ وَ تُزَيَّنُ يَوْمَ
الْجُمُعَةِ لِمَنْ أَنَاهَا فَإِنَّكُمْ تَتَسَابَقُونَ إِلَى الْجَنَّةِ عَلَى قَدْرٍ سَبْقِكُمْ إِلَى الْجُمُعَةِ وَ إِنَّ أَبْوَابَ السَّمَاءِ لَتُفَتَّحُ لِصُعُودِ
أَعْمَال الْعِبَادِ».
english_text:
From him, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Khalid, from al-
Nadr ibn Suwayd, from Abdillah ibn Sinan, who said:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: “Allah {SWT} has given superiority to Friday
over other days, and indeed the Gardens (of Paradise) are adorned and beautified on
the day of Friday for those who come to it.
For you will race toward Paradise in accordance with how early you race to Friday, and
indeed the gates of the heaven are opened for the ascent of the deeds of the servants.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.415 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.3 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1114 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.385 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.86 p.213

Chapter Title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
arabic_text:
وَ عَنَهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدِ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ أَبِي الْبِلاَدِ عَنْ بَعْضِ
أَصْحَابِهِ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ أَوْ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ قَالَ: «مَا طَلَعَتِ ٱلشَمْسُ بِيَوْمٍ أَفْضَلَ مِنْ
يَوْمِ الْجُمُعَةِ وَ إِنَّ كَلاَمَ الطِّيْرِ فِيهِ إِذَا لَقِيَ بَعْضُهَا بَعْضا سَلاَمٌ سَلاَمٌ وَ يَوْمٌ صَالِحٌ».
english_text:
From him, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Husayn ibn Said, from Ibrahim
ibn Abi al-Bilad, from one of his companions, from Abu Ja’far {a.s}, peace be upon him, or Abu Abdillah {a.s},
peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “The sun has not risen on a day better than the day of Friday.
Indeed, the speech of the birds on it, when they meet one another, is:
‘Peace, peace, and a righteous day’.”
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s} & Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al- Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.415 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.4 • ‘Uddat Al-Da’i, Vol.1 p.45 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1083 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.377 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.61 p.35 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.86 p.273

Chapter Title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي نَصْرٍ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلَامُ السَّاعَةُ الَّتِي فِي يَوْمِ الْجُمُعَةِ الَّتِي لا يَدْعُو فِيهَا مُؤْمِنٌ إِلَّ أُسْتُجِيبَ لَهُ قَالَ «نَعَمْ إِذَا خَرَجَ ٱلْإِمَامُ» قُلْتُ
إِنَّ الْإِمَامَ يُعَجِّلُ وَ يُؤَخِّرُ قَالَ «إِذَا زَاغَتِ الشَّمْسُ».
english_text:
From him, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Abi Nasr, from Muawiyah ibn
Ammar, who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him: “The hour on the day of Friday during
which no believing person supplicates except that it is answered, (when) is it?”
Imam {a.s} said: “Yes, (it is) when the Imam comes out.”
I asked: “But the Imam may come out early or late.”
Imam {a.s} said: “When the sun passes the meridian (when it declines from its zenith).”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.4146 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.4 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1085 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.352

Chapter Title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
arabic_text:
وَعَنْهُ عَنْ عَلِيَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عُذَافِرٍ عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ قَالَ: قَالَ
لِي أَبُو عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ «يَا عُمَرُ إِنَّهُ إِذَا كَانَ لَيْلَةُ الْجُمُعَةِ نَزَلَ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَلائِكَةٌ بِعَدَدِ الذَّرِّ فِي أَيْدِيهِمْ أَقْلَاَمُ
الذَّهَبِ وَ قَرَاطِيسُ اَلْفِضَّةِ لاَ يَكْتُبُونَ إِلَى لَيْلَةِ اَلسِّبْتِ إِلاَ الصَّلاَةَ عَلَى مُحَمَّدِ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ فَأْكْثِرُوا مِنْهَا» وَ قَالَ »يَا
عُمَرُ إِنَّ مِنَ السُنَّةِ أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمِّدٍ وَ أَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ فِي كُلِّ يَوْمِ جُمُعَةِ أَلْفَ مَرَّةٍ وَ فِي سَائِرِ الْأَيَامِ
مائَةً مَرَّةٍ».
english_text:
From him, from Ali ibn Muhammad, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Amru ibn Uthman, from Muhammad ibn
Udhafir, from Umar ibn Yazid, who said:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said to me: “O Umar (ibn Yazid), when it is the
night of Friday, angels descend from the sky in numbers equal to the particles of dust.
In their hands are pens of gold and scrolls of silver. They do not write, until the night of
Saturday, anything except blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad {saws} and the family of
Muhammad {saws}. So increase (your salawat) in it.”
And Imam {a.s} said: “O Umar (Ibn Yazid), indeed it is from the Sunnah that you send
blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad {saws} and the family of Muhammad {saws} and the
people of his household {a.s} one thousand times on every Friday, and one hundred
times on the other days.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.4 • Jamal Al-Usbu’, Vol.1 p.183 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1097 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.387 • Tafsir Al-Burhan, Vol.4 p.490 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.86 p.314

Chapter Title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
arabic_text:
وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ عَنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدِ عَنِ النَّضْرِ بْنِ سُوَيْدِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ
قَالَ: «كَانَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صَلَّى اللّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ يَسْتَجِبُ إِذَا دَخَلَ وَ إِذَا خَرَجَ فِي الشَّتَاءِ أَنْ يَكُونَ فِي لَيْلَةِ الْجُمُعَةِ »
وَقَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَلاَمُ «إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ إِخْتَارَ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ شَيْئاً وَ إِخْتَارَ مِنَ ٱلْأَيَامِ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ ».
english_text:
From him, from Ahmad, from al-Husayn ibn Said, from al-Nadr ibn Suwayd, from Abdillah ibn Sinan, from
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “The Messenger of Allah {SWT}, peace be upon him and his
family, used to prefer that his entering and exiting (travel or movement) during the
winter be on the night of Friday.”
And Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: “Indeed, Allah {SWT} has chosen from
everything a special part, and He {AZJ} has chosen from among the days; the day of
Friday.”
source: Abu al-Qasim Prophet Muhammad ibn Abdullah {saws} & Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.413 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.4 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1091

Chapter Title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
arabic_text:
وَ رَوَى أُبُو بَصِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ أَنّهُ قَالَ: «إِنَّ آللَّهَ تَعَالَى لَيُنَادِي كُلَّ لَيْلَةٍ جُمُعَةٍ مِنْ فَوْقٍ عَرْشِهِ مِنْ
أَوَّلِ اَللّيْلِ إِلَى آخِرِهِ «أَلاَ عَبْدٌ مُؤْمِنْ يَدْعُونِي لآخِرَتِهِ وَ دُنْيَاهُ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ ٱلْفَجْرِ لأُجِيبَهُ أَلاَ عَبْدٌ مُؤْمِنْ يَتُوبُ إِلَيَ
مِنْ ذُنُوبِهِ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ الْفَجْرِ فَأَتُوبَ عَلَيْهِ أَلاَ عَبْدٌ مُؤْمِنْ قَدْ قَتَّرْتُ عَلَيْهِ رِزْقَهُ فَيَسْأَلَنِي الزِّيَادَةَ فِي رِزْقِهِ قَبْلَ
طُلُوعِ الْفَجْرِ فَأَزِيدَهُ وَ أَوَسِّعَ عَلَيْهِ أَ لاَ عَبْدٌ مُؤْمِنْ سَقِيمٌ يَسْأَلُنِي أَنْ أَشفِيَهُ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ الْفَجْرِ فَأْعَافِيَهُ أَ لا عَبْدٌ
مُؤْمِنٌ مَحْبُوس مَعَمُومٌ يَسْأَلْنِي أَنْ أُطلِقَهُ مِنْ حَبْسِهِ وَ أُخَلِّيَ سَرْبَهُ أَلاَ عَبْدٌ مُؤْمِنْ مَظْلُومٌ يَسْأَلْنِي أَنْ آخْذَ لَهُ
بظُلامَتِهِ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ ٱلْفَجْرِ فَأَنْتَصِرَ لَهُ وَ آخْذَ لَهُ بِظُلامَتِهِ» قَالَ فَلا يَزَالُ يُنَادِي بِهَذَا حَتَّى يَطْلُعَ الْفَجْرُ».
english_text:
Abu Basir narrated from Abu Ja’far {a.s}, peace be upon him:
Imam al-Baqir {a.s} said: “Indeed, Allah {SWT}, the Exalted, calls out every night of Friday
from above His {AZJ} Throne, from the beginning of the night until its end:
‘Is there not a believing servant who will call upon Me {AZJ} for his Hereafter and his
worldly life before the rising of dawn, so that I {AZJ} may answer him?
Is there not a believing servant who will repent to Me {AZJ} from his sins before the rising
of dawn, so that I {AZJ} may turn to him in forgiveness?
Is there not a believing servant whose provision I {AZJ} have restricted, who will ask Me
{AZJ} for an increase in his provision before the rising of dawn, so that I {AZJ} may increase
it and expand it for him?
Is there not a believing servant who is sick, who will ask Me {AZJ} to cure him before the
rising of dawn, so that I {AZJ} may grant him well-being?
Is there not a believing servant who is imprisoned, distressed, who will ask Me {AZJ} to
release him from his imprisonment and relieve his condition?
Is there not a believing servant who is oppressed, who will ask Me {AZJ} to take up his
case and grant him victory over his oppressor before the rising of dawn, so that I {AZJ}
may avenge him and restore his right?’”
Imam {a.s} said: “And He {AZJ} continues to call with this until the dawn rises.”
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s} & Hadith-E-Qudsi
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.420 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.5 • ‘Uddat Al-Da’i, Vol.1 p.45 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1086 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.389 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.84 p.166

Chapter Title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
arabic_text:
وَ قَدْ رَوَى أَبْو بَصِيرٍ أَيْضا عَنْ أَحَدِهِمَا عَلَيْهِمَا السَلاَمُ قَالَ: «إِنَّ ٱلْعَبْدَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنَ يَسْأَلُ اللَّهَ الْحَاجَةَ فَيُوَخَرُ اللّهُ عَزَّ وَ
جَلَّ قَضَاءَ حَاجَتِهِ الَّتِي سَأَلَ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْجُمُعَةِ ».
قال الشيخ رحمه اللّه : واقرأ في صلاة المغرب في ليلة الجمعة سورة الجمعة. إلى قوله : ومن السنن اللازمة.
english_text:
And Abu Basir also narrated from one of the two (Imams {a.s}), peace be upon them, who said:
Imam {a.s} said: “Indeed, the believing servant asks Allah {SWT} for a need, and Allah {SWT},
the Mighty and Majestic, delays the fulfillment of his need that he asked for, until the
day of Friday.”
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s} & Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al- Sadiq {a.s}
commentary:
Shaykh (Al-Mufid), may Allah {SWT} have mercy on him, said: “And recite in the Maghrib
prayer on the night of Friday, Surah ‘al-Jumu’ah’, Up to his statement: ‘And among the
necessary Sunnahs’.”
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.5 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.381 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.86 p.274

Chapter Title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
arabic_text:
اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ الْجَوْهَرِيِّ عَنْ سَلَمَةَ بْنِ حَيَّانَ عَنْ أَبِي الصَّبَّاحِ الْكِنَانِيّ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ
اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ : «إِذَا كَانَ لَيْلَةُ الْجُمُعَةِ فَاقْرَأُ فِي الْمَغْرِبِ سُورَةَ الْجُمُعَةِ وَ «قُلْ هُوَ اللهُ أَحَدٌ» وَ إِذَا كَانَ فِي
الْعِشَاءِ الْآخِرَةِ فَاقْرَأْ سُورَةَ الْجُمُعَةِ وَ «سَبِّحِ اِسْمَ رَبِّكَ الْأَعْلَى» فَإِذَا كَانَ صَلاَةُ الْغَدَاةِ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ فَاقْرَأْ سُورَةَ
الْجُمُعَةِ وَ «قُل هُو اللهُ أَحَدٌ» فَإِذَا كَانَ صَلاَةُ الْجُمُعَةِ فَاقْرَأُ سُورَةَ الْجُمُعَةِ وَ الْمُنَافِقِينَ وَ إِذَا كَانَ صَلَاَةُ الْعَصْرِ يَوْمَ
الْجُمُعَةِ فَاقْرَأُ سُورَةَ الْجُمُعَةِ وَ «قُلْ هُوَ اللهُ أَحَدٌ» ».
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Said, from al-Qasim ibn Muhammad al-Jawhari, from Salamah ibn Hayyan, from Abu al-
Sabbah al-Kinani, who said:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: “When it is the night of Friday, then recite
in the Maghrib prayer Surah al-Jumu’ah and ‘Qul Huwa Allahu Ahad’ (Surah al-Ikhlas).
And when it is in the Isha al-Akhirah (the last evening prayer), then recite Surah al-
Jumu’ah and ‘Sabbihi Isma Rabbika al-Ala’ (Surah al-Ala).
Then when it is the Fajr (dawn) prayer on the day of Friday, then recite Surah al-
Jumu’ah and ‘Qul Huwa Allahu Ahad’ (Surah al-Ikhlas).
Then when it is the Jumu’ah prayer (Friday congregational prayer), then recite Surah
al-Jumu’ah and Surah al-Munafiqun.
And when it is the Asr (afternoon) prayer on the day of Friday, then recite Surah al-
Jumu’ah and ‘Qul Huwa Allahu Ahad’ (Surah al-Ikhlas).”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.5 • Jamal Al-Usbu’, Vol.1 p.184 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1138 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.119

Chapter Title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
arabic_text:
وَعَنْهُ عَنْ عُثُمَانَ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ : «اِقْرَأْ فِي لَيْلَةِ ٱلْجُمُعَةِ
الْجُمُعَةً وَ «سَبِّحِ اِسْمَ رَبِّكَ الْأَعْلَى» وَ فِي الْفَجْرِ سُورَةَ الْجُمُعَةِ وَ «قُل هُوَ اللهُ أَحَدٌ» وَ فِي الْجُمُعَةِ سُورَةَ الْجُمُعَةِ
وَ الْمُنَافِقِينَ ».
english_text:
From him, from Uthman ibn Isa, from Sama’ah, from Abu Basir, who said:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: “Recite on the night of Friday, Surah al-
Jumu’ah and ‘Sabbihi Isma Rabbika al-Ala’ (Surah al-Ala).
Recite in the Fajr prayer, Surah al-Jumu’ah and ‘Qul Huwa Allahu Ahad’ (Surah al-
Ikhlas), and in the Jumu’ah (Friday congregational) prayer; Surah al-Jumu’ah and al-
Munafiqun.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.425 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.6 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.413 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1133 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.118 • Tafsir Nur Al-Thaqalayn, Vol.5 p.320 • Tafsir Kanz Al-Daqaiq, Vol.13 p.242

Chapter Title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
arabic_text:
وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنْ أَبِي أَيْوبَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَلاَمُ الْقِرَاءَةُ فِي الصَّلاَةِ
فِيهَا شَيْءٌ مُوَقَّتْ قَالَ «لا إِلاَّ فِي الْجُمُعَةِ يُقْرَأْ فِيهَا بِالْجُمُعَةِ وَ ٱلْمُنَافِقِينَ».
english_text:
From him, from Safwan, from Abu Ayyub, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him: “Is there anything fixed regarding the
recitation in prayer?”
Imam {a.s} said: “No, except in the Friday prayer (Salat Al Jumu'ah); Surah al-Jumu’ah
and al-Munafiqun are to be recited in it.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.313 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.6 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.413 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1133 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.118 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.155 • Tafsir Nur Al-Thaqalayn, Vol.5 p.320 • Tafsir Kanz Al-Daqaiq, Vol.13 p.241

Chapter Title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللّهِ بْنِ ٱلْمُغِيرَةِ عَنْ جَمِيلٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ عَنْ أَبِي
جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السِّلاَمُ قَالَ: «إِنَّ اللَّهَ أَكْرَمَ بِالْجُمُعَةِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ فَسَنَّهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ بِشَارَةً لَهُمْ وَ
الْمُنَافِقِينَ تَوْبِيحاً لِلْمُنَافِقِينَ فَلَاَ يَنْبَغِي تَرْكُهُمَا فَمَنْ تَرَكَهُمَا مُتَعَمَّداً فَلاَ صَلَاَةَ لَهُ».
قوله عليه السلام فلا صلاة له يحتمل وجهين ، أحدهما : انه إذا ترك قراءة هاتين السورتين غير معتقد أن في قراءتهما
فضلا كثيرا وثوابا جزيلا فلا صلاة له. ويحتمل ايضا أن يكون أراد عليه السلام فلا صلاة كاملة فاضلة له كما قال النبي
صلى اللّٰه عليه واله لاصلاة لجار المسجد إلا في مسجده ، وإنما أراد صلى اللّٰه عليه وآله لاصلاة فاضلة كاملة دون أن يكون
المراد به رفع جوازها وكذلك الخبر الذي رواه:
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Abdillah ibn al-Mughirah, from Jamil, from
Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja’far {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Baqir {a.s} said: “Indeed, Allah {SWT} has honored the believers with Friday, so
the Messenger of Allah {SWT}, peace be upon him and his family, instituted it as a glad
tiding for them, and (He {saws} instituted the recitation of) Surah al-Munafiqun as a
rebuke to the hypocrites. So they (both) should not be abandoned.
Whoever deliberately abandons them, then there is no prayer for him.”
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s} & Abu al-Qasim Prophet Muhammad ibn Abdullah {saws}
commentary:
Imam {a.s} statement, peace be upon him, “then there is no prayer for him,” may carry
two meanings.
The first possible meaning; that if he abandons the recitation of these two surahs
without believing that their recitation holds great merit and abundant reward, then his
prayer is invalid.
The second possible meaning; that what Imam {a.s}, peace be upon him, intended is
that there is no complete and virtuous prayer for him just as the Prophet {saws}, peace
be upon him and his family said; ‘There is no prayer for the neighbor of the mosque
except in the mosque.’
What Prophet {saws}, peace be upon him and his family, meant by this was: ‘there is no
superior and complete prayer (if not prayed in the mosque), and not that the validity of
the prayer is nullified’. And similarly is the report that he narrated:
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.425 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.6 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.414 • Awali Al-La’ali, Vol.3 p.85 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1134 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.154 • Tafsir Al-Burhan, Vol.5 p.371 • Bihar Al- Anwar, Vol.86 p.138 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.86 p.209 • Tafsir Nur Al-Thaqalayn, Vol.5 p.321

Chapter Title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
arabic_text:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ الْأَحْوَلِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: «مَنْ لَمْ يَقْرَأُ
فِي الْجُمُعَةٍ بِالْجُمُعَةِ وَ الْمُنَافِقِينَ فَلاَ جُمُعَةَ لَهُ».
فانه يحتمل ما ذكرناه من نفي الكمال أو ما ذكرناه من بطلان الصلاة أذا اعتقد انه ليس في قرائتهما فضل ، والذي يدل
على أن قراءة هاتين السورتين ليس بفريضة تفسد بتركها الصلاة ما رواه:
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Said, from al-Husayn ibn Abd al-Malik al-Ahwal, from his father, from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace
be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “Whoever does not recite in the Friday prayer (Salat Al
Jumu'ah); Surah al-Jumu’ah and al-Munafiqun, then there is no Friday (prayer) for
him.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
commentary:
For it may carry the interpretation we have mentioned of negation of ‘completeness’
or what we also mentioned regarding ‘invalidity of the prayer’ if the person believes
that there is no merit in their recitation.
And what indicates that the recitation of these two surahs is not an obligation whose
omission invalidates the prayer is what has been narrated:
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.7 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.414 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1136 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.155

Chapter Title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
arabic_text:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ حَرِيزٍ وَ رِبْعِيِّ رَفَعَاهُ إِلَى أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السِّلَاَمُ قَالَ: «إِذَا كَانَ لَيْلَةُ
الْجُمُعَةٍ يُسْتَحَبّ أَنْ يُقْرَأ فِي الْعَتَمَةِ سُورَةُ الْجُمُعَةِ وَ «إِذَا جَاءَكَ الْمُنافِقُونَ» وَ فِي صَلَاَةِ الصُّبْحِ مِثْلُ ذَلِكَ وَ فِي
صَلاَةِ اَلْجُمُعَةِ مِثلُ ذَلِكَ وَ فِي صَلاَةِ الْعَصْرِ مِثلُ ذَلِكَ».
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Said, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Hariz and Ribi, who both raised it to Abu Ja’far {a.s}, peace
be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Baqir {a.s} said: “When it is the night of Friday, it is recommended to recite in
the Atamah (Isha prayer) Surah al-Jumu’ah and ‘Idha Jaaka al-Munafiqun’ (Surah al-
Munafiqun), and in the Fajr prayer the same, and in the Jumu’ah prayer the same, and
in the Asr prayer the same.”
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.7 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.414 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1139 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.119 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.82 p.26

Chapter Title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
arabic_text:
وَرَوَى مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ ٱلْحَسَنِ عَنْ أَخِيهِ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ عَلِيَ بْنِ يَقْطِينٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ
قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا الْحَسَنِ الْأَوَّلَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلَامُ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يَقْرَأْ فِي صَلاَةِ الْجُمُعَةِ بِغَيْرِ سُورَةِ الْجُمُعَةِ مُتَعَمَّداً قَالَ «لا
بَأْسَ بِذَلِكَ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Hasan, from his brother
al-Husayn ibn Ali ibn Ya'qtin, from his father, who said:
I asked Abu al-Hasan al-Awwal, peace be upon him, about a man who deliberately
recites in the Friday prayer (Salat Al Jumu'ah), other than Surah al-Jumu’ah.
Imam {a.s} said: “There is no harm in that.”
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.7 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.7 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.414 • Al- Istibsar, Vol.1 p.414 • Awali Al-La’ali, Vol.3 p.84 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1137 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.157 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.158

Chapter Title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
arabic_text:
أحمد بن محمد بن عيسى عن محمد بن سهل الاشعري عن أبيه قال سألت أبا الحسن عليه السلام : عن الرجل
يقرأ في صلاة الجمعة بغير سورة الجمعة متعمدا قال : لا بأس.
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Muhammad ibn Sahl al-Ashari, from his father, who said:
I asked Abu al-Hasan {a.s}, peace be upon him, about a man who deliberately recites in
the Friday prayer (Salat Al Jumu'ah), something other than Surah al-Jumu’ah.
Imam {a.s} said: “There is no harm.”
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.7

Chapter Title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
arabic_text:
فَأَمًّا مَا رَوَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ
يَزِيدَ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ : «مَنْ صَلَّى الْجُمُعَةَ بِغَيْرِ ٱلْجُمُعَةِ وَ ٱلْمُنَافِقِينَ أَعَادَ الصَّلاَةَ فِي سَفَرٍ أَوْ
حَضَرٍ».
فالمراد بهذا الخبر الترغيب لمن صلى بغير الجمعة والمنافقين أن يجعل ما صلى من جملة النوافل ويستأنف الصلاة ليلحق
فضل هاتين السورتين والذي يبين عما ذكرناه :
english_text:
As for what was narrated by Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr,
from Muawiyah ibn Ammar, from Umar ibn Yazid, who said:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: “Whoever prays the Friday prayer (Salat Al
Jumu'ah), without (reciting) Surah al-Jumu’ah and Surah al-Munafiqun must repeat
the prayer, whether he is travelling or resident.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
commentary:
What is meant by this narration is to encourage the one who has prayed without
(reciting) al-Jumu’ah and al-Munafiqun to count what he has prayed as part of the
supererogatory (nafl) prayers and to begin the prayer anew, in order to attain the merit
of these two surahs. And what clarifies what we have mentioned is:
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.7

Chapter Title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
arabic_text:
مَا رَوَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ يُونُسَ عَنْ صَبَّاحِ بْنِ صَبِيحِ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لأَبِي عَبْدِ آللَّهِ
عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ رَجُلْ أَرَادَ أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ الْجُمُعَةَ فَقَرَأَ إٍ «قُلْ هُوَ اللهُ أَحَدٌ» قَالَ «يُتِمُهَا رَكْعَتَيْنِ ثُمَّ يَسْتَأْنِفُ».
والذي يدل على ما ذكرناه ما رواه :
english_text:
What was narrated by Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Yunus, from
Sabbah ibn Sabih, who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him: “A man intended to pray the Friday
prayer (Salat Al Jumu'ah), and recited ‘Qul Huwa Allahu Ahad’ (Surah al-Ikhlas).”
Imam {a.s} said: “He completes it as two rak’ahs, then begins again.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
commentary: And what supports what we have mentioned is what was narrated:
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.8 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.415 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1136 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.159 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.82 p.18

Chapter Title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَبِي الْفَضْلِ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ جَمِيلٍ عَنْ عَلِيّ بْنِ
يَقْطِينٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا ٱلْحَسَنِ عَ عَنِ ٱلْجُمُعَةِ فِي السَّفَرِ مَا أَقْرَأْ فِيهِمَا قَالَ «اِقْرَأْهُمَا «قُلْ هُوَ اللَهُ أَحَدٌ»».
فاجاز له عليه السلام في هذا الخبر قراءة قل هو اللّٰه أحد، وفي الخبر أنه يعيد سواء كان في سفر أو حضر، فلو كان المراد
غير ما ذكرناه من الترغيب لما جوز له في هذا الخبر قراءة قل هو اللّٰه أحد.
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Abu al-Fadl, from Safwan ibn Yahya,
from Jamil, from Ali ibn Yaqtin, who said:
I asked Abu al-Hasan {a.s}, peace be upon him, about the Friday prayer (Salat Al
Jumu'ah), during travel what should I recite in them?
He said: “Recite in them ‘Qul Huwa Allahu Ahad’ (Surah al-Ikhlas).”
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}
commentary:
So, in this narration, Imam {a.s}, peace be upon him, permitted the recitation of ‘Qul
Huwa Allahu Ahad’ (Surah al-Ikhlas). And in the earlier narration, it was stated that he
should repeat the prayer whether he was travelling or resident.
Therefore, if what we mentioned namely, encouragement and recommendation was
not the intended meaning, then he would not have permitted him in this narration to
recite ‘Qul Huwa Allahu Ahad’ (Surah al-Ikhlas).
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.415 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.8 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.415 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1137 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.157

Chapter Title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَامِرٍ عَنْ عَلِيّ بْنِ مَهْزِيَارَ عَنِ النَّضْرِ بْنِ سُوَيْدِ عَنْ عَبْدِ
اَللَّه بَنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلَاَمُ قَالَ: «تَقُولُ فِي آخِرٍ سَجْدَةٍ مِنَ النَّوَافِلِ بَعْدَ الْمَغْرِبِ لَيْلَةَ الْجُمُعَةِ -
اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّي أَسْأَلْكَ بِوَجْهِكَ الْكَرِيمِ وَ أَسْأَلُكَ بِاسْمِكَ الْعَظِيمِ أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدِ وَ أَنْ تَغْفِرَ لِي ذَنْبِيَ
العَظِيم سَبعاً ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from al-Husayn ibn Muhammad, from Abdillah ibn Amir, from Ali ibn Mahziyar, from
al-Nadr ibn Suwayd, from Abdillah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “In the last prostration of the supererogatory prayers after
Maghrib on the night of Friday, you say:
‘O’ Allah {SWT}, I ask You {AZJ} by Your Noble Face, and I ask You {AZJ} by Your Great Name,
to send blessings upon (prophet) Muhammad {saws} and the family of Muhammad {saws},
and to forgive me my great sin’ seven times.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.428 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.8 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1096 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.394

Chapter Title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
arabic_text:
عَلِيُّ بْنُ مَهْزِيَارَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى الْخَزَّازِ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عُثُمَانَ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ يَقُولُ:
«يُسْتَحَبُّ أَنْ تَقْرَأ فِي دُبُرِ ٱلْغَدَاةِ - يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ الرَّحْمَنَ ثُمَّ تَقُولَ كُلَّمَا قُلْتَ «فَبِأْيِّ آلاَءِ رَبَّكُمَا تُكَذَّبَانِ» قُلْتَ لا
بِشَيْءٍ مِنْ آلآَئِكَ رَبِّ أَكَذَّبُ ».
english_text:
Ali ibn Mahziyar, from Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Khazzaz, from Hammad ibn Uthman, who said:
I heard Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, say: “It is recommended to recite after
the Fajr (dawn) prayer on the day of Friday; Surah al-Rahman.
Then, every time you say; ‘Fa-bi-ayyi alai rabbikuma tukaḏḏiban’ (So which of the
favors of your Lord {AZJ} will you both deny?) in Surah al-Rahman, you say;
‘I do not deny any of Your favors, O’ Lord {AZJ}’.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.429 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.8 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1100 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.72 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.408 • Al-Fusul Al-Muhimmah, Vol.3 p.313 • Tafsir Al-Burhan, Vol.5 p.227 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.86 p.354 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.89 p.306 • Tafsir Nur Al-Thaqalayn, Vol.5 p.187

Chapter Title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
arabic_text:
عَثْهُ عَنْ أَيُوبَ بْنِ نُوحِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي حَمْرَةَ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ : «مَنْ قَرَأَ سُورَةَ الْكَهْفِ فِي
كُلِّ لَيْلَةٍ جُمُعَةٍ كَانَتْ كَفَّارَةً لَهُ لِمَا بَيْنَ الْجُمُعَةِ إِلَى الْجُمُعَةِ ».
ثم قال الشيخ رحمه اللّٰه : ومن السنن اللازمة للجمعة الغسل بعد الفجر من يوم الجمعة. إلى قوله : فخذ شيئا من شاربك.
قال محمد بن الحسن : قد بينا في كتاب الطهارة فضل غسل يوم الجمعة ، ويزيده بيانا ما رواه:
english_text:
From him, from Ayyub ibn Nuh, from Muhammad ibn Abi Hamzah, who said:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: “Whoever recites Surah al-Kahf on every
night of Friday, it will be an expiation for him for what is between that Friday and the
next Friday.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
commentary:
Then Shaykh (Al-Mufid), may Allah {SWT} have mercy on him, said:
“And among the necessary Sunnahs for Friday is performing ghusl after Fajr on the day
of Friday” up to his statement: “Take something from your mustache.”
Muhammad ibn al-Hasan said: “We have already clarified in the ‘Book of Taharah’
(Purification) the virtue of the Friday ghusl, and what further clarifies it is what has
been narrated”
references: Al-Muqni’ah, Vol.1 p.157 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.8 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1100 • Tafsir Al- Safi, Vol.3 p.270 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.408 • Tafsir Al-Burhan, Vol.3 p.609 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.89 p.282 • Tafsir Nur Al-Thaqalayn, Vol.3 p.241 • Tafsir Kanz Al-Daqaiq, Vol.8 p.27

Chapter Title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
arabic_text:
سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ أَذَيْنَةَ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ
أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ غُسْلٍ يَوْمِ الْجُمُعَةِ فَقَالَ «سُنَّةً فِي السَّفَرِ وَ الْحَضَرِ إِلاَّ أَنْ يَخَافَ ٱلْمُسَافِرُ
عَلَى نَفْسِهِ اَلْقُرَّ».
english_text:
Sa’ad ibn Abdillah, from Abu Ja’far, from Yaqub ibn Yazid, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Umar ibn
Udhaynah, from Zurarah, from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Imam {a.s} about the ghusl of the day of Friday
Imam {a.s} said: “It is a Sunnah in both travel and residence, except if the traveller fears
cold for himself.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.1 p.112 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.9 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.102 • Awali Al-La’ali, Vol.2 p.171 • Al-Wafi, Vol.6 p.393 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.3 p.314

Chapter Title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ (عَبْدِ خ ل) اللَّهِ وَ عَبْدِ اللّهِ بْنِ ٱلْمُغِيرَةِ عَنْ أَبِي الْحَسَنِ الرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ
السّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ الْغُسْلِ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ فَقَالَ «وَاجِبٌ عَلَى كُلِّ ذَكَرٍ وَ أَنتَى مِنْ عَبْدٍ أَوْ حُرِّ».
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Muhammad ibn Abdillah and Abdillah ibn al-Mughirah, from Abu al-
Hasan al-Ridha {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Imam {a.s} about the ghusl on the day of Friday.
Imam {a.s} said: “It is obligatory upon every male and female, whether slave or free.”
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Ali ibn Musa al-Ridha {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.41 • Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.42 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.1 p.111 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.1 p.111 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.9 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.103 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.103 • Awali Al-La’ali, Vol.2 p.171 • Al-Wafi, Vol.6 p.389 • Al-Wafi, Vol.6 p.389

Chapter Title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
arabic_text:
وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ سَيْفٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ سَيْفِ بْنِ عَمِيرَةَ عَنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ خَالِدِ الصِّيْرَفِيِّ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا الْحَسَنِ الْأَوَّلَ
عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ كَيْفَ كَانَ غُسْلُ يَوْمِ الْجُمُعَةِ وَاجِباً فَقَالَ «إِنَّ اللَّهَ تَعَالَى أَتَمَّ صَلاَةَ الْفَرِيضَةِ بِصَلاَةِ النَّافِلَةِ وَ أَنَمَّ
صِيَامَ ٱلْفَرِيضَةِ بِصِيَامِ النَّافِلَةِ وَ أَتَمَّ وُضُوءَ ٱلْفَرِيضَةِ بِغُسْلِ يَوْمِ الْجُمُعَةِ مَا كَانَ مِنْ ذَلِكَ مِنْ سَهْوٍ أَوْ تَقْصِيرٍ أَوْ
نُقْصَانٍ».
english_text:
From him, from Ali ibn Sayf, from his father Sayf ibn Umayrah, from al-Husayn ibn Khalid al-Sayrafi, who
said:
I asked Abu al-Hasan al-Awwal {a.s}, peace be upon him: “How was the ghusl of Friday
made obligatory?”
Imam {a.s} said: “Indeed, Allah {SWT}, the Exalted, completed the obligatory prayer with
the supererogatory prayer,
And He {AZJ} completed the obligatory fast with the supererogatory fast, and He {AZJ}
completed the obligatory wudu with the ghusl of the day of Friday,
For what may occur therein of forgetfulness, shortcoming, or deficiency.”
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.42 • ‘Ilal Al-Shara’i’, Vol.1 p.285 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.1 p.111 • Tahdib Al- Ahkam, Vol.1 p.366 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.9 • Al-Wafi, Vol.6 p.390 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.3 p.313 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.78 p.123

Chapter Title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
arabic_text:
محَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ إسْحَاقَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللّهِ بْنِ حَمَّادِ ٱلْأَنْصَارِيَّ عَنْ صَبَّاحِ ٱلْمُرَنِيَّ عَنِ الْحَارِثِ
عَنِ الْأَصْبَغِ قَالَ: كَانَ عَلِيٌّ عَلَيْهِ السَلاَمُ إِذَا أَرَادَ أَنْ يُوَبِّخَ ٱلرَّجُلَ يَقُولُ لَهُ «وَ آللَّهِ لَأَنْتَ أَعْجَزُ مِنْ تَارِكِ ٱلْغُسْلِ يَوْمَ
اَلْجُمُعَةِ فَإِنَّهُ لا يَزَالُ فِي طُهْرٍ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْجُمُعَةِ الْأُخْرَى».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Ibrahim ibn Ishaq, from Abdillah ibn Hammad al-Ansari, from
Sabbah al-Muzani, from al-Harith, from al-Asbagh, who said:
Whenever Imam Ali {a.s}, peace be upon him, wanted to rebuke a man,
Imam {a.s} would say to him: “By Allah {SWT}, you are more incapable than the one who
abandons the ghusl on the day of Friday, for indeed, one remains in a state of purity
until the following Friday.”
source: Amir al-Mu’minin Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib al-Murtadha {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.9

Chapter Title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
arabic_text:
أحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ دُوَيْلِ بْنِ هَارُونَ عَنْ أَبِي وَلاَّدِ الْحَنَاطِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلَاَمُ قَالَ:
«مَنِ اِغْتَسَلَ يَوْمَ ٱلْجُمُعَةِ فَقَالَ - أَشهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لا شَرِيكَ لَهُ وَ أَنَّ مُحَمَّداً عَبْدُهُ وَ رَسُولُهُ اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ
عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اِجْعَلْنِي مِنَ التَّوَّابِينَ وَ اِجْعَلْنِي مِنَ الْمُتَطَهِّرِينَ كَانَ لَهُ طُهَراً مِنَ الْجُمُعَةِ إِلَى يَوْمِ
اَلْجُمُعَةِ ».
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ahmad ibn Duwail ibn Harun, from Abu Walad al-Hannat, from Abu
Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “Whoever performs ghusl on the day of Friday and says:
‘I bear witness that there is no God but Allah {SWT}, alone, without partner, and that
Muhammad {saws} is His {AZJ} servant and His {AZJ} messenger.
O’ Allah {SWT}, send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad {saws} and the family of
Muhammad {saws, and make me among those who repent, and make me among
those who purify themselves’
then it will be for him a purification from that Friday to the next Friday.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.112 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.10 • Jamal Al-Usbu’, Vol.1 p.368 • Al-Wafi, Vol.6 p.513 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.3 p.323 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.86 p.352

Chapter Title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ مُحَمَدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ قَالَ
قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ : «لِيَتَزَّيَّنْ أَحَدُكُمْ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ يَفْتَسِلُ وَ يَتَطَيَّبُ وَ يُسَرِّحُ لِحَيَتَهُ وَ يَلْبَسُ أَنْظَفَ
ثِيَابِهِ وَ لْيَتَهَيَّأُ لِلْجُمُعَةِ وَ لَيَكُنْ عَلَيْهِ فِي ذَلِكَ الْيَوْمِ السَّكِينَةُ وَ الْوَقَارُ وَ لْيُحْسِنْ عِبَادَةَ رَبِّهِ وَ لَيَفْعَلِ الْخَيْرَ مَا
اِسْتَطَاعَ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ تَعَالَى يَطَّلِعُ إِلَى الْأَرْضِ لِيُضَاعِفَ الْحَسَنَاتِ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Yunus ibn Abd al-Rahman, from
Hisham ibn al-Hakam, who said:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: “Let each of you adorn himself on the day
of Friday perform ghusl, apply perfume, comb his beard, wear his cleanest clothes,
prepare himself for Friday, and let there be upon him on that day calmness and dignity.
Let him perfect his worship of his Lord {AZJ} and do as much good as he is able.
For indeed, Allah {SWT}, the Exalted, looks upon the earth to multiply good deeds.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.417 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.10 • Jamal Al-Usbu’, Vol.1 p.366 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1095 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.395 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.86 p.352

Chapter Title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
arabic_text:
وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحُصَيْنِ عَنْ عُمَرَ الْجُرْجَانِيَّ
عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْعَلاَءِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ قَالَ سَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ: «مَنْ أَخَذَ مِنْ شَارِبِهِ وَ قَلَّمَ أَظْفَارَهُ يَوْمَ
الْجُمُعَةِ ثُمَّ قَالَ بِسْمِ اللهِ عَلَى سُنَّةٍ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ كَتَبَ اللهُ لَهُ بِكُلِّ شَعْرَةٍ وَ كُلِّ قُلاَمَةٍ عِثْقَ رَقَبَةٍ وَ لَمْ يَمْرَضْ
مَرَضاً يُصِيبُهُ إِلاَّ مَرَضَ الْمَوْتِ».
قال الشيخ رحمه اللّٰه : وصل ست ركعات عند انبساط الشمس. الى قوله: واعلم ان الرواية جاءت..
english_text:
From him, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Husayn ibn Said, from
Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Umar al-Jurjani, from Muhammad ibn al-Ala, from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace
be upon him, who said:
I heard Imam (al-Sadiq {a.s}) say: “Whoever trims his moustache and clips his nails on
the day of Friday, then says:
‘In the name of Allah {SWT}, upon the Sunnah of Muhammad {saws} and the family of
Muhammad {saws}’,
Allah {SWT} will write for him, for every hair and every nail clipping, the reward of freeing
a slave. And he will not suffer any illness except the illness of death.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
commentary:
Shaykh (Al-Mufid), may Allah {SWT} have mercy on him, said: “And perform six rak’ahs
when the sun rises’ up to his statement: ‘And know that the narration has come”.
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.417 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.10 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1095 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.362 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.86 p.358

Chapter Title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى وَ غَيْرِهِ عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي نَصْرِ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو
الْحَسَنٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ : «الصَّلاَةُ النَّافِلَةُ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ سِتُّ رَكَعَاتٍ صَدْرَ النَّهَارِ وَ رَكْعَتَانٍ إِذَا زَالَتِ الشَّمْسُ ثُمَّ صَلِّ
الْفَرِيضَةَ ثُمَّ صَلِّ بَعْدَهَا سِنَّ رَكَعَاتٍ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Yaqub, from Muhammad ibn Yahya and others, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ahmad ibn
Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, who said:
Abu al-Hasan {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: “The recommended prayer (nafilah) on the
day of Friday is six rak’ahs at the beginning of the day, and two rak’ahs when the sun
passes its zenith. Then perform the obligatory prayer, then perform after it six rak’ahs.”
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Ali ibn Musa al-Ridha {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.427 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.10 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.409 • Jamal Al- Usbu’, Vol.1 p.393 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1101 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.325 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.87 p.14

Chapter Title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
arabic_text:
وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ جَمَاعَةٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ ٱلْمُخْتَارِ عَنْ
عَلِيَّ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ عَنْ مُرَادِ بْنِ خَارِجَةَ قَالَ قَالَ أُبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ : «أمًا أنَا فَإِذَا كَانَ يَوْمُ ٱلْجُمُعَةِ وَ كَانَتِ
الشَّمْسُ مِنَ الْمَشرِقِ مِقْدَارَهَا مِنَ الْمَغْرِبِ فِي وَقْتِ صَلَاَةِ الْعَصْرِ صَلَّيْتُ سِنَّ رَكَعَاتٍ فَإِذَا اِرْتَفَعَ النَّهَارُ صَلِّيْتُ
سِتَاً فَإِذَا زَاغَتِ الشَّمْسُ أَوْ زَالَتْ صَلَّيْتُ رَكْعَتَيْنِ ثُمَّ صَلَّيْتُ الظُهْرَ ثُمَّ صَلَّيْتُ بَعْدَهَا سِتَاً».
english_text:
From him, from a group (of narrators), from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Husayn ibn Said, from Hammad
ibn Isa, from al-Husayn ibn al-Mukhtar, from Ali ibn Abd al-Aziz, from Murad ibn Kharijah, who said:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: “As for me when it is the day of Friday, and
the sun in the east is at the same position as it is in the west during the time of the Asr
prayer, I perform six rak’ahs.
Then, when the day has risen high, I perform six (more rak’ahs).
Then, when the sun inclines or passes its zenith, I perform two rak’ahs.
Then, I perform Dhuhr, and then I perform six (rak’ahs) after it.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.428 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.11 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.410 • Jamal Al- Usbu’, Vol.1 p.394 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1101 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.325 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.87 p.15

Chapter Title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
arabic_text:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ يَقْطِينٍ عَنِ الْعَبْدِ الصَّالِحِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ التَّطَوْعِ فِي يَوْمِ الْجُمُعَةِ
قَالَ «إِذَا أَرَدْتَ أَنْ تَتَطَوَّعَ فِي يَوْمِ الْجُمُعَةِ فِي غَيْرٍ سَفَرٍ صَلَّيْتَ سِنْ رَكَعَاتِ اِرْتِفَاعَ النَّهَارِ وَ سِتَّ رَكَعَاتٍ قَبْلَ
نِصْفِ اَلنَّهَارِ وَ رَكْعَتَيْنِ إِذَا زَالَتِ الشَّمْسُ قَبْلَ الْجُمُعَةِ وَ سِتَّ رَكَعَاتٍ بَعْدَ الْجُمُعَةِ».
وقد روي انه يجوز أن يصليها الانسان كما يصلي ساير الايام على ترتيبها روى ذلك
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Said, from Yaqub ibn Yaqtin, from the Righteous Servant (of Allah {SWT}), peace be upon him,
who said:
I asked (Imam al-Kadhim {a.s}) about voluntary (nafl) prayers on the day of Friday.
Imam {a.s} said: “If you want to perform voluntary prayers on the day of Friday while not
travelling, then pray six rak’ahs when the day rises, and six rak’ahs before midday, and
two rak’ahs when the sun passes its zenith before the Friday (congregational prayer),
and six rak’ahs after the Friday prayer (Salat Al Jumu'ah).”
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}
commentary:
And it has been narrated that it is permissible for a person to perform them (the
recommended prayers of Friday) as he does on other days, in their usual order. This
was narrated by:
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.11 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.410 • Jamal Al-Usbu’, Vol.1 p.394 • Al- Wafi, Vol.8 p.1102 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.324 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.87 p.15

Chapter Title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
arabic_text:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ النَّضْرِ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ سَالِمِ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ خَالِدِ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ النَّافِلَةُ
يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ قَالَ «سِتُّ رَكَعَاتٍ قَبْلَ زَوَالِ الشَّمْسِ وَ رَكْعَتَانٍ عِنْدَ زَوَالِهَا وَ الْقِرَاءَةُ فِي الْأُولَى بِالْجُمُعَةِ وَ فِي
الثَّانِيَةِ بِالْمُنَافِقِينَ وَ بَعْدَ الْفَرِيضَةِ ثَمَانِي رَكَعَاتٍ».
قال محمد بن الحسن : والافضل عندي تقديم النوافل كلها يوم الجمعة. والذي يدل على ذلك ما رواه:
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Said, from al-Nadr, from Hisham ibn Salim, from Sulayman ibn Khalid, who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him: “What is the (ruling on) the nafilah
(supererogatory prayer) on the day of Friday?”
Imam {a.s} said: “Six rak’ahs before the sun’s zenith, and two rak’ahs at its zenith, and
in the first (of those two) recite Surah al-Jumu’ah, and in the second Surah al-
Munafiqun, and after the obligatory prayer, (perform) eight rak’ahs.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
commentary:
Muhammad ibn al-Hasan said: “The best, in my opinion, is to perform all the
supererogatory (nafilah) prayers before (the obligatory prayer) on the day of Friday.”
And what indicates that is what was narrated:
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.11 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.410 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1102 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.324

Chapter Title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
arabic_text:
مُحَمِّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ عَنْ أَجِيهِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ بْنِ يَقْطِينٍ عَنْ أَبِيِهِ قَالَ:
سَأَلْتُ أَبَا الْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ عَنِ النَّافِلَةِ الَّتِي تُصَلَّى يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ قَبْلَ الْجُمُعَةِ أَفْضَلُ أَوْ بَعْدَهَا قَالَ «قَبْلَ الصَّلاةِ».
ويدل عليه ايضا أنه قد روي انه إذا زالت الشمس لا يصلي الانسان إلا الفريضة ، وإذا لم يجزله غير ذلك فقد سوغ له
تقديمها فالافضل له أن يقدمها لانه لا يأمن أن يخترم فلا يبقى إلى بعد الفراغ من الفريضة فيفوته ثواب النافلة.
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Hasan, from his brother al-Husayn
ibn Ali ibn Yaqtin, from his father, who said:
I asked Abu al-Hasan {a.s} about the supererogatory prayer that is performed on the day
of Friday, whether it is better before the Friday prayer (Salat Al Jumu'ah) or after it.
Imam {a.s} said: “Before the prayer.”
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}
commentary:
And it is also supported by what has been narrated; once the sun passes its zenith, a
person may not pray anything except the obligatory prayer. And if nothing else is
permitted for him at that time, then it is allowed for him to perform the supererogatory
prayers beforehand. Thus, it is better for him to perform them earlier, because he
cannot be sure he will live until after completing the obligatory prayer, and so he may
miss the reward of the nafilah.
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.12 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.411 • Jamal Al-Usbu’, Vol.1 p.369 • Al- Wafi, Vol.8 p.1104 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.87 p.25

Chapter Title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
arabic_text:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُحَمِّدِ بْنِ سِنَانِ عَنِ اِبْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَجْلاَنَ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلاَمُ : «إِذَا كُنْتَ شَاكَاً فِي الزَّوَالِ فَصَلَّ الرَّكْعَنَيْنِ وَ إِذَا اِسْتَيْقَنْتَ الزَّوَالَ فَصَلِّ الْفَرِيضَةَ».
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Said, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Ibn Muskan, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Ajlan, who said:
Abu Ja’far {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: “If you are uncertain about the sun's zenith,
then perform the two rak’ahs. But when you are certain that the sun has passed the
zenith, then perform the obligatory prayer.”
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.12 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.412 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1107 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.318 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.324

Chapter Title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
arabic_text:
وَ عَنَهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ وَ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ حُسَيْنٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرِ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي
أَنَّهُ سَأْلَهُ عَنِ الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ اللَّتَيْنِ عِنْدَ الزَّوَالِ يَوْمَ ٱلْجُمْعَةِ قَالَ فَقَالَ «أمّا أَنَا فَإِذَا زَالَتِ الشَّمْسُ بَدَأْتُ بِالْفَرِيضَةِ».
english_text:
From him, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Ibn Muskan, from Ibn Abi Umayr and Fadalah, from Husayn,
from Ibn Abi Umayr, who said:
He (Husayn) narrated to me (Ibn Abi Umayr) that he asked Imam {a.s} about the two
rak’ahs at the time of the sun's zenith on the day of Friday.
Imam {a.s} said: “As for me when the sun passes its zenith, I begin with the obligatory
prayer.”
source: Implicit (Muzmar)
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.12 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.412 • Al-Sarair, Vol.3 p.557 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1108 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.317 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.326 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.328 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.87 p.24

Chapter Title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
arabic_text:
اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ رِبْعِيِّ عَنْ سَمَاعَةً وَ الْحَسَنِ عَنْ زُرْعَةَ عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ قَالَ قَالَ: «وَقْتُ الظُهْرِ يَوْمَ
الْجُمُعَةً حِينَ تَزُولُ الشَّمْسُ ).
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Said from Hammad from Ribi from Sama’ah and al-Hasan from Zurah from Sama’ah, he said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “The time of Dhuhr on the day of Friday is when the sun passes
the meridian (zawal al-shams).”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.420 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.12 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1111 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.317 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.318

Chapter Title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
arabic_text:
وَعَنْهُ عَنِ النَّضْرِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللّهِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَلاَمُ قَالَ: «كَانَ رَسُولُ اللّهِ صَلَّى اللّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ
يُصَلِّي الْجُمُعَةَ جِينَ تَزُولُ الشَّمْسُ قَدْرَ شِرَاكِ وَ يَخْطُبُ فِي الظَّلَ الْأَوْلِ فَيَقُولُ جَبْرَئِيلُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ يَا مُحَمَّدُ
قَدْ زَالَتِ الشِّمْسُ فَانْزِلْ فَصَلّ وَ إِنَّمَا جُعِلَتِ الْجُمُعَةُ رَكْعَتَيْنِ مِنْ أَجْلِ الْخُطْبَتَيْنِ فَهِيَ صَلاَةً حَتَّى يَنْزِلَ الْإِمَامُ».
english_text:
And from him, from al-Nadr, from Abdillah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “The Messenger of Allah {SWT}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his
family, used to perform the Friday prayer (Salat Al Jumu'ah) when the sun had passed
the meridian by the measure of a sandal strap.
And He {saws} would deliver the sermon in the first shadow.
Then Jibra’il {a.s}, peace be upon him, would say: “O Muhammad {saws}, the sun has
passed the meridian, so descend and pray.”
And indeed, Friday was made two rak’ahs on account of the two sermons, for the
sermon is part of the prayer until the Imam descends.”
source: Abu al-Qasim Prophet Muhammad ibn Abdullah {saws} & Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.12 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1110 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.316

Chapter Title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
arabic_text:
وَعَنْهُ عَنِ النِّضْرِ عَنِ اِبْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَلاَمُ قَالَ قَالَ: «وَقْتُ صَلاَةِ الْجُمُعَةِ عِنْدَ ٱلزَّوَالِ وَ وَقْتُ
الْعَصْرٍ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ وَقْتُ صَلاَةِ الظُّهْرِ فِي غَيْرِ يَوْمِ الْجُمُعَةِ وَ يُسْتَحَبُّ التَّبْكِيرُ بِهَا».
english_text:
And from him, from al-Nadr, from Ibn Muskan, from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, he said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “The time of the Friday prayer (Salat Al Jumu'ah) is at the
meridian (zawal), and the time of Asr on the day of Friday is the same as the time of
Dhuhr on other than the day of Friday, and it is recommended to hasten to it (the Friday
prayer).”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.13 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1110 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.317

Chapter Title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
arabic_text: وَعَنْهُ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللّهِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَ قَالَ: «لاَ صَلاَةَ نِصْفَ النَّهَارِ إِلاَّ يَوْمَ ٱلْجُمُعَةِ».
english_text:
And from him, from Fadalah, from Abdillah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “There is no prayer at midday except on the day of Friday.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.13 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.412 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.350 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.317

Chapter Title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
arabic_text:
وَعَنْهُ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنِ اِبْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْخَالِقِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسِّلامُ عَنْ وَقْتِ
الظُهر فَقَالَ «بَعْدَ ٱلزَّوَالِ بِقَدَمٍ أَوْ نَحْوِ ذَلِكَ إِلاَّ فِي يَوْمِ ٱلْجُمُعَةِ أَوْ فِي السَّفَرِ فَإِنَّ وَقْتَهَا جِينَ تَزُولُ».
english_text:
And from him, from Safwan, from Ibn Muskan, from Ismail ibn Abd al-Khaliq, he said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, about the time of Dhuhr.
Imam {a.s} said: “After the meridian (zawal) by a footstep or something like that, except
on the day of Friday or while traveling, for its time is when the sun passes the
meridian.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.21 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.244 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.13 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.247 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.412 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.235 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.144 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.317

Chapter Title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
arabic_text:
وَعَنَهُ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ أُذَيْنَةَ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ يَقُولُ: «إِنَّ مِنَ ٱلْأُمُورِ
أُمُوراً مُضَيَّقَةً وَ أُمُوراً مُوَسِّعَةً وَ إِنَّ الْوَقْتَ وَقْتَانِ الصَّلاَةُ مِمَّا فِيهِ السِّعَةُ فَرُبَّمَا عَجَّلَ رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ
وَآلِهِ وَرُبَّمَا أَخْرَ إِلاَّ صَلاَةَ الْجُمُعَةِ فَإِنَّ صَلاَةَ ٱلْجُمُعَةِ مِنَ ٱلأَمْرِ ٱلْمُضَيَّقِ إِنَّمَا لَهَا وَقْتُ وَاحِدٌ جِينَ تَزُولُ وَ وَقْتُ
اَلْعَصْرِ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ وَقْتُ الظُّهْرِ فِي سَائِرِ الْأَيَّامِ».
وليس ينافي هذه الاخبار ما رواه:
english_text:
And from him, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Umar ibn Udhaynah, from Zurarah, he said:
I heard Abu Ja’far {a.s}, peace be upon him, say: “Indeed, among matters are those that
are restricted and those that are expansive, and indeed, time is of two types. Prayer is
among those matters in which there is flexibility.
So sometimes the Messenger of Allah {SWT}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his family,
would pray early, and sometimes He {saws} would delay except for the Friday prayer
(Salat Al Jumu'ah), for the Friday prayer (Salat Al Jumu'ah) is among the restricted
matters. It has only one time, which is when the sun passes the meridian (zawal), and
the time of Asr on the day of Friday is the same as the time of Dhuhr on the rest of the
days.”
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s} & Abu al-Qasim Prophet Muhammad ibn Abdullah {saws}
commentary: And these reports are not contradicted by what was narrated:
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.13 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1109 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.316

Chapter Title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
arabic_text:
اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ بُكَيْرٍ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ قَالَ: دَخَلْتُ عَلَى أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ فِي يَوْمِ جُمُعَةِ
وَ قَدْ صَلَّيْتُ الْجُمُعَةَ وَ الْعَصْرَ فَوَجَدْتُهُ قَدْ بَاهَى يَعْنِي مِنَ الْبَاهِ أَيْ جَامَعَ فَخَرَجَ إِلَيَّ فِي مِلْحَفَةٍ ثُمَّ دَعَا جَارِيَتَهُ
فَأَمَرَهَا أَنْ تَضَعَ لَهُ مَاءً تَصُبُّهُ عَلَيْهِ فَقُلْتُ لَهُ أَصْلَحَكَ اللَّهُ اِغْتَسَلْتَ فَقَالَ «مَا اِغْتَسَلْتُ بَعْدُ وَ لا صَلَّيْتُ» فَقُلْتُ لَهُ
قَدْ صَلَّيْنَا الظُهْرَ وَ الْعَصْرَ جَمِيعاً قَالَ «لا بَأْسَ».
الانه لا يمتنع تأخير الظهر عن وقت زوال الشمس إذا كان عذر، وإنما أو جبنا ذلك على من لا عذر له.
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Said from Safwan from Abdillah ibn Bukayr from Abu Basir, he said:
I entered upon Abu Abdillah {a.s} on a Friday, and I had already performed the Friday
prayer (Salat Al Jumu'ah) and the Asr prayer.
I found that Imam {a.s} had had intercourse. Imam {a.s} came out to me in a sheet, then
called his slave girl and ordered her to bring him water to pour over himself.
I asked Imam {a.s}: “May Allah {SWT} keep you well, have you not performed ghusl?”
Imam {a.s} said: “I have not performed ghusl yet, nor have I prayed.”
I asked Imam {a.s}: “I have already prayed Dhuhr and Asr together.”
Imam {a.s} said: “There is no problem in that.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
commentary:
Because it is not impermissible to delay Dhuhr beyond the time of the sun’s meridian
if there is an excuse; rather, we have only made it obligatory at that time for the one
who has no excuse.
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.13 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.412 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.288 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.321

Chapter Title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
arabic_text:
فَأَمَّا مَا رَوَاهُ الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ خَالِدِ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لأَبِي عَبْدِ
اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ أُقَدِّمُ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ شَيْئًا مِنَ الرَّكَعَاتِ قَالَ «نَعَمْ سِتَّ رَكَعَاتٍ» قُلْتُ فَأَيُّهُمَا أَفْضَلُ أُقَدِّمُ الرَّكَعَاتِ
- يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ أَمْ أُصَلَّيِهَا بَعدَ ٱلْفَرِيضَةِ قَالَ «تُصَلَّيهَا بَعْدَ ٱلْفَرِيضَةِ أَفْضَلُ».
فالمراد بهذا الحديث أن تأخير النوافل إذا زالت الشمس أفضل من تقديمها في يوم الجمعة، وليس كذلك في سائر الايام
لان سائر الايام إذا زالت الشمس الافضل أن يصلي الانسان السبحة ثم يصلي الفريضة وليس كذلك في يوم الجمعة ، لان
يوم الجمعة حين زالت الشمس فالبداية بالفريضة أفضل حسب ما قدمناه ، ولم يرد عليه السلام ان تأخيرها افضل عما قبل
الزوال على ما ظن بعض الناس.
english_text:
As for what was narrated by al-Husayn ibn Said from Muhammad ibn Sinan from Ibn Muskan from Sulayman
ibn Khalid, he said:
I said to Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him: “May I perform some rak’ahs on the day
of Friday beforehand?”
Imam {a.s} said: “Yes, six rak’ahs.”
I asked: “Which of the two is better, that I perform the rak’ahs on the day of Friday
beforehand, or that I pray them after the obligatory prayer?”
Imam {a.s} said: “Praying them after the obligatory prayer is better.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
commentary:
So what is meant by this narration is that delaying the nawafil (supererogatory prayers)
until after the sun has passed the meridian is better than performing them beforehand
on the day of Friday.
And it is not so for the rest of the days, because on the other days, when the sun passes
the meridian, it is better for a person to pray the supererogatory ‘subhah’ first and then
perform the obligatory prayer.
But this is not the case on the day of Friday, because on Friday, when the sun passes
the meridian, beginning with the obligatory prayer is better, as we have explained
earlier.
And Imam {a.s}, peace be upon him, did not mean that delaying them is better than
performing them before the meridian, as some people have assumed.
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.14 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.411 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1103 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.328

Chapter Title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنِ الْحَلَبِيّ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ
عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ عَنِ ٱلْقِرَاءَةِ فِي يَوْمِ الْجُمُعَةِ إِذَا صَلَّيْتُ وَحْدِي أَرْبَعا أَجْهَرُ بِالْقِرَاءَةِ فَقَالَ «نَعَمْ» وَ قَالَ «اِقْرَأْ بِسُورَةِ
اَلْجُمُعَةً وَ الْمُنَافِقِينَ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Yaqub from Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Ibn Abi Umayr from Hammad from al-
Halabi, he said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, about the recitation on the day of Friday
if I pray alone four rak’ahs, should I recite aloud?
Imam {a.s} said: “Yes,”
And Imam {a.s} said: “Recite Surah al-Jumu’ah and al-Munafiqun on the day of Friday.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.425 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.14 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.692 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1134 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.160 • Tafsir Nur Al-Thaqalayn, Vol.5 p.321 • Tafsir Kanz Al-Daqaiq, Vol.13 p.242

Chapter Title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
arabic_text:
سَعْدٌ عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ أَبِي الْخَطَابِ عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ بَشِيرٍ عَنْ حَمَادِ بْنِ عُثُمَانَ عَنْ عِمْرَانَ ٱلْحَلَبِيّ قَالَ
سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ يَقُولُ: وَ سُيْلَ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يُصَلِّي الْجُمُعَةَ أَرْبَعَ رَكَعَاتٍ أَيَجْهَرُ فِيهَا بِالْقِرَاءَةِ فَقَالَ
«نَعَمْ وَ الْقُنُوتُ فِي الثَّانِيَةِ».
english_text:
Sa’ad from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn ibn Abi al-Khattab from Ja’far ibn Bashir from Hammad ibn Uthman
from Imran al-Halabi, he said:
I heard Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, say and Imam {a.s} was asked about a man
who performs the Friday prayer as four rak’ahs, should he recite aloud in it?
Imam {a.s} said: “Yes, and the qunut is in the second rak’ah.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.14 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.416

Chapter Title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
arabic_text:
اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ النُّعْمَانِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنْ حَرِيزِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ عَنْ
أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: قَالَ لَنَا «صَلُوا فِي السَّفَرِ صَلاَةَ الْجُمُعَةِ جَمَاعَةً بِغَيْرِ خُطْبَةٍ وَ اِجْهَرُوا بِالْقِرَاءَةِ»
فَقُلْتُ إِنَّهُ يُنْكَرُ عَلَيْنَا الْجَهْرُ بِهَا فِي السَّفَرِ فَقَالَ «اِجْهَرُوا بِهَا».
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Said from Ali ibn al-Numan from Abdillah ibn Muskan from Hariz ibn Abdillah from
Muhammad ibn Muslim from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, he said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said to us: “Perform the Friday prayer (Salat Al Jumu'ah) in
congregation while traveling, without a sermon, and recite aloud.”
So I asked: “It is objected against us to recite aloud during travel.”
Imam {a.s} said: “Recite aloud.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.15 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.416 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.693 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.161

Chapter Title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
arabic_text:
وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنِ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللّهِ الْأَرّجَانِيّ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مَرْوَانَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱَلسَّلَاَمُ
عَنْ صَلَاَةِ الظُّهْرِ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ كَيْفَ نُصَلِّيهَا فِي السَّفَرِ فَقَالَ «تُصَلِّيهَا فِي السَّفَرِ رَكْعَتَيْنٍ وَ الْقِرَاءَةُ فِيهَا جَهْراً».
english_text:
And from him, from Fadalah, from al-Husayn ibn Abdillah al-Arrajani, from Muhammad ibn Marwan, he said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, about the Dhuhr prayer on the day of
Friday, how should we perform it while traveling?
Imam {a.s} said: “You perform it while traveling as two rak’ahs, and the recitation in it is
aloud.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.15 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.416 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.693 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.161

Chapter Title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
arabic_text:
فَأَمَّا مَا رَوَاهُ الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ جَمِيلٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ عَنِ ٱلْجَمَاعَةِ
يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ فِي السَّفَرِ فَقَالَ «تَصْنَعُونَ كَمَا تَصْنَعُونَ فِي غَيْرِ يَوْمِ ٱلْجُمُعَةِ فِي الظُهْرِ وَ لا يَجْهَرُ الْإِمَامُ إِنَّمَا يَجْهَدُ
إِذَا كَانَتْ خُطْبَةٌ».
english_text:
As for what was narrated by al-Husayn ibn Said from Ibn Abi Umayr from Jamil, he said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, about congregational prayer on the day
of Friday while traveling.
Imam {a.s} said: “You do as you would do on other than Friday for the Dhuhr prayer, and
the imam (of prayer) does not recite aloud, he only recites aloud if there is a sermon.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.15 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.416 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.693 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.161

Chapter Title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
arabic_text:
وَعَنْهُ عَنِ ٱلْعَلاَءِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ صَلاَةِ ٱلْجُمُعَةِ فِي السّفَرِ قَالَ «تَصْنَعُونَ كَمَا تَصْنَعُونَ فِي
الظُّهْرِ وَ لا يَجْهَرُ الْإِمَامُ فِيهَا بِالْقِرَاءَةٍ وَ إِنَّمَا يَجْهَرُ إِذَا كَانَتْ خُطْبَةٌ».
فالمراد بهذين الخبرين حال التقية والخوف لان الجماعة يوم الجمعة بغير خطبة مما يتقى فيه ، ومتى كان الحال حال
التقية لا يجمع ولا يجهر بالقراءة ، والذي يكشف عما ذكرناه ما رواه :
english_text:
And from him, from al-Ala, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, he said:
I asked Imam {a.s} about the Friday prayer (Salat Al Jumu'ah) while traveling.
Imam {a.s} said: “You do as you do for Dhuhr, and the imam (of prayer) does not recite
aloud in it. He only recites aloud if there is a sermon.”
source: Implicit (Muzmar)
commentary:
So what is meant by these two reports is the state of taqiyyah (precautionary
dissimulation) and fear, because holding congregational prayer on the day of Friday
without a sermon is among those things for which precaution is taken.
And whenever the situation is one of taqiyyah, then neither the Friday congregational
prayer is held nor is the recitation done aloud. What clarifies what we have mentioned
is that which was narrated:
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.15 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.416 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.162

Chapter Title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
arabic_text:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ بُكَيْرٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ عَنْ قَوْمٍ فِي قَرْيَةٍ لَيْسَ
لَهُمْ مَنْ يُجَمِّعُ بِهِمْ أَيُصَلُونَ الظُّهْرَ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ فِي جَمَاعَةٍ قَالَ «نَعَمْ إِذَا لَمْ يَخَافُوا».
فصرح ع في هذا الخبر أن الجمعة إنما تجوز إذا لم يكن الحال حال التقية، فاما القنوت يوم الجمعة فان صلى الانسان في
جماعة يقنت في الركعة الاولى قبل الركوع وفي الثانية بعد الركوع، فإذا صلى على الانفراد يقنت في الثانية قبل الركوع.
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Said from Safwan from Abdillah ibn Bukayr, he said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, about a group of people in a village who
do not have anyone to lead the Friday prayer for them, should they perform the Dhuhr
prayer in congregation on the day of Friday?
Imam {a.s} said: “Yes, if they are not in fear.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
commentary:
So Imam {a.s}, peace be upon him, explicitly stated in this report that the Friday prayer
is only permissible when the situation is not one of taqiyyah (precautionary
dissimulation).
As for the qunut on the day of Friday, if a person prays in congregation, he performs
qunut in the first rak’ah before rukuh, and in the second rak’ah after ruku.
But if he prays alone, he performs qunut in the second rak’ah before ruku.
references: Qurb Al-Isnad, Vol.1 p.169 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.15 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.417 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1122 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.327

Chapter Title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
arabic_text:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ فَضَالَةً عَنْ حُسَيْنٍ عَنْ أَبِي أَيُوبَ إبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ خَالِدٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ
عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ وَ صَفْوَانَ عَنْ أَبِي أَيُوبَ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ خَالِدِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: «الْقُنُوتُ
يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ فِي الرَّكْعَةِ الْأُولَى».
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Said from Fadalah from Husayn from Abu Ayyub Ibrahim ibn Isa from Sulayman ibn Khalid
from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, and Safwan from Abu Ayyub, he said: Sulayman ibn Khalid
narrated to me from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, he said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “Qunut on the day of Friday is in the first rak’ah.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.16 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.417 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1142 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.271

Chapter Title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
arabic_text:
وَعَثَهُ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ أَبَانٍ عَنْ إسْمَاعِيلَ ٱلْجُعْفِيّ عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ حَثْظَلَةَ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلَامُ ٱلْقُنُوتُ
يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ فَقَالَ «أَنْتَ رَسُولِي إِلَيْهِمْ فِي هَذَا إِذَا صَلِّيْثُمْ فِي جَمَاعَةٍ فَفِي الرَّكْعَةِ ٱلْأُولَى وَ إِذَا صَلِّيْثُمْ وُحْدَاناً
فَفِي الرَّكْعَةِ الثَّانِيَةِ».
english_text:
And from him, from Fadalah, from Aban, from Ismail al-Jufi, from Umar ibn Hanzalah, he said:
I said to Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him: “(What about) the qunut on the day of
Friday?”
Imam {a.s} said: “You are my messenger to them in this matter, if you pray in
congregation, then it is in the first rak’ah; and if you pray individually, then it is in the
second rak’ah.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.427 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.16 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.417 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1142 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.271

Chapter Title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
arabic_text: وَعَنْهُ عَنِ ٱلْحَسَنِ عَنْ زُرْعَةَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ قَالَ: «آلْقُنُوتُ فِي الرَّكْعَةِ الْأُولَى قَبْلَ الرُكُوعِ».
english_text:
And from him, from al-Hasan, from Zurah ibn Muhammad, from Abu Basir, he said:
He said: “Qunut is in the first rak’ah before ruku.”
source: Implicit (Muzmar)
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.16 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.417 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1143 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.271

Chapter Title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَامِرٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَهْزِيَارَ عَنْ فَضَالَةً بْنِ أَيُوبَ عَنْ
مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ عَمَّارِ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ يَقُولُ: («فِي قُنُوتِ ٱلْجُمُعَةِ إِذَا كَانَ إمَاما قَنَتَ فِي الرَّكْعَةِ
الْأُولَى وَ إِنْ كَانَ يُصَلِّي أَرْبَعاً فَفِي الرَّكْعَةِ الثَّانِيَةِ قَبْلَ الرُّكُوعِ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Yaqub from al-Husayn ibn Muhammad from Abdillah ibn Amir from Ali ibn Mahziyar from
Fadalah ibn Ayyub from Muawiyah ibn Ammar, he said:
I heard Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, say: “In the qunut of Friday, if he is the
imam, he performs qunut in the first rak’ah. But if he is praying four rak’ahs, then in the
second rak’ah, before ruku.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.427 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.16 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.417

Chapter Title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
arabic_text:
فَأَمّا مَا رَوَاهُ الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُحَمّدِ بْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ جَمِيلٍ بْنِ صَالِحِ عَنْ عَبْدِ ٱلْمَلِكِ بْنِ عَمْرِو قَالَ: قُلْتُ
الأَبِي عَبْدِ اللهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قُنُوتُ الْجُمُعَةِ فِي الرَّكْعَةِ الْأَولَى قَبْلَ الرُّكُوعِ وَ فِي الثَّانِيَةِ بَعْدَهُ فَقَالَ لِي «لا قَبْلُ وَ
لا بَعْدُ».
english_text:
As for what was narrated by al-Husayn ibn Said from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr from Jamil ibn Salih from
Abd al-Malik ibn Amr, he said:
I said to Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him: “The qunut of Jumu‘ah, should it be in
