source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.466 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.173 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.441

Chapter Title: THE PRAYER DURING PURSUIT AND SWORD FIGHTING
arabic_text:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ أُدَيْنَةَ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ وَ فُضَيْلٍ وَ مُحَمِّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «فِي صَلاَةِ ٱلْخَوْفِ عِنْدَ ٱلْمُطَارَدَةِ وَ ٱلْمُنَاوَشَةِ وَ تَلاَحُمِ ٱلْقِتَالِ فَإِنَّهُ يُصَلِّي كُلُّ إِنْسَانٍ مِنْهُمْ بِالْإِيمَاءِ
حَيْثُ كَانَ وَجْهُهُ فَإِذَا كَانَتِ ٱلْمُسَايَفَةُ وَ ٱلْمُعَانَقَةُ وَ تَلاَحُمُ ٱلْقِتَالِ فَإِنَّ أَمِيرَ ٱلْمُوْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ لَيْلَةَ صِفِّينَ وَ
هِيَ لَيْلَةُ ٱلْهَرِيرِ لَمْ يَكُنْ صَلَّى بِهِمُ ٱلظُهْرَ وَ ٱلْعَصْرَ وَ ٱلْمَغْرِبَ وَ الْعِشَاءَ عِنْدَ وَقْتِ كُلِّ صَلاّةِ إِلاَّ بِالتَّكْبِيرِ وَ التَّهْلِيلِ
وَ اَلتَّسْبِيحِ وَ التَّمْجِيدِ وَ الدُّعَاءِ فَكَانَتْ تِلْكَ صَلاَتَهُمْ وَ لَمْ يَأْمُرْهُمْ بِإِعَادَةِ الصَّلاةِ».
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa’id from Ibn Abi ‘Umayr from Umar ibn Udhaynah from Zurarah, Fudayl, and Muhammad
ibn Muslim from Abu Ja’far {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Baqir {a.s} said: “In the prayer of ‘al Khawf’ (prayer of fear) during pursuit,
skirmishes, and the intensification of fighting, each person among them should pray
by gesturing, wherever his face is.
But when there is close combat, grappling, and intense fighting, then indeed the
Commander of the Faithful {a.s}, peace be upon him, on the night of Siffin and it was the
night of al-Harir, had not led them in Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib, and Isha at the time of each
prayer; except with takbir (‘Allahu Akbar’), tahlil (‘La ilaha illa Allah’), tasbih
(‘SubhanAllah’), tamjid (‘Al-hamdu lillah’), and supplication.
So that was their prayer, and Imam Ali {a.s} did not command them to make up the
prayer.”
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s} & Amir al-Mu’minin Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib al- Murtadha {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.457 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.173 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1068 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.445 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.3 2 p.605

Chapter Title: THE PRAYER DURING PURSUIT AND SWORD FIGHTING
arabic_text:
وَ عَنْهُ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ عَنْ زُرْعَةَ عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ صَلاَةِ ٱلْقِتَالِ فَقَالَ «إِذَا اِلْتَقَوْا فَاقْتَتَلُوا فَإِنَّمَا الصَّلاَةُ
جينَئِذٍ بِالتَكْبِيرٍ وَ إِذَا كَانُوا وُقُوفا فَالصَّلاَةُ إِيمَاءَ».
english_text:
And from him, from al-Hasan, from Zur’ah, from Sama’ah. He said:
I asked Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} about the prayer during combat.
Imam {a.s} said: “When they meet and engage in fighting, then at that time, the prayer is
only with takbir. And if they are standing still, then the prayer is by gesturing.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.174

Chapter Title: THE PRAYER DURING PURSUIT AND SWORD FIGHTING
arabic_text:
عَبْدِ
سَعدٌ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ الْحَلَبِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي
اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ قَالَ: «صَلَاَةُ الزَّحْفِ عَلَى الظَّهْرِ إِيمَاءُ بِرَأْسِكَ وَ تَكْبِيرٌ وَ الْمُسَايَفَةُ تَكْبِيرٌ مَعَ إِيمَاءِ وَ الْمُطَارَدَةُ
إِيمَاءُ يُصَلِّي كُلُّ رَجُلٍ عَلَى جِيَالِهِ».
english_text:
Sadd from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Abi ‘Umayr from Hammad ibn Uthman from
Ubaydullah ibn Ali al-Halabi from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “The prayer during a march (of war), is performed at noon with
gesturing by your head and with takbir,
And during sword fighting, it is with takbir along with gesturing,
And during pursuit it is by gesturing each man prays individually in his position.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.466 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.174 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1069 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.443 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.86 p.110

Chapter Title: THE PRAYER DURING PURSUIT AND SWORD FIGHTING
arabic_text:
وَ عَنَهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللّهِ بْنِ ٱلْمُغِيرَةِ وَ أَيُوبَ بْنِ نُوحِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللّهِ بْنِ ٱلْمُغِيرَةِ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي
بَعْض أَصْحَابِنَّا عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلامُ قَالَ: «أَقَلُ مَا يُجْزِي فِي حَدّ ٱلْمُسَايَفَةِ مِنَ التَّكْبِيرِ تَكْبِيرَتَانِ لِكُلِّ
صَلاَةٍ إِلاَّ صَلاَةَ ٱلْمَعْرِبِ فَإِنَّ لَهَا ثَلاَثا».
١٤ - باب صلاة الغريق والمتوحد والمضطر بغير ذلك
قال الشيخ رحمه اللّه : ويصلي السابح في الماء عند غرقه أو ضرورته إلى السباحة مؤميا إلى القبلة ان عرفها ، وإلا ففي
وجهه ويكون ركوعه اخفض من سجوده لان الركوع انخفاض منه والسجود إيماء إلى القبلة وكذلك صلاة المتوحل.
english_text:
And from him, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from his father from Abdillah ibn al-Mughirah, and from Ayyub
ibn Nuh from Abdillah ibn al-Mughirah. He said: One of our companions narrated to me from Abu Abdillah
{a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “The minimum that suffices in the case of close combat
(musayafah), in terms of takbir, is two takbirs for each prayer except for the Maghrib
prayer, for it requires three.”
OTHER SUCH CASES
IS ALONE, AND THE ONE IN NECESSITY, AND OTHER SUCH CASES
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
commentary:
Shaykh (Al-Mufid), may Allah {SWT} have mercy on him, said: “The one swimming in
water, at the time of drowning or due to necessity of swimming, should pray by
gesturing toward qibla if he knows its direction; otherwise, in the direction of his face.
His bowing should be lower than his prostration, because bowing is a form of lowering,
and prostration is gesturing toward qibla. And likewise is prayer of one stuck in mud.”.
-----
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.467 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.174 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.444

Chapter Title: THE PRAYER OF THE DROWNING PERSON, THE ONE WHO
arabic_text:
مُحَمِّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ هِلاَلٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرِ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ :
«مَنْ كَانَ فِي مَكَانٍ لاَ يَقْدِرُ عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَلْيُومِ إِيمَاءَ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya from Ahmad ibn Hilal from Ibn Muskan from Abu Basir. He said:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: “Whoever is in a place where he is unable
to reach the ground, should gesture with indications.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.175 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.141 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.450

Chapter Title: THE PRAYER OF THE DROWNING PERSON, THE ONE WHO
arabic_text:
سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُصَدَّقٍ بْنِ صَدَقَةَ عَنْ عَمَّارِ بْنِ
مُوسَى عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يُومِ فِي الْمَكْتُوبَةِ وَ النَّوَافِلِ إِذَا لَمْ يَجِدْ مَا يَسْجُدَ
عَلَيْهِ وَ لَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ مَوْضِعْ يَسْجُدُ فِيهِ فَقَالَ «إِذَا كَانَ هَكَذَا قَلْيُومِ فِي الصَّلاَةِ كُلِّهَا».
english_text:
Sa’ad ibn Abdillah from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal from Amr ibn Said from Musaddiq ibn
Sadaqah from Ammar ibn Musa from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him. He said:
I asked Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} about a man who gestures in the obligatory and
supererogatory prayers, when he does not find anything to prostrate upon and does
not have a place in which he can perform prostration.
Imam {a.s} said: “If it is like that, then let him gesture throughout the entire prayer.”
OTHER SUCH CASES
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.175 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.141 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.450

Chapter Title: THE PRAYER OF THE DROWNING PERSON, THE ONE WHO IS ALONE, AND THE ONE IN NECESSITY, AND
arabic_text:
وَ بِهَذَا الْإِسْنَادِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يُصِيبْهُ ٱلْمَطَرُ وَ هُوَ فِي مَوْضِعٍ لا يَقْدِرُ أَنْ يَسْجُدَ فِيهِ
مِنَ الطَّينِ وَ لاَ يَجِدُ مَوْضِعاً جَافّاً قَالَ «يَفْتَتِحُ الصَّلاَةَ فَإِذَا رَكَعَ فَلْيَرْكَعْ كَمَا يَرْكَعُ إِذَا صَلَّى وَ إِذَا رَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ مِنَ
الرُّكُوعِ فَلْيُومِ بِالسُّجُودِ إِيمَاءً وَ هُوَ قَائِمٌ يَفْعَلُ ذَلِكَ حَتَّى يَفْرُغَ مِنَ الصَّلاَةِ وَ يَتَشَهَدُ وَ هُوَ قَائِمٌ وَ يُسَلَّمُ».
قال الشيخ رحمه اللّٰه : وإذا كان ممنوعا بالرباط وما أشبهه صلى بحسب استطاعته.
english_text:
And with this same chain of transmission, from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, he said:
I asked Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} about a man who is caught in the rain, while in a place where
he is unable to prostrate, due to mud and does not find a dry spot.
Imam {a.s} said: “He should begin the prayer, and when he bows, let him bow as he
would normally do in prayer.
And when he raises his head from the bowing, let him gesture for the prostration while
standing. He should continue in this manner until he completes the prayer, perform
the tashahhud while standing, and give the salam.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
commentary:
Shaykh (Al-Mufid), may Allah {SWT} have mercy on him, said: “And if he is restrained by
shackles or something similar, he should pray according to his ability.”
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.175 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1051 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.142

Chapter Title: THE PRAYER OF THE DROWNING PERSON, THE ONE WHO IS ALONE, AND THE ONE IN NECESSITY, AND
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عِدَّةٍ مِنْ أَصْحَابِنَا عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ زُرْعَةَ عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ
عَنِ الْأَسِيرِ يَأْسِرُهُ الْمُشْرِكُونَ فَتَحْضُرُهُ الصَّلاةُ فَيَمْنَعُهُ الَّذِي أَسَرَهُ مِنْهَا قَالَ «يُومِنُ إِيمَاءَ».
قال الشيخ رحمه اللّٰه : والمريض يصلي قائما مع قدرته. إلى قوله : ويكره.
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ya‘qub from a group of our companions from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid from his
father from Zur’ah from Sama’ah. He said:
I asked Imam {a.s} about a prisoner taken captive by the polytheists, and the time of
prayer comes, while the one who captured him, prevents him from performing it.
Imam {a.s} said: “He should gesture with indications.”
OTHER SUCH CASES
source: Implicit (Muzmar)
commentary:
Shaykh (Al-Mufid), may Allah {SWT} have mercy on him, said: “And the sick person prays
standing if he is able,” up to his statement: “and it is disliked.”
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.411 • Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.457 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.246 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.175 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.299 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1071 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.448

Chapter Title: THE PRAYER OF THE DROWNING PERSON, THE ONE WHO IS ALONE, AND THE ONE IN NECESSITY, AND
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدِ عَنْ مُصَدِّقِ بْنِ صَدَقَةَ عَنْ عَمَّارٍ عَنْ
أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ قَالَ: «الْمَرِيضُ إِذَا لَمْ يَقْدِرْ أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ قَاعِداً كَيْفَ قَدَرَ صَلَّى إِمَّا أَنْ يُوَجِّهَ فَيُومِئُ إِيمَاءَ»
وَ قَالَ «يُوَجَّهُ كَمَا يُوَجَّهُ الرَّجُلُ فِي لَحْدِهِ وَ يَنَامُ عَلَى جَنْبِهِ الْأَيْمَنِ ثُمَّ يُومِئُ بِالصَّلاَةِ فَإِنْ لَمْ يَقْدِرْ أَنْ يَنَامَ عَلَى
جَنْبِهِ الْأَيْمَنِ فَكَيْفَ مَا قَدَرَ فَإِنَّهُ لَهُ جَائِزٌ وَ يَسْتَقْبِلُ بِوَجْهِهِ الْقِبْلَةَ ثُمَّ يُومِئُ بِالصَّلاَةِ إِيمَاءَ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ali from Amr ibn Said from Musaddiq ibn
Sadaqah from Ammar from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “If the sick person is unable to pray sitting, then he should pray
however he is able, either by being positioned and gesturing with indications.” And
Imam {a.s} said: “He should be positioned as a man is positioned in his grave, and lie on
his right side, then gesture for the prayer.
If he is unable to lie on his right side, then however he is able, it is permissible for him.
He should face the qibla with his face, then gesture for the prayer by indication.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.175 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1043 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.483 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.81 p.337

Chapter Title: THE PRAYER OF THE DROWNING PERSON, THE ONE WHO IS ALONE, AND THE ONE IN NECESSITY, AND
arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَمَّنْ حَدَّتَهُ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ
عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: «يُصَلِّي الْمَرِيضُ قَائِماً فَإِنْ لَمْ يَقْدِرْ عَلَى ذَلِكَ صَلَّى جَالِساً فَإِنْ لَمْ يَقْدِرْ عَلَى ذَلِكَ صَلَّى مُسْتَلْقِياً
يُكَبِّرُ ثُمَّ يَقْرَأْ فَإِذَا أَرَادَ الرُّكُوعَ غَمَّضَ عَيْنَيْهِ ثُمَّ يُسَبِّحُ فَإِذَا سَبَّحَ فَتَحَ عَيْنَيْهِ فَيَكُونُ فَتَحُهُ عَيْنَيْهِ رَفْعَهُ رَأْسَهُ مِنَ
الرُّكُوعِ فَإِذَا أَرَادَ أَنْ يَسْجُدَ غَمَضَ عَيْنَيْهِ ثُمَّ يُسَبِّحُ فَإِذَا سَبَّحَ فَتَحَ عَيْنَيْهِ فَيَكُونُ فَتَحُهُ عَيْنَيْهِ رَفْعَهُ رَأْسَهُ مِنَ
السُجُودِ ثُمَّ يَتَشَهَّدُ وَ يَنْصَرِفُ».
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Abdillah ibn al-Qasim from Amr ibn Uthman from Muhammad ibn Ibrahim from
someone who narrated to him from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “The sick person prays standing, and if he is unable to do that,
he prays sitting.
If he is unable to do that, he prays lying on his back he pronounces the takbir, then
recites. When he wishes to bow, he closes his eyes, then glorifies (‘SubhanAllah’).
When he has glorified, he opens his eyes, and the opening of his eyes is considered
his rising from bowing.
When he wishes to prostrate, he closes his eyes, then glorifies. When he has glorified,
he opens his eyes, and the opening of his eyes is considered his rising from
prostration. Then he recites the tashahhud and ends the prayer.”
OTHER SUCH CASES
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.411 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.361 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.176 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1039 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.484 • Tafsir Nur Al-Thaqalayn, Vol.1 p.545 • Tafsir Kanz Al-Daqaiq, Vol.3 p.529

Chapter Title: THE PRAYER OF THE DROWNING PERSON, THE ONE WHO IS ALONE, AND THE ONE IN NECESSITY, AND
arabic_text:
وَ عَنْهُ عَنِ النَّضْرِ عَنِ اِبْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «لا ثُمْسِكْ بِخَمَرِكَ وَ أَنْتَ تُصَلِّي وَ لا تَسْتَنِذْ
إلَى جِدَارٍ إِلَّ أَنْ تَكُونَ مَرِيضاً».
english_text:
And from him, from al-Nadr from Ibn Sinan from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “Do not hold your turban while you are praying, and do not lean
against a wall unless you are ill.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.176 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.900 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.500

Chapter Title: THE PRAYER OF THE DROWNING PERSON, THE ONE WHO IS ALONE, AND THE ONE IN NECESSITY, AND
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْجَبَارِ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَهْزِيَارَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ ٱلْمُغْمَى عَلَيْهِ يَوْماً أَوْ
أَكْثَرَ مِنْ ذَلِكَ هَلْ يَقْضِي مَا فَانَهُ مِنَ الصَّلاةِ فَكَتَبَ «لا يَقْضِي الصَّوْمَ وَ لا يَقْضِي الصَّلاةَ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Jabbar from Ali ibn Mahziyar. He said:
I asked Imam al-Hadi {a.s} about a person who falls unconscious for a day or more than
that, does he make up the prayers he missed?
Imam {a.s} wrote: “He does not make up the fasts, nor does he make up the prayers.”
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Ali ibn Muhammad al-Hadi {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.176 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.4 p.243 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.262

Chapter Title: THE PRAYER OF THE DROWNING PERSON, THE ONE WHO IS ALONE, AND THE ONE IN NECESSITY, AND
arabic_text:
مُحَمِّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيَّ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ ٱلْحَسَنِ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ أَبِي حَمْرَةَ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ : فِي قَوْلٍ
اللّه عَزّ وَ جَلَّ «آَلَّذِينَ يَذْكُرُونَ اللهَ قِياما» قَالَ «الصَّجِيحُ يُصَلِّي قَائِماً «وَقُعُوداً» الْمَرِيضُ يُصَلِّي جَالِساً «وَ عَلى
جُنُوبِهم» اَلَّذِي يَكُونْ أَضْعَفَ مِنَ ٱلْمَرِيضِ الَّذِي يُصَلِّي جَالِساً».
قال الشيخ رحمه الله : ويكره له وضع الجبهة على سجادة يمسكها غيره ومروحة.
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ya‘qub by Ali from his father from al-Hasan ibn Mahbub from Abu Hamzah by Abu Ja’far {a.s}:
Imam al-Baqir {a.s} was asked regarding the saying of Allah {SWT}, the Mighty and Majestic:
“Those who remember Allah {SWT} standing” (Surah Aal Imran 3:191)
Imam {a.s} said: “The healthy one prays ‘standing’. ‘And sitting’ (Surah Aal Imran 3:191),
for the sick person prays sitting. ‘And on their sides’ (Surah Aal Imran 3:191), for the
one who is weaker than the sick person who prays sitting.”
OTHER SUCH CASES
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
commentary:
Shaykh (Al-Mufid), may Allah {SWT} have mercy on him, said: “And it is disliked for him to
place his forehead on a prayer mat held by someone else, or on a fan.”
references: Tafsir Al-’Ayyashi, Vol.1 p.211 • Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.411 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.169 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.176 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1040 • Tafsir Al-Safi, Vol.1 p.408 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.481 • Tafsir Al-Burhan, Vol.1 p.726 • Tafsir Al-Burhan, Vol.1 p.729 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.6 6 p.349

Chapter Title: THE PRAYER OF THE DROWNING PERSON, THE ONE WHO IS ALONE, AND THE ONE IN NECESSITY, AND
arabic_text:
اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ حُسَيْنٍ عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ ٱلْمَرِيضِ هَلْ ثُمْسِكُ لَهُ ٱلْمَرْأَةُ
شَيْئاً يَسْجُدُ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالَ «لا إِلاَّ أَنْ يَكُونَ مُضْطَرَاً لَيْسَ عِنْدَهُ غَيْرُهَا وَ لَيْسَ شَيْءُ مِمَّا حَرَّمَ آللَّهُ إِلا وَ قَدْ أَحَلْهُ لِمَنِ
أضْطُرَ إِلَيْهِ».
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Said from Fadalah from Husayn from Sama’ah from Abu Basir. He said:
I asked Imam {a.s} about a sick person, can a woman hold something for him to
prostrate upon?
Imam {a.s} said: “No, unless he is in a state of necessity, having no one else with him
and nothing else available. There is nothing that Allah {SWT} has forbidden except that
He {AZJ} has made it permissible, for the one who is compelled to it.”
source: Implicit (Muzmar)
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.177 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1044 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.483 • Al- Fusul Al-Muhimmah, Vol.1 p.621

Chapter Title: THE PRAYER OF THE DROWNING PERSON, THE ONE WHO IS ALONE, AND THE ONE IN NECESSITY, AND
arabic_text:
وَ عَنْهُ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ أَذَيْنَةَ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ الْمَرِيضِ قَالَ
«يَسْجُدُ عَلَى الْأَرْضِ أَوْ عَلَى مِرْوَحَةٍ أَوْ عَلَى سِوَاكٍ يَرْفَعُهُ هُوَ أَفْضَلُ مِنَ الإيمَاءِ إِنَّمَا كَرِهَ مَنْ كَرِهَ السُّجُودَ عَلَى
الْمِرْوَحَة مِنْ أَجْلِ الْأَوْثَانِ الَّتِي كَانَتْ تُعْبَدُ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ وَ إِنَّا لَمْ نَعْبُدْ غَيْرَ اللَّهِ قَطْ فَاسْجُدْ عَلَى الْمِرْوَحَةِ أَوْ عَلَى
سِوَاكٍ أَو عَلَى عُودٍ».
english_text:
And from him, from Ibn Abi Umayr from Umar ibn Udhaynah from Zurarah from Abu Ja’far {a.s}, peace be upon
him. He said:
I asked Imam al-Baqir {a.s} about the (prayer of a) sick person.
Imam {a.s} said: “He should prostrate on the ground, or on a fan, or on a tooth-stick
(siwak), something he raises up that is better than gesturing.
Those who disliked prostration on a fan, only disliked it because of the idols that used
to be worshipped besides Allah {SWT}.
And we have never worshipped anyone other than Allah {SWT}, ever. So prostrate on a
fan, or on a tooth-stick, or on a piece of wood.”
OTHER SUCH CASES
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.311 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.177 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.745

Chapter Title: THE PRAYER OF THE DROWNING PERSON, THE ONE WHO IS ALONE, AND THE ONE IN NECESSITY, AND
arabic_text:
وَ عَنْهُ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ أُذَيْنَةَ عَمَّنُ أَخْبَرَهُ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ : أَنَّهُ سُيْلَ مَا حَدُ ٱلْمَرَضِ الَّذِي
يُضْطَرُ صَاحِبُهُ وَ ٱلْمَرَضِ الّذِي يَدَعُ صَاحِبُهُ فِيهِ الصَّلاَةَ قَائِما قَالَ « «بَلِ ٱلْإِنْسَانُ عَلىٰ نَفْسِهِ بَصِيرَةُ» قَالَ ذَاكَ
إِلَيْهِ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِنَفْسِهِ».
english_text:
And from him, from Ibn Abi Umayr from Umar ibn Udhaynah from someone who informed him from Abu
Ja’far {a.s}, peace be upon him:
Imam al-Baqir {a.s} was asked: “What is the degree of illness that compels its sufferer,
and what is the illness in which its sufferer should leave off praying while standing?”
Imam {a.s} said: “Rather, man is a witness against himself.” (Surah Al Qiyamah 75:14)
Imam {a.s} said: “That is up to him, he is more knowledgeable about himself.”
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.177 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1044

Chapter Title: THE PRAYER OF THE DROWNING PERSON, THE ONE WHO IS ALONE, AND THE ONE IN NECESSITY, AND
arabic_text:
وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ بْنِ أَيُوبَ عَنْ جَمِيلٍ وَ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ جَمِيلٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ مَا حَدْ
الْمَرَضِ الَّذِي يُصَلِّي صَاحِبُهُ قَاعِداً فَقَالَ «إِنَّ الرَّجُلَ لَيُوعَكُ وَ يُجْرَحُ وَ لَكِنَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِنَفْسِهِ إِذَا قَوِيَ فَليَقُمْ».
١٨٨٢٧ /٦٩
english_text:
And from him, from Fadalah ibn Ayyub from Jamil, and from Ibn Abi Umayr from Jamil. He said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him: “What is the degree of illness for which a
person should pray sitting?”
Imam {a.s} said: “Indeed, a man may suffer fever or be wounded, but he knows himself
best. If he has the strength, then let him stand (for prayer).”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.177

Chapter Title: THE PRAYER OF THE DROWNING PERSON, THE ONE WHO IS ALONE, AND THE ONE IN NECESSITY, AND
arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ عَنْ سَيْفٍ عَنْ بَكَارِ قَالَ: سَأَلَهُ أَبِي يَعْنِي أَبَا عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ وَ أَنَا أَسْمَعُ
مَا حَدُّ الْمَرَضِ الَّذِي يُثْرَكُ فِيهِ الصَّوْمُ قَالَ «إِذَا لَمْ يَسْتَطِعْ أَنْ يَتَسَحِّرَ».
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn al-Hakam from Sayf from Bakkar. He said:
My father, spoke to Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, and asked Imam {a.s} while I
(Bakkar) was listening:
“What is the degree of illness in which fasting is to be abandoned?”
Imam {a.s} said: “When he is unable to partake in the pre-dawn meal (suhur).”
OTHER SUCH CASES
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.4 p.118 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.178 • Al-Wafi, Vol.11 p.300 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.10 p.221

Chapter Title: THE PRAYER OF THE DROWNING PERSON, THE ONE WHO IS ALONE, AND THE ONE IN NECESSITY, AND
arabic_text:
الصِّفَّارُ عَنْ مُحَمّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ حَفْص الْمَرْوَزِيّ قَالَ قَالَ ٱلْفَقِيهُ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ : «الْمَرِيضُ إِنَّمَا يُصَلَّي
قَاعِداً إِذَا صَارَ بِالْحَالِ آلَّتِي لا يَقْدِرُ فِيهَا أَنْ يَمْشِيَ مِقْدَارَ صَلاتِهِ إِلَى أَنْ يَفْرُغَ قَائِماً».
١٥ - باب صلاة العراة
english_text:
Al-Saffar from Muhammad ibn Isa from Sulayman ibn Hafs al-Marwazi. He said:
The Jurist (Faqih), Imam al-Hadi {a.s}, peace be upon him, said:
“The sick person is to pray sitting only when he reaches the condition, in which he is
unable to walk the length of his prayer, from beginning to end while standing.”
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Ali ibn Muhammad al-Hadi {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.178 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.4 p.257 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.2 p.114 • Awali Al-La’ali, Vol.3 p.82 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1044 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.495 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.81 p.335

arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لأَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلَاَمُ
رَجُلُ خَرَجَ مِنْ سَفِينَةِ عُزْيَاناً أَوْ سُلِبَ ثِيَابُهُ وَ لَمْ يَجِدْ شَيْئاً يُصَلِّي فِيهِ فَقَالَ «يُصَلِّي إيمَاءً وَ إِنْ كَانَتِ اِمْرَأَةً
جَعَلَتْ يَدَهَا عَلَى فَرْجِهَا وَ إِنْ كَانَ رَجْلاً وَضَعَ يَدَهُ عَلَى سَوْأَتِهِ ثُمَّ يَجْلِسَانِ فَيُومِيَانِ إِيمَاءً وَ لاَ يَرْكَعَانٍ وَ لاَ
يَسْجُدَانٍ فَيَنْدُوَ مَا خَلْفَهُمَا تَكُونُ صَلاَتُهُمَا إِيمَاءً بِرُءُوسِهِمَا» قَالَ «وَ إِنْ كَانَا فِي مَاءِ أَوْ بَحْرٍ لُجَيٍّ لَمْ يَسْجُدَا عَلَيْهِ
وَ مَوْضُوعٌ عَنْهُمَا التَّوَجُّهُ فِيهِ يُومِيَانٍ فِي ذَلِكَ إِيمَاءً رَفْعُهُمَا تَوَجُّهُ وَ وَضْعُهُمَا».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ya‘qub from Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Hammad from Hariz from Zurarah. He said:
I said to Abu Ja’far {a.s}: “A man comes out of a ship naked, or his clothes have been
taken from him, and he does not find anything to pray in, what should he do?”
Imam {a.s} said: “He should pray by gesturing. If it is a woman, she should place her
hand over her private part, and if it is a man, he should place his hand over his private
part. Then they should both sit and gesture with indications.
They should neither bow nor prostrate, as what is behind them (anus) would become
exposed. Their prayer should be by gesturing with their heads.”
Imam {a.s} said: “And if they are in water or in a deep sea, they should not prostrate in it,
and the requirement of facing the qibla is lifted from them in that case.
They should gesture therein with indications, their lifting is counted as turning toward
the qibla, and their lowering (is considered) likewise.”
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.396 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.364 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.178 • Al- Wafi, Vol.7 p.437 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.449

arabic_text:
سَعْدٌ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ النَّضْرِ بْنِ سُوَيْدٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللّهِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَ قَالَ:
سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ قَوْمِ صَلَّوْا جَمَاعَةً وَ هُمْ عُرَاةً قَالَ «يَتَقَدَّمُهُمُ الْإِمَامُ بِرُكْبَتَيْهِ وَ يُصَلِّي بِهِمْ جُلُوساً وَ هُوَ جَالِسٌ».
english_text:
Sa’ad from Abu Ja’far from al-Husayn ibn Said from al-Nadr ibn Suwayd from Abdillah ibn Sinan from Abu
Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} about a group of people who prayed in congregation, while
they were naked.
Imam {a.s} said: “The imam (of prayer) should go before them on his knees and lead
them in prayer sitting, while he is also sitting.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.365 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.178 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.439 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.450

arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَيُوبَ بْنِ نُوحِ عَنْ بَعْضِ أَصْحَابِنَا عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلَاَمُ قَالَ: «الْعَارِي الَّذِي
لَيْسَ لَهُ ثَوْبٌ إِذَا وَجَدَ حُفْرَةً دَخَلَهَا فَسَجَدَ فِيهَا وَ رَكَعَ».
وما ذكره بعد ذلك من كيفية الصلاة على الميت إذا كان عريانا، يدل على ذلك ما رواه:
٣٨٦٢ ٩٩
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya from Ayyub ibn Nuh from one of our companions from Abu Abdillah {a.s}:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “The naked person, who has no garment, if he finds a pit, he
should enter it and perform his prostration and bowing in it.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
commentary:
And what he mentioned after that regarding the manner of performing the prayer over
a deceased person, if he is naked, is indicated by what is narrated:
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.365 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.179 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.438 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.448

arabic_text:
أحمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي نَصْرٍ عَنْ مَرْوَانَ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ عَنْ عَمَّارِ السَّابَاطِيِّ قَالَ: قُلْتُ
الأَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ مَا تَقُولُ فِي قَوْمٍ كَانُوا فِي سَفَرٍ لَهُمْ يَمْشَونَ عَلَى سَاحِلِ الْبَحْرِ فَإِذَا هُمْ بِرَجُلٍ مَيَّتِ
عُزْيَانٍ قَدْ لَفَظَهُ الْبَحْرُ وَ هُمْ عُرَاةً لَيْسَ عَلَيْهِمْ إِلَّ إِزَارُ أَوْ رِدَاءُ كَيْفَ يُصَلُونَ عَلَيْهِ وَ هُمْ عُرَاةً لَيْسَ مَعَهُمْ فَضْلُ
ثَوْبِ يُكَفَّنُونَهُ بِهِ قَالَ «يُحْفَرُ لَهُ وَ يُوضَعُ فِي لَحْدِهِ وَ يُوضَعُ اللَّبِنُ عَلَى عَوْرَتِهِ فَيُسْتَرُ بِاللّبِنِ وَ بِالْحَجَرِ ثُمَّ يُصَلّى
عَلَيْهِ ثُمَّ يُدْفَنُ» قُلْتُ فَلاَ يُصَلَّى عَلَيْهِ إِذَا دُفِنَ قَالَ «لا يُصَلِّى عَلَى الْمَيِّتِ بَعْدَ مَا يُدْفَنُ وَ لاَ يُصَلَّى عَلَيْهِ وَ هُوَ
عُزيَانٌ حَتَّى تُوَارَى عَوْرَتُهُ».
١٦ - باب صلاة الاستخارة
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr from Marwan ibn Muslim from
Ammar al-Sabati. He said:
I said to Abu Abdillah {a.s}: “What do you say about a group of people, who were on a
journey walking along the shore of the sea, when suddenly they came upon a dead
man; naked, whom the sea had cast ashore. These group of people are themselves
naked, having only a waist wrap or a cloak. How should they pray over him (the
deceased), while they are naked and have no extra garment to shroud him with?”
Imam {a.s} said: “A grave should be dug for him, and he should be placed in his burial
niche (lahd), and bricks should be placed over his private parts, so that his private area
is covered with the bricks and stones. Then the prayer should be performed over him,
and then he should be buried.”
I asked: “So, the prayer is not to be performed over him, if he has already been buried?”
Imam {a.s} said: “No, the prayer is not performed over the deceased after he has been
buried, nor is it performed over him while he is naked, until his private parts are
covered.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.214 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.166 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.179 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.327 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.487 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.3 p.131

arabic_text:
مُحَمِّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ خَالِدِ عَنِ النَّضْرِ بْنِ سُوَيْدٍ عَنْ يَحْيَى
اَلْحَلَبِيِّ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ حُرَيْثِ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ : «صَلِّ رَكْعَتَيْنِ وَ اِسْتَخِرِ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ فَوَ اللَّهِ
مَا اِسْتَخَارَ اَللهَ مُسْلِمٌ إِلَّ خَارَ اللهُ لَهُ الْبَنَّةَ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ya‘qub from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn
Khalid from al-Nadr ibn Suwayd from Yahya al-Halabi from Amr ibn Hurayth. He said:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: “Pray two rak’ahs and seek guidance
(istikharah) from Allah {SWT}, the Mighty and Majestic, for by Allah {SWT}, no Muslim ever
seeks guidance from Allah {SWT} except that Allah {SWT} surely grants him the best
outcome.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.470 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.179 • Misbah Al-Mutahajid, Vol.2 p.533 • Makarim Al-Akhlaq, Vol.1 p.324 • Fath Al-Abwab, Vol.1 p.164 • Al-Wafi, Vol.9 p.1409 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.63 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.88 p.266 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.88 p.283

arabic_text:
اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ عُثَمَانَ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ شِمْرٍ عَنْ جَابِرٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: «كَانَ عَلِيُ
بْنُ الْحُسَيْنِ عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلامُ إِذَا هَمَّ بِأَمْرِ حَجِّ أَوْ عُمْرَةٍ أَوْ بَنْعِ أَوْ شِرَاءٍ أَوْ عِثقٍ تَطَهَرَ ثُمَّ صَلَّى رَكْعَتَي الإِسْتِخَارَةِ
يَقْرَأُ فِيهِمَا سُورَةَ الْحَشْرِ وَ سُورَةَ الرَّحْمَنِ ثُمَّ يَقْرَأُ ٱلْمُعَوِّدَتَيْنِ وَ «قُلْ هُوَ اللهُ أَحَدٌ» ثُمْ يَقُولُ » آللّهُمْ إِنْ كَانَ كَذَا
وَكَذَا خَيْراً لِي فِي دِيني وَ دُنْيَايَ وَ آخِرَتِي وَ عَاجِلٍ أَمْرِي وَ آجِلِهِ فَيَسُرْهُ لِي عَلَى أَحْسَنِ ٱلْوُجُوهِ وَ أَجْمَلِهَا اللَّهُمَّ
وَ إِنْ كَانَ كَذَا وَ كَذَا شَرّاً لِي فِي دِينِي وَ دُنْيَايَ وَ آخِرَتِي وَ عَاجِلِ أَمْرِي وَ آجِلِهِ فَاصْرِفْهُ عَنَّي عَلَى أَحْسَنِ ٱلْوُجُوهِ
رَبّ اِغْزِمْ لِي عَلَى رُشَدِي وَ إِنْ كَرِهْتُ ذَلِكَ أَوْ أَبَثَهُ نَفْسِي »».
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa’id from Uthman ibn Isa from ‘Amru ibn Shimr from Jabir from Abu Ja’far {a.s}, peace be upon
him, said:
Imam al-Baqir {a.s} said: “When Imam Ali ibn al-Husayn {a.s}, peace be upon them both,
intended to perform the Hajj, or the ‘Umrah, or to engage in buying, or selling, or
manumission (of a slave);
Imam al-Husayn {a.s} would perform ablution, then he would pray the two units
(rak‘ahs) of the prayer of Istikharah, in which He {a.s} would recite Surah al-Hashr and
Surah al-Rahman.
Then He {a.s} would recite ‘al-Mu‘awwidhatayn’ (the two chapters of refuge) and ‘Qul
Huwa Allahu Ahad’ (Surah al-Ikhlas).
Then Imam al-Husayn {a.s} would say:
“O’ Allah {SWT}, if such and such a matter is good for me in my religion, my worldly life,
my hereafter, my immediate affairs, and my future ones, then facilitate it for me in the
best and most beautiful manner. O’ Allah {SWT}, and if such and such a matter is bad for
me in my religion, my worldly life, my hereafter, my immediate affairs, and my future
ones, then turn it away from me in the best manner. My Lord {SWT}, determine for me
what is right, even if I dislike it or my soul refuses it.”
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s} & Abu Muhammad Imam Ali ibn Husayn Zayn al- Abidin {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.180 • Misbah Al-Mutahajid, Vol.2 p.533

arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ فَضَّالٍ قَالَ: سَأَلَ اَلْحَسَنُ بْنُ الْجَهْمِ - أَبَا
الْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ لاِبْنِ أَسْبَاطِ فَقَالَ لَهُ مَا تَرَى لَهُ وَ اِبْنُ أَسْبَاطِ حَاضِرٌ وَ نَحْنُ جَمِيعاً يَرْكَبُ الْبَحْرَ أَوِ الْبَرَّ إِلَى
مِصْرَ وَ أَخْبَرَهُ بِخَبَرِ طَرِيقِ الْبَرِّ فَقَالَ «فَأْتِ ٱلْمَسْجِدَ فِي غَيْرِ وَقْتِ صَلاَةٍ فَرِيضَةِ فَصَلَ رَكْعَتَيْنِ وَ اِسْتَخْرِ ٱللَّهَ
مِائَةَ مَرَّةٍ ثُمَّ أنْظُرْ أَيِّ شَيْءٍ يَقَعُ فِي قَلْبِكَ فَاعْمَلْ بِهِ» قَالَ لَهُ الْحَسَنُ الْبَرْ أَحَبُ إِلَيَّ لَهُ قَالَ »وَ إِلَيَّ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ya‘qub from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ibn Faddal, who said:
Al-Hasan ibn al-Jahm asked Aba al-Hasan {a.s} on behalf of Ibn Asbat.
He (Al-Hasan) said to Imam {a.s}: “What do you see for him?”, and Ibn Asbat was
present, and we were all together,
(Al-Hasan asked) “Should he (ibn Asbat) travel by sea or by land to Egypt?”
Then he (Al-Hasan) informed Imam {a.s} about the condition of the land route.
Imam {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: “Go to the mosque at a time other than the time
of obligatory prayer. Then pray two units (rak‘ahs) and seek the guidance of Allah {SWT}
(istikharah) one hundred times. Then look at what settles in your heart, and act upon
it.”
Al-Hasan said to Imam {a.s}: “The land route is more beloved to me for him (ibn Asbat).”
Imam {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: “And to me as well.”
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Ali ibn Musa al-Ridha {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.471 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.180 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.311 • Misbah Al-Mutahajid, Vol.2 p.533 • Makarim Al-Akhlaq, Vol.1 p.321 • Al-Wafi, Vol.9 p.1413 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.88 p.280

arabic_text:
وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمِّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ حَدِيدٍ عَنْ مُرَازِمِ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ
: «إِذَا أَرَادَ أَحَدُكُمْ شَيْئاً فَلْيْصَلَ رَكْعَتَيْنِ وَ لَيَحْمَدِ اللَّهَ وَ لَيْثِنِ عَلَيْهِ ثُمَّ يُصَلِّي عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ وَ يَقُولُ - اللَّهُمَ إنْ
كَانَ هَذَا الْأَمْرُ خَيْراً لِي فِي دِينِي وَ دُنْيَايَ فَيَسِّرْهُ لِي وَ قَدِّرْهُ وَ إِنْ كَانَ عَلَى غَيْرِ ذَلِكَ فَاصْرِفْهُ عَنِّي » فَسَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ
أَيِّ شَيْءٍ أَقْرَأَ فِيهِمَا فَقَالَ «اِقْرَأْ فِيهِمَا مَا شِئْتَ وَ إِنْ شِئْتَ قَرَأْتَ «قُلْ هُوَ اللَهُ أَحَدٌ» وَ «قُلْ يَا أَيْهَا الْكَافِرُونَ» ».
english_text:
From him, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn Hadid, from Murazim said:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: “When one of you intends something, let
him pray two units (rak’ahs), then praise Allah {SWT} and commend Him {AZJ}, then send
blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad {saws} and his family {a.s}, and then say:
‘O’ Allah {SWT}, if this matter is good for me in my religion and my worldly life, then
facilitate it for me and ordain it for me; and if it is otherwise, then turn it away from
me.’”
I asked Imam {a.s}: “What should I recite in them (the two rak’ahs)?”
Imam {a.s} said: “Recite in them whatever you wish, and if you wish, you may recite ‘Qul
Huwa Allahu Ahad’ (Surah al-Ikhlas) and ‘Qul Ya Ayyuha al-Kafirun’ (Surah al-
Kafirun).”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.472 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.180 • Misbah Al-Mutahajid, Vol.2 p.534 • Makarim Al-Akhlaq, Vol.1 p.321 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.88 p.283

arabic_text:
وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ عَلِيّ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ وَ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ خَلَفٍ بْنِ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ
إسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: قُلْتُ لَهُ رُبَّمَا أَرَدْتُ الْأَمْرَ فَيَفْرُقُ مِنَّي فَرِيقَانِ أَحَدُهُمَا يَأْمُرُنِي وَ ٱلْآخَرُ يَنْهَانِي
فَقَالَ «إِذَا كُنْتَ كَذَلِكَ فَصَلَ رَكْعَتَيْنِ وَ اِسْتَخِرِ اللَّهَ مِائَةَ مَرَّةٍ وَ مَرَّةً ثُمَّ أنظُرْ أَحْزَمَ ٱلْأَمْرَيْنِ لَكَ فَافْعَلْهُ فَإِنَّ ٱلْخَيْرَ
فِيهِ إنْ شَاءَ اللهُ وَ لْتَكُنِ اِسْتِخَارَتُكَ فِي عَافِيَةٍ فَإِنَّهُ رُبَّمَا خِيرَ لِلرَّجُلِ فِي قَطْعِ يَدِهِ وَ مَوْتِ وَلَدِهِ وَ ذَهَابٍ مَالِهِ».
english_text:
From him, from Ali ibn Muhammad, from Sahl ibn Ziyad and Muhammad ibn Isa, from Amru ibn Ibrahim,
from Khalaf ibn Hammad, from Ishaq ibn Ammar, from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
I said to Imam al-Sadiq {a.s}: “At times I intend to do something, but two thoughts arise
within me; one commands me to proceed, and the other forbids me.”
Imam {a.s} said: “When you are in such a situation, then pray two units (rak‘ahs) and
seek Allah’s {SWT} guidance (istikharah) one hundred and one times.
Then look to whichever of the two matters is more prudent for you, and do it, for indeed
the good is in it, if Allah {SWT} wills.
And let your istikharah be in a state of well-being, for indeed it may happen that a
man’s best outcome lies in cutting off of his hand, death of his child, or loss of wealth.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.472 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.181 • Misbah Al-Mutahajid, Vol.2 p.534 • Makarim Al-Akhlaq, Vol.1 p.322 • Fath Al-Abwab, Vol.1 p.232 • Al-Balad Al-Amin, Vol.1 p.159 • Al-Misbah (Lil-Kaf’ami), Vol.1 p.390 • Al-Wafi, Vol.9 p.1412 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.65

arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ غَيْرِ وَاحِدٍ عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ ٱلْبَصْرِيَّ عَنِ ٱلْقَاسِمِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ
الْهَاشِمِيِّ عَنْ هَارُونَ بْنِ خَارِجَةَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: «إِذَا أَرَدْتَ أَمْراً فَخُذْ سِنَّ رِقَاعِ فَاكْتُبْ فِي
ثَلاَثٍ مِنْهَا «بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمُنِ الرَّجِيمِ» خِيَرَةٌ «مِنَ اللهِ الْعَزِيزِ الْحَكِيمِ» لِفلانِ بْنِ فُلاَنَةَ اِفْعَلْهُ وَ فِي ثَلاَثِ مِنْهَا
«بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمِنِ الرَّحِيمِ» خِيَرَةُ «مِنَ اللهِ الْعَزِيزِ الْحَكِيمِ» لِفُلانِ بْنِ فُلانَةَ لا تَفْعَلْ ثُمَّ ضَعْهَا تَحْتَ مُصَلاَكَ فَإِذَا
فَرَغْتَ فَاسْجُدْ سَجْدَةً وَ قُلْ فِيهَا مِائَةَ مَرَّةِ أَسْتَخِيرُ اللَّهَ بِرَحْمَتِهِ خِيَرَةً فِي عَافِيَةِ ثُمَّ اِسْتَوِ جَالِساً وَ قُلِ - اللَّهُمَّ
خِز لِي فِي جَمِيع أَمُورِي فِي يُسْرٍ مِنْكَ وَ عَافِيَةٍ ثُمَّ اِضْرِبْ بِيَدِكَ إِلَى الرَّقَاعِ فَشَوِّشُهَا وَ أُخْرِجْ وَاحِدَةً فَإِنْ خَرَجَ
ثَلاَثُ مُتَوَالِيَاتْ اِفْعَلْ فَافْعَلْ ذَلِكَ الْأَمْرَ الّذِي تُرِيدُهُ وَ إِنْ خَرَجَ ثَلاَثُ مُتَوَالِيَاتْ لاَ تَفْعَلْ فَلاَ تَفْعَلْهُ وَ إِنْ خَرَجَتْ
وَاجِدَةً اِفْعَلْ وَ الْأُخْرَى لا تَفُعَلْ فَأَخْرِجَ مِنَ الرِّقَاعِ إِلَى خَمْسِ فَانظُرْ أَكْثَرَهَا فَاعْمَلْ بِهِ وَ دَعِ السَّادِسَةَ لا تَحْتَاجُ
إلَيْهَا».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ya‘qub from more than one person, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad al-
Basri, from al-Qasim ibn Abd al-Rahman al-Hashimi, from Harun ibn Kharijah, from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace
be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “When you intend to undertake a matter, take six slips (of
paper). Write on three of them:
‘In the Name of Allah {SWT}, the All-Beneficent, the All-Merciful. A choice (khirah) from
Allah {SWT}, the Mighty, the Wise, for (so-and-so) son of (so-and-so): Do it.’
And on the other three write:
‘In the Name of Allah {SWT}, the All-Beneficent, the All-Merciful. A choice (khirah) from
Allah {SWT}, the Mighty, the Wise, for (so-and-so) son of (so-and-so): Do not do it.’
Then place them beneath your prayer mat. When you finish, perform a prostration and
say in it one hundred times:
‘I seek the best (khirah) from Allah {SWT} through His {AZJ} mercy a choice in well-being.’
Then sit upright and say: “O’ Allah {SWT}, choose for me in all of my affairs with ease from
You {AZJ} and with well-being.”
Then reach your hand toward the slips, mix them up thoroughly, and draw one out.
If three consecutive slips come out that say ‘Do it,’ then proceed with the matter you
intended.
And if three consecutive slips come out that say ‘Do not do it,’ then do not proceed
with it.
And if one says ‘Do it’ and the other says ‘Do not do it,’ then continue drawing from the
slips until you have drawn five. Then look at the majority among them and act
according to it.
Leave the sixth; you do not need it.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.470 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.181 • Misbah Al-Mutahajid, Vol.2 p.534 • Makarim Al-Akhlaq, Vol.1 p.322 • Fath Al-Abwab, Vol.1 p.181 • Fath Al-Abwab, Vol.1 p.184 • Fath Al-Abwab, Vol.1 p.187 • Al-Balad Al-Amin, Vol.1 p.159 • Al-Misbah (Lil-Kaf’ami), Vol.1 p.390 • Al-Wafi, Vol.9 p.1410

arabic_text:
وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ رَفَعَهُ عَنْهُمْ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلسَّلاَمُ : أَنَّهُ قَالَ لِبَعْضِ أَصْحَابِهِ وَ قَدْ سَأَلَهُ عَنِ الْأَمْرِ يَمْضِي فِيهِ وَ
لا يَجِدُ أَحَداً يُشَاوِرُهُ فَكَيْفَ يَصْنَعُ قَالَ «شَاوِرْ رَبَّكَ» قَالَ فَقَالَ لَهُ كَيْفَ قَالَ «اِنْوِ ٱلْحَاجَةَ فِي نَفْسِكَ وَ أكْتُبْ
رُقْعَتَيْنِ فِي وَاحِدَةٍ لاَ وَ فِي وَاحِدَةٍ نَعَمْ وَ اِجْعَلْهُمَا فِي بُنْدُقَتَيْنِ مِنْ طِينٍ ثُمَّ صَلِّ رَكْعَنَيْنِ وَ اِجْعَلْهُمَا تَحْتَ ذَيْلِكَ
وَ قُلْ - يَا اللَّهُ إِنِّي أُشَاوِرُكَ فِي أَمْرِي هَذَا وَ أَنْتَ خَيْرُ مُسْتَشَارٍ وَ مُشِيرٍ فَأَشِرْ عَلَيَّ مَا فِيهِ صَلاحٌ وَ حُسْنُ عَاقِبَةٍ
ثُمَّ أَدْخِلْ يَدَكَ فَإِنْ كَانَ فِيهَا نَعَمْ فَافْعَلْ وَ إِنْ كَانَ فِيهَا لاَ لاَ تَفْعَلْ هَكَذَا تُشَاوِرُ رَبَّكَ».
english_text:
From him, from Ali ibn Muhammad, who transmitted it with a raised chain from the Imams {a.s}:
Imam {a.s} said to one of his companions, who had asked Imam {a.s} about a matter he
wished to proceed in, but could not find anyone to consult so what should he do?
Imam {a.s} said: “Consult your Lord {AZJ}.” He said to Imam {a.s}: “How?”
Imam {a.s} replied: “Intend the need within yourself, and write two slips on one write
‘No’ and on the other write ‘Yes.’ Place them into two pellets of clay.
Then pray two units (rak’ahs) and place the two pellets beneath your prayer garment,
and say: ‘O’ Allah {SWT}, I consult You {AZJ} regarding this matter of mine, and You {AZJ} are
the best of those who are consulted and who give counsel. So guide me to that which
contains righteousness and a good outcome.’
Then insert your hand (into the pellets). If the one you draw says ‘Yes’, then proceed
with it. And if it says ‘No’, then do not proceed. This is how you consult your Lord {AZJ}.”
source: Implicit (Muzmar)
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.473 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.182 • Misbah Al-Mutahajid, Vol.2 p.535 • Makarim Al-Akhlaq, Vol.1 p.323 • Fath Al-Abwab, Vol.1 p.227 • Al-Wafi, Vol.9 p.1412 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.69 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.88 p.237

arabic_text:
وَ رَوَى مُعَاوِيَةُ بْنُ مَيْسَرَةَ عَنْهُ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلامُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «مَا اِسْتَخَارَ ٱللَّهَ عَبْدٌ سَبْعِينَ مَرَّةً بِهَذِهِ الإِسْتِخَارَةِ إِلاَ رَمَاهُ
اللّهُ بِالْخَيْرِ يَقُولُ - يَا أَبْصَرَ النَّاظِرِينَ وَ يَا أَسْمَعَ السَّامِعِينَ وَ يَا أَسْرَعَ الْحَاسِبِينَ وَ يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ وَ يَا أَحْكَمَ
اَلْحَاكِمِينَ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ أُهْلِ بَيْتِهِ وَ خِزْ لِي فِي كَذَا وَ كَذَا ».
١٧ - باب صلاة الحوائج
english_text:
Muawiyah ibn Mayasrah narrated from Imam {a.s}, peace be upon him, that he said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “No servant seeks Allah’s {SWT} guidance (istikharah) seventy
times, with this form of istikharah, except Allah {SWT} directs him toward what is good.
He (the seeker) should say: ‘O’ Most Seeing of those who see, O’ Most Hearing of those
who hear, O’ Swiftest of those who take account, O’ Most Merciful of the merciful, O’
Wisest of those who judge, send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad {saws} and the
people of his household, and choose for me in such and such matter.’”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.563 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.182 • Misbah Al- Mutahajid, Vol.2 p.536 • Makarim Al-Akhlaq, Vol.1 p.320 • Fath Al-Abwab, Vol.1 p.249 • Al-Balad Al-Amin, Vol.1 p.160 • Al-Misbah (Lil-Kaf’ami), Vol.1 p.391 • Al-Wafi, Vol.9 p.1415 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.75 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.88 p.282

arabic_text:
رَوَى سَمَاعَةُ بْنُ مِهْرَانَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلاَمُ قَالَ: «إِنَّ أَحَدَكُمْ إِذَا مَرِضَ دَعَا الطَّبِيبَ وَ أَعْطَاهُ وَ إِذَا كَانَ
لَهُ حَاجَةٌ إِلَى سُلْطَانٍ رَشَا الْبَوَّابَ وَ أَعْطَاهُ وَ لَوْ أَنَّ أَحَدَكُمْ إِذَا فَدَحَهُ أَمْرٌ فَزِعَ إِلَى اللَّهِ تَعَالَى فَتَطَهَّرَ وَ تَصَدَّقَ
بِصَدَقَةٍ قَلَّثْ أَوْ كَثُرَثْ ثُمَّ دَخَلَ ٱلْمَسْجِدَ فَصَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ فَحَمِدَ اللّهَ وَ أَثنَى عَلَيْهِ وَ صَلَّى عَلَى النَّبِيِّ وَ أَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ
ثُمَّ قَالَ اللَّهُمَّ إِنْ عَافَيْتَنِي مِنْ مَرَضِي أَوْ رَدَدْتَنِي مِنْ سَفَرِي أَوْ عَافَيْتَنِي مِمَّا أَخَافُ مِنْ كَذَا وَ كَذَا إِلاَّ آتَاهُ آللَّهُ ذَلِكَ
وَ هِيَ الْيَمِينُ الْوَاجِبَةُ وَ مَا جَعَلَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى عَلَيْهِ فِي الشُّكْرِ».
صلاة اخرى للحاجة
english_text:
Sama’ah ibn Mihran narrated from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “Indeed, when one of you falls ill, he calls for the physician and
gives him (payment), and when he has a need from a ruler, he bribes the doorkeeper
and gives him something.
But if one of you, when a matter becomes overwhelming for him, Were to turn to your
Lord {SWT}, the Exalted, performing purification, giving charity whether little or much,
then entering the mosque and praying two units (rak’ahs), praising Allah {SWT} and
commending Him {AZJ}, and sending blessings upon the Prophet {saws} and his family, and
then said:
‘O’ Allah {SWT}, if You {AZJ} grant me recovery from my illness, or return me safely from my
journey, or protect me from that which I fear such and such then You {AZJ} will surely
grant me that,’
Allah {SWT} would indeed grant it to him.
And this is the binding oath, and it is what Allah {SWT}, the Exalted, has made obligatory
upon him in gratitude.”
ANOTHER PRAYER FOR NEED (SECOND)
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.557 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.182 • Misbah Al- Mutahajid, Vol.2 p.530 • Makarim Al-Akhlaq, Vol.1 p.325 • Al-Balad Al-Amin, Vol.1 p.155 • Al-Misbah (Lil- Kaf’ami), Vol.1 p.398 • Al-Wafi, Vol.9 p.1427 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.136 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.88 p.351

arabic_text:
رَوَى مُوسَى بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ الْبَجَلِي عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ يَخْيّى وَ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سُهَيْلٍ عَنْ أَشيَاجِهِمَا عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلامُ قَالَ: «إِذَا حَضَرَتْ لَكَ حَاجَةٌ مُهِمَّةٌ إِلَى اللّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ فَصُمْ ثَلاَثَةَ أَيَّامِ مُتَوَالِيَةِ الْأَرْبِعَاءَ وَ الْخَمِيسَ وَ
الْجُمُعَةَ فَإِذَا كَانَ يَوْمُ الْجُمُعَةِ إِنْ شَاءَ اللهُ فَاغْتَسِلْ وَ اِلْبَسْ ثَوْباً جَدِيداً ثُمَّ اِصْعَدْ إِلَى أَعْلَى بَيْتٍ فِي دَارِكَ وَ صَلِّ
فِيهِ رَكْعَتَيْنِ وَ اِرْفَعْ يَدَيْكَ إِلَى السَّمَاءِ ثُمَّ قُلِ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي حَلَلْتُ بِسَاحَتِكَ لِمَعْرِفَتِي بِوَحْدَانِيَّتِكَ وَ صَمَدَانِيَّتِكَ وَ أَنَّهُ
لاَ قَادِرَ عَلَى قَضَاءِ حَاجَتِي غَيْرُكَ وَ قَدْ عَلِمْتَ يَا رَبٌّ أَنَّهُ كُلّمَا تَظَاهَرَتْ نِعَمُكَ عَلَيَّ اِشتَدَّثْ فَاقَتِي إِلَيْكَ وَ قَدْ
طَرَقَنِي هَمْ كَذَا وَ أَنْتَ بِكَشَفِهِ عَالِمٌ غَيْرُ مُعَلَّمِ وَاسِعٌ غَيْرُ مُتَكَلَّفٍ فَأَسْأَلُكَ بِاسْمِكَ الَّذِي وَضَعْتَهُ عَلَى الْجِبَالِ
فَنُسِفَتْ وَ وَضَعْتَهُ عَلَى السِّمَاءِ فَالْشَقَّتْ وَ عَلَى النُجُومِ فَالْتَشَرَثْ وَ عَلَى الْأَرْضِ فَسْطِحَتْ وَ أَسْأَلُكَ بِالْحَقِّ الَّذِي
جَعَلْتَهُ عِنْدَ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ الْأَيِمَةِ وَ ثُسَمِّيهِمْ إِلَى آخِرِهِمْ أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ أَهْلٍ بَيْتِهِ وَ أَنْ تَقْضِيَ حَاجَتِي وَ أَنْ
تُيَسِّرَ لِي عُسْرَهَا وَ تَكْفِيَنِي مُهِمَّهَا فَإِنْ فَعَلْتَ فَلَكَ اَلْحَمْدُ وَ إِنْ لَمْ تَفْعَلْ فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ غَيْرَ جَائِرٍ فِي حُكْمِكَ وَ لا
مُتَّهَمِ فِي قَضَائِكَ وَ لاَ حَائِفٍ فِي عَذْلِكَ وَ تُلْصِقُ خَدَّكَ بِالْأَرْضِ وَ تَقُولُ - اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّ يُونُسَ بْنَ مَتَّى عَبْدُكَ دَعَاكَ
فِي بَطْنِ الْحُوتِ وَ هُوَ عَنْدُكَ فَاسْتَجَبْتَ لَهُ وَ أَنَا عَبْدُكَ أَدْعُوكَ فَاسْتَجِبْ لِي » ثُمَّ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ
«إِذَا كَانَتْ لِيَ الْحَاجَةُ فَأَدْعُو بِهَذَا الدُّعَاءِ فَأَرْجِعُ وَ قَدْ قُضِيَتْ».
صلاة اخرى للحاجة
english_text:
Musa ibn al-Qasim al-Bajali narrated from Safwan ibn Yahya and Muhammad ibn Suhayl from their shaykhs,
from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
“When you are faced with an important need before Allah {SWT}, Mighty and Majestic,
then fast for three consecutive days; Wednesday, Thursday, and Friday.
When it is Friday, Allah {SWT} willing, perform ghusl and wear a new garment, then
ascend to the highest room in your house and pray two units (rak’ahs) therein.
Then raise your hands toward the sky and say:
‘O’ Allah {SWT}, I have come to Your courtyard,
Acknowledging Your Oneness and Your Self-Sufficiency,
And knowing that none is capable of fulfilling my need besides You {AZJ}.
And You {AZJ} know, O’ my Lord {AZJ}, that every time Your blessings increase upon me,
my neediness toward You {AZJ} intensifies.
A worry (such-and-such) has struck me,
You {AZJ} are aware of its removal without being taught, all-encompassing without effort.
So I ask You {AZJ} by Your Name which,
when You {AZJ} placed it upon the mountains, they were crushed;
And when You {AZJ} placed it upon the sky, it split;
And when You {AZJ} placed it upon the stars, they scattered;
And when You {AZJ} placed it upon the earth, it was spread out.
And I ask You {AZJ} by the truth which You {AZJ} have placed with (Prophet) Muhammad
{saws} and the Imams {a.s} (and you name them to their end),
I ask that You {AZJ} send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad {saws} and his family {a.s},
And that You {AZJ} fulfill my need,
And ease its difficulty for me,
And suffice me in its concern.
So if You {AZJ} do so, then to You {AZJ} belongs all praise;
And if You {AZJ} do not do so, then to You {AZJ} belongs all praise,
You {AZJ} are neither unjust in Your judgment,
nor accused in Your decree, nor feared in Your justice.’”
(Imam {a.s} then continued)
“Then place your cheek on the ground and say:
‘O’ Allah {SWT}, indeed Yunus son of Matta, Your servant, called upon You {a.s} from within
the belly of the whale, and he was Your servant, and You {a.s} answered him.
And I am Your servant; I call upon You {a.s}, so answer me.’”
Then Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said:
“When I have a need, I supplicate with this supplication, and whilst I return, it has
already been fulfilled.”
ANOTHER PRAYER FOR NEED (THIRD
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.556 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.183 • Misbah Al- Mutahajid, Vol.2 p.530 • Makarim Al-Akhlaq, Vol.1 p.325 • Al-Wafi, Vol.9 p.1426 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.132

arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ دُوَيْلٍ عَنْ مُقَاتِلٍ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِلرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ
السَّلامُ جُعِلْتُ فِدَاكَ عَلَّمْنِي دُعَاءً لِقَضَاءِ الْحَوَائِجِ فَقَالَ «إِذَا كَانَتْ لَكَ حَاجَةٌ إِلَى اللَّهِ مُهِمَّةٌ فَاغْتَسِلْ وَ اِلْبَسْ أَنظَفَ
ثِيَابِكَ وَ شَمَّ شَيْئاً مِنَ الطَّيبِ ثُمَّ أبْرُزْ تَحْتَ السَّمَاءِ فَصَلّ رَكْعَتَيْنِ تَفْتَتِحُ الصَّلاَةُ فَتَقْرَأْ فَاتِحَةَ الْكِتَابِ وَ قُلْ هُوَ
اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ خَمْسَ عَشْرَةَ مَرَّةً ثُمَّ تَرْكَعُ فَتَقْرَأْ خَمْسَ عَشْرَةَ مَرَّةً عَلَى مِثَالِ صَلَاةِ التَّسْبِيحِ غَيْرَ أَنَّ الْقِرَاءَةَ خَمْسَ
عَشَرَةَ مَرَّةً فَإِذَا سَلَمْتَ فَاقْرَأُهَا خَمْسَ عَشْرَةَ مَرّةً ثُمَّ تَسْجُدُ وَ تَقُولُ فِي سُجُودِكَ - اَللّهُمَّ إِنَّ كُلَّ مَعْبُودٍ مِنْ لَدُنْ
عَرْشِكَ إِلَى قَرَارِ أَرْضِكَ فَهُوَ بَاطِلٌ سِوَاكَ فَإِنَّكَ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ الْحَقُّ الْمُبِينُ اِقْضِ لِي حَاجَةَ كَذَا وَ كَذَا السَّاعَةَ السَّاعَةَ
وَثُلِحٌ فِيمَا أَرَدْتَ ».
وصلوات الحوائج اكثر من ان نستوفيها وفيما ذكرناه كفاية ان شاء الله.
١٨ - باب صلاة الشكر
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ya‘qub from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn Duwail from
Muqatil, who said:
I said to Imam al-Ridha {a.s}, peace be upon him: “May I be your ransom, teach me a
supplication for the fulfillment of needs.”
Imam {a.s} said: “When you have an important need from Allah {SWT}, perform ghusl (ritual
bathing), wear your cleanest clothes, and apply some perfume.
Then go out under the open sky and pray two units (rak’ahs) of prayer.
Begin the prayer by reciting the ‘Fatihat al-Kitab’ (Surah al-Fatihah) and ‘Qul Huwa
Allahu Ahad’ (Surah al-Ikhlas) fifteen times.
Then bow (for rukuh) and recite it fifteen times in the same manner as the prayer of al-
Tasbih, except that the recitation is fifteen times.
When you finish with salam, recite it again (Surah Ikhlas) fifteen times. Then go into
prostration (sujud) and say in your prostration:
‘O’ Allah {SWT}, every object of worship from beneath Your Throne to the depth of Your
earth is false except You {AZJ}, for indeed You {AZJ} are Allah {SWT}, the True, the Clear.
Fulfill for me the need of such and such this very hour, this very hour!’
And be insistent in what you seek.”
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Ali ibn Musa al-Ridha {a.s}
commentary:
And the prayers for needs are more numerous than what we have mentioned
completely, but what we have cited is sufficient, God willing.
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.477 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.184 • Misbah Al-Mutahajid, Vol.2 p.532 • Makarim Al-Akhlaq, Vol.1 p.327 • Al-Wafi, Vol.9 p.1420 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.131 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.88 p.353

arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إسْمَاعِيلَ عَنْ أَبِي إسْمَاعِيلَ السِّرَّاجِ
عَنْ هَارُونَ بْنِ خَارِجَةَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: قَالَ لِي فِي صَلاَةِ الشُّكْرِ «إِذَا أُنْعَمَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَ عَلَيْكَ
بِنِعْمَةٍ فَصَلّ رَكْعَتَيْنِ تَقْرَأْ فِي الْأُولَى بِفَاتِحَةِ الْكِتَابِ وَ «قُلْ هُوَ اللَهُ أَحَدٌ» وَ تَقْرَأْ فِي الثَّانِيَةِ بِفَاتِحَةِ الْكِتَابِ وَ
«قُلْ يَا أَيُّهَا الْكَافِرُونَ» وَ تَقُولُ فِي الرّكْعَةِ الْأُولَى فِي رُكُوعِكَ وَ سُجُودِكَ: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ شُكْراً شُكْراً وَ حَمْداً وَ تَقُولُ
فِي الرَّكْعَةِ الثَّانِيَةِ فِي رُكُوعِكَ وَ سُجُودِكَ الْحَمْدُ لِلْهِ الَّذِي اِسْتَجَابَ دُعَائِي وَ أَعْطَانِي مَسْأَلَتِي ».
١٩ - باب صلاة يوم المبعث وليلة النصف من شعبان
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Yaqub from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn
Ismail from Abu Ismail al-Sarraj from Harun ibn Kharijah from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who
said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said to me regarding the ‘Prayer of Gratitude’ (salat al-shukr):
“When Allah {SWT}, Mighty and Majestic, bestows a blessing upon you, then pray two
units (rak’ahs).
In the first, recite the ‘Fatihat al-Kitab’ (Surah al-Fatihah) and ‘Qul Huwa Allahu Ahad’
(Surah Ikhlas)
And in the second (rak’ah), recite the ‘Fatihat al-Kitab’ (Surah al-Fatihah) and ‘Qul Ya
Ayyuha al-Kafirun’ (Surah al-Kafirun).
In the first rak’ah, during your bowing (rukuh) and prostration (sujud), say:
‘All praise is due to Allah {SWT} thanks, thanks, and praise.’
And in the second rak’ah, during your bowing and prostration, say:
‘All praise is due to Allah {SWT} who answered my supplication and granted me my
request.’”
OF THE MIDDLE OF SHA‘BAN
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.481 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.184 • Misbah Al-Mutahajid, Vol.2 p.532 • Makarim Al-Akhlaq, Vol.1 p.327 • Al-Wafi, Vol.9 p.1435 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.142 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.88 p.384

Chapter Title: THE PRAYER OF THE DAY OF MAB‘ATH AND THE NIGHT
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ رَفَعَهُ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «إِذَا كَانَ لَيْلَةُ النَّصْفِ مِنْ شَعْبَانَ
فَصَلَ أَرْبَعَ رَكَعَاتٍ تَقْرَأْ فِي كُلّ رَكْعَةِ - الْحَمْدَ وَ «قُلْ هُوَ اللهُ أَحَدٌ» مِائَةَ مَرَّةٍ فَإِذَا فَرَغْتَ فَقُلِ - اللَّهُمَ إِنَّي إِلَيْكَ
فَقِيرٌ وَ إِنِّي عَائِذٌ بِكَ وَ مِنكَ خَائِفٌ وَ بِكَ مُسْتَجِيرٌ رَبَّ لا تُبَدَّلِ اِسْمِي وَ لا تُغَيَّزُ جِسْمِي رَبَّ لا تُجْهِذْ بَلاَئِي وَ لا
ثُشمِتْ بِي أَعْدَائِي أَعُوذُ بِعَفْوِكَ مِنْ عِقَابِكَ وَ أَعُوذُ بِرِضَاكَ مِنْ سَخَطِكَ وَ أَعُوذُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِكَ وَ أَعُوذُ بِكَ
مِثْكَ جَلَّ ثَنَاؤُكَ أَنْتَ كَمَا أَثْنَيْتَ عَلَى نَفْسِكَ وَ فَوْقَ مَا يَقُولُ الْقَائِلُونَ » قَالَ وَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَلاَمُ - «
يَوْمُ سَبْعَةٍ وَ عِشِرِينَ مِنْ رَجَبِ نُبِّئَ فِيهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ مَنْ صَلَّى فِيهِ أَيِّ وَقْتِ شَاءَ اِثْنَتَيْ عَشَرَةَ
رَكْعَةً يَقْرَأْ فِي كُلِّ رَكْعَةٍ - بِأَمَّ ٱلْقُرْآنِ وَ سُورَةٍ مِمَّا تَيَسَّرَ فَإِذَا فَرَغَ وَ سَلَّمَ جَلَسَ مَكَانَهُ ثُمَّ قَرَأَ أُمَّ ٱلْقُرْآنِ أَرْبَعَ مَرَّاتٍ
وَ الْمُعَوِّذَاتِ الثَّلاَثَ كُلَ وَاحِدَةِ أَرْبَعَ مَرَّاتٍ فَإِذَا فَرَغَ وَ هَوَ فِي مَكَانِهِ قَالَ - لا إِلَهَ إِلاَّا ٱللَّهُ وَ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ وَ ٱَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ
وَ سُبْحَانَ اللّهِ وَ لا حَوْلَ وَ لا قُوَّةَ إِلَّ بِاللّهِ أَرْبَعَ مَرَّاتٍ ثُمَّ يَقُولُ اللَّهُ اللَّهُ رَبِّي وَ لا أُشْرِكُ بِهِ شَيْئاً أَرْبَعَ مَرَّاتٍ ثُمَّ
يَدْعُو فَلا يَدْعُو بِشَيْءٍ إِلاَّ أسْتُجِيبَ لَهُ فِي كُلِّ حَاجَةِ إِلاَّ أَنْ يَدْعُوَ فِي جَائِحَةِ قَوْمٍ أَوْ قَطِيعَةِ رَجِمِ».
٢٠ - باب صلاة التسبيح وغيرها من الصلوات
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Yaqub from Ali ibn Muhammad, who transmitted it with a raised chain from Abu Abdillah
{a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “When it is the night of the middle of Shaban, pray four rak’ahs.
In each rak’ah, recite ‘al-Hamd’ (Surah al-Fatihah) and ‘Qul Huwa Allahu Ahad’ (Surah
Ikhlas) one hundred times.
When you have finished, say:
‘O’ Allah {SWT}, indeed I am in need before You {AZJ},
And I seek refuge in You {AZJ},
And I fear from You {AZJ},
And I seek protection through You {AZJ}.
My Lord {AZJ}, do not change my name,
And do not alter my body.
My Lord {AZJ}, do not burden me with severe trials,
And do not let my enemies gloat over me.
I seek refuge in Your pardon from Your punishment,
And I seek refuge in Your pleasure from Your anger,
And I seek refuge in Your mercy from Your chastisement,
And I seek refuge in You {AZJ}, from You {AZJ}. Exalted is Your praise.
You {AZJ} are as You {AZJ} have praised Yourself, and above what those who speak may
say.’”
He (Ibn Muhammad) said “And Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, also said:
‘On the twenty-seventh day of Rajab, the Messenger of Allah {SWT}, may Allah {SWT} bless
him and his family, was commissioned (nubbi’a - received revelation for the first time).
Whoever prays on that day, at any time he wishes, twelve rak‘ahs;
reciting in each rak‘ah the ‘Umm al-Kitab’ (Surah Al Fatihah) and any surah that is easy
for him,
And when he finishes and gives the salam, he remains seated in his place.
Then recites the ‘Umm al-Kitab’ (Surah Al Fatihah), (four times).
And the three chapters of seeking refuge (al-Mu‘awwidhat: ‘Qul A‘udhu bi-Rabbi al-
Falaq’ (Surah al-Falaq), (four times).
And ‘Qul A‘udhu bi-Rabbi al-Nas’ (Surah an-Nas)), (four times).
Then, while still seated, he says:
‘There is no God but Allah {SWT}, Allah {SWT} is the Greatest, (four times).
praise be to Allah {SWT}, glory be to Allah {SWT}, (four times).
And there is no power and no strength except with Allah {SWT}’ (four times).
Then he says:
‘Allah {SWT}, Allah {SWT} is my Lord {AZJ}, and I do not associate anything with Him {AZJ}’, (four
times).
Then he supplicates, and he will not ask for anything except that he will be answered
in every need, unless he prays for a calamity upon a people or for the severing of family
ties.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Abu al-Qasim Prophet Muhammad ibn Abdullah {saws}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.469 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.185 • Al-Wafi, Vol.9 p.1400

Chapter Title: THE PRAYER OF TASBIH AND OTHER PRAYERS
arabic_text:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ عَنْ بِسْطَامَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: قَالَ لَهُ رَجُلٌ جُعِلْتُ فِدَاكَ أَيَلْتَزِمُ الرَّجُلُ أَخَاهُ
فَقَالَ «نَعَمْ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ يَوْمَ اِفْتَتَحَ خَيْبَرَ أَتَاهُ الْخَبَرُ أَنَّ جَعْفَراً قَدْ قَدِمَ فَقَالَ »وَ اللَّهِ مَا
أَدْرِي بِأَيِّهِمَا أَنَا أَشَدَّ سُرُوراً أَبِقُدُومِ جَعْفَرٍ أَوْ بِفَتَحِ خَيْبَرَ» » قَالَ «فَلَمْ يَلْبَثْ أَنْ جَاءَ جَعْفَرٌ» قَالَ »فَوَثَبَ رَسُولُ
اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ فَالْتَزَمَهُ وَ قَبَّلَ مَا بَيْنَ عَيْنَيْهِ» قَالَ فَقَالَ لَهُ الرَّجُلُ الْأَرْبَعُ الرَّكَعَاتِ آلَّتِي بَلَغَنِي أَنْ رَسُولَ
اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ أَمَرَ جَعْفَراً عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ أَنْ يُصَلِّيَهَا فَقَالَ « لَمَّا قَدِمَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ عَلَيْهِ قَالَ لَهُ «يَا جَعْفَرُ أَ
لا أَعْطِيكَ أَلاَ أَمْنَحُكَ أَلا أَحْبُوكَ» » قَالَ «فَتَشَوَّفَ النَّاسُ وَ رَأَوْا أَنَّهُ يُعْطِيهِ ذَهَباً أَوْ فِضَّةً قَالَ بَلَى يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ
قَالَ «صَلَّ أَرْبَعَ رَكَعَاتٍ مَتَى مَا صَلِّيْتَهُنَّ غُفِرَ لَكَ مَا بَيْنَهُنَّ إِنِ اِسْتَطَعْتَ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ وَ إِلاَّ فَكُلَّ يَوْمَيْنٍ أَوْ كُلَّ جُمُعَةِ أَوْ
كُلَّ شَهْرِ أَوْ كُلَّ سَنَةٍ فَإِنَّهُ يُغْفَرُ لَكَ مَا بَيْنَهُمَا» قَالَ كَيْفَ أُصَلِّيهَا قَالَ «تَفْتَتِحُ ٱلصَلاةَ ثُمَّ تَقْرَأْ ثُمَّ تَقُولُ خَمْسَ
عَشرَةَ مَرَّةً وَ أَنْتَ قَائِمٌ - سُبْحَانَ ٱللَّهِ وَ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ وَ لا إِلَهَ إِلَّ ٱللَّهُ وَ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ فَإِذَا رَكَعْتَ قُلْتَ ذَلِكَ عَشراً وَ إِذَا
رَفَعْتَ رَأْسَكَ فَعَشَراً وَ إِذَا سَجَدْتَ فَعَشراً فَإِذَا رَفَعْتَ رَأْسَكَ فَعَشَراً وَ إِذَا سَجَدْتَ الثَّانِيَةَ عَشراً وَ إِذَا رَفَعْتَ
رَأْسَكَ عَشراً فَذَلِكَ خَمْسٌ وَ سَبْعُونَ يَكُونُ ثَلاَثُمِائَةٍ فِي أَرْبَعِ رَكَّعَاتٍ فَهُنَّ أَلْفٌ وَ مِائَتَانٍ وَ تَقْرَأْ فِي كُلِّ رَكْعَةِ بِ
«قُلْ هُوَ اللهُ أَحَدٌ» وَ «قُلْ يَا أَيُّهَا الْكَافِرُونَ» » ».
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Said from Bistam from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
A man said to Imam al-Sadiq {a.s}: “May I be your ransom, is it proper for a man to
embrace his brother?”
Imam {a.s} said: “Yes. Indeed, when the Messenger of Allah {SWT}, blessings on him and
his family, conquered Khaybar, the news came to Him {saws} that Ja’far {a.s} had arrived.
So Prophet {saws} said: ‘By Allah {SWT}, I do not know which of the two gladdens me more;
the arrival of Ja’far {a.s} or the conquest of Khaybar’.”
Imam {a.s} continued: “It was not long before Ja’far {a.s} arrived.
So the Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and his family, leapt up, embraced
him, and kissed him between his eyes.”
The man then said to Imam al-Sadiq {a.s}: “The four rak‘ahs, which I have heard the
Messenger of Allah {SWT}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his family, commanded Ja’far {a.s},
peace be upon him, to pray?”
Imam {a.s} said: “When Ja’far {a.s}, peace be upon him, arrived,
Prophet {saws} said to Imam {a.s}: ‘O Ja’far, shall I not give you something? Shall I not grant
you something? Shall I not bestow something upon you?’”
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} continued: “So the people (around the Prophet {saws}) became
attentive, thinking that He {saws} was going to give Ja’far {a.s} gold or silver.
Ja’far {a.s} said: 'Yes, O Messenger of Allah {SWT}.'
Prophet {saws} said: 'Pray four rak‘ahs, whenever you pray them, whatever is between
them will be forgiven for you. If you are able to perform them every day, then do so.
Otherwise, every two days, or every Friday, or every month, or every year. For indeed,
what is between them will be forgiven for you.'
Ja’far {a.s} asked: 'How do I pray them?'
Prophet {saws} said: 'You begin the prayer, then recite, then say fifteen times while
standing: ‘Subhana Allah, wal-hamdu lillah, wa la ilaha illa Allah, wa Allahu Akbar.’
Then when you bow, say that ten times.
And when you raise your head from the bowing, ten times.
And when you prostrate, ten times.
And when you raise your head from the prostration, ten times.
And when you prostrate the second time, ten times.
And when you raise your head, ten times.
That makes seventy-five (times per rak‘ah), which totals three hundred in four rak‘ahs,
and that is one thousand and two hundred.
And you recite in every rak‘ah: ‘Qul Huwa Allahu Ahad’ (Surah al-Ikhlas) and ‘Qul Ya
ayyuhal-Kafirun’ (Surah al-Kafirun)”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Abu al-Qasim Prophet Muhammad ibn Abdullah {saws}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.186 • Al-Wafi, Vol.9 p.1389 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.50

Chapter Title: THE PRAYER OF TASBIH AND OTHER PRAYERS
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ أَسْبَاطِ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ أَبِي الْبِلاَدِ قَالَ: قُلْتُ
لِأَبِي الْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ أَيُّ شَيْءٍ لِمَنْ صَلَّى صَلاةً جَعْفَرِ قَالَ «لَوْ كَانَ عَلَيْهِ مِثْلُ رَمْلٍ عَالِجِ وَ زَبَدِ الْبَحْرِ ذُنُوباً
لَغَفَرَ اللَّهُ لَهُ» قُلْتُ هَذِهِ لَنَا قَالَ «فَلِمَنْ هِيَ إِلاَّ لَكُمْ خَاصَّةً» قَالَ «فَأَيّ شَيْءٍ تَقْرَأ فِيهَا» قُلْتُ أُعْتَرِضُ ٱلْقُرْآنَ قَالَ
«لا اِقْرَأْ فِيهَا «إِذا زُلْزِلَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ» وَ «إِذَا جَاءَ نَصْرُ اللهِ» وَ «إِنّا أَنْزَلْنَاهُ فِي لَيْلَةِ القَدرِ» وَ «قُلْ هُوَ اللهُ أَحَدٌ»».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya from Ahmad ibn Abi Abdillah from Ali ibn Asbat from Ibrahim ibn Abi al-
Bilad, who said:
I (Ibrahim) asked Abu al-Hasan {a.s}, peace be upon him: “What is the merit for one who
performs the ‘Prayer of Ja’far {a.s}’?”
Imam {a.s} said: “If his sins were as numerous as the sand of Alij and the foam of the
sea, Allah {SWT} would forgive them for him.”
Ibrahim asked: “Is this for us?”
Imam {a.s} said: “And for whom else is it for, if not for you, specifically?”
Imam {a.s} said: “And So what should be recited in it?”
Ibrahim said: “I alternate through the Qur'an.”
Imam {a.s} said: “No. Recite in it: ‘Idha zulzilati al-ardu’ (Surah al-Zalzalah), ‘Idha jaa
nasrullah’ (Surah al-Nasr), ‘Inna anzalnahu fi laylat al-qadr’ (Surah al-Qadr), and ‘Qul
huwa Allahu Ahad’ (Surah Ikhlas).”
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.553 • Thawab Al-A’mal wa ‘Iqab Al-A’mal, Vol.1 p.40 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.186 • Al-Wafi, Vol.9 p.1388 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.54 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.88 p.204

Chapter Title: THE PRAYER OF TASBIH AND OTHER PRAYERS
arabic_text:
وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ عَنِ ابْنِ أبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ عِمْرَانَ عَنْ ذَرِيحِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَلاَمُ قَالَ:
«إِنْ شِئتَ صَلِّ صَلاَةَ التَّسْبِيحِ بِاللَّيْلِ وَ إِنْ شِئْتَ بِالنَّهَارِ وَ إِنْ شِئْتَ فِي السَّفَرِ وَ إِنْ شِئْتَ جَعَلْتَهَا فِي نَوَافِلِكَ وَ
إنْ شِئْتَ جَعَلْتَهَا مِنْ قَضَاءِ صَلاَةٍ».
english_text:
And from him, from Yaqub ibn Yazid, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Yahya ibn Imran, from Dhurayh, from Abu
Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “If you wish, perform the ‘Prayer of Tasbih’ (Salat Ja’far al-
Tayyar) at night, and if you wish, during the day. And if you wish, while traveling. And if
you wish, make it part of your recommended (nafl) prayers. And if you wish, make it as
the makeup (qadah) of an obligatory prayer.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.187 • Al-Wafi, Vol.9 p.1390 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.57 • Al- Fusul Al-Muhimmah, Vol.2 p.110

Chapter Title: THE PRAYER OF TASBIH AND OTHER PRAYERS
arabic_text:
وَ فِي رِوَايَةِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْحَمِيدِ عَنْ أَبِي الْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ : «يُقْرَأْ فِي الْأُولَى إِذَا زُلْزِلَتْ وَ فِي الثَّانِيَةِ وَ
ٱلْعَادِيَاتٍ وَ فِي الثَّالِثَةِ «إِذا جَاءَ نَصْرُ اللهِ» وَ فِي الرّابِعَةِ «قُلْ هُوَ اللهُ أَحَدٌ»» قُلْتُ فَمَا ثَوَابُهَا قَالَ «لَوْ كَانَ عَلَيْهِ
مِثْلُ رَمْلٍ عَالِجِ ذُنُوباً غَفَرَ اللَّهُ لَهُ ثُمَّ نَظَرَ إِلَيَّ فَقَالَ إِنَّمَا ذَلِكَ لَكَ وَ لِأَصْحَابِكَ».
english_text:
And in the narration of Ibrahim ibn Abd al-Hamid from Abu al-Hasan {a.s}, peace be upon him:
Imam al-Kadhim {a.s} said: “In the first rak’ah, ‘Idha zulzilati’ (Surah al-Zalzalah) is
recited; in the second, recite ‘al-Adiyat’ (Surah Al-'Adiyat); in the third, recite ‘Idha jaa
nasrullah’ (Surah al-Nasr); and in the fourth, recite ‘Qul Huwa Allahu Ahad’ (Surah al-
Ikhlas).”
I asked: “What is its reward?”
Imam {a.s} said: “If his sins were as numerous as the sand of Alij, Allah {SWT} would forgive
them for him.”
Then Imam {a.s} looked at me and said: “This is only for you and your companions.”
(meaning our Shia)
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.187 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.54

Chapter Title: THE PRAYER OF TASBIH AND OTHER PRAYERS
arabic_text:
مُحَمِّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ إبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ مُحَسَّنِ بْنِ أَحْمَدَ عَنْ أَبَانِ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسِّلَاَمُ
يَقُولُ: «مَنْ كَانَ مُسْتَعْجِلاً يُصَلِّي صَلاَةَ جَعْفَرِ مُجَرَّدَةَ ثُمَّ يَقْضِي التَّسْبِيحَ وَ هُوَ ذَاهِبٌ فِي حَوَائِجِهِ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Yaqub from Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Muhassin ibn Ahmad from Aban, who said:
I heard Abu Abdillah {a.s} say: “Whoever is in a hurry, may pray the ‘Prayer of Ja’far’ in its
basic form, then complete the tasbih (the prescribed glorifications) while he is going
about his needs.” (meaning away from the prayer mat)
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.466 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.187 • Al-Wafi, Vol.9 p.1392 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.60

Chapter Title: THE PRAYER OF TASBIH AND OTHER PRAYERS
arabic_text:
وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ ذَكَرَهُ عَمَّنْ حَدَّثَهُ عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدِ ٱلْمَدَائِنِيِّ
قَالَ: قَالَ لِي أَبُو عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ «أَلا أُعَلَّمُكَ شَيْئاً تَقُولُهُ فِي صَلاةٍ جَعْفَرٍ » فَقُلْتُ بَلَى فَقَالَ «إِذَا كُنْتَ فِي
آخِرٍ سَجَدَةٍ مِنَ الْأَرْبَعِ رَكَعَاتٍ فَقُلْ إِذَا فَرَغْتَ مِنْ تَسْبِيحِكَ - سُبْحَانَ مَنْ لَبِسَ الْعِزَّ وَ الْوَقَارَ سُبْحَانَ مَنْ تَعَطَّفَ
بِالْمَجْدِ وَ تَكَرَّمَ بِهِ سُبْحَانَ مَنْ لا يَنْبَغِي التَّسْبِيحُ إِلا لَهُ سُبْحَانَ مَنْ أَحْصَى كُلَّ شَيْءٍ عِلْمُهُ سُبْحَانَ ذِي الْمَنِّ وَ
النَّعَمِ سُبْحَانَ ذِي الْقُدْرَةِ وَ الْأَمْرِ اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِمَعَاقِدِ الْعِزَّ مِنْ عَرْشِكَ وَ مُنْتَهَى الرَّحْمَةِ مِنْ كِتَابِكَ وَ اِسْمِكَ
الْأَعْظَمِ وَ كَلِمَاتِكَ التَّامَةِ الَّتِي تَمْثُ صِدقاً وَ عَدْلا صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ أَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ وَ اِفْعَلْ بِي كَذَا وَ كَذَا ».
english_text:
And from him, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Abdillah ibn al-Qasim he
mentioned it from someone who narrated to him from Abu Said al-Madaini, who said:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said to me (al-Madaini):
“Shall I teach you something to say in the ‘Prayer of Ja’far’?”
I said: “Yes.”
Imam {a.s} said: “When you are in the final prostration of the four rak’ahs, then say once
you have completed your tasbih;
‘Glory be to the One who is clothed in might and dignity.
Glory be to the One who is wrapped in majesty and ennobled by it.
Glory be to the One to whom glorification is not fitting except for Him {AZJ}.
Glory be to the One whose knowledge encompasses everything.
Glory be to the Possessor of bounty and blessings.
Glory be to the Possessor of power and command.
O’ Allah {SWT}, I ask You {AZJ} by the stations of might in Your Throne,
and the utmost of mercy in Your Book, and by Your Greatest Name,
and by Your complete words which are fulfilled in truth and justice,
send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad {saws} and his family {a.s},
and do for me (such-and-such) and (such-and-such).”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.467 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.187 • Al-Wafi, Vol.9 p.1393 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.55

Chapter Title: THE PRAYER OF TASBIH AND OTHER PRAYERS
arabic_text:
وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمِّدِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ أَسْبَاطِ عَنِ الْحَكَمِ بْنِ مِسْكِينٍ عَنْ إسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ
قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ مَنْ صَلِّى صَلَاَةَ جَعْفَرِ كُتِبَ لَهُ مِنَ الْأَجْرِ مِثْلُ مَا قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صَلَّى اللهُ
عَلَيْهِ وَ آلهِ لِجَعْفَرٍ قَالَ «إِي وَ اللّهِ».
english_text:
And from him, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ali ibn Asbat, from al-Hakam ibn
Miskin, from Ishaq ibn Ammar, who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him: “Whoever performs the ‘Prayer of Ja’far’,
is it written for him the same reward as that which the Messenger of Allah {SWT}, may
Allah {SWT} bless him and his family, said to Ja’far {a.s}?”
Imam {a.s} said: “Yes, by Allah {SWT}.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Abu al-Qasim Prophet Muhammad ibn Abdullah {saws}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.467 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.188 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.50

Chapter Title: THE PRAYER OF TASBIH AND OTHER PRAYERS
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عِدَّةِ مِنْ أَصْحَابِنَا عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ الْبَرْقِيّ عَنْ سَعْدَانَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللّهِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ
أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: «مَنْ صَلَّى أَرْبَعَ رَكَعَاتٍ يَقْرَأُ فِي كُلِّ رَكْعَةٍ - «قُلْ هُوَ اللهُ أَحَدٌ» خَمْسِينَ مَرّةً لَمْ
بَتْفَتِلْ وَ بَيْنَهُ وَ بَيْنَ اللَّهِ ذَنْبٌ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Yaqub from a group of our companions from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Barqi from
Sadan from Abdillah ibn Sinan from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “Whoever prays four rak’ahs, reciting in each rak’ah ‘Qul Huwa
Allahu Ahad’ (Surah al-Ikhlas) fifty times, will not complete the prayer while there
remains any sin between him and Allah {SWT}.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.468 • Thawab Al-A’mal wa ‘Iqab Al-A’mal, Vol.1 p.40 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.188 • Al-Wafi, Vol.9 p.1395 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.115 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.88 p.171 • Tafsir Nur Al-Thaqalayn, Vol.5 p.703

Chapter Title: THE PRAYER OF TASBIH AND OTHER PRAYERS
arabic_text:
وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ بِإِسْنَادِهِ عَنْ بَعْضِهِمْ عَلَيْهِمُ السِّلاَمُ : فِي قَوْلِ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ «إِنَّ نَاشِئَةَ اللَّيْلِ هِيَ أَشَدُّ
وَظئاً وَ أَقْوَمُ قِيلاً» قَالَ «هِيَ رَكْعَتَانِ بَعْدَ ٱلْمَغْرِبِ تَقْرَأْ فِي أَوَّلِ رَكْعَةِ - بِفَاتِحَةِ الْكِتَابِ وَ عَشَرٍ مِنْ أَوَّلِ ٱلْبَقَرَةِ وَ
آيَةِ السُّخْرَةِ مِنْ قَوْلِهِ »وَ إِلْهُكُمْ إِلَهٌ وَاحِدٌ لا إِلَهَ إِلا هُوَ الرَّحْمَنُ الرَّحِيمُ إِنَّ فِي خَلْقِ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَ الْأَرْضِ وَ اِخْتِلافِ
اللَّيْلِ وَ النَّهَارِ» إِلَى قَوْلِهِ «لَآيَاتٍ لِقَوْمٍ يَعْقِلُونَ» وَ خَمْسَ عَشْرَةَ مَرَّةً «قُلْ هُوَ اللهُ أَحَدٌ» وَ فِي الرَّكْعَةِ الثَّانِيَةِ فَاتِحَةَ
اَلْكِتَابِ وَ آيَةَ الْكُرْسِيِّ وَ آخِرَ الْبَقَرَةِ مِنْ قَوْلِهِ «لِلّهِ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَ مَا فِي الْأَرْضِ» إِلَى أَنْ تَخْتِمَ السُّورَةَ وَ
خَمْسَ عَشرَةَ مَرَّةً «قُلْ هُوَ اللهُ أَحَدٌ» ثُمَّ أدْعُ بَعدَ هَذَا بِمَا شِئْتَ» قَالَ «وَ مَنْ وَاظَبَ عَلَيْهِ كَتَبَ ٱللَّهُ لَهُ بِكُلَ صَلاةٍ
سِتَّمِائَةٍ أَلْفِ حَجَّةٍ».
٢١ - باب الصلاة على الاموات
قال الشيخ رحمه اللّٰه : والصلاة عليهم تكبير ودعاء واستغفار. إلى قوله : فإذا حضرت.
english_text:
And from him, from Ali ibn Muhammad, with his chain of narration from one of the Imams {a.s}, peace be upon
them:
Imam {a.s} was asked regarding the saying of Allah {SWT}, the Mighty and Majestic:
“Indeed, the rising at night is strongest in impression and more upright in speech”
(Surah Al Muzzammil 73:6)
Imam {a.s} said: “It is two rak’ahs after Maghrib in which you recite in the first rak’ah with
the ‘Fatihat al-Kitab’ (Surah al-Fatihah) and ten (verses) from the beginning of Surah
al-Baqarah, and the verse of submission (Ayat al-Sukhrah) from His {AZJ} saying:
‘And your God is one God; there is no deity except Him, the Most Merciful, the Most
Compassionate. Indeed, in the creation of the heavens and the earth, and the
alternation of the night and the day’ up to His {AZJ} saying:
‘Surely in that are signs for a people who use reason.’” (Surah Al Baqarah 2:163–164).
(Imam {a.s} then continued)
“And (recite) fifteen times; ‘Qul Huwa Allahu Ahad’ (Surah Ikhlas),
And in the second rak’ah, recite the ‘Fatihat al-Kitab’ (Surah al-Fatihah), and Ayat al-
Kursi, and the end of Surah al-Baqarah from His {AZJ} saying:
‘To Allah {SWT} belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth’ (Surah
Al Baqarah 2:284) until you complete the surah.
And recite fifteen times; ‘Qul Huwa Allahu Ahad’ (Surah Ikhlas),
Then supplicate after this with whatever you wish.”
Imam {a.s} said: “And whoever maintains it regularly, Allah {SWT} will write for him with
every prayer six hundred thousand pilgrimages (hajj).”
source: Implicit (Muzmar)
commentary:
The Shaykh (Al-Mufid), may Allah {SWT} have mercy on him, said: “And the prayer over
them (deceased) is glorification, supplication, and seeking forgiveness” up to his
statement: “Then when (the time of the funeral) arrives.”
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.468 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.188 • Al-Wafi, Vol.9 p.1399 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.118 • Tafsir Nur Al-Thaqalayn, Vol.5 p.448 • Tafsir Kanz Al-Daqaiq, Vol.13 p.501

arabic_text:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أُذَيْنَةَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ وَ زُرَارَةَ أَنَّهُمَا سَمِعَا أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ
يَقُولُ: «لَيْسَ فِي الصَّلاَةِ عَلَى ٱلْمَيِّتِ قِرَاءَةٌ وَ لاَ دُعَاءُ مُوَقّتْ إِلاَّا أَنْ تَدْعُوَ بِمَا بَدَا لَكَ وَ أَحَقُ ٱلْأَمْوَاتِ أَنْ يُدْعَى لَهُ
أَنْ يُبْدَأْ بِالصَّلاَةِ عَلَى اَلنَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ ».
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Said from Ibn Abi Umayr from Ibn Udhaynah from Muhammad ibn Muslim and Zurarah, both
of them heard Aba Ja’far {a.s}, peace be upon him, say:
Imam al-Baqir {a.s} said: “There is no prescribed recitation nor fixed supplication in the
prayer over the dead, except that you may supplicate with whatever occurs to you.
And the one most deserving among the dead for whom supplication should be made,
is he for whom the prayer begins with the blessings upon the Prophet {saws}, may Allah
{SWT} bless him and his family.”
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.189 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.3 p.89

arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عِدَّةٍ مِنْ أَصْحَابِنَا عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ
اَلْحَضْرَمِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ الْحَضْرَمِيِّ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السِّلاَمُ : «يَا أَبَا بَكْرٍ أَتَدْرِي كَمِ الصَّلاةُ عَلَى الْمَيِّتِ»
قُلْتُ لا قَالَ «خَمْسُ تَكْبِيرَاتٍ فَتَدْرِي مِنْ أَيْنَ أُخِذَتِ الْخَمْسُ تَكْبِيرَاتٍ» قُلْتُ لا قَالَ «أُخِذَتِ الْخَمْسُ تَكْبِيرَاتٍ
مِنِ الْخَمْسِ صَلَوَاتُ مِنْ كُلِّ صَلاَةٍ تَكْبِيرَةٌ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Yaqub from a number of our companions from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn al-
Hakam from Uthman ibn Abd al-Malik al-Hadrami from Abu Bakr al-Hadrami, he said:
