narrated to us from Ja’far ibn Bashir from Hisham ibn Salim from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said:
I asked Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} about the woman, can she lead other women in prayer?
Imam {a.s} said: “She may lead them in the nafilah (supererogatory prayer), but as for
the maktoobah (obligatory prayer), then no.
And she should not stand in front of them, but rather she stands in the middle of
them.” (meaning other women will join her shoulder-to-shoulder either side of her)
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.396 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.205

arabic_text:
وَ عَنْهُ عَنِ الْعَبَّاسِ بْنِ ٱلْمُغِيرَةِ قَالَ حَدَّتَنِي الْفَضْلُ بْنُ شَاذَانَ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَادٍ عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ
أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: قُلْتُ الْمَرْأَةُ تَوُمُّ النَّسَاءَ قَالَ «لَا إِلَّ عَلَى الْمَيَّتِ إِذَا لَمْ يَكُنْ أَحَدٌ أَوْلَى مِنْهَا تَقُومُ
وَسَطَهُنَّ فِي الصَّفّ فَتُكَبِّرُ وَ يُكَبَّرْنَ».
english_text:
And from him, from al-Abbas ibn al-Mughirah, who said: al-Fadl ibn Shadhan narrated to me from Ibn Abi
‘Umayr from Hammad from Hariz from Zurarah from Abu Ja’far {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Imam al-Baqir {a.s}: “Can a woman lead other women in prayer?”
Imam {a.s} said: “No, except over the deceased (Salat Al Mayyit), if there is no one more
entitled than her. She stands in the middle of them in the row, and she says the takbir,
and they say the takbir.”
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.397 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.206 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.268 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.326 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.331 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.427 • Al- Wafi, Vol.8 p.1225 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.418 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.3 p.117 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.334

arabic_text:
عَلِيّ بْنُ إبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ طَلْحَةَ بْنِ زَيْدِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلَاَمُ قَالَ: «إِذَا حَضَرَ
اَلْإِمَامُ الْجِنَازَةَ فَهُوَ أَحَقُ النَّاسِ بِالصَّلَاَةِ عَلَيْهَا».
english_text:
Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Talhah ibn Zayd from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “If the Imam is present at the funeral, then he is the most
entitled of the people to perform the prayer over it.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.177 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.206 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.415 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.3 p.114

arabic_text:
مُحَمّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ إبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ هَاشِمِ عَنِ النَّوْفَلِيَ عَنِ السَّكُونِيّ عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ آبَائِهِ عَلَيْهِمُ
السَّلَامُ قَالَ قَالَ أَمِيرُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ : «إِذَا حَضَرَ سُلْطَانٌ مِنْ سُلْطَانِ اللّهِ جِنَازَةً فَهُوَ أَحَقُّ بِالصَّلاَةِ عَلَيْهَا
إِنْ قَدَّمَهُ وَلِيّ الْمَيَّتِ وَ إِلا فَهُوَ غَاصِبٌ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya from Ibrahim ibn Hashim from al-Nawfali from al-Sakuni from Imam Ja’far
{a.s} from his father Imam al-Baqir {a.s}, from his forefathers, peace be upon them, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “The Commander of the Faithful {a.s}, peace be upon him, said:
‘If a ruler among the rulers of Allah {SWT} (meaning Imam {a.s}), is present at a funeral, then
he is the most entitled to perform the prayer (Salat Al Mayyit) over it, if the guardian of
the deceased permits him.
Otherwise, he (one who assumed without permission) is a usurper (Gasib).”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Amir al-Mu’minin Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib al-Murtadha {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.206 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.416 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.3 p.114

arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ مِهْرَانَ عَنْ سَيْفِ بْنِ عَمِيرَةَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَلاَمُ
قَالَ: «لا يُصَلَّى عَلَى الْجِنَازَةِ بِحِذَاءٍ وَ لا بَأْسَ بِالْخُفِّ».
كتاب الصلاة - الجزء الثاني
٢٣ - باب الصلاة في السفر
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ya‘qub from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Isma’il ibn Mehran from Sayf ibn ‘Umayrah from Abu
Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “One should not perform the funeral prayer in shoes (bi-
hidha’), but there is no harm in (performing Salat Al Mayyit) in leather socks (khuff).”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.176 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.206 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.426 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.3 p.118 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.78 p.366 BOOK OF SALAT - PART TWO BOOK OF SALAT - PART TWO

arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ عَنِ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ عَنِ ٱلْحَسَنِ عَنْ زُرْعَةَ عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ ٱلْمُسَافِرِ فِي
كَمْ يُقَصِّرُ الصَّلاةَ فَقَالَ «فِي مَسِيرَةِ يَوْمٍ وَ ذَلِكَ بَرِيدَانِ وَ هُمَا ثَمَانِيَةُ فَرَاسِخَ وَ مَنْ سَافَرَ قَصَّرَ الصَلاةَ وَ أَفْطَرَ إِلاّا
أَنْ يَكُونَ رَجُلاً مُشَيِّعاً أَوْ خَرَجَ إِلَى صَيْدٍ أَوْ إِلَى قَرْيَةٍ لَهُ يَكُونُ مَسِيرَةَ يَوْمِ يَبِيتُ إِلَى أَهْلِهِ لا يُقَصِّرُ وَ لا يُفْطِرُ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Ahmad from al-Husayn from al-Hasan from Zur’ah from Sama’ah, said:
I asked Imam {a.s} about the traveller, at what distance does he shorten the prayer?
Imam {a.s} said: “At the distance of a day’s journey, and that is two ‘barid’, which is eight
‘farsakh’.
And whoever travels, shortens the prayer and breaks the fast, unless he is a man
seeing someone off (mushayyi’), or he goes out for hunting, or to a village of his where
the journey is a day’s travel and he spends the night with his family.
In that case, he does not shorten (the prayer) and does not break the fast.”
source: Implicit (Muzmar)
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.207 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.222 • Al-Wafi, Vol.11 p.308

arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْن مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ يَحْيَى الْكَاهِلِيِّ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ يَقُولُ:
فِي التَّقْصِيرٍ فِي الصَّلاَةِ قَالَ «بَرِيدٌ فِي بَرِيدِ أَرْبَعَةٌ وَ عِشَرُونَ مِيلاً».
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn al-Hakam from Abdillah ibn Yahya al-Kahili, who said:
I heard Abu Abdillah {a.s}, speaking about shortening the prayer (taqsir).
Imam {a.s} said: “A ‘barid’ by a ‘barid’, which is twenty-four miles.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.207 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.223 • Tafsir Al-Burhan, Vol.2 p.163

arabic_text:
فَأَمَّا مَا رَوَاهُ عَلِيْ بْنُ إبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ جَمِيلٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ:
«التَّقْصِيرُ فِي بَرِيدِ وَ الْبَرِيدُ أَرْبَعَةُ فَرَاسِخَ».
english_text:
As for what was narrated by Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Ibn Abi 'Umayr from Jamil from Zurarah from
Abu Ja’far {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Baqir {a.s} said: “Shortening (the prayer, ‘al-taqsir’) is at a ‘barid’, and a ‘barid’
is four ‘farsakh’.”
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.207 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.4 p.223

arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ أَبِي أَيُوبَ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لأَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ أَدْنَى مَا يُقَصِّرُ فِيهِ ٱلْمُسَافِرُ
فَقَالَ «بَرِيدٌ».
فلا تنافي بين هذين الخبرين وبين الخبرين الاولين لان الوجه فيهما ان المسافر إذا أراد الرجوع من يومه فقد وجب عليه
التقصير في أربعة فراسخ ، يدل على ذلك ما رواه :
english_text:
From him, from his father, from Ibn Abi ‘Umayr, from Abu Ayyub, who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him: “What is the minimum distance at which
the traveller shortens (the prayer)?”
Imam {a.s} said: “A ‘barid’.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
commentary:
So there is no contradiction between these two reports and the first two reports,
because the interpretation of them is that if the traveller intends to return on the same
day, then shortening the prayer becomes obligatory upon him, at a distance of four
‘farsakh’. This is supported by what was narrated:
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.432 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.207 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.4 p.223 • Al- Istibsar, Vol.1 p.223 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.123 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.460

arabic_text:
سَعَدٌ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ بْنِ أَيُوبَ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ وَهْبِ قَالَ: قُلْتُ
لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ أَدْنَى مَا يُقَصِّرُ فِيهِ الْمُسَافِرُ فَقَالَ «بَرِيدٌ ذَاهِباً وَ بَرِيدٌ جَائِياً».
على ان الذي نقوله في ذلك انه يجب القصر إذا كان مقدار السفر ثمانية فراسخ وإذا كان أربعة فراسخ كان بالخيار في
ذلك إن شاء أتم وإن شاء قصر، والذي يدل على جوار التقصير في أربعة فراسخ ما رواه:
english_text:
Sa’ad from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Fadalah ibn Ayyub from Mu'awiyah
ibn Wahb, who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him: “What is the minimum distance at which
the traveller shortens the prayer?”
Imam {a.s} said: “A ‘barid’ going, and a ‘barid’ returning.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
commentary:
Moreover, what we affirm in this matter is that shortening the prayer (al-qasr) becomes
obligatory when the total distance of the journey is eight farsakh. And if it is four
farsakh, then the traveller has the option if he wishes, he may pray in full, and if he
wishes, he may shorten. What indicates the permissibility of shortening the prayer at
four farsakh is what was narrated:
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.208 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.223 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.130 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.456

arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ بُكَيْرٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ عَنِ الْقَادِسِيَّةِ
أَخْرُجْ إلَيْهَا أَتِمُ أَمْ أَقَصِّرُ قَالَ «وَكَمْ هِيَ» قُلْتُ هِيَ الَّتِي رَأَيْتَ قَالَ «قَصِّرْ».
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Abi ‘Umayr from Abdillah ibn Bukayr, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, about al-Qadisiyyah. When I go out to it,
should I pray in full or shorten?
Imam {a.s} said: “And how far is it?”
I said: “It is the one you saw.”
He said: “Shorten (the prayer).”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.208 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.224 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.127 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.458

arabic_text:
سَعدٌ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عُثِمَانَ عَنْ أَبِي أُسَامَةَ زَيْدِ الشَّحَّامِ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ
أَبَا عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ يَقُولُ: «يُقَصِّرُ الرَّجُلُ الصَّلاَةَ فِي مَسِيرَةِ اِثنَي عَشَرَ مِيلاً».
english_text:
Sa’ad from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Husayn from Fadalah from Hammad ibn Uthman from Abu
Usamah Zayd al-Shahham, who said:
I heard Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, say: “A man shortens the prayer on a
journey of twelve miles.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.208 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.4 p.223 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.224 • Al- Wafi, Vol.7 p.126 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.456

arabic_text:
وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ
فِي كَمْ أَقَصِّرُ الصَّلاةَ فَقَالَ «فِي بَرِيدِ أَلا تَرَى أَنَّ أَهْلَ مَكَّةَ إِذَا خَرَجُوا إِلَى عَرَفَةَ كَانَ عَلَيْهِمُ التَّقْصِيرُ».
english_text:
And from him, from Abu Ja’far from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal from Mu‘awiyah ibn ‘Ammar, who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him: “At what distance do I shorten the
prayer?”
Imam {a.s} said: “At a ‘barid’. Do you not see that the people of Mecca, when they go out
to ‘Arafah, shortening becomes obligatory upon them?”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.208 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.224 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.127 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.464

arabic_text:
وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ أَبِي الْخَطَابِ عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ بَشِيرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عُثُمَانَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ النُّعْمَانِ عَنْ
إسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ الْفَضْلِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ عَنِ التَّقْصِيرِ فَقَالَ «فِي أَرْبَعَةِ فَرَاسِخَ».
٢٦٩
english_text:
And from him, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn ibn Abi al-Khattab from Ja’far ibn Bashir from Hammad ibn
Uthman from Muhammad ibn al-Nu‘man from Isma’il ibn al-Fadl, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, about shortening the prayer.
Imam {a.s} said: “At four ‘farsakh’.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.208 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.224 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.127 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.457

arabic_text:
وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ حُكَيْمِ عَنْ أَبِي مَالِكِ الْحَضْرَمِيّ عَنْ أَبِي الْجَارُودِ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لأَبِي
جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ فِي كَمِ التَّقْصِيرُ فَقَالَ «فِي بَرِيدِ».
english_text:
And from him, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from Mu'awiyah ibn Hakim from Abu Malik al-Hadrami from
Abu al-Jarud, who said:
I said to Abu Ja’far {a.s}, peace be upon him: “At what distance is the shortening (of
prayer)?”
Imam {a.s} said: “At a ‘barid’.”
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.209 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.224 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.127 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.458

arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ حُكَيْمٍ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ الْخَتَعَمِيِّ عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَمَّارِ قَالَ: قُلْتُ
الأَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلاَمُ فِي كَمِ التَّقْصِيرُ فَقَالَ «فِي بَرِيدِ وَيُحَهُمْ كَأَنْهُمْ لَمْ يَحُجُوا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ
عَلَيْهِ وَ آلهِ فَقَصَّرُوا».
english_text:
From him, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from Mu‘awiyah ibn Hakim from Sulayman ibn Muhammad al-
Khath‘ami from Ishaq ibn ‘Ammar, who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him: “At what distance is the shortening (of
prayer)?”
Imam {a.s} said: “At one ‘barid’. Woe to them! (meaning the opponents)
It is as if they did not perform Hajj with the Messenger of Allah {SWT}, may Allah {SWT} bless
him and his family, and shorten (their prayers).”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.209 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.225 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.128 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.464

arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ بْنِ يَقْطِينٍ عَنْ أَجِيهِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَلِيَّ بْنِ يَقْطِينٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا الْحَسَنِ الْأَوّلَ
عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يَخْرُجُ فِي سَفَرِهِ وَ هُوَ مَسِيرَةُ يَوْمِ قَالَ «يَجِبُ عَلَيْهِ التَّقْصِيرُ إِذَا كَانَ مَسِيرَةَ يَوْمِ وَ إِنْ
كانَ يَدُورُ فِي عَمَلِهِ ».
english_text:
From him, from Abu Ja’far, from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Yaqtin, from his brother, from their father Ali ibn Yaqtin,
who said:
I asked Abu al-Hasan al-Awwal (a.s} (the First), peace be upon him, about a man who
sets out on a journey and it is the distance of a day.
Imam al-Kadhim {a.s} said: “He is obligated to shorten (the prayer) if it is the distance of
a day, even if he is going around for his work (‘ya-duuru fi amalihi’).”
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.209 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.225 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.130 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.455

arabic_text:
فَأَمَّا مَا رَوَاهُ أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي نَصْرٍ عَنْ أَبِي الْحَسَنِ الرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ ٱلسّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ ٱلرَّجُلِ يُرِيدُ
السَّفَرَ فِي كَمْ يُقَصِّرُ فَقَالَ «فِي ثَلاَثَةِ بُرُدٍ».
فهذا خبر موافق للعامة ولسنا نعمل به.
english_text:
As for what was narrated by Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ibn Abi Nasr from Abu al-Hasan al-Ridha {a.s}, peace
be upon him, he said:
I asked Imam al-Ridha {a.s} about a man who intends to travel, at what distance does he
shorten (the prayer)?
Imam {a.s} said: “At three ‘barid’ (‘burud’).”
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Ali ibn Musa al-Ridha {a.s}
commentary:
So this is a report in agreement with the 'amma (the general public, meaning non-
Shia), and we (Shia) do not act upon it.
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.209

arabic_text:
فَأَمَّا مَا رَوَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَمِيلَةَ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي
عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ قَالَ: «لا بَأْسَ لِلْمُسَافِرِ أَنْ يُتِمَّ السَّفَرَ مَسِيرَةَ يَوْمَيْنِ».
فهذا الخبر ايضا موافق للعامة وليس عليه العمل لان الذي يجب فيه التقصير القدر الذي ذكرناه سواء كانت مسيرة يومين
أو أقل أو أكثر، ويجوز أن يكن الخبر محمولا على من يسير في اليومين أقل مما يجب فيه التقصير فخينئذ يجب عليه
التمام، والذي يكشف عما ذكرناه ما رواه:
english_text:
As for what was narrated by Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Ahmad from al-Hasan ibn Mahbub from
Abu Jamila from Abu Basir from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, he said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “There is no harm for the traveller to complete (the prayer) if
the journey is the distance of two days.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
commentary:
So this report is also in agreement with the 'amma (the general public, meaning non-
Shia), and it is not acted upon, because that in which shortening (of the prayer) is
obligatory is the measure we have mentioned, whether it be a journey of two days or
less or more.
And it is permissible that the report be interpreted as referring to someone who, in the
two days, travels less than the distance in which shortening is obligatory so in that
case, completion (of the prayer) is obligatory upon him. What clarifies what we have
mentioned is what was narrated:
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.209

arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ أَبِي أَيُوبَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ
قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ التَّقْصِيرِ قَالَ فَقَالَ «فِي بَرِيدَيْنِ أَوْ بَيَاضٍ يَوْمٍ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Yaqub ibn Yazid from Ibn Abi Umayr from Abu Ayyub from Abu Abdillah
{a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} about shortening (the prayer).
Imam {a.s} said: “At two ‘barid’ (‘buridayn’) or the brightness of a day (‘bayad yawm’).”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.210 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.225 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.131 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.453

arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنِ الْعَبَّاسِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللّهِ بْنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ إِنَّ أَهْلَ مَكَّةَ
يُتِمُّونَ الصَّلاَةَ بِعَرَفَاتٍ قَالَ «وَيْلَهُمْ أَوْ وَيُحَهُمْ وَ أَيْ سَفَرِ أَشَدُّ مِنْهُ لا ثُتِمَّ».
english_text:
From him, from al-Abbas, from Abdillah ibn al-Mughira, from Muawiyah ibn Ammar, who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him: “Indeed, the people of Mecca complete
the prayer (in full) at Arafat.”
Imam {a.s} said: “Woe to them! (Or ‘May they be ruined!’ (waylahum aw wayhahum))
And what journey is more strenuous than that? Do not complete (the prayer in full).”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.4 p.519 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.2 p.466 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.210 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.128 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.463

arabic_text:
سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ أَبَانِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ إسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ
الْفَضْلِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ سَافَرَ مِنْ أَرْضِ إِلَى أَرْضِ وَ إِنَّمَا يَنْزِلُ قُرَاهُ وَ ضَيْعَتَهُ قَالَ
«إِذَا نَزَلْتَ قُرَاكَ وَ ضَيْعَتَكَ فَأْتِمَّ الصَّلاةَ وَ إِذَا كُنُتَ فِي غَيْرِ أَرْضِكَ فَقَصِّرْ».
english_text:
Sa’ad ibn Abdillah from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Faddalah from Aban ibn
Uthman from Isma'il ibn al-Fadl, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, about a man who travelled from one land
to another and only stayed in his villages and his estate.
Imam {a.s} said: “If you settle in your villages and estate, then complete the prayer, and
if you are in other than your own land, then shorten (the prayer).”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.210 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.228 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.158 • Bihar Al- Anwar, Vol.86 p.36

arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ عِمْرَانَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي جَعْفَرِ النَّانِي عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ
جُعِلْتُ فِدَاكَ إنَّ لِي ضَيْعَةً عَلَى خَمْسَةَ عَشَرَ مِيلاً خَمْسَةِ فَرَاسِخَ فَرُبَّمَا خَرَجْتُ إِلَيْهَا فَأَقِيمُ فِيهَا ثَلاَثَةَ أَيَّامِ أَوْ
خَمْسَةَ أَيَّامٍ أَوْ سَبْعَةَ أَيَّامٍ فَأْتِمُ الصَّلاةَ أَمْ أُقَصِّرُ فَقَالَ «قَصِّرْ فِي الطَّرِيقِ وَ أَتِمّ فِي الضَّيْعَةِ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Muhammad ibn Isa from Imran ibn Muhammad, who said:
I said to Abu Ja’far al-Thani {a.s}: “May I be your ransom, I have an estate at a distance
of fifteen miles, five parasangs (‘faraasikh’), so sometimes I go out to it and stay there
for three days, or five days, or seven days. Should I complete the prayer or shorten it?”
Imam {a.s} said: “Shorten (the prayer) on the way, and complete in the estate.”
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Jawad {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.210 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.229 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.159 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.496 • Awalim Al-Uloom, Vol.23 p.405

arabic_text:
وَعَنْهُ عَنْ عَلِيّ بْنِ إسْحَاقَ بْنِ سَعْدِ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ ٱلْخَزْرَجِ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي الْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلَامُ أَخْرُجْ إِلَى ضَيْعَتِي
وَ مِنْ مَنْزِلِي إِلَيْهَا اِثْنَا عَشَرَ فَرْسَخاً أَتِمُ الصَّلاةَ أَمْ أُقَصِّرُ قَالَ «أَتِمَّ».
english_text:
And from him, from Ali ibn Ishaq ibn Sa’ad from Musa ibn al-Khazraj, who said:
I said to Abu al-Hasan {a.s}, peace be upon him: “I go out to my estate, and from my
house to it, is twelve parasangs. Should I complete the prayer or shorten it?”
Imam {a.s} said: “Complete (the prayers in full).”
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.210 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.229 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.158 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.496

arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سَهْلٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا الْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ يَسِيرُ إِلَى ضَيْعَتِهِ عَلَى بَرِيدَيْنِ أَوْ
ثَلاَثَةٍ وَ مَمَرْهُ عَلَى صِيَاعِ بَنِي عَمِّهِ أَيُقَصِّرُ وَ يُفْطِرُ أَوْ يُتِمْ وَ يَصُومُ قَالَ «لا يُقَصِّرُ وَ لاَ يُفطِرُ».
english_text:
From him, from Muhammad ibn Sahl from his father, who said:
I asked Abu al-Hasan {a.s}, peace be upon him, about a man who travels to his estate at
a distance of two or three ‘barid’, and his route passes through the estates of his
cousins. Should he shorten (the prayer) and break his fast, or complete (the prayer)
and fast?
Imam {a.s} said: “He does not shorten (the prayers), and he does not break his fast.”
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s} & Abu al-Hasan Imam Ali ibn Musa al-Ridha {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.211 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.229 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.161 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.496 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.510

arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيّى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدِ الْمَدَائِنِيِّ عَنْ مُصَدِّقِ بْنِ
صَدَقَةَ عَنْ عَمَّارِ بْنِ مُوسَى عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ : فِي الرَّجُلِ يَخْرُجُ فِي سَفَرِهِ فَيَمُرُّ بِقَرْيَةٍ لَهُ أَوْ دَارٍ
فَيَنْزِلُ فِيهَا قَالَ «يُتِمُّ الصَّلاةَ وَ لَوْ لَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ إِلاَّ نَخْلَةٌ وَاحِدَةٌ وَ لاَ يُقَصِّرُ وَ لْيَصُمْ إِذَا حَضَرَهُ الصَّوْمُ وَ هُوَ فِيهَا».
قال محمد بن الحسن : ما تتضمن هذه الاخبار من الامر بالاتمام في ضيعة الانسان يحتمل وجوها منها انه إنما
أمر بالاتمام إذا أراد المقام عشرة ايام والذي يدل على ذلك ما رواه:
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal from Amr ibn Sa'id al-Mada'ini
from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah from Ammar ibn Musa from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said regarding a man who sets out on a journey and passes by a
village or a house of his and stays in it.
Imam {a.s} said: “He should complete the prayer, even if he possesses nothing there,
except a single palm tree, and he should not shorten (the prayers).
And he should fast, if fasting becomes due, while he is there.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
commentary:
Muhammad ibn al-Hasan said: “What these reports contain regarding the command
to complete (the prayer) in a person's estate, carries several possible meanings.
Among them is that he was only commanded to complete, when he intended to stay
for ten days. What indicates this is what was narrated:
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.211 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.229 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.158 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.493 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.86 p.36

arabic_text:
سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ هَاشِمٍ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ مَرَّارٍ عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ عَبْدِ ٱلرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ
عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: «مَنْ أَتَّى ضَيْعَتَهُ ثُمّ لَمْ يُرِدِ ٱلْمُقَامَ عَشَرَةَ أَيَّامٍ قَصْرَ وَ إِنْ أَرَادَ ٱلْمُقَامَ عَشَرَةَ
أَيَّامِ أَنَمَّ الصَّلَاةَ».
english_text:
Sa’ad ibn Abdillah from Ibrahim ibn Hashim from Isma'il ibn Marrar from Yunus ibn Abd al-Rahman from
Abdillah ibn Sinan from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “Whoever comes to his estate and does not intend to stay for
ten days, he should shorten (the prayer), but if he intends to stay for ten days, he
should complete the prayer.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.211 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.229 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.160 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.499

arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنِ الْبَرْقِيِّ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ جَعْفَرِ الْجَعْفَرِيَّ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ حَمْرَةَ بْنِ بَزِيع قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي الْحَسَنِ
عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ جُعِلْتُ فِدَاكَ إِنَّ لِي ضَيْعَةً دُونَ بَغْدَادَ فَأَخْرُجُ مِنَ ٱلْكُوفَةِ أُرِيدُ بَغْدَادَ فَأْقِيمُ فِي تِلْكَ الضَّيْعَةِ فَأْقَصِّرُ
أَمْ أُتِم فَقَالَ «إِنْ لَمْ تَنو الْمُقَامَ عَشراً فَقَصِّرْ».
والوجه الثاني ان تكون الاخبار محمولة على من يمر بمنزل له كان قد استوطنه ستة أشهر فصاعدا فحينئذ يجب عليه
التمام، يدل على ذلك ما رواه :
english_text:
From him, from Ibrahim from al-Barqi from Sulayman ibn Ja’far al-Ja’fari from Musa ibn Hamzah ibn Baziy',
who said:
I said to Abu al-Hasan {a.s}, peace be upon him: “May I be your ransom, I have an estate
before reaching Baghdad. I set out from Kufah, intending to go onwards to Baghdad,
but I stay in that estate. Should I shorten or complete (the prayer)?”
Imam {a.s} said: “If you do not intend to stay for ten (days), then shorten (the prayers).”
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s} & Abu al-Hasan Imam Ali ibn Musa al-Ridha {a.s}
commentary:
And the second possibility is that the reports are to be understood as referring to
someone who passes by a dwelling of his, which he had resided in for six months or
more at that point, completing the prayer is obligatory upon him.
What indicates this is what was narrated:
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.211 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.159

arabic_text:
سَعْدٌ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي نَصْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ عَلِيّ بْنِ يَقْطِينِ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لأَبِي الْحَسَنِ ٱلْأَوْلِ
عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ الرَّجُلُ يَتَّخِذُ ٱلْمَنْزِلَ فَيَمُرُ بِهِ أَيُتِمُ صَلاَتَهُ أَمْ يُقَصِّرُ قَالَ «كُلُّ مَنزِلِ لا تَسْتَوْطِنْهُ فَلَيْسَ لَكَ بِمَنَزِلٍ وَ
لَيْسَ لَكَ أَنْ تُتِمّ فِيهِ».
english_text:
Sa’ad from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ibn Abi Nasr from Hammad ibn Uthman from Ali ibn Yaqtin, who
said:
I said to Abu al-Hasan al-Awwal {a.s} (the First), peace be upon him: “A man establishes
a house and passes by it. Should he perform his prayer in full or shorten it?”
Imam {a.s} said: “Every house that you do not take as a permanent residence
(‘tastawtinu-hu’) is not considered your home, and you are not to perform the prayer
in full in it.”
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.212 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.230 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.160 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.493 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.86 p.37

arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ بْنِ يَقْطِينٍ عَنْ أَجِيهِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ عَلِيَّ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا الْحَسَنِ الْأَوْلَ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلَام - عَنْ رَجُلِ يَمُرُ بِبَعْضِ الْأَمْصَارِ وَلَهُ بِالْمِصْرِ دَار وَ لَيْسَ الْمِصْرُ وَطَنَهُ أَيُتِمُ صَلاَتَهُ أَمْ يُقَصِّرُ قَالَ «يُقَصِّرُ
الصَّلاَةَ وَ الضَّيَاعُ مِثْلُ ذَلِكَ إِذَا مَرَّ بِهَا».
english_text:
From him, from Ahmad from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Yaqtin from his brother al-Husayn from Ali, who said:
I asked Abu al-Hasan al-Awwal {a.s} (the First), peace be upon him, about a man who
passes through some cities, and he has a house in that city, but the city is not his
homeland. Should he complete his prayer or shorten it?
Imam {a.s} said: “He should shorten the prayer, and estates (al-diya’) are the same in
that regard, if he passes through them.”
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.212 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.161 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.493 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.86 p.37

arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ أَيُّوبَ بْنِ نُوحِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عُثُمَانَ عَنِ الْحَلَبِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ : فِي
الرَّجُلِ يُسَافِرُ فَيَمُرُ بِالْمَنْزِلِ لَهُ فِي الطَّرِيقِ يُتِمُ الصَّلاةَ أَمْ يُقَصِّرُ قَالَ «يُقَصِّرُ إِنَّمَا هُوَ ٱلْمَنْزِلُ الَّذِي تَوَطَّنَهُ».
english_text:
From him, by Ayyub ibn Nuh by Ibn Abi Umayr by Hammad ibn Uthman by al-Halabi from Abu Abdillah {a.s}:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} was asked regarding a man who travels and passes by a house of
his, on the road. Should he complete the prayer or shorten it?
Imam {a.s} said: “He should shorten (the prayers). Prayer is only (performed in full) in
the house that he has settled in permanently (‘tawattanahu’).”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.212 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.230 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.160 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.493

arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ أَيُوبَ عَنْ صَفَوَانَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي خَلَفٍ قَالَ سَأَلَ عَلِيْ بْنُ يَقْطِينٍ أَبَا الْحَسَنِ الْأَوّلَ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلامُ : عَنِ الدَّارِ تَكُونُ لِلرَّجُلِ بِمِصْرٍ أَوِ الضَّيْعَةِ فَيَمُرْ بِهَا قَالَ «إِذَا كَانَ مِمَّا قَدْ سَكَنَهُ أَتَمَّ فِيهِ الصَّلاةَ وَ إِنْ كَانَ
مِمَّا لَمْ يَسْكُنْهُ فَلْيُقَصِّرْ».
english_text:
From him, from Ayyub from Safwan ibn Yahya from Sa’ad ibn Abi Khalaf, who said:
Ali ibn Yaqtin asked Abu al-Hasan al-Awwal {a.s} (the First), peace be upon him, about a
house that a man owns in a city or in an estate, and he passes by it.
Imam {a.s} said: “If it is among the places he has lived in, then he should complete the
prayer in it; but if it is among those he has not lived in, then let him shorten (prayer).”
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.212 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.230 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.160 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.494

arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ أَيُوبَ بْنِ نُوحِ عَنْ أَبِي طَالِبِ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي نَصْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ يَقْطِينٍ
قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي الْحَسَنِ الْأَوَّلِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ إِنَّ لِي صِيَاعاً وَ مَنَازِلَ بَيْنَ الْقَرْيَةِ وَ الْقَرْيَتَيْنِ الْفَرْسَخَانِ وَ الثَّلاَثَةُ
فَقَالَ «كُلُّ مَنْزِلٍ مِنْ مَنَازِلِكَ لاَ تَسْتَوْطِنُهُ فَعَلَيْكَ فِيهِ التَّقْصِيرُ».
english_text:
From him, from Ayyub ibn Nuh from Abu Talib from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr from Hammad ibn
Uthman from Ali ibn Yaqtin, who said:
I said to Abu al-Hasan al-Awwal {a.s} (the First), peace be upon him: “I have estates and
houses between one village and another, at a distance of two or three parasangs.”
Imam {a.s} said: “Every house among your houses that you do not take as a permanent
residence (tastawtinu-hu), upon you in it is the shortening of the prayer (taqsir).”
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.213 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.230 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.160 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.494

arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَحْمَدَ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ بَزِيعِ عَنْ أَبِي الْحَسَنِ عُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ
عَنِ الرَّجْلِ يُقَصِّرُ فِي ضَيْعَتِهِ فَقَالَ «لا بَأْسَ مَا لَمْ يَنْوِ مُقَامَ عَشَرَةٍ أَيَّامِ إِلاَّ أَنْ يَكُونَ لَهُ فِيهَا مَنْزِلْ يَسْتَوْطِنُهُ»
فَقُلْتُ مَا الإِسْتِيطَانُ فَقَالَ «أَنْ يَكُونَ لَهُ فِيهَا مَنْزِلٌ يُقِيمُ فِيهِ سِنَّةَ أَشهُرٍ فَإِذَا كَانَ كَذَلِكَ يُتِمُّ فِيهَا مَتَى يَدْخُلُها)».
وقال: وأخبرني محمد بن اسماعيل انه صلى في ضيعته فقصر في صلاته ، فقال احمد وأخبرني علي بن إسحاق بن سعد
واحمد بن محمد جميعا ان ضيعته التي قصر فيها الحمراء.
english_text:
From him, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad from Ahmad ibn al-Husayn from Muhammad ibn Isma'il ibn Bazi‘
from Abu al-Hasan {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Imam al-Ridha {a.s} about a man who shortens (the prayer) in his estate.
Imam {a.s} said: “There is no harm as long as he does not intend to stay for ten days,
unless he has in it a house that he resides in permanently (yastawtinuhu).”
So I asked: “What is 'residing permanently' (al-istitan)?”
Imam {a.s} said: “That he has in it a house, in which he stays for six months if that is the
case, then he completes the prayer in it whenever he enters it.”
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Ali ibn Musa al-Ridha {a.s}
commentary:
And he said: “Muhammad ibn Isma'il informed me that he prayed in his estate and
shortened his prayer.
Ahmad said: Ali ibn Ishaq ibn Sa’ad and Ahmad ibn Muhammad both informed me that
the estate in which he shortened his prayer was al-Hamra.’”
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.451 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.213 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.231 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.86 p.36

arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ عَنْ حُذَيْفَةً بْنِ مَنْصُورٍ
عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلاَمُ قَالَ سَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ: «خَرَجْتُ إِلَى أَرْضِ لِي فَقَصَّرْتُ ثَلاَثاً وَ أَثْمَمْتُ ثَلاثاً».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Yaqub ibn Yazid from Ibn Abi Umayr from Abdillah ibn al-Mughira from
Hudhayfah ibn Mansur from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
I heard Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} say: “I went out to a land of mine, and I shortened (the prayer)
for three days and performed it in full for three days.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.213 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.159 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.495

arabic_text:
فَأَمَّا مَا رَوَاهُ أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ بُكَيْرٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْحَجَّاجِ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لأَبِي
عَبْدِ اللّهِ عُ الرَّجُلُ لَهُ الضِّيَاعُ بَعْضُهَا قَرِيبٌ مِنْ بَعْضٍ فَيَخْرُجُ فَيَطُوفُ فِيهَا أَيُتِمُ أَمْ يُقَصِّرُ قَالَ «يُتِمّ».
english_text:
As for what was narrated by Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ibn Abi Umayr from Abdillah ibn Bukayr from Abd
al-Rahman ibn al-Hajjaj, who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him: “A man has estates, some of them near
to others, and he goes out and moves around among them. Should he complete (the
prayer) or shorten it?”
Imam {a.s} said: “He should complete (the prayer).”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.213 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.231 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.495

arabic_text:
وَ مَا رَوَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ وَ غَيْرِهِ عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي نَصْرٍ
قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ الرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ - عَنِ ٱلرَّجُلِ يَخْرُجُ إِلَى ضَيْعَتِهِ فَيُقِيمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ وَ الْيَوْمَيْنِ وَ الثَّلاَثَ أَيُقَصِّرُ أَمْ يُتِمُ
قَالَ «يُتِمُّ الصَّلاَةَ كُلّمَا أَنَى ضَيْعَةً مِنْ صِيَاعِهِ».
فليس في هذين الخبرين ما ينافي ما قدمناه لانه ليس فيهما مقدار المسافة التي يخرج فيها وإذا لم يكن ذلك فيهما احتمل
ان يكون المراد بهما إذا كانت الضيعة قريبة إليه فلا يجب عليه حينئذ التقصير.
english_text:
And what was narrated by Muhammad ibn Yaqub from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan and others from Sahl ibn
Ziyad from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, who said:
I asked Imam al-Ridha {a.s}, peace be upon him, about a man who goes out to his estate
and stays there for a day, or two days, or three dyas. Should he shorten (the prayer) or
complete (the prayer)?
Imam {a.s} said: “He should complete the prayer whenever he comes to one of his
estates.”
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Ali ibn Musa al-Ridha {a.s}
commentary:
So there is nothing in these two reports that contradicts what we have previously
presented, because they do not mention the distance of the journey. And since that is
not mentioned in them, it is possible that what is meant by them is when the estate is
near to him, and thus shortening (the prayer) is not obligatory upon him in that case.
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.437 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.214 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.231 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.157 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.497

arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْن مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ عَنْ إسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ أَبِي زِيَادٍ عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ
عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «سَبْعَةً لَاَ يُقَصِّرُونَ الصَّلَاَةَ الْجَابِي يَدُورُ فِي جِبَايَتِهِ وَ الْأَمِيرُ اَلَّذِي يَدُورُ فِي إِمَارَتِهِ وَ التَاجِرُ
الَّذِي يَدُورُ فِي تِجَارَتِهِ مِنْ سُوقٍ إِلَى سُوقٍ وَ الرَّاعِي وَ الْبَدَوِي الَّذِي يَطَلُبُ مَوَاضِعَ الْقَطْرِ وَ مَنْبِتَ الشَّجَرِ وَ
الرَّجُلُ يَطْلُبُ الصَّيْدَ يُرِيدُ بِهِ لَهَوَ الدُّنْيَا وَ الْمُحَارِبُ اَلَّذِي يَقْطَعُ السَّبِيلَ».
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Isa from Abdillah ibn al-Mughira from Isma'il ibn Abi Ziyad from
Imam Ja’far {a.s} from his father {a.s}, peace be upon them both, who said:
Imam al-Baqir {a.s} said: “Seven (groups of people) do not shorten the prayer;
the tax collector (al-jabi) who moves about in his collection (of taxes),
the governor (al-amir) who moves about in his governorship,
the merchant (al-tajir) who moves about in his trade from market to market,
the shepherd (al-ra’i),
the Bedouin (al-badawi) who seeks places of rainfall and plant growth,
the man who seeks hunting for the amusement of the world,
And the highwayman (al-muharib) who cuts off the road.” (Arabic idiom for ambush or
attack on travellers on the road,)
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s} & Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al- Sadiq {a.s}
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.441 • Al-Khisal, Vol.2 p.403 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.214 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.232 • Awali Al-La’ali, Vol.3 p.110 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.166 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.486

arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمِّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ أَبِي الْمِعْزَى عَنْ مُحَمِّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ عَنْ أَحَدِهِمَا عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: «لَيْسَ عَلَى
الْمَلاَجِينَ فِي سَفِينَتِهِمْ تَقْصِيرٌ وَ لا عَلَى الْمُكَارِينَ وَ لا عَلَى الْجَمَّالِينَ».
english_text:
From him, from Muhammad ibn Isa from Abu al-Mi'za from Muhammad ibn Muslim from one of the two
Imams {a.s}, peace be upon them, who said:
Imam {a.s} said: “There is no shortening (of the prayer) upon the sailors in their ships,
nor upon the mule drivers, nor upon the camel drivers.”
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s} & Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al- Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.214 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.486

arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمْدٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ : « أَرْبَعَةً قَدْ يَجِبُ عَلَيْهِمُ
اَلتَّمَامُ فِي سَفَرٍ كَانُوا أَوْ فِي حَضَرِ الْمُكَارِي وَ الْكَرِيُ وَ الرَّاعِي وَ الْأَشْتَقَانُ لِأَنَّهُ عَمَلُهُمْ».
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Hammad ibn Isa from Hariz from Zurarah, who said:
Abu Ja’far {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: “There are four for whom it may be obligatory
to perform the prayer in full, whether they are traveling or residing;
the muleteer (al-mukari), the hired rider (al-kariyy), the shepherd (al-ra‘i), and the
courier (al-ashtaqan), because it is their work.”
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.215 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.232 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.485

arabic_text:
عَلِي بْنُ إبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ ٱلْمَلاَحِينَ
وَ الْأَعْرَابٍ هَلْ عَلَيْهِمْ تَقْصِيرٌ قَالَ «لا بُيُوتُهُمْ مَعَهُمْ».
english_text:
Ali ibn Ibrahim from Muhammad ibn Isa from Yunus ibn Abd al-Rahman from Ishaq ibn Ammar, who said:
I asked Imam {a.s} about the sailors (al-mallahin) and the Bedouins (al-a‘rab), is the
shortening of the prayer (taqsir) obligatory upon them?
Imam {a.s} said: “No, their ‘homes’ are with them.”
source: Implicit (Muzmar)
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.438 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.215 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.233 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.167 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.485 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.86 p.22

arabic_text:
فَأَمّا مَا رَوَاهُ سَعْدٌ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمّدٍ عَنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدِ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنِ الْعَلاءِ بْنِ رَزِينِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بِنِ مُسْلِمِ
عَنْ أَحَدِهِمَا عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: «الْمُكَارِي وَ الْجَمَّالُ إِذَا جَدَّ بِهِمَا السَّيْرُ فَلْيَقْصُرَا».
english_text:
As for what was narrated by Sa’ad from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Faddalah
from al-Ala ibn Razin from Muhammad ibn Muslim from one of the two Imams {a.s}, peace be upon them, who
said:
Imam {a.s} said: “The muleteer (al-mukari) and the camel driver (al-jammal), if the travel
becomes serious for them, then let them shorten (the prayer).”
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s} & Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al- Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.215

arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ عَنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ أَبَانِ بْنِ عُثمَانَ عَنِ الْفَضْلِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلاَمُ - عَنِ الْمُكَارِينَ الَّذِينَ يَخْتَلِفُونَ فَقَالَ «إِذَا جَدُّوا السِّيْرَ فَلْيَقْصُرُوا».
فالوجه في هذين الخبرين ما ذكره محمد بن يعقوب الكليني رحمه اللّٰه قال : هذا محمول على من يجعل المنزلين منزلا
فيقصر في الطريق ويتم في المنزل، والذي يكشف عن ذلك ما رواه:
english_text:
From him, from Ahmad from al-Husayn from Faddalah from Aban ibn Uthman from al-Fadl ibn Abd al-Malik,
who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, about the mule drivers (al-makarin) who
travel frequently.
Imam {a.s} said: “If they intensify the travel, then let them shorten (the prayer).”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
commentary:
So the interpretation of these two reports is what was mentioned by Muhammad ibn
Yaqub al-Kulayni, may Allah {SWT} have mercy on him.
He (al-Kulayni) said: “This is to be understood as referring to those who consider two
residences as one, so they shorten on the road and perform the prayer in full at the
residence.”
What clarifies this is what he narrated:
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.215 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.4 p.219 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.233 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.490

arabic_text:
سَعْدٌ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ عَنْ عِمْرَانَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِمْرَانَ ٱلْأَشْعَرِيَّ عَنْ بَعْضِ أَصْحَابِنَا يَرْفَعُهُ إِلَى أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلَاَمُ
قَالَ: «الْجَمَالُ وَ الْمُكَارِي إِذَا جَدَّ بِهِمَا السَّيْرُ فَلْيَقْصُرَا فِيمَا بَيْنَ ٱلْمَنْزِلَيْنِ وَ يُتِمَّا فِي الْمَنْزِلِ».
english_text:
Sa’ad from Ahmad from Imran ibn Muhammad ibn Imran al-Ash'ari from some of our companions who
raised it (in isnad) to Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “The camel driver (al-jammal) and the mule driver (al-makari)
if the travel becomes intense for them, then let them shorten (the prayer) between the
two residences, and perform it in full at the residence.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.215 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.233 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.168 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.491

arabic_text:
سَعْدٌ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ هَاشِمِ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ مَرَّارٍ عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ
اَللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ قَالَ: قَالَ: «الْمُكَارِي إِنْ لَمْ يَسْتَقِرَّ فِي مَنْزِلِهِ إِلاَّ خَمْسَةَ أَيَّامِ أَوْ أَقَلّ قَصَّرَ فِي سَفَرِهِ بِالنَّهَارِ وَ أَتَمَّ
بِاللّيْلِ وَ عَلَيْهِ صَوْمُ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ فَإِنْ كَانَ لَهُ مُقَامٌ فِي الْبَلَدِ الَذِي يَذْهَبُ إِلَيْهِ عَشَرَةَ أَيَّامِ وَ أَكْثَرَ قَصَّرَ فِي سَفَرِهِ
وَ أفْطَرَ».
english_text:
Sa’ad from Ibrahim ibn Hashim from Isma'il ibn Marrar from Yunus ibn Abd al-Rahman from Abdillah ibn
Sinan from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “The mule driver (al-makari), if he does not stay in his home for
more than five days or less, then he shortens (the prayer) during his travel in the
daytime and completes it at night, and he is obligated to fast the Month of Ramadan.
But if he has a residence in the town, to which he travels, where he stays for ten days
or more, then he shortens (the prayer) during his journey and breaks his fast.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.216 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.234 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.86 p.23

arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ خَالِدِ ٱلطَّيَالِسِيِّ عَنْ سَيْفِ بْنِ عَمِيرَةَ عَنْ إسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ
عَنِ اَلَّذِينَ يُكْرُونَ الدَّوَابَ يَخْتَلِفُونَ كُلَّ ٱلْأَيَّامِ أ عَلَيْهِمُ التَقْصِيرُ إِذَا كَانُوا فِي سَفَرِ قَالَ «نَعَمْ».
english_text:
From him, from Muhammad ibn Khalid al-Tayalisi from Sayf ibn Umayrah from Ishaq ibn Ammar, who said:
I asked Abu Ibrahim (Imam al-Kadhim {a.s}), peace be upon him, about those who hire
out animals and travel constantly, every day. Are they required to shorten (the prayer),
when they are on a journey?
Imam {a.s} said: “Yes.”
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.216 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.233 • Awali Al-La’ali, Vol.3 p.110 • Al- Wafi, Vol.7 p.169 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.488

arabic_text:
سَعْدٌ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ وَ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ خَالِدِ الْبَرْقِيِّ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ عَنْ أُبِي
إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَألْتُهُ عَنِ الْمُكَارِينَ ٱَلَّذِينَ يُكْرُونَ الدَّوَابَ وَ قُلْتُ يَخْتَلِفُونَ كُلَ أَيَامِ كُلَّمَا جَاءَهُمْ شَيْءٌ
اِخْتَلَفُوا فَقَالَ «عَلَيْهِمُ التَّقْصِيرُ إِذَا سَاقَرُوا».
english_text:
Sa’ad from Abu Ja’far from his father, and Muhammad ibn Khalid al-Barqi from Abdillah ibn al-Mughira from
Ishaq ibn Ammar from Abu Ibrahim (Imam al-Kadhim {a.s}), peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Imam al-Kadhim {a.s} about the mule drivers who hire out animals, and said:
“They are constantly traveling, whenever some opportunity comes to them, they set
out.”
Imam {a.s} said: “They are required to shorten (the prayer) when they travel.”
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.216 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.4 p.219 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.234 • Al- Wafi, Vol.7 p.170 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.488

arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللّهِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ جَزَّكٍ قَالَ: كَتَبْتُ إِلَى أَبِي الْحَسَنِ الثَّالِثِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ أَنَّ لِي جِمَالاً وَ لِي
قُوّاماً عَلَيْهَا وَ لَسْتُ أَخْرُجُ فِيهَا إِلاّ فِي طَرِيقِ مَكَّةَ لِرَغْبَتِي فِي الْحَجِّ أَوْ فِي النَّدْرَةِ إِلَى بَعْضِ الْمَوَاضِعِ فَمَا يَجِبُ
عَلَيَّ إِذَا أَنَا خَرَجْتُ مَعَهُمْ أَنْ أَعْمَلَ أَ يَجِبُ عَلَيَّ التَّقْصِيرُ فِي الصَّلَاةِ وَ الصِّيَامِ فِي السَّفَرِ أَوِ التَّمَامُ فَوَقَّعَ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلاَمُ «إِذَا كُنْتَ لا تَلْزَمُهَا وَ لا تَخْرُجُ مَعَهَا فِي كُلِّ سَفَرِ إِلاَّ إِلَى طَرِيقٍ مَكَّةَ فَعَلَيْكَ تَقْصِيرٌ وَ إفْطَارٌ».
english_text:
From him, from Abdillah ibn Ja’far from Muhammad ibn Jazzaq, who said:
I wrote to Abu al-Hasan al-Thalith {a.s} (the Third), peace be upon him, saying:
“I have camels and caretakers over them, and I do not go out with them except on the
road to Mecca, due to my desire for Hajj, or rarely to some (other) places. What is
incumbent upon me when I go out with them what should I do? Is it obligatory upon
me to shorten the prayer and break the fast while traveling, or to complete them?”
So Imam al-Hadi {a.s}, peace be upon him, wrote in response:
“If you do not accompany them regularly and do not go out with them on every journey,
except on the road to Mecca, then shortening (the prayer) and breaking the fast are
incumbent upon you.”
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Ali ibn Muhammad al-Hadi {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.216 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.234 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.169 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.489

arabic_text:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ بْنِ أَيُوبَ عَنْ أَبَانِ بْنِ عُثُمَانَ عَنِ الْفَضْلِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلَاَمُ عَنِ الْمُسَافِرِ يَنْزِلُ عَلَى بَعْضِ أَهْلِهِ يَوْماً وَلَيْلَةً قَالَ «يُقَصِّرُ الصَّلاةَ».
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Faddalah ibn Ayyub from Aban ibn Uthman from al-Fadl ibn Abd al-Malik, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, about a traveller who stays with some of
his family for a day and a night.
Imam {a.s} said: “He should shorten the prayer.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.217 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.231 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.161 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.510

arabic_text:
سَهَلُ بْنُ زِيَادٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ أَسْبَاطِ عَنِ اِبْنِ بُكَيْرٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يَتَصَيَّدُ الْيَوْمَ وَ
الْيَوْمَيْنِ وَ الثَّلاثَ أَيُقَصِّرُ الصَّلاةَ قَالَ «لا إِلَّ أَنْ يُشَيِّعَ الرَّجُلُ أَخَاهُ مِنَ الدِّينِ وَ إِنَّ التَّصَيِّدَ مَسِيرٌ بَاطِلْ لا يُقَصِّرُ
الصَّلاةُ فِيهِ» وَ قَالَ «يُقَصِّرُ إِذَا شَيَّعَ أَخَاهُ».
english_text:
Sahl ibn Ziyad from Ali ibn Asbat from Ibn Bukayr, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, about a man who goes hunting for a day,
or two days, or three days. Should he shorten the prayer?
Imam {a.s} said: “No, unless the man is accompanying his brother in faith. Indeed,
hunting is a vain journey (‘masir batil’) in which the prayer is not to be shortened.”
And Imam {a.s} said: “He shortens (the prayer) if he is accompanying his brother.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Muhasin, Vol.2 p.371 • Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.437 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.217 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.235 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.174 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.480 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.86 p.31

arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ ابْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ بُكَيْرٍ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ زُرَارَةَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ ٱلرَّجُلِ
يَخْرُجُ إِلَى الصِّيْدِ أَيُقَصِّرُ أَوْ يُتِمُ قَالَ «يُتِمُ لِأَنَّهُ لَيْسَ بِمَسِيرِ حَقّ».
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ibn Faddal from Ibn Bukayr from Ubayd ibn Zurarah, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, about a man who goes out for hunting,
should he shorten or complete (the prayer)?
Imam {a.s} said: “He should complete (the prayer), because it is not a journey of truth
(masir haqq).” (meaning it is not a journey of necessity)
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.438 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.217 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.236 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.174 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.479

arabic_text:
عَنَهُ عَنْ عِمْرَانَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِمْرَانَ ٱلْقُمِّيِّ عَنْ بَعْضِ أَصْحَابِنَا عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لَهُ الرَّجُلُ
يَخْرُجُ إِلَى الصَّيْدِ مَسِيرَةَ يَوْمِ أَوْ يَوْمَيْنِ يُقَصِّرُ أَوْ يُتِمُّ فَقَالَ «إِنْ خَرَجَ لِقُوتِهِ وَ قُوتِ عِيَالِهِ فَلْيُفْطِرْ وَ يُقَضِّرُ وَ إِنْ
خَرَجَ لِطَلَبِ الْفُضُولِ فَلاَ وَ لاَ كَرَامَةَ».
english_text:
From him, from Imran ibn Muhammad ibn Imran al-Qummi from some of our companions from Abu Abdillah
{a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
I said to Imam al-Sadiq {a.s}: “A man goes out for hunting for a distance of a day or two,
should he shorten or complete (the prayer)?”
Imam {a.s} said: “If he goes out for his sustenance and the sustenance of his family
(meaning necessity), then let him break his fast and shorten (the prayer);
But if he goes out seeking excess (luxury or amusement, without necessity), then no
(breaking fast or shortening prayer) and no honor (in that) for him.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.438 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.452 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.217 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.236 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.174 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.480

arabic_text:
اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ الْمُعَلَّى بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ الْوَشَّاءِ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عُثُمَانَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ : فِي قَوْلٍ
اللّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ «فَمَنِ أُضْطُرّ غَيْرَ باغٍ وَ لا عَادٍ» قَالَ «الْبَاغِي بَاغِي الصِّيْدِ وَ اَلْعَادِي هُوَ السَّارِقُ لَيْسَ لَهُمَا أنْ يَأْكُلاَ
الْمَيْتَةَ إِذَا أُضْطُرًا إِلَيْهَا هِيَ حَرَامُ عَلَيْهِمَا لَيْسَ هِيَ عَلَيْهِمَا كَمَا هِيَ عَلَى الْمُسْلِمِينَ وَ لَيْسَ لَهُمَا أَنْ يُقَصِّرَا فِي
الصَّلاةِ».
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad from al-Mu'alla ibn Muhammad from al-Washa from Hammad ibn Uthman from
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} was asked regarding the saying of Allah {SWT}, the Majestic:
“But whoever is forced by necessity, neither desiring it nor transgressing” (Surah Al
Baqarah 2:173).
Imam {a.s} said: “The one who ‘desires’ (it) is the seeker of game (hunting, ‘al-baghi’),
and the ‘transgressor’ is the thief (al-adi);
Neither of them is permitted to eat the dead meat (al-maytah) if they are compelled to
it (starvation), it is forbidden for them (even under extreme necessity).
It is not (allowed) upon them as it is upon the Muslims, and also they are not allowed
to shorten the prayer.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.438 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.217 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.9 p.78 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.175 • Al-Wafi, Vol.19 p.94 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.476 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.24 p.215 • Tafsir Al-Burhan, Vol.1 p.373 • Tafsir Nur Al-Thaqalayn, Vol.1 p.155 • Tafsir Kanz Al-Daqaiq, Vol.2 p.221

arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ بْنِ عَبَّاسِ بْنِ عَامِرٍ عَنْ أَبَانِ بْنِ عُثُمَانَ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ
عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَمَّنْ يَخْرُجُ مِنْ أَهْلِهِ بِالصُّقُورِ وَ الْبُرَاةِ وَ الْكِلابِ يَتَنَزَّهُ اللَّيْلَةَ وَ اللَّيْلَتَيْنِ وَ الثَّلاَثَةَ هَلْ
بُقَصِّرُ مِنْ صَلاَتِهِ أَمْ لاَ يُقَصِّرُ قَالَ «إِنَّمَا خَرَجَ فِي لَهْوِ لا يُقَصِّرُ» قُلْتُ ٱلرَّجُلُ يُشَيَّعُ أَخَاهُ اليَوْمَ وَ الْيَوْمَيْنِ فِي شَهْرِ
رَمَضَانَ قَالَ «يُفْطِرُ وَ يُقَصِّرُ فَإِنَّ ذَلِكَ حَقُّ عَلَيْهِ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Abbas ibn Amir from Aban ibn Uthman from
Zurarah from Abu Ja’far {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Imam al-Baqir {a.s} about a man who goes out, from his family with falcons,
hawks, and dogs, spending a night or two or three nights for recreation. Should he
shorten his prayer or not?
Imam {a.s} said: “Indeed, he has gone out for amusement; he does not shorten (the
prayer).”
I asked: “A man accompanies his brother for a day or two, during the Month of
Ramadan.”
Imam {a.s} said: “He breaks his fast and shortens the prayer, for that is a right upon him
(to accompany his brother or brother in faith).”
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.218 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.175

arabic_text:
فَأَمَّا مَا رَوَاهُ مُحَمَدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنْ عَبْدِ آَللَّهِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ آللَّهِ
عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يَتَصَيَّدُ فَقَالَ «إِنْ كَانَ يَدُورُ حَوْلَهُ فَلاَ يُقَصِّرُ وَ إِنْ كَانَ يُجَاوِزُ الْوَقْتَ فَلْيُقَصِّرْ».
english_text:
As for what was narrated by Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from Safwan
from Abdillah, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, about a man who goes hunting.
Imam {a.s} said: “If he moves about within his vicinity, then he should not shorten (the
prayer);
but if he goes beyond the distance (that defines the time limit), then let him shorten
(the prayer).”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.218 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.236 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.176 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.479

arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنِ الْعَبَّاسِ بْنِ مَعْرُوفٍ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ بَعْضٍ أَصْحَابِنَا عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «لَيْسَ عَلَى صَاحِبِ الصِّيْدِ تَقْصِيرٌ ثَلاَثَةَ أَيَّامِ وَ إِذَا جَاوَزَ الثَّلاَثَةَ لَزِمَهُ».
فالوجه في هذين الخبرين من كان صيده لقوته وقوت عياله ، فاما من كان صيده للهو فلا يجوز له التقصير على ما بيناه.
english_text:
From him, from al-Abbas ibn Ma'ruf from al-Hasan ibn Mahbub from some of our companions from Abu
Basir from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “There is no shortening (of the prayer) upon the one who goes
hunting for three days, but if he exceeds three days, then it becomes obligatory upon
him (to shorten prayer).”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
commentary:
So the interpretation of these two reports applies to one whose hunting is for his
sustenance and the sustenance of his family.
As for the one whose hunting is for amusement, then it is not permissible for him to
shorten (the prayer), as we have explained.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.452 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.218 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.236 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.177 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.479

arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ السَّيَّارِيِّ عَنْ بَعْضِ أَهْلِ الْعَسْكَرِ قَالَ: خَرَجَ عَنْ أَبِي الْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلامُ «أَنَّ صَاحِبَ الصَّيْدِ يُقَصِّرُ مَا دَامَ عَلَى الْجَادَّةِ فَإِذَا عَدَلَ عَنِ الْجَادَةِ أَتَمَّ فَإِذَا رَجَعَ إِلَيْهَا قَصَّرَ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad al-Sayyari, from one of the people of al-
Askari, said:
There came a statement from Abu al-Hasan {a.s}, peace be upon him:
“Indeed, the hunter (sahib al-sayd) shortens (the prayer) as long as he is on the main
road (al-jaddah).
But when he deviates from the main road, he performs the full prayer. Then, if he
returns to it, he shortens again.”
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Ali ibn Muhammad al-Hadi {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.218 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.480 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.86 p.32

arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ عُثُمَانَ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ جَابِرٍ قَالَ: اِسْتَأْذَنْتُ
أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ وَ نَحْنُ نَصُومُ رَمَضَانَ لِنَلْقَى وَلِيداً بِالْأَعْوَصِ فَقَالَ «تَلَقَّهُ وَ أَفْطِر».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from al-Husayn ibn Uthman, from Isma'il
ibn Jabir, said:
I sought permission from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, while we were fasting
in the Month of Ramadan, to go and meet Walid in al-A‘was.
So Imam {a.s} said: “Meet him and break your fast (aftir).”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.219 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.235 • Al-Wafi, Vol.11 p.307 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.483

arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنِ الْعَلاءِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَحَدِهِمَا عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «إِذَا شَيَّعَ الرَّجُلُ
أخَاهُ فَلْيُقَصِّر» قُلْتُ أَيُهُمَا أَفْضَلُ يَصُومُ أَوْ يُشَيِّعُهُ وَ يُفْطِرُ قَالَ «يُشَيَّعُهُ لِأَنَّ اللَّهَ قَدْ وَضَعَهُ عَنْهُ إِذَا شَيَّعَهُ».
english_text:
From him, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Safwan, from al-Ala’, from Muhammad, from one of the
two Imams {a.s}, peace be upon them, who said:
Imam {a.s} said: “When a man escorts (yushayyi‘u) his brother (on a journey), then let
him shorten (his prayer).”
I asked: “Which of the two is better; that he fasts or that he escorts him and breaks his
fast?”
Imam {a.s} said: “(It is better that) He escorts him, for Allah {SWT} has lifted it from him
when he escorts him.”
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s} & Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al- Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.219 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.178 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.483

arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عُثُمَانَ عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لَهُ أَ
رَأَيْتَ مَنْ قَدِمَ بَلْدَةً إِلَى مَتَى يَنْبَغِي لَهُ أَنْ يَكُونَ مُقَصِّراً وَ مَتَى يَنْبَغِي لَهُ أَنْ يُتِمَّ فَقَالَ «إِذَا دَخَلْتَ أَرْضاً فَأَيْقَنْتَ
أَنَّ لَكَ بِهَا مُقَامَ عَشَرَةٍ أَيَّامِ فَأَتِمّ الصَّلاةَ وَ إِنْ لَمْ تَذْرِ مَا مُقَامُكَ بِهَا تَقُولُ عَداً أَخْرُجُ أَوْ بَعْدَ غَدِ فَقَصِّرْ مَا بَيْنَكَ وَ
بَيْنَ أَنْ يَمْضِيَ شَهْرٌ فَإِذَا تَمَّ لَكَ شَهْرٌ فَأَتِمَّ الصَّلاةَ وَ إِنْ أَرَدْتَ أَنْ تَخْرُجَ مِنْ سَاعَتِكَ».
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Hammad ibn Uthman, from Hariz, from Zurarah, from Abu Ja’far {a.s},
peace be upon him, who said:
I said to Imam al-Baqir {a.s}: “What do you say about someone who arrives in a town,
until when should he remain shortening (his prayer), and when should he complete it
(his prayer in full)?”
Imam {a.s} said: “If you enter a land and you are certain (‘ayqanta’) that you will stay
there for ten days, then complete the prayer (‘atimm al-salat’).
But if you do not know how long your stay will be there, saying, ‘Tomorrow I will leave,’
or ‘the day after tomorrow,’ then shorten (your prayer) until a month passes.
When a full month has passed for you, then complete the prayer even if you intend to
leave at that very moment.”
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.435 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.219 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.237 • Al-Sarair, Vol.3 p.586 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.149 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.500 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.86 p.38

arabic_text:
فَأَمَّا مَا رَوَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الصَّمَدِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ حَنَانٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَلَامُ
قَالَ: «إِذَا دَخَلْتَ الْبَلْدَةَ فَقُلْتَ الْيَوْمَ أَخْرُجُ أَوْ غَداً أَخْرُجُ فَاسْتَثْمَمْتَ عَشراً فَأَتِمَّ».
فهذا الخبر محمول على الاستحباب بدلالة ما قدمناه من الاخبار ويزيد ذلك بيانا :
english_text:
As for what was narrated by Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub, from Abd al-Samad ibn Muhammad, from
Hanan, from his father, from Abu Ja’far {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Baqir {a.s} said: “If you enter a town and say, ‘Today I will leave’ or ‘Tomorrow I
will leave,’ but you complete ten (days), then complete (the prayer, ‘atimm’).”
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
commentary:
So this report is to be understood as indicating recommendation (mustahabb or ‘al-
istihbab’), based on what we have previously presented of the narrations.
And what further clarifies this is:
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.219 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.152 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.502

arabic_text:
ما رواه عَلِيُّ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ أَبِي أَيُوبَ قَالَ: سَأَلَ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمِ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلاَمُ وَ أَنَا أُسْمَعُ عَنِ الْمُسَافِرِ إِنْ حَدَّثَ نَفْسَهُ بِإِقَامَةٍ عَشَرَةِ أَيَّامٍ قَالَ «فَلْيُتِمَّ الصَّلاةَ فَإِنْ لَمْ يَدْرٍ مَا يُقِيمُ يَوْماً
أَوْ أَكْثَرَ فَلْيَعُدَ ثَلاَثِينَ يَوْماً ثُمَّ ليُتِمَّ وَ إِنْ كَانَ أَقَامَ يَوْماً أَوْ صَلاَةً وَاحِدَةً» فَقَالَ لَهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمِ بَلَغَنِي أَنَّكَ
قُلْتَ خَمْساً فَقَالَ («قَدْ قُلْتُ ذَاكَ» قَالَ أَبُو أَيُوبَ فَقُلْتُ أَنَا جُعِلْتُ فِدَاكَ يَكُونُ أَقَلَّ مِنْ خَمْسَةِ أَيَّامِ فَقَالَ «لا».
قال محمد بن الحسن: ما يتضمن هذا الخبر من الامر بالاتمام إذا أراد مقام خمسة ايام محمول على انه إذا كان بمكة أو
بالمدينة، يدل على ذلك ما رواه :
english_text:
What was narrated by Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Ibn Abi Umayr from Abu Ayyub, who said:
Muhammad ibn Muslim asked Abu Ja’far {a.s}, peace be upon him, and I was listening,
about the traveller; ‘if he considers staying for ten days.’
Imam {a.s} said: “Then let him complete the prayer.
But if he does not know how long he will stay, a day or more, then let him count thirty
days, then complete (the prayer), even if he has already stayed one day or performed
one prayer.”
Then Muhammad ibn Muslim said to Imam {a.s}: “It has reached me that you said five
(days).”
Imam {a.s} said: “Yes, I did say that.”
Abu Ayyub said: “So I asked: ‘May I be your ransom, could it be less than five days?’”
Imam {a.s} said: “No.”
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
commentary:
Muhammad ibn al-Hasan said: “What is implied by this report, of commanding
completion (of the prayer) if one intends to stay five days, is to be understood as
referring to when one is in Mecca or Medina. This is indicated by the narration:
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.436 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.219 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.238 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.501 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.86 p.39

arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ السِّنْدِيِّ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ
عَنِ الْمُسَافِرِ يَقْدَمُ الْأَرْضَ فَقَالَ «إِنْ حَدَّثَتْهُ نَفْسُهُ أَنْ يُقِيمَ عَشراً فَلْيُتِمَّ وَ إِنْ قَالَ الْيَوْمَ أَخْرُجُ أَوْ غَداً أَخْرُجُ وَ لا
يَدْرِي فَلْيُقَصِّرْ مَا بَيْنَهُ وَ بَيْنَ شَهْرٍ فَإِنْ مَضَى شَهْرْ فَلْيُتِمَّ وَ لاَ يُتِمَّ فِي أَقَلَّ مِنْ عَشَرَةٍ إِلاّ بِمَكَّةَ وَ ٱلْمَدِينَةِ وَ إِنْ أَقَامَ
بِمَكَّةَ وَ الْمَدِينَةِ خَمْساً فَلْيُتِمَّ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub, from Ali ibn al-Sindi, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Hariz, from Muhammad
ibn Muslim, who said:
I asked Imam {a.s} about the traveller who arrives in a land.
Imam {a.s} said: “If he considers within himself to stay for ten days, then let him
complete (the prayer);
but if he says, 'Today I will leave,' or 'Tomorrow I will leave,' and he does not know,
then let him shorten (his prayer) until a month passes.
If a month passes, then let him complete (the prayer).
And he should not complete (the prayer) in less than ten (days), except in Mecca and
Medina.
And if he stays in Mecca and Medina for five (days), then let him complete (the prayer
in full).”
source: Implicit (Muzmar)
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.220 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.238 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.151 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.502 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.86 p.40

arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنِ اِبْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ بُكَيْرٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلَاَمُ - عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يَكُونُ بِالْبَصْرَةِ وَ هُوَ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْكُوفَةِ لَهُ بِهَا دَارٌ وَ مَنْزِلٌ فَيَمُرُ بِالْكُوفَةِ وَ إِنَّمَا هُوَ مُجْتَازُ لا
يُرِيدُ الْمُقَامَ إِلاَّ بِقَدْرٍ مَا يَتَجَهْزُ يَوْماً أَوْ يَوْمَيْنِ قَالَ «يُقِيمُ فِي جَانِبِ ٱلْمِصْرِ وَ يُقَصَّرُ» قُلْتُ فَإِنْ دَخَلَ أَهْلَهُ قَالَ
«عَلَيْهِ التَّمَامُ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ibn Faddal, from Abdillah ibn Bukayr, said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, about a man who is in Basra while he is
originally from Kufa, and he has a house and residence there.
He passes through Kufah, and he is only passing by, not intending to stay except for
the duration needed to prepare himself, for a day or two.
Imam {a.s} said: “He stays on the outskirts of the city and shortens (the prayer).”
I asked: “And if he enters his family’s home?”
Imam {a.s} said: “Then it is upon him to perform the full prayer.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.435 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.220 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.150 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.474

arabic_text:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ وَهْبٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلاَمُ قَالَ: «إِذَا دَخَلْتَ بَلَداً
وَ أَنْتَ تُرِيدُ الْمُقَامَ عَشَرَةَ أَيَّامِ فَأَتِمَّ الصَّلَاةَ حِينَ تَقْدَمُ وَ إِنْ أَرَدْتَ دُونَ الْعَشَرَةِ فَقَصِّرْ مَا بَيْنَكَ وَ بَيْنَ شَهْرٍ فَإِذَا
ثَمَّ الشَّهْرُ فَأَتِمَّ الصَّلاةَ» قَالَ قُلْتُ دَخَلْتُ بَلَداً أَوَّلَ يَوْمِ مِنْ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ وَ لَسْتُ أَرِيدُ أَنْ أَقِيمَ عَشراً فَقَالَ «قَصِّرْ
وَأَفْطِر» قُلْتُ فَإِنِّي مَكَثْتُ كَذَلِكَ أَقُولُ غَداً أَوْ بَعْدَ غَدٍ فَأْفْطِرُ الشَهْرَ كُلَّهُ وَ أَقَصِّرُ قَالَ »نَعَمْ هُمَا وَاجِدْ إِذَا قَصَّرْتَ
أفْطَرْتَ وَ إِذَا أَفْطَرْتَ قَصَّرْتَ».
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa’id, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Mu‘awiyah ibn Wahb, from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon
him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “If you enter a town and you intend to stay for ten days, then
complete the prayer (atimm al-salat) as soon as you arrive.
But if you intend to stay less than ten days, then shorten (the prayer, ‘fa-qassir’) until
a month has passed.
When the month is complete, then complete the prayer.”
He (ibn Wahb) said: “I asked, ‘I entered a town on the first day of the Month of
Ramadan, and I did not intend to stay for ten days.’”
Imam {a.s} said: “Shorten (the prayer, ‘qassir’) and break your fast (aftir).”
I asked: “I continued in that state, saying, ‘Tomorrow (I will leave)’ or ‘the day after
tomorrow,’ and so I broke my fast for the whole month and shortened (the prayer).”
Imam {a.s} said: “Yes, the two are the same;
if you shorten (the prayer), you also break your fast,
and if you break your fast, you also shorten (the prayer).”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.437 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.220 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.152 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.503

arabic_text:
سَعدٌ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ عُمَرَ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ النُّعْمَانِ عَنْ مَنصُورِ بْنِ حَازِمِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السْلاَمُ قَالَ سَمِعْثُهُ
يَقُولُ: «إِذَا أَتَيْتَ بَلْدَةً فَأَزْمَعْتَ ٱلْمُقَامَ عَشَرَةَ أَيَامِ فَأَتِمَّ الصَّلاَةَ فَإِنْ تَرَكَهُ رَجُلٌ جَاهِلٌ فَلَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ إِعَادَةٌ».
english_text:
Sa’ad, from Musa ibn Umar, from Ali ibn al-Nu‘man, from Mansur ibn Hazim, from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace
be upon him, who said:
I heard Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} say: “If you come to a town and firmly decide (azma‘ta) to
stay for ten days, then complete the prayer (atimm al-salat).
But if a man leaves it (completing the prayer) out of ignorance, then there is no need
for him to repeat it.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.221 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.152 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.506

arabic_text:
سَعْدُ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ أَبِي وَلاَّدِ الْحَنَّاطِ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لأَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ إِنَّي كُنْتُ
نَوَيْتُ جِينَ دَخَلْتُ الْمَدِينَةَ أَنْ أَقِيمَ بِهَا عَشَرَةَ أَيَّامٍ فَأْتِمَ الصَّلاةَ ثُمَّ بَدَا لِي بَعْدُ أَنْ لا أَقِيمَ بِهَا فَمَا تَرَى لِي أُتِمُ أَمْ
أُقَصِّرُ فَقَالَ «إِنْ كُنْتَ جِينَ دَخَلْتَ الْمَدِينَةَ صَلِّيْتَ بِهَا صَلاَةً فَرِيضَةً وَاحِدَةً بِتَمَامٍ فَلَيْسَ لَكَ أَنْ تَقْصُرَ حَتَّى تَخْرُجَ
مِنْهَا وَ إِنْ كُثْتَ جِينَ دَخَلْتَهَا عَلَى نِيَّتِكَ التَّمَامَ فَلَمْ تُصَلَّ فِيهَا صَلاَةً فَرِيضَةً وَاحِدَةً بِتَمَامِ حَتَّى بَدَا لَكَ أَنْ لاَ تُقِيمَ
فَأَنْتَ فِي تِلْكَ الْحَالِ بِالْخِيَارِ إِنْ شِنْتَ فَانْوِ ٱلْمُقَامَ عَشَراً وَ أَتِمَّ وَ إِنْ لَمْ تَنْوِ ٱلْمُقَامَ فَقَصِّرْ مَا بَيْنَكَ وَ بَيْنَ شَهْرٍ فَإِذَا
مَضَى لَكَ شَهْرٌ فَأَتِمَّ الصَّلاَةَ».
english_text:
Sa’ad, from Abu Ja’far, from al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Abu Walad al-Hannat, who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him:
“Indeed, I had intended when I entered Medina to stay there for ten days, so I
completed the prayer (in full).
Then afterward it appeared to me that I would not remain there. So what do you see
for me, should I complete (the prayer) or shorten it?”
Imam {a.s} said: “If, when you entered Medina, you prayed one obligatory prayer (salat
faridah wahidah) in full, then you may not shorten (prayer) until you leave it (Medina).
But if, when you entered it (Medina), your intention was to complete (the prayer), yet
you did not pray in it one obligatory prayer in full, until it appeared to you that you would
not stay.
Then you are, in that state, at liberty (bil-khiyar);
if you wish, then intend to stay for ten days and complete (the prayer),
and if you do not intend to stay, then shorten (the prayer) until a month passes for you;
and when a month has passed, then complete the prayer.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.437 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.221 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.238 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.153 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.508

arabic_text:
وَ أَمَا مَا رَوَاهُ سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ خَالِدِ ٱلْبَرْقِيَ عَنْ حَمْرَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللّهِ الْجَعْفَرِيّ قَالَ:
لَمَّا أَنْ نَقَرْتُ مِنْ مِنَّى نَوَيْتُ ٱلْمُقَامَ بِمَكَّةَ فَأَثْمَمْتُ الصَّلَاةَ حَتَّى جَاءَنِي خَبَرٌ مِنَ الْمَنْزِلِ فَلَمْ أَجِدْ بُدَاً مِنَ الْمَصِيرِ
إلَى الْمَنْزِلِ وَ لَمْ أَدْرِ أُتِمُ أَمْ أُقَصِّرُ وَ أَبُو الْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ يَوْمَئِذٍ بِمَكَّةَ فَأَتَيْثُهُ فَقَصَصْتُ عَلَيْهِ الْقِصَّةَ فَقَالَ
«اِرْجِع إِلَى التَّقْصِيرِ».
فالوجه في هذا الخبر انه انما أمره بالرجوع إلى التقصير إذا حصل مسافرا وخرج فأما قبل ذلك فلا، حسب ما قدمناه..
english_text:
As for what was narrated by Sa’ad ibn Abdillah, from Abu Ja’far, from Muhammad ibn Khalid al-Barqi, from
Hamzah ibn Abdillah al-Ja’fari, who said:
When I (Hamzah ibn Abdillah) departed from Mina, I intended to stay in Mecca, so I
completed the prayer until news came to me from home, and I found no choice but to
go to the house.
And I did not know whether I should complete or shorten (the prayer).
And Abu al-Hasan {a.s}, peace be upon him, was in Mecca on that day, so I then went to
Imam {a.s} and relayed the story to him.
Imam {a.s} said: “Return to shortening (the prayer).”
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s} & Abu al-Hasan Imam Ali ibn Musa al-Ridha {a.s}
commentary:
The interpretation of this report is that he was only commanded to return to shortening
(the prayer) if he had become a traveller and had departed; but before that, No. This is
according to what we have already explained.
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.443 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.221 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.239 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.153 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.509

arabic_text:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنْ إسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ عَنْ أَبِي إبْرَاهِيمَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يَكُونُ
مُسَافِراً ثُمّ يَقْدَمُ فَيَدْخُلُ بُيُوتَ ٱلْكُوفَةِ أَيُتِمُ الصَلاَةَ أَمْ يَكُونُ مُقَصِّراً حَتَّى يَدْخُلَ أَهْلَهُ قَالَ «بَلْ يَكُونُ مُقَصَّراً
حَتَّى يَدْخُلَ أَهْلَهُ».
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa’id, from Safwan, from Ishaq ibn Ammar, from Abu Ibrahim, peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Imam al-Kadhim {a.s} about a man who is a traveller, then arrives and enters the
houses of Kufah. Should he complete the prayer or remain shortening it until he enters
his family (house)?
Imam {a.s} said: “Rather, he remains shortening it until he enters his family (house).”
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.434 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.444 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.222 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.242 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.142 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.474

arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنِ ٱلْعِيص بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلاَمُ : «لا يَزَالُ ٱلْمُسَافِرُ مُقَصِّراً حَتَّى
يَدْخُلَ بَيْتَهُ».
english_text:
From him, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from al-‘Ayyas ibn al-Qasim, from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “The traveller continues to shorten (the prayer, ‘muqassiran’)
until he enters his house.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.222 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.242 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.142 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.475 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.86 p.28

arabic_text:
سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ عَلِيّ بْنِ حَدِيدٍ وَ الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ حَرِيزِ بْنِ عَبْدِ
الله عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ يَدْخُلُ مِنْ سَفَرِهِ وَ قَدْ دَخَلَ
وَقْتُ الصَّلاَةِ وَ هُوَ فِي الطَّرِيقِ فَقَالَ «يُصَلِّي رَكْعَتَيْنِ وَ إِنْ خَرَجَ إِلَى سَفَرِهِ وَ قَدْ دَخَلَ وَقْتُ ٱلصَّلاةِ فَلْيْصَلَ
أَرْبَعاً».
ولا ينافي هذا الخبر ما رواه:
english_text:
Sa’ad ibn Abdillah, from Abu Ja’far, from Ali ibn Hadid; and al-Husayn ibn Sa’id, from Hammad ibn Isa, from
Hariz ibn Abdillah, from Abu Ja’far, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, about a man who returns from his journey
and the time of prayer has entered while he is still on the road.
Imam {a.s} said: “He should pray two rak‘ahs.
And if he sets out on his journey and the time of prayer has entered, then he should
pray four (rak‘ahs).”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
commentary: And this report is not in contradiction with what was narrated:
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.434 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.443 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.13 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.222 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.239 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.145 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.513 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.516 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.86 p.47

arabic_text:
الحسين بن سعيد عن صفوان عن اسماعيل بن جابر قال : قلت لابي عبد الله عليه السلام يدخل علي وقت
الصلاة وانا في السفر فلا اصلي حتى أدخل اهلي فقال : صل وأتم الصلاة ، قلت : فدخل علي وقت الصلاة
وانا في أهلي اريد السفر فلا اصلي حتى اخرج؟ فقال : فصل وقصر فان لم تفعل فقد خالفت والله رسول اللّه
صلى الله عليه وآله.
الان الوجه في الجمع بينهما ان من دخل من سفره وكان الوقت باقيا بمقدار ما يتم فعليه أن يصلي على التمام وان خاف
فوت الوقت فعليه التقصير، وكذلك حكم من خرج إلى السفر فان خاف الفوت قصر وان كان عليه وقت تمم. والذي يدل
على ذلك ما رواه :
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa’id, from Safwan, from Isma’il ibn Jabir, who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him: “The time of prayer enters upon me while
I am traveling, but I do not pray until I enter my family (house).”
Imam {a.s} said: “Pray and complete the prayer.”
I asked: “And what if the time of prayer enters upon me while I am with my family and
I intend to travel, so I do not pray until I depart?”
Imam {a.s} said: “Then pray and shorten (the prayer), and if you do not do so, by Allah
{SWT}, you have opposed the Messenger of Allah {SWT}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his
family.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
