commentary:
For the proper understanding and reconciliation between the two reports is that;
whoever returns from his journey and the prayer time remains such that there is still
enough time to complete (the prayer), then it is upon him to pray in full.
But if he fears that the time will run out, then he must shorten (the prayer).
Likewise is the ruling for one who sets out on a journey, if he fears that the time will be
missed, then he shortens (the prayer);
but if there is enough time remaining, he completes it.
And what indicates that is what was narrated:
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.223

arabic_text:
سَعْدٌ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ بَشِيرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عُثُمَانَ عَنْ إسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَمَّارِ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا الْحَسَنِ
عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ يَقُولُ: فِي الرَّجْلِ يَقْدَمُ مِنْ سَفَرِهِ فِي وَقْتِ الصَّلاَةِ فَقَالَ «إِنْ كَانَ لاَ يَخَافُ الْوَقْتَ فَلْيُتِمَ وَ إِنْ كَانَ
يَخَافُ خُرُوجَ الْوَقْتِ فَلْيُقَصِّرْ».
english_text:
Sa’ad, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Ja’far ibn Bashir, from Hammad ibn Uthman, from Ishaq ibn
Ammar, who said:
I heard Abu al-Hasan {a.s}, peace be upon him, say regarding a man who returns from
his journey during the time of prayer.
Imam {a.s} said: “If he does not fear the passing of the time (of prayer), then let him
complete (the prayer in full), but if he fears that the time (of prayer) will pass, then let
him shorten (the prayer).”
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.444 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.223 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.223 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.240 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.241 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.147 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.514 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.86 p.49

arabic_text:
عنه عن محمد بن الحسين عن الحكم بن مسكين عن رجل عن ابي عبد اللّٰه عليه السلام في الرجل يقدم من
سفر في وقت الصلاة فقال : ان كان لا يخاف خروج الوقت فليتم وان كان يخاف خروج الوقت فليقصر.
ويحتمل ان يكون الاتمام توجه إلى من دخل من سفره وكان قد دخل عليه الوقت وهو مسافر على ضرب من الاستحباب
، يدل على ذلك ما رواه :
english_text:
From him, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from al-Hakam ibn Miskin, from a man, from Abu Abdillah {a.s},
peace be upon him:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said regarding a man who returns from travel during the time of
prayer.
Imam {a.s} said: “If he does not fear the passing of the time (of prayer), then let him
complete (the prayer in full);
But if he fears the passing of the time (of prayer), then let him shorten (the prayer).”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
commentary:
And it is possible that the instruction to complete (the prayer) was directed toward one
who returned from his travel, and the time for the prayer had entered, while he was still
traveling, as a form of recommendation (‘ala darb min al-istihbab’).
What indicates that is what was narrated:
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.223

arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيِى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْحَمِيدِ عَنْ سَيْفِ بْنِ عَمِيرَةَ عَنْ مَنْصُورِ بْنِ حَازِمِ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا
عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ يَقُولُ: «إِذَا كَانَ فِي سَفَرٍ فَدَخَلَ عَلَيْهِ وَقْتُ ٱلصَّلاةِ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَدْخُلَ أَهْلَهُ فَسَارَ حَتَّى يَدْخُلَ
أَهْلَهُ فَإِنْ شَاءَ قَصَّرَ وَ إِنْ شَاءَ أَتَمَّ وَ الْإِثْمَامُ أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Hamid, from Sayf ibn Umayrah, from Mansur
ibn Hazim, who said:
I heard Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, say: “If he is on a journey and the time of
prayer enters upon him, before he enters his family (house), and then he continues
traveling until he enters his family (house), then if he wishes; he may shorten (the
prayer), and if he wishes, he may complete (the prayer).
And completing (the prayer) is more beloved to me.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.223 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.241 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.148 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.515 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.86 p.48

arabic_text:
الحسين بن محمد عن معلى بن محمد عن الحسن بن علي الوشا قال : سمعت الرضا عليه السلام يقول : إذا
زالت الشمس وانت في المصر وأنت تريد السفر فأتم ، فإذا خرجت بعد الزوال قصر العصر.
english_text:
Abu al-Hasan Imam Ali ibn Musa al-Ridha {a.s}
Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad, from Mu‘alla ibn Muhammad, from al-Hasan ibn Ali al-Washsha, who said:
I heard Imam al-Ridha {a.s}, peace be upon him, say: “If the sun passes the zenith (zawat
al-shams) while you are in the city (al-misr) and you intend to travel, then complete
(the prayer); but if you depart after the zenith, then shorten the ‘Asr (prayer).”
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.224

arabic_text:
احمد بن محمد عن ابن فضال عن داود بن فرقد عن بشير النبال قال : خرجت مع ابي عبد اللّٰه عليه السلام
حتى أتينا الشجرة فقال لي أبو عبد اللّٰه عليه السلام : يا نبال فقلت : لبيك قال : انه لم يجب على أحد من أهل
هذا العسكر ان يصلي اربعا اربعا غيري وغيرك وذاك انه دخل وقت الصلاة قبل أن نخرج.
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Faddal, from Dawud ibn Farqad, from Bashir al-Nabbal, who said:
I went out with Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, until we reached al-Shajarah.
Then Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said to me: “O Nabbal!”
I said: “At your service.”
Imam {a.s} said: “It is not obligatory upon anyone from the people of this encampment
to pray four (rak‘ahs) except me and you, and that is because the time of prayer
entered before we departed.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.224

arabic_text:
عَلِي عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ يَقْطِينٍ عَنْ أَبِي الْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ قَالَ: سَأَلْثُهُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ خَرَجَ فِي
سَفَرٍ ثُمَّ تَبْدُو لَهُ اَلْإِقَامَةُ وَ هُوَ فِي صَلاَتِهِ قَالَ «يُتِمُّ إِذَا بَدَثْ لَهُ الْإِقَامَةُ».
english_text:
Ali, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Ali ibn Yaqtin, from Abu al-Hasan {a.s}, peace be upon him, said:
I asked Imam al-Kadhim {a.s} about a man who set out on a journey, then the intention
to stay (al-iqamah) occurs to him, while he is in the middle of his prayer.
Imam {a.s} said: “He should complete (the prayer), if the intention to stay arises during
it (middle of his prayer).”
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.435 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.224 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.150

arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بَنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سَهْلٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا الْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ - عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يَخْرُجُ فِي سَفَرٍ ثُمَّ
تَبْدُو لَهُ الْإِقَامَةُ وَ هُوَ فِي صَلاَتِهِ أَيُتِمُ أَمْ يُقَصِّرُ قَالَ «يُتِمُ إِذَا بَدَتْ لَهُ الْإِقَامَةُ».
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Sahl, from his father, who said:
I asked Abu al-Hasan {a.s}, peace be upon him, about a man who sets out on a journey,
then the intention to stay (al-iqamah) occurs to him while he is in the middle of his
prayer. Should he complete (the prayer) or shorten it?
Imam {a.s} said: “He should complete (the prayer), if the intention to stay arises during
it (middle of his prayer).”
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.224 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.150 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.511

arabic_text:
اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنِ الْعَلاءِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ رَجُلْ يُرِيدُ
السَّفَرَ فَيَخْرُجُ مَتَى يُقَصِّرُ قَالَ «إِذَا تَوَارَى مِنَ الْبُيُوتِ» قُلْتُ ٱلرَّجُلُ يُرِيدُ السَّفَرَ فَيَخْرُجُ حِينَ تَزُولُ الشَّمْسُ فَقَالَ
«إِذَا خَرَجْتَ فَصَلِّ رَكْعَتَيْنِ».
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa’id, from Safwan, from al-Ala’, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him: “A man intends to travel and he departs,
when should he begin shortening (his prayer)?”
Imam {a.s} said: “When he disappears from the houses (‘tawara min al-buyut’).”
I asked: “A man intends to travel and he departs when the sun has passed its zenith
(zawal al-shams).”
Imam {a.s} said: “When you set out, then pray two rak‘ahs.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.434 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.435 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.12 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.224 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.4 p.230 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.141

arabic_text:
عنه عن النضر بن سويد عن موسى بن بكر عن زرارة عن ابي جعفر عليه السلام انه سئل عن رجل دخل وقت
الصلاة وهو في السفر فأخر الصلاة حتى قدم فهو يريد يصليها إذا قدم إلى أهله ، فنسي حين قدم إلى أهله
ان يصليها حتى ذهب وقتها قال : يصليها ركعتين صلاة المسافر لان الوقت دخل وهو مسافر فكان ينبغي له
ان يصلي عند ذلك.
english_text:
From him, from al-Nadr ibn Suwayd, from Musa ibn Bakr, from Zurarah, from Abu Ja’far {a.s}, peace be upon
him:
Imam al-Baqir {a.s} was asked about a man upon whom the time of prayer entered while
he was traveling, but he delayed the prayer until he arrived (at his destination).
He intended to pray it (in full) when he reached his family (house), then he forgot to
pray it upon arriving, until the prayer time had passed.
Imam {a.s} said: “He should pray it as two rak‘ahs, the prayer of a traveller, because the
time (of prayer) entered while he was traveling, and it was incumbent upon him to pray
at that time.”
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.224

arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ بْنِ أَيُوبَ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ بَكْرٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «إِذَا نَسِيَ الرَّجُلُ صَلاَةً
أَوْ صَلاَهَا بِغَيْرِ طَهُورٍ وَ هُوَ مُقِيمٌ أَوْ مُسَافِرْ فَذَكَرَهَا فَلْيَقْضٍ الَّذِي وَجَبَ عَلَيْهِ لا يَزِيدُ عَلَى ذَلِكَ وَ لا يَنْقُصُ مَنْ
نَسِيَ أَرْبَعاً فَلْيَقْضِ أَرْبَعاً مُسَافِراً كَانَ أَوْ مُقِيماً وَ إِنْ نَسِيَ رَكْعَتَيْنِ صَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ إِذَا ذَكَرَ مُسَافِراً كَانَ أَوْ مُقِيماً».
english_text:
From him, from Fadala ibn Ayyub, from Musa ibn Bakr, from Zurarah, from Abu Ja’far {a.s}, peace be upon
him, who said:
Imam al-Baqir {a.s} said: “If a man forgets a prayer or performs it without purification
(tahur), while he is residing or traveling, then remembers it.
He must make up what was obligatory upon him, he should neither increase upon that
nor decrease.
Whoever forgets four (units) must make up four (units), whether he was traveling or
residing.
And if he forgets two (units), he should perform two (units) when he remembers,
whether he was traveling or residing.”
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.441 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.225 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1010 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.269 • Al-Fusul Al-Muhimmah, Vol.2 p.118

arabic_text:
سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ عِيصِ بْنِ ٱلْقَاسِمِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسِّلاَمُ
قَالَ: سَألْتُهُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ صَلَّى وَ هُوَ مُسَافِرٌ فَأْتَمَ الصَلاَةَ قَالَ «إِنْ كَانَ فِي ٱلْوَقْتِ فَلْيُعِذْ وَ إِنْ كَانَ ٱلْوَقْتُ قَدْ مَضَى
فلا».
ولا ينافي هذا الخبر ما رواه:
english_text:
Sa’ad ibn Abdillah, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from Iys ibn al-Qasim, from
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} about a man who prayed while he was traveling, but
completed the prayer in full.
Imam {a.s} said: “If it is still within the time, then he should repeat it (as shortened
prayer), and if the time has passed, then no (meaning he does not repeat the prayer).”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
commentary: And this report is not contradicted by what is narrated:
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.225 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.241 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.86 p.53

arabic_text:
سعد عن محمد بن الحسين عن علي بن النعمان عن سويد القلا عن ابي ايوب عن ابي بصير عن ابي عبد الله
عليه السلام قال : سألته عن الرجل ينسى فيصلي في السفر اربع ركعات قال : ان ذكر في ذلك اليوم فليعد وان
لم يذكر حتى يمضي ذلك اليوم فلا إعادة عليه.
الان ما يتضمن هذا الخبر من الامر بالاعادة بعد انقضاء الوقت في ذلك اليوم فمحمول على الاستحباب، وما تضمن الخبر
الاول مادام الوقت باقيا محمول على الوجوب.
english_text:
Sa’ad, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Ali ibn al-Nu'man, from Suwayd al-Qalla, from Abu Ayyub, from
Abu Basir, from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} about a man who forgets and prays four rak‘ahs while
traveling.
Imam {a.s} said: “If he remembers during that day, then he should repeat (and shorten
the prayer),
And if he does not remember until that day has passed, then there is no repetition upon
him.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
commentary:
Because what this report contains of commanding repetition after the time of that day
has passed, is to be understood as recommended (mustahabb).
And what the first report contains, so long as the time remains, is to be understood as
obligatory (wajib).
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.225

arabic_text:
مُحَمِّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي نَجْرَانَ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ وَ
اِبْنِ مُسْلِمِ قَالاَ: قُلْنَا لِأَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ رَجُلُ صَلَّى فِي السَّفَرِ أَرْبَعاً أَيُعِيدُ أَمْ لا قَالَ «إِنْ كَانَ قُرِيَّثْ عَلَيْهِ آيَةُ
التَّقْصِيرِ وَ فُسِّرَتْ لَهُ فَصَلَّى أَرْبَعاً أَعَادَ وَ إِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ قُرِئَتْ عَلَيْهِ وَ لَمْ يَعْلَمْهَا فَلَا إِعَادَةَ عَلَيْهِ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Abi Najran, from Hammad ibn Isa,
from Hariz, from Zurarah and Ibn Muslim, who said:
We said to Abu Ja’far {a.s}, peace be upon him: “A man prayed four (rak‘ahs) while
traveling (full prayer), Should he repeat it or not?”
Imam {a.s} said: “If the verse of shortening (‘ayat al-taqsir’) was recited to him and it was
explained to him, then he prayed four (rak‘ahs), he must repeat (the prayer).
But if it had not been recited to him and he did not know it, then there is no repetition
upon him.”
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.226 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.968 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.506

arabic_text:
اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ : سَأَلْتُ أَبَا الْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ عَنِ
اِمْرَأَةٍ كَانَتْ مَعَنَا فِي السَّفَرِ وَ كَانَتْ تُصَلِّي الْمَغْرِبَ رَكْعَتَيْنِ ذَاهِبَةً وَ جَائِيَةً قَالَ «لَيْسَ عَلَيْهَا قَضَاء».
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Muhammad ibn Ishaq ibn 'Ammar:
I asked Abu al-Hasan {a.s}, peace be upon him, about a woman who was with us on a
journey, and she used to pray Maghrib as two rak‘ahs; going and returning.
Imam {a.s} said: “There is no make-up (qada) upon her.”
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s} & Abu al-Hasan Imam Ali ibn Musa al-Ridha {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.226 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.968 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.507

arabic_text:
احمد بن محمد عن العباس بن معروف عن صفوان بن يحيى عن عبد اللّٰه بن مسكان ومحمد بن النعمان الاحول
عن ابي عبد الله عليه السلام قال : إذا دخل المسافر مع أقوام حاضرين في صلاتهم فان كانت الاولى فليجعل
الفريضة في الركعتين الاولتين وان كانت العصر فليجعل الاولتين نافلة والاخيرتين فريضة.
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Abbas ibn Ma'ruf, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from Abdillah ibn Maskan and
Muhammad ibn al-Nu'man al-Ahwal, from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “When a traveller joins a group of residents in their prayer, then
if it is the noon prayer (‘al-ula’), he should make the obligatory (prayer) in the first two
rak‘ahs. And if it is the afternoon prayer (‘al-Asr’), he should make the first two
(rak‘ahs) supererogatory (nafila) and the last two (rak’ahs) as obligatory (fardh).”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.227

arabic_text:
عنه عن احمد بن محمد بن ابي نصر عن داود بن الحصين عن ابي العباس الفضل بن عبد الملك عن ابي عبد
الله عليه السلام قال : لا يؤم الحضري المسافر ولا المسافر الحضري ، فان ابتلى بشئ من ذلك فأم قوما
حضريين فإذا أتم الركعتين سلم ثم اخذ بيد بعضهم فقدمه فأمهم ، وإذا صلى المسافر خلف قوم حضور فليتم
صلاته ركعتين ويسلم ، وان صلى معهم الظهر فليجعل الاولتين الظهر والاخيرتين العصر.
english_text:
From him, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, from Dawud ibn al-Husayn, from Abu al-Abbas al-Fadl
ibn Abd al-Malik, from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “The resident should not lead the traveller in prayer, nor should
the traveller lead the resident.
But if one is tested with such a situation and leads a group of residents in prayer, then
when he completes two rak‘ahs, he should give the salutation (taslim),
then take the hand of one of them (following him) and bring him forward, and he should
lead them (to complete the prayer).
And if the traveller prays behind a group of residents, he should complete his prayer
as two rak‘ahs and give the salutation.
And if he prays with them the noon prayer (Dhuhr), he should make the first two
(rak‘ahs) as the noon prayer and the last two (rak’ahs) as the afternoon prayer (Asr).”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.227

arabic_text:
سعد عن الحسن بن الحسين اللؤلؤي عن الحسن بن علي ابن فضال عن ابي المعزا حميد بن المثنى عن عمران
عن محمد بن علي انه سأل ابا عبد الله عليه السلام عن الرجل المسافر إذا دخل في الصلاة مع المقيمين قال :
فليصل صلاته ثم يسلم وليجعل الاخيرتين سبحة.
english_text:
Sa’ad, from al-Hasan ibn al-Husayn al-Lu'lu'i, from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal, from Abu al-Ma‘za Humayd
ibn al-Muthanna, from Imran, from Muhammad ibn Ali:
(Muhammad ibn Ali) asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, about a man who is
traveling and enters into prayer with those who are residing.
Imam {a.s} said: “Then he should pray his (shortened) prayer and give the salutation
(taslim), and he should make the last two (rak‘ahs) as supererogatory (subha).”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.227

arabic_text:
الحسين بن سعيد عن محمد بن ابي عمير عن حماد بن عثمان قال سألت ابا عبد اللّٰه عليه السلام عن المسافر
يصلي خلف المقيم قال : يصلي ركعتين ويمضي حيث شاء.
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad ibn Uthman, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, about a traveller who prays behind a
resident.
Imam {a.s} said: “He should pray two rak‘ahs and then go wherever he wishes.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.227

arabic_text:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ النَّضْرِ بْنِ سُوَيْدٍ عَنْ زُرْعَةَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ - عَنْ
وَقْتِ صَلاَةِ اللَّيْلِ فِي السّفَرِ فَقَالَ «مِنْ جِينَ تُصَلِّي الْعَتَمَةَ إِلَى أَنْ يَنْفَجِرَ الصُبْحُ».
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from al-Nadr ibn Suwayd, from Zur’ah ibn Muhammad, from Sama’ah, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, about the time of the night prayer (salat
al-layl) during travel.
Imam {a.s} said: “From the time you pray the 'atamah (nightfall prayer) until the break of
dawn (fajr).”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.227 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.332

arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عُثُمَانَ عَنِ الْحَلَبِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: «إِنْ خَشِيتَ
أَنْ لا تَقُومَ فِي آخِرِ اللَّيْلِ وَ كَانَتْ بِكَ عِلَّةٌ أَوْ أَصَابَكَ بَرْدٌ فَصَلَ وَ أَوْتِرْ مِنْ أَوَّلِ اللَّيْلِ فِي السَّفَرِ».
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad ibn Uthman, from al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah
{a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “If you fear that you will not wake up at the end of the night,
and you are afflicted with an illness or struck by cold, then pray and perform the witr
at the beginning of the night during travel.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.453 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.227 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.250

arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إسْمَاعِيلَ عَنِ الْفَضْلِ بْنِ شَاذَانَ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ مَنْصُورِ بْنِ حَازِمِ عَنْ أَبَانِ بْنِ تَغْلِبَ قَالَ:
خَرَجْتُ مَعَ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ فِيمَا بَيْنَ مَكَّةَ وَ الْمَدِينَةِ فَكَانَ يَقُولُ «أَمَا أَنْتُمْ فَشَبَابٌ تُؤَخِّرُونَ وَ أَمَّا أَنَا
فَشَيْخٌ أُعَجّلُ» فَكَانَ يُصَلِّي صَلاَةَ آللَّيْلِ أَوْلَ اللِّيْلِ.
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Isma‘il, from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from Mansur ibn Hazim, from
Aban ibn Taghlib, who said:
(Aban ibn Taghlib) said: “I went out with Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, between
Mecca and Medina.
Imam {a.s} would say: ‘As for you, you are young men who delay (the prayer), but as for
me, I am an old man who hastens (the night prayer).’
So Imam {a.s} used to perform the night prayer (salat al-layl) at the beginning of the
night.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.440 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.227 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.334 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.254

arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنِ الْحَلَبِيِّ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ - عَنْ صَلاَةٍ
اللَّيْلِ وَ الْوَثْرِ فِي أَوّلِ اللَّيْلِ فِي السَّفَرِ إِذَا تَخَوَّفْتُ الْبَرْدَ أَوْ كَانَتْ عِلَّةٌ فَقَالَ «لا بَأْسَ أَنَا أَفْعَلُ ذَلِكَ».
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Ibn Maskan, from al-Halabi, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, about performing the night prayer and
the witr at the beginning of the night during travel, if I feared the cold or there was an
illness.
Imam {a.s} said: “There is no harm, for I do that myself.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.441 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.168 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.228 • Al- Istibsar, Vol.1 p.280 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.331 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.251

arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ النُعْمَانِ وَ مُحَمِّدِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنِ الْحَلَبِيِّ : أَنَّهُ سَأَلَ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ
عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ عَنْ صَلاَةِ النَّافِلَةِ عَلَى الْبَعِيرِ وَ الدَّابَّةِ فَقَالَ «نَعَمْ حَيْثُ كَانَ مُتَوَجِّها وَ كَذَلِكَ فَعَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَ ».
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad by Ali ibn al-Nu'man by Muhammad ibn Sinan by Abdillah ibn Maskan by al-Halabi:
(al-Halabi) asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, about performing the
supererogatory prayer (al-nafilah), on a camel or riding animal.
Imam {a.s} said: “Yes, as long as he is facing the direction (of prayer). And likewise did
the Messenger of Allah {SWT}, peace be upon him and his family.”
source: Abu al-Qasim Prophet Muhammad ibn Abdullah {saws}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.228 • Awali Al-La’ali, Vol.2 p.213 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.329

arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي نَصْرٍ عَنِ الْعَلاءِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ قَالَ: قَالَ لِي أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السِّلاَمُ «صَلِّ صَلاَةَ اَللِّيْلِ وَ
الْوَثْرَ وَ الرّكْعَتَيْنِ فِي الْمَحْمِلِ».
english_text:
From him, from Ibn Abi Nasr, from al-Ala’, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:
Abu Ja’far {a.s}, peace be upon him, said to me: “Pray the night prayer (salat al-layl), the
witr, and the two rak‘ahs in the litter (al-mahmil).”
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.228 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.520

arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنِ الْعَبَّاسِ بْنِ مَعْرُوفٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَهْزِيَارَ قَالَ: قَرَأْتُ فِي كِتَابٍ لِعَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ إِلَى أَبِي الْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلَامُ : اِخْتَلَفَ أَصْحَابُنَا فِي رِوَايَاتِهِمْ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ فِي رَكْعَتَي الْفَجْرِ فِي السَّفَرِ فَرَوَى بَعْضُهُمْ
«أَنْ صَلَّهِمَا فِي الْمَحْمِلِ» وَ رَوَى بَعْضُهُمْ «أَنْ لا تُصَلَّهِمَا إِلا عَلَى الْأَرْضِ» فَأَعْلِمْنِي كَيْفَ تَصْنَعُ أَنْتَ لِأَقْتَدِيَ بِكَ
فِي ذَلِكَ فَوَقَعَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ «مُوَسَّعْ عَلَيْكَ بِأَيَّةٍ عَمِلْتَ».
english_text:
From him, from al-Abbas ibn Ma'ruf, from Ali ibn Mahziyar, who said:
I read in a letter from Abdillah ibn Muhammad to Abu al-Hasan {a.s}, peace be upon him:
“Our companions have differed in their narrations from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be
upon him, regarding the two rak‘ahs of Fajr during travel.
Some of them narrate: ‘That you should pray them in the litter (al-mahmil),’
And some narrate: ‘That you should not pray them except on the ground.’
So inform me how you act yourself, so that I may follow you in that.”
Imam {a.s}, peace be upon him, wrote in response:
“It is permitted (muwassa‘un ‘alayk) for you, whichever of the two you act upon.”
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Ali ibn Musa al-Ridha {a.s} & Abu al-Hasan Imam Ali ibn Muhammad al-Hadi {a.s} & Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.228 • Al-Wafi, Vol.1 p.284 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.520 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.330 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.27 p.122 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.2 p.235

arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنِ الْعَبَّاسِ بْنِ مَعْرُوفِ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَهْزِيَارَ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ وَ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ يَحْيَى
وَ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ أَصْحَابِهِمْ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ : فِي الصَّلاةِ فِي الْمَحْمِلِ فَقَالَ «صَلِّ مُتَرَبِّعاً
وَمَمْدُودَ الرِّجْلَيْنِ وَ كَيْفَ أَمْكَنَكَ».
english_text:
From him, from al-Abbas ibn Ma'ruf, from Ali ibn Mahziyar, from al-Hasan ibn Ali, from Abdillah ibn al-
Mughira, and Safwan ibn Yahya, and Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from their companions:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said regarding prayer in the litter (al-mahmil).
Imam {a.s} said: “Pray sitting cross-legged (mutarabbian), or with your legs extended
(mamdud al-rijlayn), or in whatever way is possible for you (kayfa amkanaka).”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.365 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.228 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.520 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.330 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.502

arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ خَالِدِ الْبَرْقِيَ عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ بَشِيرٍ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَ قَالَ: «لا بَأْسَ بِأَنْ
يُصَلِّيَ الرَّجُلُ صَلاَةَ اللَّيْلِ فِي السِّفَرِ وَ هُوَ يَمْشِي وَ لا بَأْسَ إِنْ فَاتَتْهُ صَلاَةُ اللَّيْلِ أَنْ يَقْضِيَهَا بِالنَّهَارِ وَ هُوَ يَمْشِي
يَتَوَجَّهُ إِلَى الْقِبْلَةِ ثُمَّ يَمْشِي وَ يَقْرَأْ فَإِذَا أَرَادَ أَنْ يَرْكَعَ حَوَّلَ وَجْهَهُ إِلَى الْقِبْلَةِ وَ رَكَعَ وَ سَجَدَ ثُمَّ مَشَى».
english_text:
From him, from Muhammad ibn Khalid al-Barqi, from Ja’far ibn Bashir, from Mu‘awiyah ibn ‘Ammar, from
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “There is no harm if a man prays the night prayer (salat al-layl)
during travel while he is walking, and there is no harm if he misses the night prayer and
that he makes it up during the day while walking.
He faces the qiblah, then walks and recites; and when he wants to bow (ruku‘), he
turns his face toward the qiblah and performs ruku‘ and sujud, then walks again.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.229 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.520 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.334

arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ عَنْ أَبَانِ بْنِ عُثُمَانَ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الْكَرْجِيّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لَهُ إِنَّي أَقْدِرُ عَلَى
أَنْ أَتَوَجَّهَ إِلَى الْقِبْلَةِ فِي الْمَحْمِلِ فَقَالَ «مَا هَذَا ٱلضَّيْقُ أَمَا لَكَ - بِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ أُسْوَةً».
english_text:
From him, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Aban ibn Uthman, from Ibrahim al-Karkhi, from Abu Abdillah {a.s}:
I said to Imam al-Sadiq {a.s}: “I am able to face the qiblah in the litter (al-mahmil).”
Imam {a.s} said: “What is this constriction? (meaning to rebuke this ‘over-strict’
interpretation)
Do you not have in the Messenger of Allah {SWT}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his family,
an example?”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.229 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.521

arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنِ الْعَبَّاسِ بْنِ مَعْرُوفٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَهْزِيَارَ عَنْ أَيُوبَ بْنِ نُوحِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ ٱلْمُغِيرَةِ عَنْ عُتَيْبَةَ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ
بْنِ مَيْمُونٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ قَالَ: «إِنْ صَلِّيْتَ وَ أَنْتَ تَمْشِي كَبَّرْتَ ثُمَّ مَشَيْتَ فَقَرَأْتَ فَإِذَا أَرَدْتَ أَنْ
تَرْكَعَ أَوْمَأْتَ بِالرُّكُوعِ ثُمَّ أَوْمَأْتَ بِالسُّجُودِ وَ لَيْسَ فِي السَّفَرِ تَطَوْعٌ».
english_text:
From him, from al-Abbas ibn Ma‘ruf, from Ali ibn Mahziyar, from Ayyub ibn Nuh, from Abdillah ibn al-
Mughira, from ‘Utaybah, from Ibrahim ibn Maymun, from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “If you pray while you are walking, you pronounce the takbir,
then walk and recite.
When you want to bow, you indicate the bowing (ruku‘) with a gesture, then you
indicate the prostration (sujud) with a gesture.
And there is no supererogatory (voluntary) prayer in travel.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.229 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.521 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.334

arabic_text:
سَعْدٌ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ شُعَيْبٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ عَنِ الصَّلاَةِ
فِي السَّفَرِ وَ أَنَا أَمْشِي قَالَ «أَوْمِ إِيمَاءَ وَ اِجْعَلِ السُّجُودَ أَخْفَضَ مِنَ الرُّكُوعِ».
english_text:
Sa’ad, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Safwan, from Ya‘qub ibn Shu‘ayb, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, about praying while traveling, and I am
walking.
Imam {a.s} said: “Gesture (perform the prayer) with motions (ima'), and make the
(gesture of) prostration (sujud) lower than the bowing (ruku‘).”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.229 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.519 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.335

arabic_text:
سَعْدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ وَ عَلِيَّ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ أَبِي الْحَسَنِ
الْأَوَّلٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ : فِي الرَّجُلِ يُصَلِّي النَّافِلَةَ وَ هُوَ عَلَى دَابَّةٍ فِي الْأَمْصَارِ قَالَ «لا بَأْسَ».
english_text:
Sa’ad ibn Muhammad from al-Husayn ibn Sa’id from Ibn Abi Umayr and Ali ibn al-Hakam from Hammad ibn
Uthman from Abu al-Hasan al-Awwal {a.s}, peace be upon him:
Imam al-Kadhim {a.s} said regarding a man who performs the nafila (supererogatory)
prayer, while on a riding animal in towns (al-amsar).
Imam said: “There is no problem.”
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.229 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.518 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.330

arabic_text:
مُحَمِّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنْ ذَرِيجٍ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ فَاتَثَنِي صَلاَةُ
اللَّيْلِ فِي السِّفَرِ أَفَأَقْضِيهَا بِالنَّهَارِ فَقَالَ «نَعَمْ إنْ أَطَقْتَ ذَلِكَ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Safwan, from Dharih, who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him: “I missed the night prayer (salat al-layl)
during travel, Should I make it up during the day?”
Imam {a.s} said: “Yes, if you are able to do that.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.440 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.229 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1027 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.92 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.277

arabic_text:
عَلِيْ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْحَجَاجِ عَنْ أَبِي الْحَسَنِ الْأَوْلِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ : فِي
الرَّجْلٍ يُصَلِّي النَّوَافِلَ فِي الْأَمْصَارِ وَ هُوَ عَلَى دَابَّتِهِ حَيْثُ تَوَجَّهَتْ بِهِ فَقَالَ «نَعَمْ لا بَأْسَ بِهِ».
english_text:
Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Hajjaj, from Abu al-Hasan
al-Awwal {a.s}, peace be upon him:
Imam al-Kadhim {a.s} said regarding a man who performs supererogatory prayers (al-
nawafil) in cities, while on his riding animal, in whatever direction it turns him.
Imam {a.s} said: “Yes, there is no harm in it.”
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.440 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.230 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.517

arabic_text:
عَنهُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَمَّنْ ذَكَرَهُ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ : «أَنَّهُ لَمْ يَكُنْ يَرَى بَأْساً أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ ٱلْمَاشِي
وَهُوَ يَمْشِي وَ لَكِنْ لاَ يَسُوقُ الْإِبِلَ».
english_text:
From him, from his father, from Hammad, from Hariz, from one who mentioned it, from Abu Ja’far {a.s}, peace
be upon him:
Imam al-Baqir {a.s} saw no problem with a person praying while walking, as he is
walking. But he should not be driving the camels.
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.441 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.230 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.519 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.267

arabic_text:
مُحَمِّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمِّدٍ عَنِ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ مُوسَى عَنْ زُرَارَةَ قَالَ:
سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يَخْرُجُ فِي سَفَرٍ يُرِيدُهُ فَدَخَلَ عَلَيْهِ الْوَقْتُ وَ قَدْ خَرَجَ مِنَ الْقَرْيَةِ عَلَى
فَرْسَخَيْنٍ فَصَلَوْا وَ اِنْصَرَفَ بَعْضُهُمْ فِي حَاجَةٍ لَهُ ثُمَّ لَمْ يُقْضَ لَهُ اَلْخُرُوجُ مَا يَصْنَعُ فِي الصَّلاَةِ قَالَ «تَمَّتْ صَلاَثُهُ
وَ لا يُعِيدُ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-
Husayn ibn Musa, from Zurarah, who said:
I (Zurarah) asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him: “About a man who sets out on
a journey which he intends, and the prayer time enters while he has gone two farsakhs
out of the village, so they prayed (the shortened prayer).
And then some of them returned for a need of theirs, and then he was not able to
proceed on his journey. What should he do regarding the prayer? “
Imam {a.s} said: “His prayer is complete and he does not repeat it.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.230 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.4 p.227 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.228 • Al- Wafi, Vol.7 p.136

arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى الْعُبَيْدِيّ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ حَفْصِ الْمَزْوَزِيّ قَالَ قَالَ الْفَقِيهُ الْعَسْكَرِيُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ : «يَجِبُ
عَلَى الْمُسَافِرِ أَنْ يَقُولَ فِي دُبُرِ كُلِّ صَلاَةٍ يُقَصِّرُ فِيهَا سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ وَ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ ثَلاَثِينَ
مَرَّةً لِتَمَامِ الصَّلاَةِ».
english_text:
From him, from Muhammad ibn Isa al-‘Ubaydi, from Sulayman ibn Hafs al-Marwazi, who said:
The jurist (faqih) of ‘Askar (Imam al-Hadi {a.s}), peace be upon him, said:
“It is obligatory upon the traveller to say at the end of every prayer in which he
shortens: ‘Subhana Allah, wal-hamdu lillah, wa la ilaha illa Allah, wallahu akbar’ ,
thirty times to complete the prayer.”
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Ali ibn Muhammad al-Hadi {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.230 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.815 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.523 • Mustadrak Al-Wasa’il, Vol.6 p.544

arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُصَدِّقِ بْنِ صَدَقَةَ عَنْ عَمَّارٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ
عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ عَنِ الْمُسَافِرِ يَمْرَضُ وَ لا يَقْدِرُ أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ الْمَكْتُوبَةَ قَالَ «يَقْضِي إِذَا قَامَ مِثلَ صَلاَةِ الْمُسَافِرِ بِالتَّقْصِيرِ».
english_text:
From him, from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ali, from Amr ibn Sa’id, from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah, from ‘Ammar:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, about a traveller who becomes ill and is
unable to perform the obligatory prayer.
Imam {a.s} said: “He should make it up when he recovers, in the same manner of the
‘traveller’s prayer’ shortened (with taqsir).”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.230 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1009 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.269

arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَحْمَدَ الْعَلَوِيِّ عَنِ ٱلْعَمْرَكِيَّ الْبُوفَكِيَّ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَخِيهِ مُوسَى
عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ رَجُلِ جَعَلَ لِلَّهِ عَلَيْهِ أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ كَذَا وَ كَذَا صَلاَةً هَلْ يُجْزِيهِ أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ ذَلِكَ عَلَى دَابَّتِهِ
وَ هُوَ مُسَافِرٌ قَالَ «نَعَمْ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad al-‘Alawi, from al-‘Amraki al-Bufaki, from Ali
ibn Ja’far, from his brother Imam Musa {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Imam al-Kadhim {a.s} about a man who made a vow to Allah {SWT} upon himself,
to perform such-and-such number of prayers. Does it suffice him to perform that while
on his riding animal and he is traveling?
Imam {a.s} said: “Yes.”
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.231 • Al-Wafi, Vol.11 p.531 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.326 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.81 p.92

arabic_text:
عَنَهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُصَدَّقِ بْنِ صَدَقَةَ عَنْ عَمَّارِ السَّابَاطِيَّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلاَمُ: عَنْ رَجُلٍ وَجَبَتْ عَلَيْهِ صَلاَةٌ مِنْ قُعُودِ قَنَسِيَ حَتَّى قَامَ وَ اِفْتَتَحَ ٱلصَلاَةَ وَ هُوَ قَائِمٌ ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ قَالَ «يَقْعُدُ
وَ يَفْتَتِحُ الصَّلاةَ وَ لا يَعْتَدْ بِافْتِتَاحِهِ الصَّلاَةَ وَ هُوَ قَائِمٌ».
english_text:
From him, from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan, from Amr ibn Sa’id, from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah, from Ammar al-
Sabati, from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said regarding a man upon whom a prayer was obligatory, from a
sitting position, but he forgot until he stood and began the prayer while standing, then
remembered.
Imam {a.s} said: “He should sit down and begin the prayer, and he should not count his
beginning of the prayer while he was standing.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.231 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.915

arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ عَنِ النَّضْرِ عَنِ اِبْنِ سِنَانِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلَاَمُ قَالَ: «لَا تُصَلّ شَيْئاً مِنَ ٱلْمَفْرُوضِ
رَاكِباً» قَالَ النَّضْرُ فِي حَدِيثِهِ «إِلاَّ أَنْ تَكُونَ مَرِيضاً».
english_text:
From him, from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan, from al-Nadr, from Ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon
him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “Do not perform any of the obligatory (mafrud) prayers while
riding.”
Al-Nadr said in his narration: “Except if you are ill.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.231 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.524 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.326

arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ ظَرِيفٍ بْنِ نَاصِحٍ عَنْ مُصَبِّحِ عَنْ مَنْدَلِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ
قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ يَقُولُ: «صَلّى رَسُولُ اللهِ صَلَّى اللّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ عَلَى رَاحِلَتِهِ ٱلْفَرِيضَةَ فِي
يَوْمٍ مَطِيرٍ».
english_text:
From him, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal, from Zharif ibn Nasih, from
Musabbih, from Mandal ibn Ali, who said:
I heard Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, say: “The Messenger of Allah {SWT}, may
Allah {SWT} bless him and his family, performed the obligatory prayer (al-faridah) on his
mount on a rainy day.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Abu al-Qasim Prophet Muhammad ibn Abdullah {saws}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.231 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.523 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.327

arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنِ ٱلْجِمْيَرِيِّ قَالَ: كَتَبْتُ إِلَى أَبِي الْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ رَوَى جَعَلَنِيَ اللَّهُ فِدَاكَ مَوَالِيكَ عَنْ آبَائِكَ «أَنَّ رَسُولَ
اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ صَلَّى الْفَرِيضَةَ عَلَى رَاجِلَتِهِ فِي يَوْمِ مَطِيرٍ» وَ يُصِيبُنَا الْمَطَرُ وَ نَحْنُ فِي مَحَامِلِنَا وَ
الْأَرْضُ مُبْتَلَّةٌ وَ الْمَطَرُ يُوْذِي فَهَلْ يَجُوزُ لَنَا يَا سَيِّدِي أَنْ نُصَلَّيَ فِي هَذِهِ الْحَالِ فِي مَحَامِلِنَا أَوْ عَلَى دَوَابِّنَا الْفَرِيضَةَ
إِنْ شَاءَ اللهُ فَوَقَّعَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ «يَجُوزُ ذَلِكَ مَعَ الضَّرُورَةِ الشَّدِيدَةِ».
english_text:
From him, from al-Himyari, who said:
I wrote to Abu al-Hasan {a.s}, peace be upon him:
“May I be your ransom, your followers narrate from your forefathers {a.s} that;
‘The Messenger of Allah {SWT}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his family, performed the
obligatory prayer (al-faridah) on his mount on a rainy day.’
Rain falls upon us while we are in our litters (mahamil), and the ground is wet, and the
rain causes harm, so is it permissible for us?
O’ my master, (Is it) to perform the obligatory prayer in such a state, in our litters or on
our riding animals, Allah {SWT} willing?”
Imam {a.s}, peace be upon him, wrote in reply:
“That is permissible, in the case of severe necessity.”
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Ali ibn Muhammad al-Hadi {a.s} & Abu al-Qasim Prophet Muhammad ibn Abdullah {saws}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.231 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.523 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.326

arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سَهْلٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا الْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يُصَلِّي النَّافِلَةَ
قَاعِداً وَ لَيْسَتْ بِهِ عِلْةٌ فِي سَفَرِ أَوْ حَضَرِ قَالَ «لاَ بَأْسَ».
english_text:
From him, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Sahl, from his father, who said:
I asked Abu al-Hasan {a.s}, peace be upon him, about a man who performs the
supererogatory prayer (al-nafilah) sitting down, and he has no illness, whether in travel
or at home.
Imam {a.s} said: “There is no harm.”
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.232 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.112 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.491

arabic_text:
سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ جَمِيلٍ بْنِ دَرَّاجِ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلامُ يَقُول: «صَلِّى رَسُولُ اللهِ صَلَّى اللّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ ٱلْفَرِيضَةَ فِي ٱلْمَحْمِلِ فِي يَوْمِ وَحَلٍ وَ مَطَرِ».
english_text:
Sa’ad ibn Abdillah, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Jamil ibn Darraj, who said:
I heard Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, say:
“The Messenger of Allah {SWT}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his family, performed the
obligatory prayer (al-faridah) in the litter (al-mahmil) on a day of mud and rain.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Abu al-Qasim Prophet Muhammad ibn Abdullah {saws}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.232 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.523 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.327

arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ أُحْمَدَ بْنِ هِلاَلٍ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عُذَافِرِ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لأَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلاَمُ رَجْلٌ
يَجْلِبُ اَلْغَنَمَ مِنَ الْجَبَلِ يَكُونُ فِيهَا الْأَجِيرُ ٱلْمَجُوسِيُ وَ النَّصْرَانِيُ فَتَقَعُ الْعَارِضَةُ فَيَأْتِيهِ بِهَا مُمَلَّحَةً قَالَ «لا يَأْكُلْهَا)»
قُلْتُ يَكُونُ فِي وَقْتِ فَرِيضَةٍ لا تُمَكِّنُهُ ٱلْأَرْضُ مِنَ ٱلْقِيَامِ عَلَيْهَا وَ لاَ ٱلسُّجُودِ عَلَيْهَا مِنْ كَثْرَةِ اَلتَّلْجِ وَ ٱلْمَاءِ وَ ٱلْمَطَرِ
وَ الْوَحَلِ أَيَجُوزُ لَهُ أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ الْفَرِيضَةَ فِي الْمَحْمِلِ قَالَ «نَعَمْ هُوَ بِمَنْزِلَةِ السَّفِينَةِ إِنْ أَمْكَنَهُ قَائِما وَ إِلاَّ قَاعِداً وَ
كُلَّمَا كَانَ مِنْ ذَلِكَ فَاللَّهُ أُوْلَى بِالْعُذْرِ يَقُولُ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ «بَلِ الْإِنْسَانُ عَلىٰ نَفْسِهِ بَصِيرَةٌ» ».
english_text:
From him, from Ahmad ibn Hilal, from Amr ibn Uthman, from Muhammad ibn ‘Udhafir, who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him: “A man brings sheep down from the
mountain, and among them is a Magian (al-majusi) or Christian (al-nasrani) hired
worker, and the sudden, unforeseen death of the animal (al-aridah) occurs, so it is
brought to him salted.” (meaning the non-Muslim worker brings the meat back, salted,
presumably to preserve it for later use)
Imam {a.s} said: “He should not eat it.”
I asked: “(What if) it is during the time of an obligatory prayer, and the ground does not
allow him to stand on it or to prostrate upon it due to the abundance of snow, water,
rain, and mud does it become permissible for him to perform the obligatory prayer in
the litter (al-mahmil)?”
Imam {a.s} said: “Yes, it is like the case of a boat if he is able to (pray) standing, then (he
should do so), and if not, then sitting. And in all such cases, Allah {SWT} is more deserving
of granting the excuse. Allah {SWT}, Mighty and Majestic, says:
‘Rather, man is a witness against himself.’ (Surah Al Qiyamah 75:14)”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.232

arabic_text:
الْحُسَيْنُ بَنْ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ وَهْبٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ يَقُولُ: «كَانَ
أَبِي عَلَيْهِ السِّلَامُ يَدْعُو بِالطُّهُورِ فِي السَّفَرِ وَ هُوَ فِي مَحْمِلِهِ فَيُوتَى بِالثَّوْرِ فِيهِ الْمَاءُ فَيَتَوَضَّأُ ثُمَّ يُصَلِّي الثَّمَانِيَ
وَ الْوَثْرَ فِي مَحْمِلِهِ فَإِذَا نَزَلَ صَلَّى الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ وَ الصُّبْحَ».
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa’id, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Mu‘awiyah ibn Wahb, who said:
I heard Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, say:
“My father (Imam al-Baqir {a.s}), peace be upon him, used to call for water for
purification (al-tahur) while on a journey, and he was in his litter (al-mahmil).
A basin (al-tawr) containing water would be brought to him, and he would perform
ablution, then he would pray the eight (rak‘ahs of night prayer) and the witr in his litter.
Then, when He (Imam al-Baqir {a.s}) dismounted, He {a.s} would pray two rak‘ahs and the
morning prayer (al-subh).”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al- Baqir {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.232 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.522 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.331

arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ صَفَوَانَ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْحَجَّاجِ عَنْ أَبِي الْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ صَلاَةِ النَّافِلَةِ فِي
اَلْحَضَرِ عَلَى ظَهْرِ الدَّابَّةِ إِذَا خَرَجْتُ قَرِيباً مِنْ أَبْيَاتِ الْكُوفَةِ أَوْ كُنْتُ مُسْتَعْجِلاً بِالْكُوفَةِ فَقَالَ «إِنْ كُنْتَ مُسْتَعْجِلاً
لاَ تَقْدِرُ عَلَى النُّزُولِ تَخَوَّفْتَ فَوْتَ ذَلِكَ إِنْ تَرَكْتَهُ وَ أَنْتَ رَاكِبٌ فَنَعَمْ وَ إِلاَّ فَإِنَّ صَلاَتَكَ عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَحَبٌ إِلَيَّ».
english_text:
From him, from Safwan, from Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Hajjaj, from Abu al-Hasan {a.s}, peace be upon him, said:
I asked Imam al-Kadhim {a.s} about performing the supererogatory prayer (al-nafilah)
while in residence (al-hadar) on the back of a riding animal, when I go out close to the
houses of Kufah or if I am in a hurry in Kufah.
Imam {a.s} said: “If you are in a hurry and unable to dismount, and you fear missing it
(the prayer) if you leave it while you are riding, then yes.
Otherwise, your prayer on the ground is more beloved to me.”
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.232 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.522 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.331

arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي نَجْرَانَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا الْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ عَنِ الصَّلَاةِ بِاللِّيْلِ فِي السَّفَرِ فِي الْمَحْمِلِ
قَالَ «إِذَا كُنْتَ عَلَى غَيْرِ الْقِبْلَةِ فَاسْتَقْبِلِ ٱلْقِبْلَةَ ثُمَّ كَبَّرْ وَ صَلَّ حَيْثُ ذَهَبَ بِكَ بَعِيرُكَ» قُلْتُ جُعِلْتُ فِدَاكَ فِي أَوْلٍ
اللّيْلِ فَقَالَ «إِذَا خِفْتَ الْفَوْتَ فِي آخِرِهِ».
english_text:
From him, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Najran, who said:
I asked Abu al-Hasan {a.s}, about praying at night during travel in the litter (al-mahmil).
Imam {a.s} said: “If you are not facing the qiblah, then face the qiblah, pronounce the
takbir, and pray in whatever direction your camel takes you.”
I asked: “May I be your ransom, (can I pray) at the beginning of the night?”
Imam {a.s} said: “(Yes), If you fear missing it at the end of the night.”
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.233 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.522 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.331

arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «لا بَأْسَ بِصَلاةٍ
اللّيْل فِيمَا بَيْنَ أَوَّلِهِ إِلَى آخِرِهِ إِلاّ أَنَّ أَفْضَلَ ذَلِكَ بَعْدَ اِنْتِصَافِ اللَّيْلِ».
english_text:
From him, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Ja’far ibn Uthman, from Sama’ah, from Abu Abdillah {a.s}:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “There is no harm in performing the night prayer (salat al-layl)
at any time, between its beginning and its end, except that the best of it is after the
middle of the night.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.337 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.233 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.334 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.252 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.80 p.120 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.80 p.122

arabic_text:
مُحَمِّدُ بْنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ دَاوْدَ بْنِ الْحُصَيْنِ عَنْ فَضْلِ الْبَقْبَاقِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ ٱلْمُسَافِرِ يَنْزِلُ عَلَى بَعْضِ أَهْلِهِ يَوْماً أَوْ لَيْلَةً أَوْ ثَلاَثاً قَالَ «مَا أُجِبُّ أَنْ يُقَصِّرَ الصَّلاةَ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Dawud ibn al-Husayn, from Fadl al-
Baqbaq, from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} about a traveller (shortening his prayer), who stays with
some of his family for a day, or a night, or three (days).
Imam {a.s} said: “I do not like that he should shorten the prayer.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.233 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.232 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.161 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.510

arabic_text:
عَلِيُّ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنِ الْحَلَبِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ آللَّهِ عَ قَالَ: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى
اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ إِذَا كَانَ فِي سَفَرٍ أَوْ عَجَّلَتْ بِهِ حَاجَةٌ يَجْمَعُ بَيْنَ الظُّهْرِ وَ الْعَصْرِ وَ بَيْنَ ٱلْمَغْرِبِ وَ الْعِشَّاءِ الْآخِرَةِ
قَالَ فَقَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ «لا بَأْسَ بِأَنْ تُعَجِّلَ عِشَاءَ الْآخِرَةِ فِي السَّفَرِ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَغِيبَ الشَّفَقُ».
english_text:
Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad, from al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah {a.s}:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “The Messenger of Allah {SWT}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his
family, when He {saws} was on a journey or if a need hastened him, He {saws} would
combine between the noon (Dhuhr) and afternoon (Asr) prayers.
And (He {saws} would combine) between the sunset (Maghrib) and the final night (Isha
al-akhira) prayers.”
He (al-Halabi) said: “Then Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said;
‘There is no harm in performing the final night prayer early, during travel before the
twilight (shafaq) disappears.’”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Abu al-Qasim Prophet Muhammad ibn Abdullah {saws}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.431 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.233 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.281 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.219

arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ أَبَانِ بْنِ عُثُمَانَ عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلامُ : «وَقْتُ ٱلْمَغْرِبِ فِي السَّفَرِ إِلَى رُبُعِ اللّيْلِ».
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad, by al-Husayn ibn Sa’id, by Fadalah, by Aban ibn Uthman, from Umar ibn Yazid, said:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: “The time of the Maghrib prayer during
travel extends until one-fourth of the night.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.281 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.233 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.291 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.194 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.194

arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدِ عَنْ فَضَالَةً عَنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ عُثُمَانَ عَنْ إسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو
عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ : «أَنْتَ فِي وَقْتٍ مِنَ ٱلْمَعْرِبِ فِي السَّفَرِ إِلَى خَمْسَةِ أَمْيَالٍ مِنْ بَعْدِ غُرُوبِ الشَّمْسِ».
english_text:
From him, from al-Husayn ibn Sa’id, from Fadalah, from al-Husayn ibn Uthman, from Ishaq ibn Ammar, from
Abu Basir, who said:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: “You are within the time of the Maghrib
prayer, during travel, until five miles after the setting of the sun.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.447 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.234 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.291 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.194

arabic_text:
الْحُسَيْنُ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ بَكْرٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «صَلاَةُ ٱلْمُسَافِرِ حِينَ تَزُولُ
الشَّمْسُ لِأَنَّهُ لَيْسَ قَبْلَهَا فِي السِّفَرِ صَلاَةً وَ إِنْ شَاءَ أَخَرَهَا إِلَى وَقْتِ الظُّهْرِ فِي الْحَضَرِ غَيْرَ أَنْ أَفْضَلَ ذَلِكَ أَنْ
يُصَلَّيَهَا فِي أَوّلِ وَقْتِهَا جِينَ تَزُولُ».
english_text:
Al-Husayn, from Fadalah, from Musa ibn Bakr, from Zurarah, from Abu Ja’far {a.s}, peace be upon him, who
said:
Imam al-Baqir {a.s} said: “The prayer of the traveller is when the sun passes the zenith
(zawal), because there is no prayer before it during travel.
And if he wishes, he may delay it until the time of noon (Dhuhr) in a state of residence,
except that the best of that, is to perform it at the beginning of its time, when the sun
passes the zenith (zawal).”
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.234 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.236 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.135

arabic_text:
وَ بِهَذَا الْإِسْنَادِ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ يَقُولُ: «إِذَا كُثْتَ مُسَافِراً لَمْ تُبَالِ أَنْ تُؤَخِّرَ الظُهْرَ حَتَّى يَدْخُلَ
وَقْتُ ٱلْعَصْرِ فَتُصَلِّيَ الظُّهْرَ ثُمَّ تُصَلَّيَ ٱلْعَصْرَ وَ كَذَلِكَ ٱلْمَغْرِبُ وَ الْعِشَاءُ ٱَلْآخِرَةُ تُؤَخِّرُ ٱلْمَغْرِبَ حَتَّى تُصَلَّيَهَا فِي
آخِرٍ وَقْتِهَا وَ رَكْعَتَيْنِ بَعْدَهَا ثُمَّ تُصَلِّي اَلْعِشَاءَ».
english_text:
And with this chain of narration, he said:
I heard Abu Ja’far {a.s}, peace be upon him, say: “If you are a traveller, it does not matter
if you delay the noon (Dhuhr) prayer until the time of the afternoon (Asr) enters, so you
pray the noon and then you pray the afternoon (Asr).
And likewise the sunset (Maghrib) and the final night prayer (Isha al-akhira); you can
delay the sunset prayer (Maghrib) until you perform it at the end of its time, along with
two units (rak‘ahs) after it, then you perform the night prayer (Isha).”
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.234 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.283 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.136

arabic_text:
اَلْحُسَيْنُ عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ رِفَاعَةَ بْنِ مُوسَى عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ جَابِرٍ قَالَ: كُنْتُ مَعَ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلَاَمُ حَتَّى إِذَا بَلَغْنَا بَيْنَ الْعِشَاءَيْنِ قَالَ «يَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ اِمْضِ مَعَ الثَّقَلِ وَ الْعِيَالِ حَتَّى أَلْحَقَكَ» وَ كَانَ ذَلِكَ عِنْدَ
سُقُوطِ الشَّمْسِ فَكَرِهْتُ أَنْ أَنْزِلَ فَأُصَلِّيَ وَ أَدَعَ ٱلْعِيَالَ وَ قَدْ أَمَرَنِي أَنْ أَكُونَ مَعَهُمْ فَسِرْتُ ثُمَّ لَحِقَنِي أَبُو عَبْدِ آللّهِ
عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ فَقَالَ «يَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ هَلْ صَلَّيْتَ ٱلْمَغْرِبَ بَعْدُ» فَقُلْتُ لاَ فَنَزَلَ عَنْ دَابَّتِهِ فَأَذْنَ وَ أَقَامَ وَ صَلَّى ٱلْمَغْرِبَ
وَ صَلَّيْتُ مَعَهُ وَ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمَوْضِعِ الَّذِي فَارَقْتُهُ فِيهِ إِلَى ٱلْمَوْضِعِ الَّذِي لَحِقَنِي سِنَّةُ أَمْيَالٍ.
english_text:
Al-Husayn, from al-Qasim ibn Muhammad, from Rifaa‘ah ibn Musa, from Isma’il ibn Jabir, who said:
I was with Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, until when we reached between the
two evening prayers (al-Isha’ayn).
Imam {a.s} said: “O Isma‘il, go ahead with the luggage and the family, until I catch up
with you.”
And that was at the time of the sun’s setting, so I (Isma’il ibn Jabir) disliked
dismounting to pray and leaving the family behind, since Imam {a.s} had instructed me
to be with them.
So I (Isma’il ibn Jabir) continued on, then Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, caught
up with me and said: “O Isma‘il, have you prayed the Maghrib yet?”
I said: “No”.
So Imam {a.s} dismounted from his riding animal, gave the call to prayer (adhan), then
the commencement (iqamah), and prayed the Maghrib, and I prayed with Him {a.s}.
And the distance from the place where I had parted from Imam {a.s} to the place where
He {a.s} caught up with me was six miles.
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.234 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.292 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.195

arabic_text:
مُحَمِّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسِّلاَمُ قَالَ:
سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ صَلاَةِ ٱلْمَغْرِبِ وَ الْعِشَاءِ بِجَمْعٍ فَقَالَ «بِأَذَانٍ وَ إِقَامَتَيْنِ لا تُصَلِّ بَيْنَهُمَا شَيْئا هَكَذَا صَلَّى رَسُولُ اللّهِ صَلَّى
اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Safwan, from Mansur, from Abu
Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} about the Maghrib and Isha prayers at Jam‘ (al-Muzdalifah).
Imam {a.s} said: “With one adhan and two iqamahs; do not pray anything between them.
This is how Messenger of Allah {SWT}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his family, prayed.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Abu al-Qasim Prophet Muhammad ibn Abdullah {saws}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.234 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.5 p.190 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.5 p.480 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.2 p.255 • Al-Wafi, Vol.13 p.1044 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.225 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.14 p.15

arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنِ الْحَلَبِيَّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: «إِذَا صَلَّيْتَ
فِي السَّفَرِ شَيْئاً مِنَ الصَّلاَةِ فِي غَيْرٍ وَقْتِهَا فَلاَ يَضُرُّكَ».
english_text:
From him, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad, from al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah
{a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “If you pray anything of the prayer during travel, outside of its
time, it does not harm you.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.235 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.290

arabic_text:
أَحمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمّدٍ عَنْ مُحَمّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ غِيَاتِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلامُ : «أَنَّهُ كَانَ يُقَصِّرُ
الصَّلاةً جِينَ يَخْرُجُ مِنَ الْكُوفَةِ فِي أَوْلِ صَلَاَةٍ تَحْضُرُهُ».
٨٦٢ ٢٦٥
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ghiyath ibn Ibrahim, from Imam Ja’far {a.s}, from
his father {a.s}, peace be upon them, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “He (Imam al-Baqir {a.s}) would shorten the prayer when he
departed from Kufah, at the first prayer that became due upon Him {a.s}.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al- Baqir {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.235 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.144 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.472

arabic_text:
فَأَمَّا مَا رَوَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ عَنِ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ
قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا الْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ - عَنِ الْمَرْأَةِ كَانَتْ مَعَهُمْ فِي سَفَرٍ وَ كَانَتْ تُصَلِّي الْمَغْرِبَ رَكْعَتَيْنِ ذَاهِبَةً وَ
جَائِيَةً قَالَ «لَيْسَ عَلَيْهَا قَضَاءُ».
فهذا خبر شاذ لا نعمل عليه لانا قد بينا ان المغرب لا يقصر فيها فمن قصر كان عليه الاعادة.
٢٤ - باب العمل في ليلة الجمعة ويومها
english_text:
As for what was narrated by Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub, from Ahmad, from al-Husayn, from Ibn Abi
Umayr, from Muhammad ibn Ishaq ibn Ammar, who said:
I asked Abul Hasan {a.s}, peace be upon him, about a woman who was with them on a
journey, and she used to pray the Maghrib as two units (rak‘ahs), both when going and
returning.
Imam {a.s} said: “There is no make-up (qadah) upon her.”
ITS DAY
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}
commentary:
This is an anomalous report which we do not act upon, because we have already
explained that the Maghrib prayer is not shortened, so whoever shortens it is required
to repeat it.
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.235

Chapter Title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND
arabic_text:
اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ عَنِ النَّضْرِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «السَّاعَةُ اَلَّتِي يُسْتَجَابُ
فِيهَا الدُعَاءُ يَوْمَ ٱلْجُمُعَةِ مَا بَيْنَ فَرَاغِ الْإِمَامِ مِنَ ٱلْخُطْبَةِ إِلَى أَنْ يَسْتَوِيَ النَّاسُ فِي الصُّفُوفِ وَ سَاعَةً أُخْرَى مِنْ
آَخِرِ اَلنَّهَارٍ إِلَى غُرُوبِ الشَّمْسِ».
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa’id, from al-Nadr, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “The hour in which supplication is answered on Friday, is from
the time the imam (of prayer) finishes the sermon until the people stand in rows.
And another hour is from the end of the day until the setting of the sun.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.414 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.235 • Misbah Al-Mutahajid, Vol.1 p.363 • Jamal Al-Usbu’, Vol.1 p.407 • Al-Balad Al-Amin, Vol.1 p.71 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1086 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.352 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.86 p.217

Chapter Title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND
arabic_text:
سَهَلُ بْنُ زِيَادٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ الْمُفَضَّلِ بْنِ صَالِحِ عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرِ عَ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لَهُ قَوْلُ
اللَّه عَزَّ وَ جَلّ «فَاسْعَوا إلى ذِكْرِ الله» قَالَ قَالَ «اِعْمَلُوا وَ عَجّلُوا فَإِنّهُ يَوْمّ مُضَيَّقٌ عَلَى الْمُسْلِمِينَ فِيهِ وَ ثَوَابُ
أَعْمَالِ الْمُسْلِمِينَ فِيهِ عَلَى قَدْرِ مَا ضُيّقَ عَلَيْهِمْ وَ الْحَسَنَةُ وَ السِّيِّئَةُ تُضَاعَفُ فِيهِ» قَالَ وَ قَالَ أَبُو جَعْفَرِ عَ «وَ اللّهِ
لَقَدْ بَلَغَنِي أَنَّ أَصْحَابَ اَلنَّبِيِّ صَ كَانُوا يَتَجَهَزُونَ لِلْجُمُعَةِ يَوْمَ الْخَمِيسِ لِأَنَّهُ يَوْمُ مُضَيَّقٌ عَلَى ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ ».
english_text:
Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Mufaddal ibn Salih, from Jabir ibn Yazid, from Abu Ja’far
{a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Imam al-Baqir {a.s} regarding the saying of Allah {SWT}, Mighty and Majestic: “Then
hasten to the remembrance of Allah” (Surah Al Jumu’ah 62:9)
Imam {a.s} said: “Act and hasten, for it is a day made restricted upon the Muslims, and
the reward of the deeds of the Muslims on it is according to the extent that it has been
made restricted upon them. And the good deed and the bad deed are multiplied on it.”
He (Jabir ibn Yazid) said: “And Abu Ja’far {a.s}, peace be upon him, said;
‘By Allah {SWT}, it has reached me that the companions of the Prophet {saws}, may Allah
{SWT} bless him and his family, used to prepare for Friday on Thursday, because it is a
day made tight (restricted) upon the Muslims.”
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.415 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.236 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1093 • Tafsir Al-Safi, Vol.5 p.174 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.353 • Tafsir Al-Burhan, Vol.5 p.377 • Tafsir Nur Al-Thaqalayn, Vol.5 p.325 • Tafsir Kanz Al-Daqaiq, Vol.13 p.251

Chapter Title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
arabic_text:
عَلِيْ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ وَ الْفُضَيْلِ قَالا: قُلْنَا لَهُ أَيُجَزِي إِذَا اِغْتَسَلْتُ
بَعَدَ اَلْفَجْرِ لِلْجُمُعَةِ قَالَ «نَعَمْ».
english_text:
Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Hariz, from Zurarah and al-Fudayl, who said:
We said to Imam al-Baqir {a.s}: “Is it sufficient if I perform the ghusl after Fajr for Friday?”
Imam {a.s} said: “Yes.”
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.418 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.236 • Al-Sarair, Vol.3 p.588 • Jamal Al-Usbu’, Vol.1 p.361 • Al-Wafi, Vol.6 p.391 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.3 p.322 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.78 p.28 • Bihar Al- Anwar, Vol.80 p.129 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.86 p.351

Chapter Title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
arabic_text:
مُحَمِّدُ بْنُ إسْمَاعِيلَ عَنِ ٱلْفَضْلِ بْنِ شَاذَانَ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَفْصِ بْنِ الْبَخْتَرِيَّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ
قَالَ: «أَخْذُ الشَّارِبِ وَ الْأَظْفَارِ مِنَ الْجُمُعَةِ إِلَى الْجُمُعَةِ أَمَانٌ مِنَ الْجُذَامِ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Isma‘il, from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hafs ibn al-Bukhtari, from Abu
Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “Trimming the mustache and the nails, from one Friday to the
next, is a protection from leprosy.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.418 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.236 • Al-Wafi, Vol.6 p.680

Chapter Title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ سَعْدَانَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلامُ قَالَ: «مَنْ أَخَذَ مِنْ شَارِبِهِ وَ قَلَّمَ أَظْفَارَهُ وَ غَسَلَ رَأْسَهُ بِالْخِطَمِيِّ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ كَانَ كَمَنْ أَغْتَقَ نَسَمَةً».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Musa ibn Sa’adan, from Abdullah ibn Sinan,
from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “Whoever trims his mustache, clips his nails, and washes his
head with ‘khitmi’ (a cleansing herb, named ‘marshmallow plant’) on Friday, it is as if
he has freed a soul (in rewards).”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.418 • Al-Kafi, Vol.6 p.504 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.236 • Makarim Al- Akhlaq, Vol.1 p.61 • Jamal Al-Usbu’, Vol.1 p.362 • Al-Wafi, Vol.6 p.632 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.354 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.73 p.87 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.86 p.352

Chapter Title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ بُكَيْرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «غَسْلُ الرَّأْسِ بِالْخِطْمِيِّ فِي كُلِّ
جُمُعَةٍ أَمَانٌ مِنَ الْبَرَصِ وَ ٱلْجُنُونِ».
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Faddal, from Ibn Bukayr, from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “Washing the head with ‘khitmi’ (marshmallow plant) every
Friday, is a protection from leprosy and madness.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.418 • Al-Kafi, Vol.6 p.504 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.124 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.236 • Rawdat Al-Wa’izin, Vol.2 p.307 • Makarim Al-Akhlaq, Vol.1 p.60 • Jamal Al-Usbu’, Vol.1 p.362 • Al-Wafi, Vol.6 p.631 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.354 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.73 p.87

Chapter Title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ مُحَمّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ مُحَمِّدِ بْنِ الْفُضَيْلِ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ
بْنِ زَيْدٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ جَدَّهِ عَلَيْهِمُ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «جَاءَ أَعْرَابِيٌّ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صَلِّى اللَّهُ
عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ يُقَالُ لَهُ قُلَيْبٌ فَقَالَ لَهُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي تَهَيَّأْتُ إِلَى الْحَجَّ كَذَا وَ كَذَا مَرَّةً فَمَا قُدَّرَ لِي فَقَالَ لَهُ «يَا
قَلَيْبٌ عَلَيْكَ بِالْجُمُعَةِ فَإِنَّهَا حَجُّ الْمَسَاكِينِ» ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub, by Muhammad ibn Isa, by Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, by Muhammad ibn
al-Fudayl, by Abd al-Rahman ibn Zayd, by Abu Abdillah {a.s}, from his father {a.s}, from his grandfather {a.s}, said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “A Bedouin came to the Prophet {saws}, may Allah {SWT} bless him
and his family, and he was called Qulayb.
Qulayb said to Him {saws}: ‘O Messenger of Allah {SWT}, I have prepared for Hajj such and
such number of times, but it was never destined for me.’
So Prophet {saws} said to him: ‘O Qulayb, hold to Friday, for it is the Hajj of the poor.’”
(striving on Fridays, is means to earn great rewards for those too poor to afford Hajj)
source: Abu al-Qasim Prophet Muhammad ibn Abdullah {saws}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.236 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1114 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.300

Chapter Title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
arabic_text:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ وَهْبٍ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ بَكْرٍ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي الْحَسَنِ
عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ إِنَّ أَصْحَابَنَا يَقُولُونَ إِنَّ أَخْذَ الشَّارِبِ وَ قَلْمَ الأَطْفَارِ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ فَقَالَ «سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ خُذْهَا مَتَى شِئْتَ
فِي يَوْمِ الْجُمُعَةِ وَ إِنْ شِئْتَ فَفِي سَائِرِ الْأَيَّامِ».
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa’id, by al-Qasim ibn Muhammad, by Ja’far ibn Mu‘awiyah ibn Wahb, by Musa ibn Bakr, said:
I said to Abul Hasan {a.s}, peace be upon him: “Indeed, our companions say that
trimming the mustache and clipping the nails, is specific to (only) Friday.”
Imam {a.s} said: “Glory be to Allah! Do it whenever you wish on Friday, and if you wish,
then on any of the other days.”
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p237 • Makarim Al-Akhlaq, Vol.1 p64 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.73 p.121

Chapter Title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنِ ٱلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ أَبِي حَفْصِ الْجُرْجَانِيّ عَنْ
أَبِي الْخَضِيبِ الرَّبِيعِ بْنِ بَكْرٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّجِيمِ الْقَصِيرِ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «مَنْ أَخَذَ مِنْ أَظْفَارِهِ وَ
شَارِبِهِ كُلَّ جُمُعَةٍ وَ قَالَ حِينَ يَأْخُذُهُ بِسْمِ اللّهِ وَ بِاللّهِ وَ عَلَى سُنَّةٍ رَسُولِ اللّهِ صَلَّى اللّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ لَمْ تَسْقُطْ مِنْهُ
قُلاَمَةٌ وَ لاَ جُزَازَةٌ إِلاَّ كَتَبَ اللَّهُ لَهُ بِهَا عِثْقَ نَسَمَةٍ وَ لَمْ يَمْرَضْ إِلاَّ مَرَضَهُ الَذِي يَمُوتُ فِيهِ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal, from Abu
Hafs al-Jurjani, from Abu al-Khadib al-Rabi‘ ibn Bakr, from Abd al-Rahim al-Qasir, from Abu Ja’far {a.s}, peace
be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Baqir {a.s} said: “Whoever trims his nails and mustache every Friday, and says
at the time of trimming:
‘In the name of Allah {SWT}, and by Allah {SWT}, and upon the Sunnah of the Messenger of
Allah {SWT}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his family’,
then not a single clipping (of nail) or cutting (of hair) will fall from him,
except that Allah {SWT} will write for him with it the freeing of a soul (in rewards),
And he will not fall ill except with the illness by which he dies.”
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.6 p.491 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.126 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.237 • Awali Al-La’ali, Vol.4 p.13 • Al-Wafi, Vol.6 p.682

Chapter Title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ هِلاَلٍ عَنْ عَمَّهِ عَبْدِ اللّهِ بْنِ هِلاَلٍ قَالَ قَالَ لِي أَبُو عَبْدِ اللّهِ
عَلَيْهِ السِّلامُ : «خُذْ مِنْ شَارِبِكَ وَ أَطْفَارِكَ كُلَّ جُمُعَةٍ وَ إِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ فِيهَا شَيْءٌ فَزَكِّهَا فَلا يُصِيبَكَ جُذَامٌ وَ لاَ بَرَصْ
وَ لا جُنُونٌ».
english_text:
From him, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from al-Hasan ibn Sulayman ibn Hilal, from his uncle Abdullah
ibn Hilal, who said:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said to me:
“Trim your mustache and your nails every Friday,
And if there is nothing to trim, then purify them (symbolically clean or file them),
so that leprosy, vitiligo, and madness do not afflict you.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.237

Chapter Title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمِّدِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنِ ٱلْعَلاَءِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ عَنْ أَحَدِهِمَا عَلَيْهِمَا ٱلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «اِغْتَسِلْ
يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ إِلَّ أَنْ تَكُونَ مَرِيضا أَوْ تَخَافَ عَلَى نَفْسِكَ».
english_text:
From him, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Safwan, from al-‘Ala’, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from
one of the two (Imams {a.s}), peace be upon them, who said:
Imam {a.s} said: “Perform ghusl on the day of Friday, unless you are ill or fear for
yourself.”
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s} & Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al- Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.237 • Al-Wafi, Vol.6 p.392 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.3 p.314 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.78 p.129 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.86 p.356 • Mustadrak Al-Wasa’il, Vol.2 p.502

Chapter Title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنِ اِبْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ عِيسَى الْفَرَّاءِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي يَعْفُورِ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لَهُ جُعِلْتُ فِدَاكَ إِنَّهُ مَا
أُسْتُنْزِلَ الرِّرْقُ بِشَيْءٍ يَعْدِلُ التَّعْقِيبَ بَيْنَ طُلُوعِ الْفَجْرِ إِلَى طُلُوعِ الشَّمْسِ قَالَ لِي «أَجَلْ وَ لَكِنِّي أُخْبِرُكَ بِخَيْرٍ مِنْ
ذَلِكَ أَخَذِ الشَّارِبِ وَتَقْلِيمِ الْأَظْفَارِ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ ».
english_text:
From him, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Ibn Faddal, from Isa al-Farra’, from Ibn Abi Ya‘fur, who
said:
I said to Imam {a.s}: “May I be your ransom, indeed sustenance has not been brought
down by anything equal to ‘ta‘qib’ (post-prayer devotion acts) done between the rising
of the dawn and the rising of the sun.”
Imam {a.s} said to me: “Yes, but I will inform you of something better than that; trimming
the mustache and clipping the nails on the day of Friday.”
source: Implicit (Muzmar)
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.238

Chapter Title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
arabic_text:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ أُذَيْنَةَ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسِّلاَمُ : «الْجُمُعَةُ
وَاجِبَةٌ عَلَى مَنْ إِنْ صَلَّى الْغَدَاةَ فِي أَهْلِهِ أَدْرَكَ الْجُمُعَةَ وَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ إِنَّمَا يُصَلِّي الْعَصْرَ
فِي وَقْتِ الظُهْرِ فِي سَائِرِ الْأَيَّامِ كَيْ إِذَا قَضَوُا الصَّلاَةَ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللهِ صَلَّى اللّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ رَجَعُوا إِلَى رِحَالِهِمْ قَبْلَ
اللّيْلِ وَ ذَلِكَ سُنَّةٌ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ ».
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa’id, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Umar ibn Udhaynah, from Zurarah, who said:
Abu Ja’far {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: “The Friday prayer is obligatory upon the one
who, if he performs the morning prayer with his family, can reach the Friday prayer
(meaning in terms of distance).
And the Messenger of Allah {SWT}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his family, used to pray
the afternoon prayer, at the time of the noon prayer on other days,
so that when they completed the prayer with Messenger of Allah {SWT}, may Allah {SWT}
bless him and his family, the people would return to their dwellings before nightfall.
And this is a Sunnah until the Day of Resurrection.”
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s} & Abu al-Qasim Prophet Muhammad ibn Abdullah {saws}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.238 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.240 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.421 • Al- Wafi, Vol.8 p.1120 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.307

Chapter Title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنِ النَّضْرِ عَنْ عَاصِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ وَ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «مَنْ تَرَكَ الْجُمُعَةَ
ثَلَاَثَ جُمَعِ مُتَوَالِيَةً طَبَعَ اَللهُ عَلَى قَلْبِهِ».
english_text:
From him, from al-Nadr, from Asim, from Abu Basir and Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja’far {a.s}, peace
be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Baqir {a.s} said: “Whoever abandons the Friday prayer for three consecutive
Fridays, Allah {SWT} places a seal upon his heart.”
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.238 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1125 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.299

Chapter Title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
arabic_text:
الْحُسَيْنُ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنِ الْعَلَاءِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ عَنْ أَحَدِهِمَا عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْثُهُ عَنْ أُنَاسٍ فِي قَرْيَةِ
هَلْ يُصَلُّونَ الْجُمُعَةَ جَمَاعَةً قَالَ «نَعَمْ وَ يُصَلُّونَ أَرْبَعاً إِذَا لَمْ يَكُنْ مَنْ يَخْطُبُ».
english_text:
Al-Husayn, from Safwan, from al-‘Ala’, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from one of the two (Imams {a.s}), peace
be upon them, who said:
I asked Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} about a group of people in a village, do they perform the
Friday prayer in congregation?
Imam {a.s} said: “Yes, and they pray four units if there is no one to deliver the sermon.”
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s} & Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al- Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.238 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.419 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1122 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.306 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.86 p.179

Chapter Title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ أَبَانِ بْنِ عُثُمَانَ عَنِ الْفَضْلِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلاَمُ يَقُولُ: «إِذَا كَانَ
قَوْمٌ فِي قَرْيَةِ صَلَّوْا أَرْبَعَ رَكَعَاتٍ فَإِنْ كَانَ لَهُمْ مَنْ يَخْطُبُ بِهِمْ جَمَّعُوا إِذَا كَانُوا خَمْسَةَ نَفَرٍ وَ إِنَّمَا جُعِلَتْ رَكْعَتَيْنِ
لِمَكَانِ الْخُطبَتَيْنِ».
english_text:
From him, from Fadalah, from Aban ibn Uthman, from al-Fadl ibn Abd al-Malik, who said:
I heard Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, say: “If a group of people are in a village,
they pray four units. But if they have someone to deliver the sermon for them, they may
hold the Friday prayer if they are five individuals.
And it (Salat Al Jumu’ah) was made two units because of the two sermons.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.238 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.420 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1122 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.304 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.306

Chapter Title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ سَالِمِ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ قَالَ: حَثَّنَا أَبُو عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ عَلَى صَلَاَةِ الْجُمُعَةِ حَتَّى
ظَنَنْتُ أَنَّهُ يُرِيدُ أَنْ نَأْتِيَهُ فَقُلْتُ لَهُ نَغْدُو عَلَيْكَ فَقَالَ «لا إِنَّمَا عَنَيْتُ عِنْدَكُمْ».
english_text:
From him, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hisham ibn Salim, from Zurarah, who said:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, urged us to attend the Friday prayer so strongly
that I thought Imam {a.s} wanted us to come to him.
So I said to Imam {a.s}: “Shall we come to you in the morning?”
Imam {a.s} said, “No, I only meant where you are.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Muqni’ah, Vol.1 p.164 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.239 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.420 • Awali Al-La’ali, Vol.3 p.100 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1126 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.309 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.86 p.164
