Riser ‘the Qa'im {ajf}’, may Allah {SWT} the Exalted hasten his relief, will pray.
This is because the ‘Mosque of Kufah’ will be too small for them. And indeed, twelve
just Imams {a.s} shall pray in it.”
I asked: “O Commander of the Faithful {a.s}, will this ‘Mosque of Kufah’ that you
describe, be able to accommodate the people on that day?”
Imam {a.s} said: “Four mosques shall be built for him (the Qa'im {ajf});
Masjid al-Kufa will be the smallest of them, and this one, and two mosques at the two
ends of Kufa, on this side and that side”
And Imam {a.s} pointed with his hand toward the Basrans (al-Basriyyin) and the people
of al-Ghari (al-Ghariyyin).
AND ITS RULINGS
source: Amir al-Mu’minin Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib al-Murtadha {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.253 • Al-Wafi, Vol.14 p.1453 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.5 2 p.374

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحُصَيْنِ وَ عَلِيَّ بْنِ حَدِيدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بَنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ خَالِدٍ عَنْ
أَبِي حَمْرَةَ التُمَالِيِّ : أَنَّ عَلِيَّ بْنَ الْحُسَيْنِ عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلَامُ أَتَى مَسْجِدَ الْكُوفَةِ عَمْداً مِنَ الْمَدِينَةِ فَصَلَّى فِيهِ أَرْبَعَ
رَكَّعَاتٍ ثُمَّ عَادَ حَتَّى رَكِبَ رَاحِلَتَهُ وَ أَخَذَ الطَّرِيقَ.
english_text:
From him, from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn and Ali ibn Hadid, from Muhammad
ibn Sinan, from Amr ibn Khalid, from Abu Hamzah al-Thumali:
Imam Ali ibn al-Husayn {a.s}, peace be upon them both, came intentionally from Medina
to the ‘Mosque of Kufah’, and Imam {a.s} prayed in it four units of prayer.
Then Imam {a.s} returned until he mounted his riding animal and took the road.
source: Abu Muhammad Imam Ali ibn Husayn Zayn al-Abidin {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.254 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.254 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.4 6 p.64 • Awalim Al-Uloom, Vol.18 p.131

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُصَدِّقِ بْنِ صَدَفَةَ عَنْ عَمَّارِ بْنِ مُوسَى عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ آللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ الصَّلَاَةِ فِي الْمَدِينَةِ هَلْ هِيَ مِثْلُ الصَّلَةِ فِي مَسْجِدِ رَسُولِ اللّهِ صَلَّى اللّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ قَالَ
«لا إِنَّ الصَّلاةَ فِي مَسْجِدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ أَلْفُ صَلاةٍ وَ الصَّلاةَ فِي ٱلْمَدِينَةِ مِثْلُ الصَّلاةِ فِي سَائِرٍ
اَلْبُلْدَانِ».
english_text:
From him, from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan, from Amr ibn Sa'id, from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah, from Ammar ibn
Musa, from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} about prayer in Medina, is it like the prayer in the Mosque of
the Messenger of Allah {SWT}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his family?
Imam {a.s} said: “No. Indeed, the prayer in the Mosque of the Messenger of Allah {SWT},
may Allah {SWT} bless him and his family, is equal to one thousand prayers, and the
prayer in Medina is like the prayer in all other cities.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Kamil Al-Ziyarat, Vol.1 p.20 • Kamil Al-Ziyarat, Vol.1 p.21 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.254 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.515 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.281 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.96 p.381

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ بَشَارٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الدَّهْقَانِ عَنْ عَبْدِ الْحَمِيدِ عَنْ أَبِي إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلاَمُ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ : «جَنَّبُوا مَسَاجِدَكُمْ صِبْيَانَكُمْ وَ مَجَانِينَكُمْ وَ شِرَاءَكُمْ وَ بَيْعَكُمْ
وَ اِجْعَلُوا مَطَاهِرَكُمْ عَلَى أُبْوَابِ مَسَاجِدِكُمْ ».
english_text:
AND ITS RULINGS
From him, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ja’far ibn Muhammad ibn Bashshar, from Abdillah al-Dihqan, from Abd
al-Hamid, from Abu Ibrahim {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Kadhim {a.s} said: “The Messenger of Allah {SWT}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and
his family, said:
‘Keep your children and your insane ones and your buying and selling away from your
mosques, and place your wash areas (matahir) at the doors of your mosques.’”
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s} & Abu al-Qasim Prophet Muhammad ibn Abdullah {saws}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.254

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
وَ بِهَذَا الْإِسْادِ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلهِ : «مَنْ كَنَسَ الْمَسْجِدَ يَوْمَ الْخَمِيسِ وَ لَيْلَةَ الْجُمُعَةِ فَأَخْرَجَ
مِنْهُ مِنَ التُّرَابِ مَا يُذَرُّ فِي اَلْعَيْنِ غَفَرَ اللهُ لَهُ».
english_text:
And with this chain of transmission, he said:
The Messenger of Allah {SWT}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his family, said:
“Whoever sweeps the mosque on Thursday and the night of Friday and removes from
it dust, that can be scattered into the eye, Allah {SWT} will forgive him.”
source: Abu al-Qasim Prophet Muhammad ibn Abdullah {saws}
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.233 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.254 • Rawdat Al- Wa’izin, Vol.2 p.336 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.509 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.238 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.80 p.385

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ عِيسَى بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَهْزِيَارَ بِإِسْنَادٍ لَهُ قَالَ: قَالَ لَهُ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلامُ «حَدْ مَسْجِدِ ٱلْكُوفَةِ آخِرُ ٱلسَّرَّاجِينَ خَطَّهُ آدَمُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ وَ أَنَا أكْرَهُ أُنْ أُدْخُلَهُ رَاكِباً» قَالَ قُلْتُ فَمَنْ غَيَّرَهُ
عَنْ خِطَّتِهِ قَالَ «أَمَّا أَوّلُ ذَلِكَ فَالطُوفَانُ فِي زَمَانِ نُوحِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ ثُمَّ غَيَّرَهُ أَصْحَابُ كِسْرَى وَ النُعْمَانِ ثُمَّ غَيَّرَهُ
زِيَادُ بْنُ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ لَعْنَةُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya from Isa ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn Mahziyar with his chain of
transmission, who said:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said to him:
“The boundary of the ‘Mosque of Kufah’ is at the end of the area of the lamp-makers
(al-sarrajin); it was marked out by Adam {a.s}, peace be upon him, and I dislike entering
it while riding.”
He (narrator) said: “I asked, ‘Then who changed it from its original plan?’”
Imam {a.s} said: “The first of that was the flood in the time of Nuh {a.s}, peace be upon
him, then it was changed by the people of Kisra and al-Nu'man, then it was altered by
Ziyad ibn Abi Sufyan, may the curse of Allah {SWT} be upon him.”
AND ITS RULINGS
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.255

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمِّدِ بْنِ أَبِي نَصْرٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا الْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلاَمُ عَنْ قَبْرِ فَاطِمَةَ عَلَيْهَا السَّلاَمُ فَقَالَ
«دُفِنَتْ فِي بَيْتِهَا فَلَمَّا زَادَثْ بَنُو أَمَيَّةَ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ صَارَثْ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ ».
english_text:
From him, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, who said:
I asked Abul Hasan {a.s}, peace be upon him, about the grave of (Sayyidah) Fatimah {s.a},
peace be upon her.
Imam {a.s} said: “She {s.a} was buried in her house, and when the Umayyads expanded
the mosque, it became part of the mosque.”
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Ali ibn Musa al-Ridha {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.255 • Al-Manaqib, Vol.3 p.365 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.14 p.368 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.4 3 p.185 • Awalim Al-Uloom, Vol.11 p.1114

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ يَعْلَى بْنِ حَمْزَةَ عَنِ الْحَجَّالِ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ عَنْ رَجُلٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَلاَمُ قَالَ: «مَنْ مَشَى
إِلَى الْمَسْجِدِ لَمْ يَضَعْ رِجْلاً عَلَى رَطْبٍ وَ لا يَابِسِ إِلَّ سَبَّحَتْ لَهُ الْأَرْضُ إِلَى الْأَرْضِ السَّابِعَةِ».
english_text:
From him, from Ya'la ibn Hamzah, from al-Hajjal, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from a man, from Abu Abdillah {a.s},
peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “Whoever walks to the mosque, he does not place a foot on
anything moist or dry except that the earth glorifies Allah {SWT} on his behalf down to the
seventh layer of the earth.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Thawab Al-A’mal wa ‘Iqab Al-A’mal, Vol.1 p.27 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.255 • Makarim Al-Akhlaq, Vol.1 p.297 • Falah Al-Sa’il, Vol.1 p.91 • Miftah Al-Falah, Vol.1 p.32 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.514 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.200 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.81 p.13

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ هَاشِمِ عَنِ النَّوْفَلِيَّ عَنِ السَّكُونِيّ عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَلَيْهِمَا السَلَامُ قَالَ
قَالَ النَّبِيْ صَلّى اللّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ : «مَنْ كَانَ ٱلْقُرْآنُ حَدِيثَهُ وَ ٱلْمَسْجِدُ بَيْتَهُ بَنَى اللهُ لَهُ بَيْتاً فِي الْجَنَّةِ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya from Ibrahim ibn Hashim from al-Nawfali from al-Sakuni from Imam Ja’far
{a.s}, from his father {a.s}, peace be upon them both, who said:
The Prophet {saws}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his family, said:
“Whoever makes the Quran his speech and the mosque his home, Allah {SWT} will build
for him a house in Paradise.”
AND ITS RULINGS
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Abu al-Qasim Prophet Muhammad ibn Abdullah {saws}
references: Thawab Al-A’mal wa ‘Iqab Al-A’mal, Vol.1 p.27 • Al-Amali (Lil-Saduq), Vol.1 p.501 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.255 • Rawdat Al-Wa’izin, Vol.2 p.337 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.513 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.198 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.80 p.385 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.89 p.197

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ الْبَرْقِيِّ عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ جَدِّهِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ رَاشِدٍ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلامُ عَنْ آبَائِهِ عَنْ عَلِيَّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ قَالَ: «مَنْ أَكَلّ شَيْئاً مِنَ الْمُوذِيَاتِ رِيحُهَا فَلا يَقْرَبَنَّ الْمَسْجِدَ».
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Barqi from al-Qasim ibn Yahya from his grandfather al-Hasan ibn Rashid
from Abu Basir from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, from his forefathers, from Imam Ali {a.s}, peace be
upon him, who said:
Imam Ali {a.s} said: “Whoever eats anything whose odor is offensive, let him not come
near the mosque.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Amir al-Mu’minin Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib al-Murtadha {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.255 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.498 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.227 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.228 • Al-Fusul Al-Muhimmah, Vol.2 p.83

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ الْكُوفِيّ عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللّهِ بْنِ مَيْمُونِ الْقَدَّاحِ عَنْ
جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلامُ قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ : «تَعَاهَدُوا نِعَالَكُمْ عِنْدَ أَبْوَابٍ مَسَاجِدِكُمْ وَ
نَهَى أَنْ يَتَنَعَلَ الرَّجُلُ وَ هُوَ قَائِمٌ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from al-Hasan ibn Ali al-Kufi from Ja’far ibn Muhammad from Abdillah ibn
Maymun al-Qaddah from Imam Ja’far {a.s}, from his father {a.s}, peace be upon them both, who said:
The Prophet, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his family, said: “Take care of your sandals
at the doors of your mosques, and he forbade a man from putting on his sandals while
standing.”
source: Abu al-Qasim Prophet Muhammad ibn Abdullah {saws}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.255 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.498 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.229

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ عَنِ الْبَرْقِيِّ عَنِ النَّوْفَلِيَّ عَنِ السَّكُونِيِّ عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ آبَائِهِ عَنْ عَلِيَّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ : «أَنَّ عَلِيّاً عَلَيْهِ
السَّلامُ مَرَّ عَلَى مَنَارَةٍ طَوِيلَةٍ فَأَمَرَ بِهَدْمِهَا ثُمَّ قَالَ «لَا تُرْقَعُ الْمَنَارَةُ إِلَّ مَعَ سَطْحِ الْمَسْجِدِ» ».
english_text:
Ahmad from al-Barqi from al-Nawfali from al-Sakuni from Imam Ja’far {a.s}, from his father {a.s}, from his
forefathers, from Imam Ali {a.s}, peace be upon him:
Imam Ali {a.s}, peace be upon him, passed by a tall minaret and ordered it to be
demolished.
Then Imam {a.s} said: “A minaret is not to be raised except to the level of the roof of the
mosque.”
AND ITS RULINGS
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Amir al-Mu’minin Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib al-Murtadha {a.s}
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.239 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.256 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.494 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.230

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ وَهْبِ بْنِ وَهْبٍ عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَلَيْهِمَا ٱلسُلاَمُ قَالَ: «إذَا أَخْرَجَ أَحَدُكُمُ
الْحَصَاةَ مِنَ الْمَسْجِدِ فَلْيَرُدَّهَا مَكَانَهَا أَوْ فِي مَسْجِدٍ آخَرَ فَإِنَّهَا تُسَبِّحُ ».
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Abi Abdillah from his father from Wahb ibn Wahb from Imam Ja’far {a.s}, from his father {a.s}, peace
be upon them both, who said:
Imam {a.s} said: “If one of you removes a pebble from the mosque, let him return it to its
place or to another mosque, for it glorifies Allah {SWT} (does tasbih).”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al- Baqir {a.s}
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.237 • ‘Ilal Al-Shara’i’, Vol.2 p.320 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.256 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.503 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.232 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.81 p.7

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
أَحمَدُ بنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ غِيَاتِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ آبَائِهِ عَلَيْهِمُ السَّلاَمُ أَنَّ عَلِيّاً
عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «الْبُزَاقُ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ خَطِيئَةٌ وَ كَفَّارَتُهُ دَقْنُهُ».
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Ghiyath ibn Ibrahim from Imam Ja’far {a.s}, from his
father {a.s}, from his forefathers, peace be upon them:
Imam Ali {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: “Spitting in the mosque is a sin, and its
expiation is to bury it.” (meaning cover it with sand)
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Amir al-Mu’minin Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib al-Murtadha {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.256 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.442 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.499 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.222 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.81 p.2

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ مُحَمِّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ يَسَارٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ جَعْفَرِ السَّكُونِيّ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ
بْنِ مُسْلِمِ الشَّعِيرِيَّ عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ آبَائِهِ عَلَيْهِمُ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: «مَنْ وَقَّرَ بِنُخَامَتِهِ ٱلْمَسْجِدَ لَقِيَ اللَّهَ يَوْمَ
الْقِيَامَةِ ضَاحِكاً قَدْ أُعْطِيَ «كِتابَهُ بِيَمِينِهِ» ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from Musa ibn Yasar from Ali ibn Ja’far al-
Sakuni from Isma’il ibn Muslim al-Shayiri from Imam Ja’far {a.s}, from his father {a.s}, from his forefathers,
peace be upon them:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “Whoever honors the mosque regarding his phlegm (spitting it
in a respectful or hidden manner), he shall meet Allah {SWT} on the Day of Resurrection
smiling, having been given his book (of accountability) in his right hand (kitabahu
biyaminihi).”
AND ITS RULINGS
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Ash’athiyat, Vol.1 p.38 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.256 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.442 • Al- Wafi, Vol.7 p.500 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.223 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.81 p.16 • Mustadrak Al-Wasa’il, Vol.3 p.375

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ أَبِي إسْحَاقَ النَّهَا وَنْدِيَّ عَنِ الْبَرْقِيِّ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللّهِ بْنِ سِنَانِ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلامُ يَقُولُ: «مَنْ تَنَخّعَ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ ثُمَّ رَدَّهَا فِي جَوْفِهِ لَمْ تَمُرَّ بِدَاءٍ فِي جَوْفِهِ إِلَّ أَبْرَأْتْهُ».
english_text:
From him, from Abu Ishaq al-Nahawandi, from al-Barqi, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, who
said:
I heard Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, say: “Whoever spits phlegm
(tanakhkhaʿa) in the mosque and then swallows it back into his body, there will not
remain any illness in his body except that it will be cured.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.233 • Thawab Al-A’mal wa ‘Iqab Al-A’mal, Vol.1 p.18 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.256 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.442 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.500 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.223 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.81 p.13

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مِهْرَانَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلاَمُ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لَهُ الرَّجُلُ
يَكُونُ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ فِي الصَّلاةِ فَيُرِيدُ أَنْ يَبْصُقَ فَقَالَ «عَنْ يَسَارِهِ وَ إِنْ كَانَ فِي غَيْرِ صَلاَةٍ فَلَاَ يَنْزُقُ جِذَاءَ الْقِبْلَةِ
وَ يَبْزُقُ عَنْ يَمِينِهِ وَ شِمَالِهِ».
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa’id from Muhammad ibn Mihran from Abdullah ibn Sinan from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be
upon him, who said:
I said to Imam al-Sadiq {a.s}: “A man is in the mosque in prayer and wants to spit.”
Imam {a.s} said: “To his left. And if he is not in prayer, then he should not spit facing the
Qiblah, but he may spit to his right or to his left.”
AND ITS RULINGS
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.370 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.257 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.442 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.501 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.221 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.80 p.365 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.81 p.200

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنِ الْعَبَّاسِ بْنِ مَعْرُوفٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ طَلْحَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ
عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «لا يَبْزُقَنَّ أَحَدُكُمْ فِي الصَّلاَةِ قِبَلَ وَجْهِهِ وَ لاَ عَنْ يَمِينِهِ وَ لَيَبْزُقْ عَنْ يَسَارِهِ وَ تَحْتَ قَدَمِهِ
اَلْيُسْرَى».
قال محمد بن الحسن : هذه الاخبار محمولة على ضرب من الكراهية ولو فعل الانسان غير ذلك لم يكن مأثوما ، يدل على
ذلك ما رواه :
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya from al-Abbas ibn Ma'ruf from Muhammad ibn Sinan from Talhah ibn Zayd
from Imam Ja’far {a.s}, from his father {a.s}, peace be upon them both, who said:
Imam al-Baqir {a.s} said: “Let none of you spit during prayer in front of his face, nor to
his right, but let him spit to his left and beneath his left foot.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al- Baqir {a.s}
commentary:
Muhammad ibn al-Hasan said: “These reports are to be understood as indicating a
kind of dislike (karahiyyah), and if a person were to act otherwise, he would not be
sinful.” This is supported by what has been narrated:
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.277 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.257 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.501 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.319 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.222 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.80 p.365 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.81 p.201

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَهْزِيَارَ قَالَ: رَأَيْتُ أَبَا جَعْفَرِ الثَّانِيَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ تَفَلَ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ فِيمَا بَيْنَ الرُّكْنِ
اَلْيَمَانِيّ وَ الْحَجَرِ الْأَسْوَدِ وَ لَمْ يَدْفِئْهُ.
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahziyar said:
I saw Abu Ja’far al-Thani {a.s} (the Second), peace be upon him, spit in the ‘Sacred
Mosque’ (al-Masjid al-Haram) between the Yemeni Corner and the Black Stone, and
Imam {a.s} did not bury it.
AND ITS RULINGS
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Jawad {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.370 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.257 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.443 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.502 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.221 • Awalim Al-Uloom, Vol.23 p.390

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
سَعْدٌ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَنِ الْعَبَّاسِ بْنِ مَعْرُوفِ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ مَوْلَى طِرْبَالٍ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ
بْنِ زُرَارَةَ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ يَقُولُ: «كَانَ أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ يُصَلِّي فِي ٱلْمَسْجِدِ فَيَبْصُقُ
أَمَامَهُ وَ عَنْ يَمِينِهِ وَ عَنْ شِمَالِهِ وَ خَلْفَهُ عَلَى الْحَصَى وَ لا يُعَطَيهِ».
english_text:
Sa’ad from Abu Ja’far from al-Abbas ibn Ma‘ruf from Safwan from al-Qasim ibn Muhammad from Sulayman,
the client of Tirbal, from Ubayd ibn Zurarah, who said:
I heard Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, say:
“Abu Ja’far {a.s}, peace be upon him, used to pray in the mosque and would spit in front
of him, to his right, to his left, and behind him on the pebbles, and he would not cover
it.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al- Baqir {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.257 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.443 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.502 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.221 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.80 p.365

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ رِفَاعَةَ بْنِ مُوسَى قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ عَنِ ٱلْوُضُوءِ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ
فَكَرِهَهُ مِنَ الْغَائِطِ وَ الْبَوْلِ.
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa’id from Fadalah from Rifa‘ah ibn Musa who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, about performing ablution in the mosque.
Imam {a.s} disliked it when it was after defecation or urination.
(meaning dislike ‘karahah’ for doing wudu in the mosque when the cause for
purification was relieving oneself)
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.369 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.1 p.356 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.257 • Al- Wafi, Vol.6 p.341 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.503 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.1 p.492 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.80 p.350

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
عَلِي بْنُ إبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ وَهْبٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ عَنِ النَّوْمِ فِي
الْمَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ وَ مَسْجِدِ الرَّسُولِ قَالَ «نَعَمْ أَيْنَ يَنَامُ النَّاسُ».
english_text:
Ali ibn Ibrahim from Muhammad ibn Isa from Mu‘awiyah ibn Wahb who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, about sleeping in the ‘Sacred Mosque’
(al-Masjid al-Haram) and the ‘Mosque of the Messenger {saws}’.
Imam {a.s} said: “Yes. Where else would people sleep?”
AND ITS RULINGS
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.369 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.258 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.504 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.219

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لأَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ مَا تَقُولُ فِي النَّوْمِ فِي ٱلْمَسَاجِدِ
فَقَالَ «لا بَأْسَ إلاّ فِي ٱلْمَسْجِدَيْنِ - مَسْجِدِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ وَ مَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ » قَالَ وَ كَانَ يَأْخَذُ بِيَدِي
فِي بَعْضِ اللَّيْلِ فَيَتَتَحَّى نَاحِيَةً ثُمَّ يَجْلِسُ فَيَتَحَدَّثُ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ فَرُبَّمَا نَامَ فَقُلْتُ لَهُ فِي ذَلِكَ فَقَالَ «إِنَّمَا
يُكْرَهُ أَنْ يُنَامَ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ الَّذِي كَانَ عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ فَأَمَّا الَّذِي فِي هَذَا الْمَوْضِعِ فَلَيْسَ
بِهِ بَأْسٌ».
english_text:
From him, from his father, from Hammad, from Hariz, from Zurarah, who said:
I said to Abu Ja’far {a.s}, peace be upon him: “What do you say about sleeping in the
mosques?”
Imam {a.s} said: “There is no problem except in two mosques; the ‘Mosque of the
Prophet {saws}’, peace be upon him and his family, and the ‘Sacred Mosque.’”
He (Zurarah) said: “And Imam {a.s} would take me by the hand during part of the night,
then withdraw to a side, and sit and talk in the ‘Sacred Mosque’, and Imam {a.s} would
sometimes sleep.
So I asked Imam {a.s} about that, and Imam {a.s} said:
‘It is only disliked to sleep in the part of the mosque that existed during the time of the
Messenger of Allah {SWT}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his family.
As for that which is in this area, there is no problem with it.’”
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.258 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.80 p.358

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمِّدٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ الْمُخْتَارِ عَنْ أَبِي أُسَامَةَ زَيْدِ الشَّحَّامِ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لأَبِي عَبْدِ
اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَوْلُ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ «لا تَقْرَبُوا الصَّلاةَ وَ أَنْتُمْ سُكَارى» قَالَ «سُكْرُ النَّوْمِ».
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Hammad ibn Isa from al-Husayn ibn al-Mukhtar from Abu Usamah Zayd al-
Shahham who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, regarding the saying of Allah {SWT}, the
Mighty and Majestic:
Do not approach the prayer while you are intoxicated’ (Surah An Nisa 4:43).
Imam {a.s} said: “(It is referring to) ‘the intoxication of sleep’.”
AND ITS RULINGS
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.371 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.258 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.844 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.233 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.291 • Tafsir Al-Burhan, Vol.2 p.80 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.80 p.357 • Tafsir Nur Al-Thaqalayn, Vol.1 p.483 • Tafsir Kanz Al-Daqaiq, Vol.3 p.411

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
اِبْنُ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ بَعْضِ أَصْحَابِهِ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اللهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ إِنَّي لَأَكْرَهُ الصَّلاةَ فِي مَسَاجِدِهِمْ فَقَالَ «لا
تَكْرَهْ فَمَا مِنْ مَسْجِدٍ بُنِيَ إِلاَّ عَلَى قَبْرِ نَبِيٍّ أَوْ وَصِيَ نَبِيَّ قُتِلَ فَأَصَابَ تِلْكَ ٱلْبُقْعَةَ رَشَةٌ مِنْ دَمِهِ فَأَحَبَ اللَّهُ أَنْ
يُذْكَرَ فِيهَا فَأَدٍّ فِيهَا ٱلْفَرَائِضَ وَ النَّوَافِلَ وَ اِقْضٍ مَا فَاتَكَ».
english_text:
Ibn Abi ‘Umayr from one of his companions who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him: “I feel dislike for praying in their mosques
(the opponents).”
Imam {a.s} said: “Do not dislike it, for there is no mosque that was built except upon the
grave of a prophet or the trustee (wasi) of a prophet who was killed, and a sprinkling of
his blood reached that spot, so Allah {SWT} loved that He {AZJ} be remembered there.
So perform in them (these mosques) the obligatory prayers, and the recommended
ones, and make up in them what you have missed (of prayers).”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.370 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.258 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.490 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.225 • Al-Fusul Al-Muhimmah, Vol.2 p.82 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.14 p.463 • Qisas Al-Anbiya (Lil-Jaza’iri), Vol.1 p.458

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
عَلِي بْنُ إبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ عَنِ الْعَلاءِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ عَنْ أَحَدِهِمَا
عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلامُ قَالَ: «نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ عَنْ سَلِّ السَّيْفِ فِي ٱلْمَسْجِدِ وَ عَنْ بَرْي النَّبْلِ فِي
الْمَسْجِدِ» وَ قَالَ «إِنَّمَا بُنِيَ لِغَيْرِ ذَلِكَ».
english_text:
Ali ibn Ibrahim from Muhammad ibn Isa from Yunus ibn Abd al-Rahman from al-‘Ala from Muhammad ibn
Muslim from one of the two Imams {a.s}, peace be upon them, who said:
Imam {a.s} said: “The Messenger of Allah {SWT}, peace be upon him and his family, forbade
drawing the sword in the mosque and sharpening arrows in the mosque,”
And Imam {a.s} said: “It (Mosque) was only built for other than that.”
AND ITS RULINGS
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s} & Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al- Sadiq {a.s} & Abu al-Qasim Prophet Muhammad ibn Abdullah {saws}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.369 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.258 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.504 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.217 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.80 p.350

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْحَجَّاجِ عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ
عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلامُ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ : «مَنْ سَمِعْتُمُوهُ يُنْشِدُ الشَّعْرَ فِي ٱلْمَسَاجِدِ فَقُولُوا فَضَّ
اَللَّهُ فَاكَ إِنَّمَا نُصِبَتِ الْمَسَاجِدُ لِلْقُرْآنٍ».
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Hasan ibn Mahbub from Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Hajjaj from Ja’far ibn Ibrahim
from Imam Ali ibn al-Husayn, peace be upon them both, who said:
The Messenger of Allah {SWT}, peace be upon him and his family, said: “Whoever you
hear reciting poetry in the mosques, say to him:
‘May Allah {SWT} break your mouth! Verily, the mosques were only established for the
Qur’an.’”
source: Abu Muhammad Imam Ali ibn Husayn Zayn al-Abidin {a.s} & Abu al-Qasim Prophet Muhammad ibn Abdullah {saws}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.369 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.259 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.505 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.213 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.80 p.363

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ ٱلْعَلَوِيَّ عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ جُمْهُورٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ اَلْعَلَوِيِّ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ
بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ الْعُرَنِيَّ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ جُمَبْعِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ عَنِ الصْلاَةِ فِي ٱلْمَسَاجِدِ ٱلْمُصَوَّرَةِ
فَقَالَ « أكْرَهُ ذَلِكَ وَ لَكِنْ لاَ يَضُرُّكُمْ ذَلِكَ الْيَوْمَ وَ لَوْ قَدْ قَامَ الْعَدْلُ لَرَأْيْتُمْ كَيْفَ يَصْنَعُ فِي ذَلِكَ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ya‘qub from al-Hasan ibn Ali al-‘Alawi from Sahl ibn Jumhur from Abd al-‘Azim ibn Abdillah
al-‘Alawi from al-Hasan ibn al-Husayn al-‘Urani from Amr ibn Jumay’ who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, about praying in mosques that contain
images.
Imam {a.s} said: “I dislike that, but it does not harm you today. And if the ‘Just One’ (al
Qaim {ajf}) were to rise, you would see what He {ajf} would do regarding that.”
AND ITS RULINGS
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.259 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.490 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.215 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.80 p.388

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
سَهلُ بْنُ زِيَادٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي نَصْرٍ عَنْ أَبَانِ بْنِ عُثُمَانَ عَنْ أَبِي الْجَارُودِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلاَمُ - عَنِ الْمَسْجِدِ يَكُونُ فِي الْبَيْتِ فَيُرِيدُ أَهْلُ الْبَيْتِ أَنْ يَتَوَسَّعُوا بِطَائِفَةِ مِنْهُ أَوْ يُحَوِّلُونَهُ إِلَى غَيْرِ مَكَانِهِ
قَالَ «لا بَأْسَ بِذَلِكَ» قَالَ وَ سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ مَكَانٍ يَكُونُ حَشَا ثُمَّ يُنَظَّفُ وَ يُجْعَلُ مَسْجِداً قَالَ «يُطَرَحُ عَلَيْهِ مِنَ التُرَابِ
حَتَّى يُوَارِيَهُ فَهُوَ أظهَرُ».
ولا ينافي هذا الخبر ما رواه:
english_text:
Sahl ibn Ziyad from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr from Aban ibn Uthman from Abu al-Jarud who said:
I asked Abu Ja’far {a.s}, peace be upon him, about a mosque that is within a house, and
the people of the house want to expand into part of it, or move it to another place.
Imam {a.s} said: “There is no harm in that.”
He (Abu al-Jarud) said: “And I asked Imam {a.s} about a place that was previously a
refuse area, then it is cleaned and made into a mosque.”
Imam {a.s} said: “Let earth be thrown over it until it covers it, for that is purer.”
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
commentary: And this report is not contradicted by what was narrated:
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.368 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.259 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.488

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنِ الْعَبَّاسِ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ مَوْلَى طِرْبَالٍ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ
زُرَارَةَ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ يَقُولُ: «الْأَرْضُ كُلُهَا مَسْجِدٌ إِلاَّ بِئرَ غَائِط أَوْ مَقْبَرَةً».
الان الوجه في هذا الخبر هو انه لا يتخذ بئر الغائط مسجدا إلا بعد أن يطم بالتراب وتنقطع رائحته على ما بيناه في الخبر
الاول، ويزيد ذلك بيانا ما رواه :
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from al-Abbas from Safwan from al-Qasim ibn Muhammad from Sulayman,
the freed slave of Tirbal, from Ubayd ibn Zurarah, who said:
I heard Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, say: “The entire earth is a mosque except
for a latrine pit, or a graveyard.”
AND ITS RULINGS
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
commentary:
Or the reasoning in this report is that a latrine pit is not to be taken as a mosque unless
it is filled in with earth and its odor has ceased, as we explained in the first report. And
this is further clarified by what was narrated:
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.259 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.494 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.211 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.80 p.292 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.80 p.359

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
سَعدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَنْ هَارُونَ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ عَنْ مَسْعَدَةَ بْنِ صَدَقَةَ الرَّبَعِيّ عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَلاَمُ قَالَ: سُئِلَ
أَيَصْلُحُ مَكَانٍ حَشّ أَنْ يُتَّخَذَ مَسْجِداً فَقَالَ «إِذَا أَلْقِيَ عَلَيْهِ مِنَ التُرَابِ مَا يُوَارِي ذَلِكَ وَ يَقْطَعُ رِيحَهُ فَلاَ بَأْسَ وَ
ذَلِكَ لِأَنَّ التُّرَابَ طَهُورٌ وَ بِهِ مَضَتِ السُّنَّةُ».
english_text:
Sa’ad ibn Abdillah from Harun ibn Muslim from Mas‘adah ibn Sadaqah al-Ruba‘i from Imam Ja’far ibn
Muhammad {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} was asked: “Is it permissible for a place that was a refuse area to be
made into a mosque?”
Imam {a.s} said: “If earth is thrown over it to cover it and to cut off its odor, then there is
no problem. And that is because earth is purifying, and with it the Sunnah has
proceeded.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Qurb Al-Isnad, Vol.1 p.65 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.260 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.441 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.489 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.210

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
سَعْدٌ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللّهِ بْنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللّهِ بْنِ سِنَانِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ
عَنِ اَلْمَسْجِدِ يَكُونُ فِي الدَّارِ وَ فِي الْبَيْتِ وَ يَبْدُو لِأَهْلِهِ أَنْ يَتَوَسَّعُوا بِطَائِفَةٍ مِنْهُ أَوْ يُحَوِّلُونَهُ إِلَى غَيْرِ مَكَانِهِ فَقَالَ
«لا بَأْسَ بِذَلِكَ» قُلْتُ فَالْمَكَانُ يَكُونُ حَشَاً زَمَاناً فَيُنَظَّفُ وَ يُتَّخَذُ مَسْجِداً فَقَالَ «أَلْقِ عَلَيْهِ مِنَ ٱلتُرَابِ حَتَّى يَتَوَارَى
فَإنّ ذَلِكَ يُطَهَّرُهُ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى».
english_text:
Sa’ad from Abu Ja’far from his father from Abdullah ibn al-Mughirah from Abdullah ibn Sinan who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, about a mosque that is within a house or
a room, and its people want to expand into part of it or move it to another place.
Imam {a.s} said: “There is no harm in that.”
I (ibn Sinan) said: “And what about a place that was a refuse area for some time, then
it is cleaned and made into a mosque?”
Imam {a.s} said: “Throw earth over it until it is covered, for that purifies it, if Allah {SWT},
the Exalted, wills.”
AND ITS RULINGS
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.260

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنِ ٱلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ تَعْلَبَةَ بْنِ مَيْمُونٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ
بْنِ مُضَارِبٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «لا بَأْسَ بِأنْ يُجْعَلَ عَلَى الْعَذِرَةِ مَسْجِداً».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal from
Tha‘labah ibn Maymun from Muhammad ibn Mudharib from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “There is no harm in making a mosque over a place of
excrement.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.260 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.441 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.489 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.211

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
مُحَمِّدُ بْنُ إسْمَاعِيلَ عَنِ ٱلْفَصْلِ بْنِ شَاذَانَ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنِ ٱلْعِيصِ بْنِ ٱلْقَاسِمِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلَاَمُ
عَنِ البِيَعِ وَ الْكَنَائِسِ هَلْ يَصْلُحُ نَقْضُهَا لِبِنَاءِ الْمَسَاجِدِ فَقَالَ «نَعَمْ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Isma’il from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan from Safwan from al-‘Is ibn al-Qasim who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, about churches and synagogues, is it
permissible to demolish them for the construction of mosques?
Imam {a.s} said: “Yes.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.368 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.260 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.489 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.212

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ بْنِ النُّعْمَانِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ حَسَّانَ عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ يَشكَرَ الْكَاهِلِيَّ
عَنِ الْحَكَمِ عَنْ أَنْسِ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ : «مَنْ أَسْرَجَ فِي مَسْجِدٍ مِنْ مَسَاجِدِ اللَّهِ سِرَاجاً
لَمْ تَزَلِ الْمَلاَئِكَةُ وَ حَمَلَةُ الْعَرْشِ يَسْتَغْفِرُونَ لَهُ مَا دَامَ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ ضَوْءُ مِنْ ذَلِكَ السِّرَاجِ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn al-Nu‘man from Muhammad ibn Hassan from
Ishaq ibn Yashkur al-Kahili from al-Hakam from Anas who said:
The Messenger of Allah {SWT}, peace be upon him and his family, said: “Whoever lights
a lamp in a mosque from among the mosques of Allah {SWT}, the angels and the bearers
of ‘the Throne’ will continue to seek forgiveness for him as long as there is light from
that lamp in the mosque.”
AND ITS RULINGS
source: Abu al-Qasim Prophet Muhammad ibn Abdullah {saws}
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.237 • Thawab Al-A’mal wa ‘Iqab Al-A’mal, Vol.1 p.29 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.261 • Jami’ Al-Akhbar, Vol.1 p.71 • Awali Al-La’ali, Vol.1 p.351 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.509 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.241 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.81 p.15

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمِّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ مَيْمُونِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لَهُ إِنّ رَجُلاً يُصَلِّي بِنَا نَقْتَدِي
بِهِ فَهُوَ أَحَبُّ إِلَيْكَ أَوْ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ قَالَ «الْمَسْجِدُ أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ».
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali Ibrahim ibn Maymun from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
I said to Imam al-Sadiq {a.s}: “A man leads us in prayer and we follow him, is that more
beloved to you, or praying in the mosque?”
Imam {a.s} said: “(Praying in) the mosque is more beloved to me.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.261 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.513 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.239

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ طَلْحَةَ بْنِ زَيْدِ عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَلِيَّ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «لا صَلاَةَ لِمَنْ لَمْ يَشَهَدِ
الصِّلَوَاتِ الْمَكْتُوبَاتِ مِنْ جِيرَانِ الْمَسْجِدِ إِذَا كَانَ فَارِغاً صَحِيحاً».
english_text:
From him, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Talhah ibn Zayd, from Imam Ja’far {a.s}, from his father {a.s}, from
Imam Ali {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
Imam Ali {a.s} said: “There is no prayer for the one who does not attend the obligatory
prayers with the neighbours of the mosque, when he is free and in good health.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Amir al-Mu’minin Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib al-Murtadha {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.261 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.513 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1169 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.194

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
عَلِي بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عُثُمَانَ عَنِ الْحَلَبِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ:
سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ الْمَسْجِدِ الَّذِي «أُسِّسَ عَلَى التَّقْوى» فَقَالَ » مَسْجِدُ قُبَاءَ».
english_text:
Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Ibn Abi ‘Umayr from Hammad ibn Uthman from al-Halabi from Abu
Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} about the mosque which ‘was founded on piety’.
Imam {a.s} said: “The Mosque of Quba.”
AND ITS RULINGS
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tafsir Al-’Ayyashi, Vol.2 p.111 • Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.296 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.261 • Al- Wafi, Vol.14 p.1385 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.285 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.14 p.356 • Tafsir Al-Burhan, Vol.2 p.848 • Tafsir Al-Burhan, Vol.2 p.848 • Tafsir Al-Burhan, Vol.2 p.848 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.19 p.120

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
محَمِّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ إسْمَاعِيلَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدِ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مُوسَى بْنُ أَكَيْلٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ ٱلْأَعْلَى
مَوْلَى آلِ سَامٍ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ كَمْ كَانَ مَسْجِدُ رَسُولِ اللّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ فَقَالَ « ثَلاَثَةُ
آلآَفٍ وَ سِتُمِائَةِ ذِرَاعٍ مُكَسِّراً».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad from Ali ibn Isma’il from Muhammad ibn Amr ibn Sa’id who said: Musa ibn Ukayl
narrated to me from Abd al-A‘la, the freed slave of the family of Sam, who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him:
“How large was the mosque of the Messenger of Allah {SWT}, peace be upon him and his
family?”
Imam {a.s} said: “Three thousand and six hundred cubits, irregularly shaped.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.296 • Al-Kafi, Vol.4 p.555 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.261 • Al-Wafi, Vol.14 p.1360 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.283

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
عَلِيْ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ ٱلْمُغِيرَةِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ سَمِعْتُهُ
يَقُولُ: «إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللّهِ صَلّى اللَهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ بَنَى مَسْجِدَهُ بِالسُمَيْطِ ثُمّ إِنَّ الْمُسْلِمِينَ كَثُرُوا فَقَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللّهِ
لَوْ أَمَزْتَ بِالْمَسْجِدِ فَزِيدَ فِيهِ فَقَالَ «نَعَمْ» فَأَمَرَ بِهِ فَزِيدَ فِيهِ وَ بَنَاهُ بِالسَّعِيدَةِ ثُمَّ إِنَّ الْمُسْلِمِينَ كَثُرُوا فَقَالُوا يَا
رَسُولَ اللَّهِ لَوْ أَمَزْتَ بِالْمَسْجِدِ فَزِيدَ فِيهِ فَقَالَ «نَعَمْ» فَأَمَرَ بِهِ فَزِيدَ فِيهِ وَ بُنِيَ جِدَارُهُ بِالْأَنْثَى وَ اَلذَّكَرِ ثُمَّ اِشتَدَّ
عَلَيْهِمُ الْحَرُّ فَقَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ لَوْ أَمَزْتَ بِالْمَسْجِدِ فَظُلَّلَ فَقَالَ «نَعَمْ» فَأَمَرَ بِهِ فَأُقِيمَتْ فِيهِ سَوَارِي مِنْ جُذُوعِ
النَّخْلِ ثُمَّ طُرِحَثْ عَلَيْهِ الْعَوَارِضُ وَ الْخَصَفُ وَ الْإِذْخِرُ فَعَاشُوا فِيهِ حَتَّى أَصَابَثْهُمُ الْأَمْطَارُ فَجَعَلَ الْمَسْجِدُ يَكِفُ
عَلَيْهِمْ فَقَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللهِ لَوْ أَمَرْتَ بِالْمَسْجِدِ فَطْيِّنَ فَقَالَ لَهُمْ رَسُولُ اللّهِ صَلَّى اللّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ «لا عَرِيشُ كَعَرِيشٍ
مُوسَى عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ » فَلَمْ يَزَلْ كَذَلِكَ حَتّى قُبِضَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ فَكَانَ جِدَارُهُ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُظَلَّلَ
قَامَةً فَكَانَ إِذَا كَانَ الْفَيْءُ ذِرَاعاً وَ هُوَ قَدْرُ مَرْبِضٍ عَنْزٍ يُصَلِّي الظُهْرَ فَإِذَا كَانَ ضِعْفَ ذَلِكَ صَلَّى الْعَصْرَ» وَ قَالَ
«السَّمِيطُ لَبِنَةُ لَبِنَةٌ وَ السَّعِيدَةُ لَبِئَةٌ وَ نِصْفٌ وَ الْأَنْثَى وَ الذَّكَرُ لَبِئَتَانٍ مُخَالِفَتَانِ».
english_text:
AND ITS RULINGS
Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Abdullah ibn al-Mughirah from Abdullah ibn Sinan from Abu Abdillah {a.s},
peace be upon him, who said:
I heard Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} say: “Indeed, the Messenger of Allah {SWT}, peace be upon him
and his family, built his mosque with samit (a type of simple material), then the
Muslims increased in number, so they said:
‘O’ Messenger of Allah {SWT}, if only you would command the mosque to be expanded’.
Prophet {saws} said: “Yes.”
So Prophet {saws} commanded it, and it was expanded, and He {saws} built it with sa'idah
(palm trunks or branches).
Then the Muslims increased again, so they said:
‘O’ Messenger of Allah {SWT}, if only you would command the mosque to be expanded’.
Prophet {saws} said: “Yes.”
So Prophet {saws} commanded it, and it was expanded, and its wall was built with ‘al-
Untha’ and ‘al-Dhakar’ (with clay bricks called 'female' and 'male').
Then the heat became intense for them, so they said:
‘O’ Messenger of Allah {SWT}, if only you would command the mosque to be shaded’.
Prophet {saws} said: “Yes.”
So Prophet {saws} commanded it, and pillars were erected in it from palm trunks, then
crossbeams and palm leaves and al-idhkhar (a fragrant desert grass) were placed over
them.
And they remained in it until rain struck them, and the mosque began to drip on them.
So they said: ‘O’ Messenger of Allah {SWT}, if only you would command the mosque to
be plastered with clay’.
The Messenger of Allah {SWT}, peace be upon him and his family, said to them:
“No. A canopy like the canopy of Musa {a.s}, peace be upon him.”
And it remained like that until the Messenger of Allah {SWT}, peace be upon him and his
family, passed away.
Its wall, before it was shaded, was (equivalent to) a man’s height.
And when the shadow (al-fay’) reached one cubit, which is the space of a goat’s resting
place, He {saws} would pray the noon prayer (al-Dhuhr).
And when it became double that, He {saws} would pray the afternoon prayer (al-Asr).”
And Imam {a.s} said: “
‘As-samit’ is one brick by one brick,
‘As-sa‘idah’ is one and a half bricks,
and ‘Al-untha’ and ‘Al-dhakar’ are two differing bricks.”
AND ITS RULINGS
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Abu al-Qasim Prophet Muhammad ibn Abdullah {saws}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.295 • Ma’ani Al-Akhbar, Vol.1 p.159 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.261 • Al- Wafi, Vol.7 p.492 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.205 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.19 p.119 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.81 p.10 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.96 p.380

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
إبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ هَاشِمِ عَنِ النَّوْفَلِيّ عَنِ السَكُونِيّ عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ آبَائِهِ عَلَيْهِمُ السَلامُ قَالَ: «نَهَى النَّبِيُ صَلَّى
اللَهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ عَنْ رَطَانَةِ الْأَعَاجِمِ فِي الْمَسَاجِدِ».
english_text:
Ibrahim ibn Hashim from al-Nawfali from al-Sakuni from Imam Ja’far {a.s}, from his father {a.s}, from his
forefathers, peace be upon them, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “The Prophet {saws}, peace be upon him and his family, forbade
the speaking of foreign languages (ratanat al-a‘ajim) in the mosques.”
(meaning to preserve arabic clarity, reverence, and unity in worship)
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Abu al-Qasim Prophet Muhammad ibn Abdullah {saws}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.262 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.217

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ آبَائِهِ عَلَيْهِمُ السَّلامُ قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ : «مَنْ سَمِعَ النَّدَاءَ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ فَخَرَجَ
مِنْ غَيْرِ عِلَّةٍ فَهُوَ مُنَافِقٌ إِلَّ أَنْ يُرِيدَ الرُّجُوعَ إِلَيْهِ».
english_text:
From him {a.s}, from his father {a.s}, from his forefathers, peace be upon them, who said:
The Prophet {saws} said: “Whoever hears the call to prayer in the mosque, and leaves
without an excuse is a hypocrite, unless he intends to return to it.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Abu al-Qasim Prophet Muhammad ibn Abdullah {saws}
references: Al-Amali (Lil-Saduq), Vol.1 p.501 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.262 • Rawdat Al-Wa’izin, Vol.2 p.337 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.508 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.242 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.80 p.372 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.85 p.9

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ آبَائِهِ عَلَيْهِمُ السَّلاَمُ : «أَنْ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ أَبْصَرَ رَجُلاً يَخْذِفُ بِحَصَاةٍ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ فَقَالَ «مَا
زَالَتْ تَلْعَنُ حَتَّى وَقَعَتْ» » ثُمَّ قَالَ «اَلْخَذْفُ فِي النَّادِي مِنْ أَخْلاقِ قَوْمِ لُوطِ » ثُمَّ تَلا عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ « «وَ تَأْتُونَ
فِي نادِيكُمُ الْمُنْكَرَ» » قَالَ «هُوَ الْخَذْفُ».
english_text:
From him {a.s}, from his forefathers {a.s}, peace be upon them:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “The Prophet {saws}, saw a man flicking a pebble in the mosque.
Prophet {saws} said: “It continues to be cursed until it lands.”
He {saws} said: “Flicking pebbles in gatherings is from the manners of people of Lut.”
Then Prophet {saws}, peace be upon him, recited: “And you commit in your gatherings
what is detestable” (Surah Al Ankabut 29:29),
And Prophet {saws} said: “That is the flicking of pebbles.”
AND ITS RULINGS
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Abu al-Qasim Prophet Muhammad ibn Abdullah {saws}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.262 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.508 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.243 • Tafsir Al-Burhan, Vol.4 p.312

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ عَنِ الْبَرْقِيِّ عَنِ النَّوْفَلِيَّ عَنِ السَّكُونِيَّ عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَلَيْهِمَا السَلامُ أَنَّ
النَّبِيّ صَلَّى اللّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ قَالَ: «كَشَفُ السُّرَّةِ وَ الْفَخِذِ وَ الرُكْبَةِ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ مِنَ اَلْعَوْرَةِ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Ahmad from al-Barqi from al-Nawfali from al-Sakuni from Imam Ja’far
{a.s}, from his father {a.s}, peace be upon them both:
The Prophet {saws}, peace be upon him and his family, said:
“Uncovering the navel, the thigh, and the knee in the mosque is from the ‘awrah
(private parts to be covered).”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Abu al-Qasim Prophet Muhammad ibn Abdullah {saws}
references: Al-Ash’athiyat, Vol.1 p.37 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.263 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.509 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.244 • Mustadrak Al-Wasa’il, Vol.1 p.377 • Mustadrak Al-Wasa’il, Vol.3 p.387

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي الصُّهْبَانِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنِ الْعَلاَءِ بْنِ فُضَيْلٍ عَمَّنْ رَوَاهُ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسّلاَمُ
قَالَ: «إِذَا دَخَلْتَ ٱلْمَسْجِدَ وَ أَنْتَ تُرِيدُ أَنْ تَجْلِسَ فَلا تَدْخُلْهُ إِلَّ طَاهِراً وَ إِذَا دَخَلْتَ فَاسْتَقْبِلِ الْقِبْلَةَ ثُمَّ أُدْعُ اللَّهَ وَ
اِسْأَلْهُ وَ سَمِّ حِينَ تَدْخُلُهُ وَ اِحْمَدِ اللهَ وَ صَلِّ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ ».
english_text:
From him, from Muhammad ibn Abi al-Suhban from Muhammad ibn Sinan from al-‘Ala ibn Fudayl from one
who narrated it from Abu Ja’far {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Baqir {a.s} said: “When you enter the mosque intending to sit, do not enter it
except in a state of purity.
And when you enter, face the qiblah, then supplicate to Allah {SWT} and ask Him {AZJ}, and
mention His {AZJ} name when you enter it.
And praise Allah {SWT} and send blessings upon the Prophet {saws}, peace be upon him
and his family.”
AND ITS RULINGS
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.263 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.498 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.245 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.81 p.21

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ عَنْ زُرْعَةَ عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ قَالَ: «إِذَا دَخَلْتَ ٱلْمَسْجِدَ فَقُلْ - بِسْمِ اللّهِ وَ السَّلَاَمُ عَلَى
رَسُولِ اللهِ إِنَّ اللهَ وَ مَلاَئِكَتَهُ يُصَلُونَ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ السَّلَاَمُ عَلَيْهِمْ وَ رَحْمَةُ اللهِ وَ بَرَكَاتُهُ رَبِّ اِغْفِرْ لِي
ذُنُوبِي وَ اِفْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ فَضْلِكَ وَ إِذَا خَرَجْتَ فَقُلْ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ».
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa’id from al-Hasan from Zur’ah from Sama’ah who said:
It was said: “When you enter the mosque, say:
‘In the name of Allah {SWT}, and peace be upon the Messenger of Allah {SWT}.
Indeed, Allah {SWT} and His {AZJ} angels send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad {saws}
and the family of Muhammad {saws},
And peace be upon them and the mercy of Allah {SWT} and His {AZJ} blessings. My Lord {AZJ},
forgive me my sins and open for me the doors of Your grace.’
And when you leave (the mosque), say the same.”
source: Implicit (Muzmar)
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.263 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.497 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.245

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ فُضَيْلِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ قَالَ: «إِذَا دَخَلْتَ ٱلْمَسْجِدَ فَقُلِ - اللَّهُمَّ اِغْفِرْ لِي ذُنُوبِي وَ اِفْتَخ
لِي أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ وَ إِذَا خَرَجْتَ فَقُلِ اللَّهُمَّ اِغْفِرْ لِي وَ اِفْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ فَضْلِكَ».
english_text:
From him, from Fudayl ibn Uthman from Abdullah ibn al-Hasan who said:
It was said: “When you enter the mosque, say:
‘O’ Allah {SWT}, forgive me my sins and open for me the doors of Your mercy’.
And when you leave, say:
‘O’ Allah {SWT}, forgive me and open for me the doors of Your grace’.”
AND ITS RULINGS
source: Implicit (Muzmar)
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.263 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.497 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.245 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.81 p.21

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنِ الْحَجَّالِ عَنْ عَبْدِ الصِّمَدِ بْنِ بَشِيرٍ عَنْ حَسَّانَ الْجَمَّالِ قَالَ:
حَمَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ مِنَ الْمَدِينَةِ إِلَى مَكَّةَ قَالَ فَلَمَّا اِنْتَهَيْنَا إِلَى مَسْجِدِ الْغَدِيرِ نَظَرَ فِي مَيْسَرَةِ الْمَسْجِدِ
فَقَالَ «ذَاكَ مَوْضِع قَدَمِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ حَيْثُ قَالَ «مَنْ كُنْتُ مَوْلاَهُ فَعَلِيٌّ مَوْلاَهُ اللَّهُمَّ وَالِ مَنْ
وَالآهُ وَ عَادٍ مَنْ عَادَاهُ» » ثُمّ نَظَرَ فِي الْجَانِبِ الْآخَرِ فَقَالَ «هَذَا مَوْضِعُ فُسْطَاطِ أَبِي فُلانٍ وَ فُلانٍ وَ سَالِمِ مَوْلَى
أَبِي حُذَيْفَةَ وَ أَبِي عُبَيْدَةَ بْنِ الْجَرَّاحِ فَلَمَّا أَنْ رَأَوْهُ رَافِعاً يَدَهُ قَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ أنظُرُوا إِلَى عَيْنَيْهِ تَدُورَانِ كَأَنَّهُمَا عَيْنَا
مَجْنُونٍ فَنَزَلَ جَبْرَئِيلُ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ بِهَذِهِ الْآَيَةِ «وَ إِنْ يَكَادُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا لَيُزْلِقُونَكَ بِأَبْصَارِهِمْ لَمَا سَمِعُوا الذِّكْرَ وَ
يَقُولُونَ إِنَّهُ لَمَجْنُونْ وَ مَا هُوَ إِلا ذِكْرٌ لِلْعَالَمِينَ» » ثُمَّ قَالَ «يَا حَسَانُ لَوْ لاَ أَنَّكَ جَمَّالِي لَمَا حَدَّثْتُكَ بِهَذَا الْحَدِيثِ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from al-Hajjal from Abd al-Samad ibn
Bashir from Hassan al-Jammal who said:
I carried Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, from Medina to Mecca.
He (Hassan al-Jammal) said: “When we reached the ‘Mosque of al-Ghadir’, Imam {a.s}
looked towards the left side of the mosque and said:
‘That is the place of the foot of the Messenger of Allah {SWT}, may Allah {SWT} bless him
and his family, where Prophet {saws} said:
‘Whoever I am his master (mawla), then Ali {a.s} is his master (mawla).
O’ Allah {SWT}, befriend whoever befriends him and be the enemy of whoever is his
enemy.’”
Then Imam {a.s} looked to the other side and said:
“This is the place of the tent of ‘so-and-so’ and ‘so-and-so’ and Salim, the mawla
(freed slave) of Abu Hudhayfah, and Abu Ubaydah ibn al-Jarrah.
When they saw Prophet {saws} raising his (Imam Ali {a.s}) hand, some of them said:
‘Look at his eyes, they are turning as if they are the eyes of a madman.’
So Jibra'il {a.s}, peace be upon him, descended with the verse:
‘And indeed, those who disbelieve, almost drive you to slip with their eyes when they
hear the message, and they say: Indeed, he is mad; but it is nothing except a reminder
to the worlds.’” (Surah Al Qalam 68:51-52)
Then Imam {a.s} said: “O Hassan, were it not for the fact that you are my camel driver, I
would not have narrated this hadith to you.”
AND ITS RULINGS
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Abu al-Qasim Prophet Muhammad ibn Abdullah {saws}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.263 • Tafsir Al-Burhan, Vol.5 p.464

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
وَ رَوَى جَابِرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللهِ الْأَنْصَارِيُّ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: صَلَّى بِنَا عَلِيٌّ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ بِبَرَاثَا بَعْدَ رُجُوعِهِ مِنْ قِتَالِ الشُّرَاةِ وَ نَحْنُ
زُهَاءُ مِائَةِ أَلْفِ رَجُلٍ فَتَزَلَ نَصْرَانِيّ مِنْ صَوْمَعَتِهِ فَقَالَ أَيْنَ عَمِيدُ هَذَا الْجَيْشِ فَقُلنَا هَذَا فَأَقْبَلَ إِلَيْهِ فَسَلَمَ عَلَيْهِ
ثُمَّ قَالَ يَا سَيِّدِي أَنْتَ نَبِيٌّ فَقَالَ «لا النَّبِيُّ سَيِّدِي قَدْ مَاتَ» قَالَ فَأَنْتَ وَصِيُ نَبِيَ فَقَالَ «نَعَمْ» ثُمَّ قَالَ «اِجْلِس
كَيْفَ سَأَلْتَ عَنْ هَذَا» قَالَ إِنَّمَا بُنِيَتْ هَذِهِ ٱلصَّوْمَعَةُ مِنْ أَجْلِ هَذَا الْمَوْضِعِ وَ هُوَ بَرَاثًا وَ قَرَأْتُ فِي الْكُتُبِ ٱلْمُنَزَّلَةِ
أَنَّهُ لا يُصَلِّي فِي هَذَا الْمَوْضِعِ بِذَا الْجَمْعِ إِلَّ نَبِيّ أَوْ وَصِي نَبِيٍّ وَ قَدْ جِئْتُ أَنْ أُسْلِمَ فَأَسْلَمَ فَخَرَجَ مَعَنَا إِلَى الْكُوفَةِ
فَقَالَ لَهُ عَلِيٌّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ «فَمَنْ صَلّى هَاهُنَا» قَالَ صَلَّى عِيسَى اِبْنُ مَرْيَمَ وَ أَمُهُ فَقَالَ لَهُ عَلِيٌّ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ «أ
فَأَفِيدُكَ مَنْ صَلَّى هَاهُنَا» قَالَ نَعَمْ قَالَ » ٱلْخَلِيلُ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلامُ».
english_text:
And Jabir ibn Abdillah al-Ansari narrated that he said:
Imam Ali {a.s}, peace be upon him, led us in prayer at ‘Baratha’ after returning from
fighting the Kharijites, and we totalled around one hundred thousand men.
Then a Christian descended from his hermitage and said:
“Where is the leader of this army?”
We said: “This is he.” (gesturing towards Imam Ali {a.s})
So he (the Christian) approached Imam Ali {a.s} and greeted him with peace, then said:
“O my master, are you a prophet?”
Imam {a.s} replied: “No, the Prophet {saws}, my master, has died.”
He (the Christian) said: “Then you are the successor of a prophet?”
Imam {a.s} said: “Yes.”
Then Imam Ali {a.s} said: “Sit down. How did you ask about this?”
He (the Christian) said: “This hermitage was built for the sake of this place, and it is
Baratha. And I read in the ‘revealed books’ that none prays in this place with such a
gathering except a prophet or the successor of a prophet. And I have come to embrace
Islam.”
So he accepted Islam and came out with us to Kufah.
Then Imam Ali {a.s}, peace be upon him, said to him: “So who prayed here?”
He (the ex-Christian) said: “Isa ibn Maryam {a.s} and his mother prayed here.”
Then Imam Ali {a.s}, peace be upon him, said to him: “Shall I inform you who else prayed
here?”
He (the ex-Christian) said: “Yes.”
Imam {a.s} said: “Ibrahim {a.s}, peace be upon him.”
AND ITS RULINGS
source: Amir al-Mu’minin Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib al-Murtadha {a.s} ،
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.264 • Al-Wafi, Vol.3 p.740 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.3 3 p.438

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
عُبَيْدَةَ الْحَذَّاءِ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللّهِ
عَلِيّ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ عَنْ أَبِي
عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ يَقُولُ: «مَنْ بَنَى مَسْجِداً بَنَى اللّهُ لَهُ بَيْتاً فِي الْجَنَّةِ » قَالَ أَبُو عُبَيْدَةَ فَمَرَّ بِي أُبُو عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ
فِي طَرِيقٍ مَكَّةَ وَ قَدْ سَوَّيْتُ أَحْجَاراً لِمَسْجِدٍ فَقُلْتُ جُعِلْتُ فِدَاكَ نَرْجُو أَنْ يَكُونَ هَذَا مِنْ ذَاكَ فَقَالَ «نَعَمْ».
english_text:
Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Ibn Abi Umayr from Hisham ibn al-Hakam from Abu Ubaydah al-
Hadhdha' who said:
I heard Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, say:
“Whoever builds a mosque, Allah {SWT} will build for him a house in Paradise.”
Abu Ubaydah said: “Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, passed by me on the road
to Mecca, while I had arranged stones for a mosque, so I asked:
‘May I be your ransom, we hope that this is of that (included in the reward).’”
Imam {a.s} said: “Yes.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.368 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.264 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.487 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.203

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يُوسُفَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ يَقُولُ:
«إِنَّ الْجُهَنِيَّ أَنَى النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّي أَكُونُ فِي الْبَادِيَةِ وَ مَعِي أَهْلِي وَ وُلْدِي وَ
غِلْمَتِي فَأْوَذَّنُ وَ أُقِيمُ وَ أُصَلِّي بِهِمْ أَ فَجَمَاعَةٌ نَحْنُ فَقَالَ «نَعَمْ» فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّ الْعِلْمَةَ يَتْبَعُونَ قَطْرَ
السِّحَابِ فَأَبْقَى أَنَا وَ أَهْلِي وَ وُلْدِي فَأْوْذِّنُ وَ أَقِيمُ وَ أَصَلِّي بِهِمْ أَفَجَمَاعَةً نَحْنُ فَقَالَ «نَعَمْ» فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ
فَإِنَّ وُلْدِي يَتَفَرَّقُونَ فِي الْمَاشِيَةِ فَأَبْقَى أَنَا وَ أَهْلِي فَأْوَذِّنُ وَ أَقِيمُ وَ أُصَلِّي بِهِمْ أَفَجَمَاعَةٌ نَحْنُ فَقَالَ «نَعَمْ» فَقَالَ
يَا رَسُولَ اللّهِ إنَّ الْمَرْأَةَ تَذْهَبُ فِي مَصْلَحَتِهَا فَأَبْقَى أَنَا وَحْدِي فَأْوَذِّنُ وَ أُقِيمُ أَ فَجَمَاعَةً أَنَا فَقَالَ «نَعَمْ ٱلْمُوْمِنُ
وَحَدَهُ جَمَاعَةٌ» ».
english_text:
AND ITS RULINGS
Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Hammad ibn Isa from Muhammad ibn Yusuf from his father who said:
I heard Abu Ja’far {a.s}, peace be upon him, say:
“Indeed, al-Juhani came to the Prophet {saws}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his family,
and said:
‘O’ Messenger of Allah {SWT}, I live in the desert and I am with my family, my children,
and my servants. I call the adhan and the iqamah and I lead them in prayer. Are we
considered a congregation (jama'ah)?’
Prophet {saws} said: “Yes.”
He (al-Juhani) asked: “O Messenger of Allah {SWT}, sometimes the servants follow the
tracks of the clouds, so I remain with my family and children, and I call the adhan and
the iqamah and lead them in prayer, are we considered a congregation?”
Prophet {saws} said: “Yes.”
He (al-Juhani) asked: “O Messenger of Allah {SWT}, my children go about with the
livestock, so I remain with my family, and I call the adhan and the iqamah and lead
them in prayer, are we considered a congregation?”
Prophet {saws} said: “Yes.”
He (al-Juhani) asked: “O Messenger of Allah {SWT}, the woman goes out for her needs,
so I remain alone, and I call the adhan and the iqamah, am I considered a
congregation?”
Prophet {saws} said: “Yes. The believer alone is a congregation.”
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s} & Abu al-Qasim Prophet Muhammad ibn Abdullah {saws}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.371 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.265 • Al-Arba’un Hadithan (Lil-Shahid Al- Awwal), Vol.1 p.75 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1165 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.296 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.85 p.97

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَمَّارِ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ : «أَ مَا يَسْتَجِي الرَّجُلُ مِنْكُمْ أَنْ
تَكُونَ لَهُ الْجَارِيَةُ فَيَبِيعَهَا فَتَقُولَ لَمْ يَكُنْ يَحْضُرُ الصَّلاَةَ».
english_text:
From him, from Muhammad ibn Sinan from Ishaq ibn Ammar who said:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said:
“Does a man among you not feel ashamed, that he has a female servant, then he sells
her, and she says (about him),
'He did not used to attend the prayer'?”
AND ITS RULINGS
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.372 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.265 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1167 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.291

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ الْمُعَلِّى بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ الْوَشَّاءِ عَنِ ٱلْمُفَضَّلِ بْنِ صَالِحِ عَنْ جَابِرٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ ٱَلسَّلَاَمُ
قَالَ: «لِيَكُنِ الَّذِينَ يَلُونَ الْإِمَامَ أُولِي الْأَحْلَامِ مِنْكُمْ وَ النُّهَى فَإِنْ نَسِيَ الْإِمَامُ أَوْ تَعَايَا قَوَّمُوهُ وَ أَفْضَلُ الصُّفُوفِ
أَوَّلُهَا وَ أَفْضَلُ أَوَّلِهَا مَا دَنَا مِنَ الْإِمَامِ وَ فَضْلُ صَلاَةِ ٱلْجَمَاعَةِ عَلَى صَلاَةِ الرَّجُلِ قَرْداً خَمْسٌ وَ عِشرُونَ دَرَجَةً فِي
الْجَنَّةِ ».
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad from al-Mu‘alla ibn Muhammad from al-Washsha’ from al-Mufaddal ibn Salih
from Jabir from Abu Ja’far {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Baqir {a.s} said: “Let those who are closest to the imam (of prayer) be those
among you who possess understanding and intellect, for if the imam (of prayer) forgets
or becomes confused, they can correct him.
And the best of the rows is the first one, and the best part of the first row is that which
is closest to the imam (of prayer).
And the superiority of congregational prayer over the prayer of a man alone is twenty-
five degrees in Paradise.”
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.372 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.265 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1187

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ عَنِ ٱلْفَضْلِ بْنِ شَاذَانَ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَفْصِ بْنِ الْبَخْتَرِيَّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلَاَمُ
قَالَ: «يُحْسَبُ لَكَ إِذَا دَخَلْتَ مَعَهُمْ وَ إِنْ لَمْ تَقْتَدِ بِهِمْ مِثْلُ مَا يُحْسَبُ لَكَ إِذَا كُنْتَ مَعَ مَنْ تَقْتَدِي بِهِ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Isma'il from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan from Ibn Abi Umayr from Hafs ibn al-Bukhtari from Abu
Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “It will be counted for you (rewards), if you enter with them (in
prayer) even if you do not follow them in prayer, the same as it is counted for you (in
rewards) when you are with one whom you do follow (in prayer).”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.373 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.383 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.265 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1217 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.299

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ ذُبْيَانَ بْنِ حَكِيمِ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ أُكَيْلِ النَّمَيْرِيِّ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي
بَغْفُورٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «هَمَّ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ بِإِحْرَاقِ قَوْمٍ فِي مَنَازِلِهِمْ كَانُوا
يُصَلُونَ فِي مَنَازِلِهِمْ وَ لا يُصَلُونَ الْجَمَاعَةَ فَأَتَاهُ رَجُلْ أَعْمَى فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللّهِ إِنَّي ضَرِيرُ ٱلْبَصَرِ وَ رُبَّمَا أَسْمَعُ
اَلنَّدَاءَ وَلَا أَجِدُ مَنْ يَقُودُنِي إِلَى الْجَمَاعَةِ وَ الصَّلاةِ مَعَكَ فَقَالَ لَهُ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ «شُدَّ مِنْ مَنْزِلِكَ إِلَى
الْمَسْجِدِ حَبْلاً وَ أُحْضُرِ الْجَمَاعَةَ» ».
english_text:
AND ITS RULINGS
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from Dhubyan ibn Hakim from Musa ibn
Ukayl al-Numayri from Ibn Abi Ya'fur from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “The Messenger of Allah {SWT}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his
family, intended to burn the homes of a people who used to pray in their houses and
did not attend the congregational prayer.
Then a blind man came to Him {saws} and said:
‘O’ Messenger of Allah {SWT}, I am blind of sight, and sometimes I hear the call but do
not find anyone to lead me to the congregation and prayer with you’.
So the Prophet {saws}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his family, said to him:
‘Tie a rope from your house to the mosque and attend the congregation.’”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Abu al-Qasim Prophet Muhammad ibn Abdullah {saws}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.266 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1170 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.293

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللّهِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ الْحَجَّالِ عَنْ تَعْلَبَةَ بْنِ مَيْمُونٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ - عَنِ
الصَّلاَةِ خَلْفَ الْمُخَالِفِينَ فَقَالَ «فَمَا هُمْ عِنْدِي إِلاَّ بِمَنْزِلَةِ الْجُدُرِ».
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Abdillah ibn Muhammad al-Hajjal from Tha‘labah ibn Maymun who said:
I asked Abu Ja’far {a.s}, peace be upon him, about prayer behind the opponents (al-
mukhalifin).
Imam {a.s} said: “They are, in my view, nothing but like walls.”
(meaning it holds no spiritual or religious value or relevance)
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.373 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.266 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1214 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.309 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.366

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
سَهْلُ بْنُ زِيَادٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَهْزِيَارَ عَنْ أَبِي عَلِيَّ بْنِ رَاشِدِ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ إِنَّ مَوَالِيَكَ قَدِ اِخْتَلَفُوا
فَأَصَلِّي خَلْفَهُمْ جَمِيعاً فَقَالَ «لا تُصَلَ إِلَّ خَلْفَ مَنْ تَثِقُ بِدِينِهِ وَ أَمَانَتِهِ».
english_text:
Sahl ibn Ziyad from Ali ibn Mahziyar from Abu Ali ibn Rashid who said:
I said to Abu Ja’far {a.s}, peace be upon him: “Your followers have differed, so I pray
behind all of them.”
Imam {a.s} said: “Do not pray except behind one whose religion and trustworthiness you
are confident in.”
AND ITS RULINGS
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Jawad {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.266 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.309 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.85 p.39

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
عَلِيُّ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لأَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ إِنَّ أَنَاساً رَوَوْا عَنْ
أَمِيرِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ أَنَّهُ صَلَّى أَرْبَعَ رَكَعَاتٍ بَعْدَ الْجُمُعَةِ لَمْ يَفْصِلْ بَيْنَهُنَّ بِتَسْلِيمِ فَقَالَ «يَا زُرَارَةُ إِنَّ أَمِيرَ
اَلْمُؤْمِنِينَ صَلَّى خَلْفَ فَاسِقٍ فَلَمَّا سَلَّمَ وَ اِنْصَرَفَ قَامَ أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ فَصَلَّى أَرْبَعَ رَكَعَاتٍ لَمْ يَفْصِلْ
بَيْنَهُنَّ بِتَسْلِيمِ فَقَالَ لَهُ رَجُلٌ إِلَى جَنْبِهِ يَا أَبَا الْحَسَنِ صَلِّيْتَ أَرْبَعَ رَكَعَاتٍ لَمْ تَفْصِلْ بَيْنَهُنَّ بِتَسْلِيمِ فَقَالَ «إِنَّهَا أَرْبَعُ
رَكَعَاتٍ مُشَبَّهَاتٍ» فَسَكَتَ فَوَ اللّهِ مَا عَقَلَ مَا قَالَ لَهُ».
english_text:
Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Hammad from Hariz from Zurarah who said:
I said to Abu Ja’far {a.s}, peace be upon him: “Some people have narrated from the
Commander of the Faithful {a.s}, peace be upon him, that Imam {a.s} prayed four rak‘ahs
after Jumu‘ah without separating them with a taslim.”
Imam {a.s} said: “O’ Zurarah, the Commander of the Faithful {a.s} prayed behind a
transgressor (fasiq), So when the transgressor said the taslim and departed, the
Commander of the Faithful {a.s}, peace be upon him, stood and prayed four rak‘ahs
without separating them with a taslim.
A man beside Imam Ali {a.s} said: ‘O Abu al-Hasan, you prayed four rak‘ahs without
separating them with a taslim?’
Imam Ali {a.s} said: ‘They are four rak‘ahs that resemble one another’
So the man became silent, and by Allah {SWT}, the man did not understand what Imam
Ali {a.s} meant to say to him.”
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s} & Amir al-Mu’minin Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib al- Murtadha {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.374 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.266 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1216 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.350

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُحَمِّدِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنْ أَبِي الْعَبَّاسِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ عَنِ
الرَّجُلٍ يَؤُمُ الْمَرْأَةَ فِي بَيْتِهِ فَقَالَ «نَعَمْ تَقُومُ وَرَاءَهُ».
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Sinan from Ibn Muskan from Abu al-Abbas who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, about a man leading a woman in prayer
in his house.
Imam {a.s} said: “Yes, she stands behind him.”
AND ITS RULINGS
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.376 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.267 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1221 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.333

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ أَبَانٍ عَنِ الْفُضَيْلِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لأَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلَامُ أُصَلِّي الْمَكْتُوبَةَ بِأْمِّ عَلِيَّ
قَالَ «نَعَمْ تَكُونُ عَنْ يَمِينِكَ يَكُونُ سُجُودُهَا بِحِذَاءِ قَدَمَيْكَ».
english_text:
From him, from al-Husayn from Aban from al-Fudayl ibn Yasar who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him: “May I lead the obligatory prayer with
Umm Ali?”
Imam {a.s} said: “Yes, she should be on your right side, and her prostration should be
aligned with your feet.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.267 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1222 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.332

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُسْكَانَ قَالَ: بَعَثتُ إِلَيْهِ
بِمَسْأَلَةٍ فِي مَسَائِلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ يَدْفَعُهَا إِلَى اِبْنِ سَدِيرٍ فَسَأَلَ عَنْهَا وَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مَيْمُونِ جَالِسٌ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يَوْمُّ النَّسَاءَ
فَقَالَ «نَعَمْ» فَقُلْتُ سَلْهُ عَنْهُنَّ إِذَا كَانَ مَعَهُنَّ عِلْمَانْ لَمْ يُدْرِكُوا أَ يَقُومُونَ مَعَهُنَّ فِي الصَّفَّ أَمْ يَتَقَدَّمُونَهُنَّ فَقَالَ
«لا بَلْ يَتَقَدَّمُونَهُنَّ وَ إِنْ كَانُوا عَبِيدا».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Ya'qub ibn Yazid from Muhammad ibn Sinan from Abdillah ibn Muskan
who said:
I sent to Imam {a.s} a question from the questions of Ibrahim, which he was to deliver to
Ibn Sadeer.
So he asked Imam {a.s} about it while Ibrahim ibn Maymun was sitting regarding a man
leading women in prayer.
Imam {a.s} said: “Yes.”
I said: “Ask Imam {a.s} about them when there are young boys with them, who have not
yet reached puberty. Do they stand with them in the same row, or do they stand in front
of them?”
Imam {a.s} said: “No, rather they stand in front of them, even if they are slaves.”
AND ITS RULINGS
source: Implicit (Muzmar)
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.267 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1223 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.341

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمِّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى الْعُبَيْدِيَّ عَنِ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ بْنِ يَقْطِينٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَلِيَّ بْنِ يَقْطِينٍ عَنْ أَبِي الْحَسَنِ
الْمَاضِي عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ الْمَرْأَةِ تَوُمُّ النَّسَاءَ مَا حَدُّ رَفْعِ صَوْتِهَا بِالْقِرَاءَةِ أَوِ التَّكْبِيرِ فَقَالَ «بِقَدْرٍ مَا
نُسْمِعُ».
english_text:
From him, from Muhammad ibn Isa al-Ubaydi from al-Husayn ibn Ali ibn Yaqtin from his father Ali ibn Yaqtin
from Abu al-Hasan al-Madi, peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Imam al-Kadhim {a.s} about a woman leading other women in prayer, what is the
limit for raising her voice in recitation or in takbir?
Imam {a.s} said: “As much as it allows them to hear.”
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}
references: Masa’il Ali Ibn Ja’far, Vol.1 p.255 • Qurb Al-Isnad, Vol.1 p.223 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.405 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.267 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.267 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.278 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1226 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.94 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.95 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.335

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
احمد بن محمد عن موسى بن القاسم عن علي بن جعفر عن اخيه عليه السلام قال : سألته عن المرأة تؤم النساء
ما حد رفع صوتها بالقراءة أو التكبير؟ قال : قدر ما تسمع.
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Musa ibn al-Qasim from Ali ibn Ja’far from his brother, peace be upon him,
who said:
I asked Imam al-Kadhim about a woman leading women in prayer, what is the limit for
raising her voice in recitation or in takbir?
Imam {a.s} said: “As much as it allows them to hear.”
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.267

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ عَنْ أَبَانِ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ:
«صَلٍّ بِأَهلِكَ فِي رَمَضَانَ ٱلْفَرِيضَةَ وَ النَّافِلَةَ فَإِنّي أَفْعَلُهُ».
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn al-Hakam from Aban from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Abdillah from Abu
Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “Pray with your family in (Month of) Ramadan the obligatory
prayer, and the recommended (nafilah) prayer, for indeed I do so.”
AND ITS RULINGS
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.267 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1222

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
