عَنْهُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ ٱلْمُغِيرَةِ عَنِ ٱلْقَاسِمِ بْنِ ٱلْوَلِيدِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يُصَلِّي مَعَ الرَّجُلِ الْوَاجِدِ مَعَهُمَا
النَّسَاءُ قَالَ «يَقُومُ الرَّجُلُ إِلَى جَنْبِ الرَّجُلِ وَ يَتَخَلِّفْنَ النَّسَاءُ خَلْفَهُمَا».
english_text:
From him, from his father, from Abdillah ibn al-Mughirah from al-Qasim ibn al-Walid who said:
I asked Imam {a.s} about a man praying with another man, while women are with them.
Imam {a.s} said: “The man stands beside the man, and the women stand behind them
both.”
source: Implicit (Muzmar)
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.268 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1223 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.332

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنِ الْعَبَّاسِ عَنِ اِبْنِ ٱلْمُغِيرَةِ عَنْ غِيَاتٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: قَالَ: «الْمَرْأَةُ صَفِّ وَ الْمَرْأَتَانِ صَفِّ وَ الثَّلاَثُ صَفٌّ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from al-Abbas from Ibn al-Mughirah from Ghiyath from Abu Abdillah {a.s},
peace be upon him, from his father {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Baqir {a.s} said: “One woman is a row, and two women are a row, and three are
a row.” (meaning the row of women cannot conjoin with the row of men)
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al- Baqir {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.268 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1224 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.336 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.342

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
عَنهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْحَمِيدِ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ الْجَهْمِ عَنِ اِبْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنِ الْحَلَبِيَّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ
قَالَ: «تَوُمُ ٱلْمَرْأَةُ النَّسَاءَ فِي الصَّلاَةِ وَ تَقُومُ وَسَطاً مِنْهُنَّ وَ يَقُمْنَ عَنْ يَمِينِهَا وَ شِمَالِهَا تَؤُمُهُنَّ فِي النَّافِلَةِ وَ لاَ
تَوْمُّهُنَّ فِي الْمَكْتُوبَةِ».
english_text:
From him, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Hamid from al-Hasan ibn al-Jahm from Ibn Muskan from al-Halabi
from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “A woman leads women in prayer and stands in the middle of
them, and they stand on her right and her left. She leads them in the recommended
(nafilah) prayer and does not lead them in the obligatory (maktoobah) prayer.”
AND ITS RULINGS
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.268 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.427 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1225 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.336

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
محمد بن مسعود عن ابي العباس بن المغيرة قال : حدثنا الفضل بن شاذان عن ابن ابي عمير عن حماد عن
حريز عن زرارة عن ابي جعفر عليه السلام قال : قلت المرأة تؤم النساء؟ قال : لا إلا على الميت إذا لم يكن أحد
أولى منها تقوم وسطا معهن في الصف فتكبر ويكبرن.
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Mas'ud from Abu al-Abbas ibn al-Mughirah who said: Al-Fadl ibn Shadhan narrated to us
from Ibn Abi Umayr from Hammad from Hariz from Zurarah from Abu Ja’far {a.s}, peace be upon him, who
said:
I asked Imam al-Baqir {a.s}: “Does a woman lead women in prayer?”
Imam {a.s} said: “No, except over the deceased (Salat Al Mayyit), if there is no one more
entitled than her. She stands in the middle with them in the (same) row, says the takbir,
and they say the takbir.”
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.268

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
الْحُسَيْنُ عَنْ فَضَالَةً عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ مَيْمُونٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ : فِي الرَّجُلِ يَؤْمُ
اَلنَّسَاءَ وَ لَيْسَ مَعَهُنَّ رَجُلٌ فِي الْفَرِيضَةِ قَالَ «نَعَمْ وَ إِنْ كَانَ مَعَهُ صَبِيٌّ فَلْيَقُمْ إِلَى جَانِبِهِ».
english_text:
Al-Husayn from Fadalah from Hammad ibn Uthman from Ibrahim ibn Maymun from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace
be upon him:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} was asked regarding a man leading women in prayer, while there is
no other man with them, in the obligatory prayer.
Imam {a.s} said: “Yes, and if there is a boy with him, then let him stand beside him.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.377 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.394 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.268 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1221 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.333 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.342

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنِ اِبْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ خَالِدٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ عَنِ الْمَرْأَةِ
تَؤْمُ النَّسَاءَ فَقَالَ «إِذَا كُنَّ جَمِيعًا أَمّثَهُنَّ فِي النَّافِلَةِ وَ أَمَّا ٱلْمَكْتُوبَةُ فَلاَ وَ لا تَتَقَدَّمُهُنَّ وَ لَكِنْ تَقُومُ وَسَطاً مِنْهُنَّ».
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa’id from Fadalah from Ibn Sinan from Sulayman ibn Khalid who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, about a woman leading women in prayer.
Imam {a.s} said: “If they are all women, she may lead them in the recommended (nafilah)
prayer. As for the obligatory (maktoobah) prayer, no.
And she should not stand in front of them, but rather she should stand in the middle
of them (in the same row).”
AND ITS RULINGS
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.376 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.269 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.426 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1224 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.333 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.336

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ حَدِيدٍ عَنْ جَمِيلٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَحَدَهُمَا عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلاَمُ عَنِ الْإِمَامِ يَضْمَنُ
صَلَاَةَ اَلْقَوْمِ قَالَ «لا».
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn Hadid from Jamil from Zurarah who said:
I asked one of the two Imams {a.s}, peace be upon them, about whether the imam (of
prayer) bears responsibility for the prayer of the people.
Imam {a.s} said: “No.”
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s} & Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al- Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.377 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.269 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1251 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.354

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ وَ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ قَالاَ قَالَ أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السِّلاَمُ كَانَ أَمِيرُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ يَقُولُ: «مَنْ قَرَأْ خَلْفَ إِمَامِ يَأْتَمُّ بِهِ فَمَاتَ بُعِثَ عَلَى غَيْرِ الْفِطْرَةِ».
english_text:
From him, from Hammad ibn Isa from Hariz from Zurarah and Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:
Abu Ja’far {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: “The Commander of the Faithful {a.s}, peace be
upon him, used to say: ‘Whoever recites (Qur’an) behind an imam (of prayer) whom he
follows, and then dies, he will be raised not upon the natural disposition (fitrah,
meaning natural belief in oneness of God).’”
(meaning reciting Qur’an behind an imam (of prayer) during congregational prayer is
incorrect as a muqtadi (follower))
source: Amir al-Mu’minin Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib al-Murtadha {a.s} & Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Al-Muhasin, Vol.1 p.79 • Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.377 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.390 • Thawab Al-A’mal wa ‘Iqab Al-A’mal, Vol.1 p.230 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.269 • Al-Sarair, Vol.3 p.588 • A’lam Al-Din, Vol.1 p.402 • Awali Al-La’ali, Vol.3 p.108 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.356

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
عَلِي بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنِ الْحَلَبِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلاَمُ : فِي الْأَعْمَى يَؤُمُ
اَلْقَوْمَ وَ هُوَ عَلَى غَيْرِ الْقِبْلَةِ قَالَ «يُعِيدُ وَ لاَ يُعِيدُونَ فَإِنَّهُمْ تَحَرَّوْا».
english_text:
Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Ibn Abi Umayr from Hammad from al-Halabi from Abu Abdillah {a.s}:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} was asked regarding a blind man leading the people in prayer while
not facing the qiblah.
Imam {a.s} said: “He must repeat the prayer, but they do not, for they made an effort to
determine the direction.”
AND ITS RULINGS
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.378 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.269 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1243 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.317 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.339 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.375

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ حَدِيدٍ عَنْ جَمِيلٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةً قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَحَدَهُمَا عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلاَمُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ صَلَّى بِقَوْمِ
رَكْعَتَيْنِ فَأَخْبَرَهُمْ أَنَّهُ لَمْ يَكُنْ عَلَى وُضُوءِ قَالَ «يُتِمُّ ٱلْقَوْمُ صَلاَتَهُمْ فَإِنَّهُ لَيْسَ عَلَى الْإِمَامِ ضَمَانْ».
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn Hadid from Jamil from Zurarah who said:
I asked one of the two Imams {a.s}, peace be upon them, about a man who led people
in prayer for two rak‘ahs, then informed them that he was not in a state of wudu.
Imam {a.s} said: “The people should complete their prayer, for the imam (of prayer)
bears no responsibility.”
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s} & Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al- Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.378 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.406 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.269 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.440 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1243 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.371 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.85 p.251

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ غِيَاتٍ عَنْ صَاعِدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ عَنْ الشَّعْبِيّ
قَالَ قَالَ عَلِيٌّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ : «لاَ يَوُمُّ الْأَعْمَى فِي الْبَرِيَّةِ وَ لاَ يَؤُمُ ٱلْمُقَيَّدُ الْمُطْلَقِينَ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Ghiyath
from Sa’id ibn Muslim from al-Sha‘bi who said:
Imam Ali {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: “A blind man does not lead in prayer in the open
land, and a shackled person does not lead those who are free.”
source: Amir al-Mu’minin Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib al-Murtadha {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.269 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1176

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَلاَمُ قَالَ: قُلْتُ إِنَّي
أَدْخُلُ الْمَسْجِدَ وَ قَدْ صَلِّيْتُ فَأْصَلِّي مَعَهُمْ فَلا أَحْتَسِبُ بِتِلْكَ الصَّلاةِ قَالَ «لا بَأْسَ وَ أَمَا أَنَا فَأْصَلِّي مَعَهُمْ وَ أُرِيهِمْ
أَنِّي أُسْجُدُ وَ مَا أسْجُدُ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from al-Qasim ibn Urwah from Ubayd ibn Zurarah from Abu Abdillah {a.s},
peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Imam al-Sadiq {a.s}: “I enter the mosque having already prayed, so I pray with
them but I do not count that prayer (as my obligation).”
Imam {a.s} said: “There is no problem. As for me, I pray with them and make it appear to
them that I am prostrating, but I do not actually prostrate.”
AND ITS RULINGS
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.269 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1213 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.304

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ ٱلْمُغِيرَةِ عَنْ نَاصِحِ ٱلْمُؤَذِّنِ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ إِنِّي
أُصَلِّي فِي الْبَيْتِ وَ أَخْرُجُ إِلَيْهِمْ قَالَ «إِجْعَلُهَا نَافِلَةً وَ لا تُكَبَّرْ مَعَهُمْ فَتَدْخَلَ مَعَهُمْ فِي الصَّلاَةِ فَإِنَّ مِفْتَاحَ الصَّلاةِ
اَلتَّكْبِيرُ».
english_text:
From him, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from his father from Ibn al-Mughirah from Nasih the mu’adhdhin,
who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him: “I pray at home and then go out to them
(the opponents).”
Imam {a.s} said: “Consider it a supererogatory (nafilah) prayer, and do not pronounce
the takbir with them (the opponents), for that would enter you into the prayer with
them, for the key to the prayer is the takbir.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.270 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1213 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.304

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
سَهْلُ بَنْ زِيَادٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْوَلِيدِ عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ أُصَلِّي ثُمَّ
أَدْخُلُ الْمَسْجِدَ فَتُقَامُ الصَّلاةُ وَ قَدْ صَلّيْتُ فَقَالَ «صَلِّ مَعَهُمْ يَخْتَارُ اللَّهُ أَحَبَّهُمَا إِلَيْهِ».
english_text:
Sahl ibn Ziyad from Muhammad ibn al-Walid from Yaqub from Abu Basir who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him: “I perform the prayer and then enter the
mosque and the congregational prayer is established while I have already prayed.”
Imam {a.s} said: “Pray with them; Allah {SWT} chooses the one He {AZJ} loves more from the
two.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.379 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.270 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1248 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.403

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ يَقْطِينٍ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي الْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ جُعِلْتُ فِدَاكَ تَحْضُرُ صَلاَةُ الظُهْرِ
فَلا نَقْدِرُ أَنْ نَنْظَرَ فِي الْوَقْتِ حَتَّى يَنْزِلُوا فَنَنْزِلَ مَعَهُمْ نُصَلِّي ثُمَّ يَقُومُونَ فَيُسْرِعُونَ فَتَقُومُ فَنُصَلِّي الْعَصْرَ وَ
نُرِيهِمْ كَأَنَّا نَرْكَعُ ثُمَّ يَنْزِلُونَ لِلْعَضْرِ فَيُقَدَّمُونَا فَنُصَلِّي بِهِمْ فَقَالَ «صَلَّ بِهِمْ لا صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ».
english_text:
AND ITS RULINGS
Al-Husayn ibn Saeed from Yaqub ibn Yaqtin who said:
I said to Abu al-Hasan {a.s}, peace be upon him:
“May I be your ransom, the time for the noon prayer (Dhuhr) arrives, but we are not
able to check the time until they (the public, meaning non-Shia) descend, so we
descend with them and pray.
Then they (the opponents) rise quickly and we rise and pray the afternoon prayer (Asr),
but we make it appear to them as though we are bowing.
Then later, they descend for the afternoon prayer (Asr) and they put us forward, so we
lead them in prayer.”
Imam {a.s} said: “Lead them in prayer, may Allah {SWT} not accept their prayer.”
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s} & Abu al-Hasan Imam Ali ibn Musa al-Ridha {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.379 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.270 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1213 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.402

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنِ الْهَيْثَمِ بْنِ وَاقِدٍ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللّهِ الْأَرّجَانِيَّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: «مَنْ صَلَّى فِي
مَنْزِلِهِ ثُمَّ أَنَّى مَسْجِداً مِنْ مَسَاجِدِهِمْ فَصَلَّى فِيهِ خَرَجَ بِحَسَنَاتِهِمْ ».
english_text:
From him, from al-Haytham ibn Waqid, from al-Hasan ibn Abdillah al-Arrajani, from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace
be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “Whoever prays in his house, then comes to one of their
(opponent) mosques and prays in it, he departs with their good deeds.”
(meaning to promote strategic use of taqiyyah to preserve life and faith)
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.380 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.407 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.270 • Al-Arba’un Hadithan (Lil-Shahid Al-Awwal), Vol.1 p.79 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1219 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.304 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.85 p.98

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
سَهْلُ بْنُ زِيَادٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي نَصْرٍ عَنِ ٱلْمِيثَمِيّ عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلَامُ جُعِلْتْ فِدَاكَ يَسْبِقُنِي الْإِمَامُ بِالرَّكْعَةِ فَتَكُونُ لِي وَاجِدَةٌ وَ لَهُ ثِنْتَانِ أَفَأْتَشَهْدُ كُلَّمَا قَعَدْتُ فَقَالَ « نَعَمْ إِنَّمَا
اَلتَّشَهْدُ بَرَكَةٌ».
english_text:
Sahl ibn Ziyad from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr from al-Mithami from Ishaq ibn Yazid who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him:
“May I be your ransom, the imam (of prayer) precedes me by one rak‘ah, so I have one
and he has two. Should I recite the tashahhud every time I sit?”
Imam {a.s} said: “Yes, indeed the tashahhud is a blessing.”
AND ITS RULINGS
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.381 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.270 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1233 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.416

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى عَنْ عَبْدِ اللّهِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ عَنْ أَبَانِ بْنِ عُثُمَانَ عَنْ عَبْدِ ٱلرَحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ
عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «إِذَا سَبَقَكَ الْإِمَامُ بِرَكْعَةٍ فَأَدْرَكْتَ ٱلْقِرَاءَةَ الْأَخِيرَةَ قَرَأْتَ فِي الثَّالِثَةِ مِنْ صَلاَتِهِ
وَ هِيَ ثِثْتَانٍ لَكَ فَإِنْ لَمْ تُدْرِك مَعَهُ إِلاَّ رَكْعَةً وَاحِدَةً قَرَأْتَ فِيهَا وَ فِي الَّتِي ثَلِيهَا وَ إِذَا سَبَقَكَ بِرَكْعَةٍ جَلَسْتَ فِي
الثَّانِيَةِ لَكَ وَ الثَّالِثَةِ لَهُ حَثَّى تَعْتَدِلَ الصُّفُوفُ قِيَاما» قَالَ وَ قَالَ «إِذَا وَجَدْتَ الْإِمَامَ سَاجِداً فَاثْبُتْ مَكَانَكَ حَتَّى
يَرْفَعَ رَأْسَهُ وَ إِنْ كَانَ قَاعِداً قَعَدْتَ وَ إِنْ كَانَ قَائِماً قُمْتَ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Yahya from Abdillah ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn al-Hakam from Aban ibn Uthman from Abd
al-Rahman ibn Abi Abdillah from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “If the imam (of prayer) precedes you by one rak‘ah and you
catch the final recitation, then you recite in the third rak‘ah of his prayer, and it is the
second for you.
But if you only catch one rak‘ah with him, then you recite in that one and in the one
that follows it.
And if he precedes you by one rak‘ah, you sit in what is the second for you and the third
for him, until the rows become upright standing.”
He (narrator) said “And Imam {a.s} said:
‘If you find the imam (of prayer) in prostration, then remain in your place until he raises
his head, and if he is sitting, then sit; and if he is standing, then stand.’”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.381 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.271 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1230

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
احمد بن محمد عن علي بن النعمان عن ابن مسكان عن سليمان بن خالد قال : قال أبو عبد اللّٰه عليه السلام :
في الرجل يدرك الامام وهو راكع فكبر وهو مقيم صلبه ثم ركع قبل ان يرفع الامام رأسه فقد أدرك.
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn al-Nu‘man from Ibn Muskan from Sulayman ibn Khalid who said:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: “Regarding a man who catches the imam
(of prayer) while he is in rukuh, and if he says the takbir (‘Allahu Akbar’) while his back
is still upright, then bows before the imam (of prayer) raises his head, (then) he has
caught the rak‘ah”.
AND ITS RULINGS
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.271

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ النُّعْمَانِ عَنِ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ أَبِي الْعَلاءِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: قُلْتُ أَجِيءُ إِلَى ٱلْإِمَامِ وَ
قَدْ سَبَقَنِي بِرَكْعَةٍ فِي الْفَجْرِ فَلَمًا سَلَّمَ وَقَعَ فِي قَلْبِي أَنَّي أَثْمَمْتُ فَلَمْ أَزَلْ ذَاكِراً لِلِّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ حَتَّى طَلَعَتِ الشَّمْسُ
فَلَمَّا طَلَعَتْ نَهَضْتُ فَذَكَزْتُ أَنَّ الْإِمَامَ كَانَ قَدْ سَبَقَنِي بِرَكْعَةٍ فَقَالَ «إِنْ كُنْتَ فِي مَقَامِكَ فَأْتِمَّ بِرَكْعَةِ وَ إِنْ كُنْتَ قَدِ
اِنْصَرَفْتَ فَعَلَيْكَ الْإِعَادَةُ».
english_text:
From him, from Ali ibn al-Nu‘man from al-Husayn ibn Abi al-A‘la from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him,
who said:
I asked Imam al-Sadiq {a.s}: “I come to the imam (of prayer) and he has preceded me by
one rak‘ah in the dawn prayer.
When he gave the taslim, it occurred to my heart that I had completed the prayer, so I
remained remembering Allah {SWT}, Mighty and Majestic, until the sun rose.
When it rose, I stood up and remembered that the imam (of prayer) had preceded me
by one rak‘ah.”
Imam {a.s} said: “If you are still in your place, then complete the prayer with one rak‘ah;
but if you have already left (the place of prayer), then you must repeat the prayer.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.383 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.183 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.271 • Al- Istibsar, Vol.1 p.367 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.959 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.209

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ بْنِ أَيُوبَ عَنِ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ
رَجُلٍ صَلَّى مَعَ قَوْمِ وَ هُوَ يَرَى أَنَّهَا الْأُولَى وَ كَانَتِ الْعَصْرَ قَالَ «فَلْيَجْعَلُهَا ٱلْأُولَى وَ لَيُصَلِّ ٱلْعَصْرَ».
english_text:
From him, from al-Husayn ibn Saeed from Fadalah ibn Ayyub from al-Husayn ibn Uthman from Sama’ah
from Abu Basir who said:
I asked Imam {a.s} about a man who prayed with a group while thinking it was the noon
(Dhuhr) prayer, but it was actually the afternoon (Asr) prayer.
Imam {a.s} said: “Then let him count it as the noon (Dhuhr) prayer and let him perform
the afternoon (Asr) prayer anew.”
AND ITS RULINGS
source: Implicit (Muzmar)
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.272 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1235 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.399

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ حَدِيدٍ عَنْ جَمِيلٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَحَدَهُمَا عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلامُ عَنْ إِمَامِ أَمَّ قَوْمًا فَذَكَرَ أَنَّهُ لَمْ
يَكُنْ عَلَى وُضُوءِ فَانْصَرَفَ وَ أَخَدَ بِيَدِ رَجُلٍ فَأَدْخَلَهُ فَقَدَّمَهُ وَ لَمْ يَعْلَمِ آلَّذِي قُدَّمَ مَا صَلَّى ٱلْقَوْمُ قَالَ «يُصَلِّي بِهِمْ
فَإِنْ أَخْطَاً سَبَّحَ الْقَوْمُ بِهِ وَ بَنَى عَلَى صَلاَةِ الَّذِي كَانَ قَبْلَهُ».
english_text:
From him, from Ali ibn Hadid from Jamil from Zurarah who said:
I asked one of the two Imams {a.s}, peace be upon them, about an imam (of prayer) who
led a group in prayer, then remembered that he was not in a state of wudu.
So he withdrew and took the hand of a man, brought him forward, and put him in front.
But the one who was brought forward did not know what the group had already prayed.
Imam {a.s} said: “He should lead them in prayer, and if he makes a mistake, the group
should say ‘SubhanAllah’ to alert him, and he continues based on the prayer of the
one who was before him.”
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s} & Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al- Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.384 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.272 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1240 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.378

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ وَهْبٍ قَالَ: رَأَيْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ يَوْماً
دَخَلَ الْمَسْجِدَ الْحَرَامَ فِي صَلَاَةِ الْعَصْرِ فَلَمَّا كَانَ دُونَ الصُّفُوفِ رَكَعُوا فَرَكَعَ وَحْدَهُ وَ سَجَدَ السَّجْدَتَيْنِ ثُمَّ قَامَ وَ
مَضَى حَتَّى لَحِقَ ٱلصُّفُوفَ.
english_text:
From him, from al-Husayn ibn Saeed from Hammad ibn Isa from Muawiyah ibn Wahb who said:
I saw Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, one day enter the ‘Sacred Mosque’ at the
time of the afternoon (Asr) prayer.
When Imam {a.s} was still short of reaching the rows, they bowed, so Imam {a.s} bowed
alone and performed the two prostrations, then stood up and continued until Imam
{a.s} reached the rows.
AND ITS RULINGS
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.384 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.272 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.281 • Al- Wafi, Vol.8 p.1196 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.384

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ عُثُمَانَ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ سَعِيدِ الْأَعْرَجِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ - عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يَأْتِي الصَّلاَةَ فَلاَ
يَجِدُ فِي الصَّفَّ مَقَاماً أَيَقُومُ وَحْدَهُ حَتَّى يَفْرُغَ مِنْ صَلاَتِهِ قَالَ «نَعَمْ لاَ بَأْسَ يَقُومُ بِحِذَاءِ ٱلْإِمَامِ».
english_text:
From him, from Uthman ibn Isa from Saeed al-A‘raj who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, about a man who comes to the prayer and does not find a
place in the row. Should he stand alone until he finishes his prayer?
Imam {a.s} said: “Yes, there is no problem, he may stand beside the imam (of prayer).”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.385 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.272 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1189

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إسْمَاعِيلَ عَنِ ٱلْفَضْلِ بْنِ شَاذَانَ عَنْ حَمَادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ رِبْعِيِّ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ قَالَ: قَلْتُ لَهُ الرَّجْلُ
يَتَأَخَرُ وَ هُوَ فِي الصَّلاَةِ قَالَ «لا» قُلْتُ فَيَتَقَدَّمُ قَالَ «نَعَمْ مَاشِياً إلَى ٱلْقِبْلَةِ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ismail from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan from Hammad ibn Isa from Rubi‘i from Muhammad ibn
Muslim who said:
I said to Imam {a.s}: “(May) a man moves backward while in prayer?”
Imam {a.s} said: “No.” (meaning it is not allowed)
I asked: “Then may he move forward?”
Imam {a.s} said: “Yes, walking toward the qiblah.”
source: Implicit (Muzmar)
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.272 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.385 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.85 p.91

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُصَدَّقٍ بْنِ صَدَقَةً عَنْ عَمَّارِ السَابَاطِيّ
عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يُذْرِكُ الْإِمَامَ وَ هُوَ قَاعِدٌ يَتَشَهَدُ وَ لَيْسَ خَلْفَهُ إِلَّ رَجُلٌ وَاجِدْ
عَنْ يَمِينِهِ قَالَ «لاَ يَتَقَدَّمُ ٱلْإِمَامَ وَ لاَ يَتَأْخَرُ ٱلرَّجُلَ وَ لَكِنْ يَقْعُدُ الَّذِي يَدْخُلُ مَعَهُ خَلْفَ ٱلْإِمَامِ فَإِذَا سَلَّمَ الْإِمَامُ قَامَ
الرّجُلُ فَاتَمَّ صَلاَتَهُ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan from Amr ibn Saeed from Musaddiq ibn
Sadaqah from Ammar al-Sabati from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} about a man who catches imam (of prayer) while he is sitting
and reciting tashahhud, and there is no one behind him except a man on his right.
Imam {a.s} said: “The imam (of prayer) should not move forward, and the man should
not move backward, but the one who enters to pray with him should sit behind the
imam (of prayer). When the imam (of prayer) gives the salam, the man should stand
and complete his prayer.”
AND ITS RULINGS
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.386 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.272 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1198 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.392

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ عَنْ مَرْوَكِ بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ عَنْ نَشِيطِ بْنِ صَالِحٍ عَنْ أُبِي الْحَسَنِ الْأَوَّلِ
عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لَهُ الرَّجُلُ مِنَّا يُصَلِّي صَلاتَهُ فِي جَوْفٍ بَيْتِهِ مُغْلِقاً عَلَيْهِ بَابَهُ ثُمَّ يَخْرُجُ فَيُصَلِّي مَعَ جِيرَتِهِ
تَكُونُ صَلاَتُهُ تِلْكَ وَحْدَهُ فِي بَيْتِهِ جَمَاعَةً فَقَالَ «الَّذِي يُصَلِّي فِي بَيْتِهِ يُضَاعِفُهُ اللَّهُ لَهُ ضِعْفَيْ أَجْرِ ٱلْجَمَاعَةِ يَكُونُ
لَهُ خَمْسِينَ دَرَجَةً وَ الَّذِي يُصَلِّي مَعَ جِيرَتِهِ يَكْتُبُ اللَّهُ لَهُ أَجْرَ مَنْ صَلَّى خَلْفَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ وَ
يَدْخُلُ مَعَهُمْ فِي صَلاَتِهِمْ فَيُخَلَّفُ عَلَيْهِمْ ذُنُوبَهُ وَ يَخْرُجُ بِحَسَنَاتِهِمْ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Yaqub ibn Yazid from Marwak ibn Ubayd from Nashit ibn Salih from
Abu al-Hasan al-Awwal {a.s} (the First), peace be upon him, who said:
I said to Imam al-Kadhim {a.s}: “A man among us performs his prayer inside his house
with the door closed, then he goes out and prays with his neighbors. Is his prayer alone
in his house considered a congregational prayer?”
Imam {a.s} said: “The one who prays in his house, Allah {SWT} multiplies it for him to twice
the reward of congregation; he will have fifty degrees (of reward).
And the one who prays with his neighbors, Allah {SWT} writes for him the reward of one
who prayed behind the Messenger of Allah {SWT}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his family.
And if he joins them in their prayer, so he leaves his sins behind with them (the
opponents), and departs with their good deeds.”
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.273 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1219 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.303

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ خَالِدٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُصَدِّقِ بْنِ صَدَقَةَ عَنْ عَمَّارٍ
السَّابَاطِيّ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ الرَجُلِ يُصَلِّي بِقَوْمٍ فَيَدْخُلُ قَوْمٌ فِي صَلاتِهِ بَعْدَ مَا قَدْ صَلَّى
رَكْعَةً أَوْ أَكْثَرَ مِنْ ذَلِكَ فَإِذَا فَرَغَ مِنْ صَلَاَتِهِ وَ سَلَّمَ أَيَجُوزُ لَهُ وَ هُوَ إِمَامٌ أَنْ يَقُومَ مِنْ مَوْضِعِهِ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَفْرُغَ مَنْ
دَخَلَ فِي صَلاَتِهِ قَالَ «نَعَمْ».
قال محمد بن الحسن : هذا الخبر محمول على الرخصة والافضل ما قدمناه من انه ينبغي أن يصبر حتى يتم من خلفه ما
قد فاته، ويزيد ذلك بيانا ما رواه :
english_text:
AND ITS RULINGS
From him, from Ali ibn Khalid from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal from Amr ibn Saeed from
Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah from Ammar al-Sabati who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, about a man who leads a group in prayer,
and another group joins his prayer after he has already performed one rak‘ah or more
than that. When he finishes his prayer, and gives the salam, is it permissible for him as
the imam (of prayer) to leave his place (of prayer) before those who joined the prayer
(later) have finished?
Imam {a.s} said: “Yes.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
commentary:
Muhammad ibn al-Hasan said: “This report is to be understood as a concession
(rukhsah), and the preferable (afdhal) course is what we have previously stated that
he should wait until those behind him complete what they have missed.”
This is further clarified by what has been narrated:
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.273 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1267 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.435

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
احمد بن محمد عن علي بن الحكم عن اسماعيل بن عبد الخالق قال : سمعته يقول : لا ينبغي للامام أن يقوم
إذا صلى حتى يقضي كل من خلفه ما قد فاته من الصلاة.
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn al-Hakam from Ismail ibn Abd al-Khaliq who said:
I heard Imam {a.s} say: “It is not proper for the imam (of prayer) to stand up after he has
prayed, until everyone behind him has completed what they missed of the prayer.”
source: Implicit (Muzmar)
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.274

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ عَنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنِ النَّضْرِ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ سَالِمِ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ خَالِدٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ
عَنْ رَجُلٍ دَخَلَ الْمَسْجِدَ فَافْتَتَحَ الصَّلاةَ قَالَ قَبَيْنَا هُوَ قَائِمٌ يُصَلِّي إِذْ أَذَّنَ الْمُؤَذِّنُ فَأَقَامَ الصَّلاةَ قَالَ «فَلْيُصَلَّ
رَكْعَتَيْنِ وَ يَسْتَأْنِفُ الصَّلَاةَ مَعَ الْإِمَامِ وَ لْتَكُنِ الرَّكْعَتَانِ تَطَوْعاً».
english_text:
Ahmad from al-Husayn from al-Nadr from Hisham ibn Salim from Sulayman ibn Khalid from Abu Abdillah
{a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} about a man who enters the mosque and begins the prayer.
While he is standing and praying, the muezzin gives the call to prayer and establishes
the congregational prayer.
Imam {a.s} said: “Then let him complete two rak‘ahs and begin the prayer anew with the
imam (of prayer), and let the two rak‘ahs be counted as voluntary (nafl) prayer.”
AND ITS RULINGS
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.274

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيّ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُصَدِّقِ بْنِ صَدَقَةَ عَنْ عَمَّارٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ
عَنْ رَجْلٍ أَدْرَكَ الْإِمَامَ وَ هُوَ جَالِسٌ بَعْدَ الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ قَالَ «يَفْتَتِحُ الصَّلاَةَ وَ لا يَقْعُدُ مَعَ الْإِمَامِ حَتَّى يَقُومَ».
english_text:
Ahmad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ali from Amr ibn Saeed from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah from Ammar who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, about a man who catches the imam (of
prayer) while he is sitting after the two rak‘ahs.
Imam {a.s} said: “He should begin the prayer anew and should not sit with the imam (of
prayer) until the imam (of prayer) stands.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.274 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1234 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.393

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
أحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ جَمِيلٍ عَنْ سَمَاعَةً عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ : فِي رَجُلٍ سَبَقَهُ
الْإِمَامُ بِرَكْعَةٍ وَ أَوْهَمَ الْإمَامُ فَصَلَّى خَمْساً قَالَ «يُعِيدُ تِلْكَ الرَّكْعَةَ وَ لا يَعْتَدْ بِوَهَمِ ٱلْإمَامِ».
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Hasan ibn Mahbub from Jamil from Sama’ah from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace
be upon him:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} was asked regarding a man whom the imam (of prayer) precedes by
one rak‘ah, and the imam (of prayer) makes a mistake and prays five rak‘ahs.
Imam {a.s} said: “He should repeat that rak‘ah and should not consider the mistake of
the imam (of prayer).”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.409 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.274 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1256 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.418

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ السِّنْدِيِّ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنْ إسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ آللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ
قَالَ: «يَنْبَغِي لِلْإِمَامِ أَنْ تَكُونَ صَلاَثُهُ عَلَى أَضْعَفٍ مَنْ خَلْفَهُ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Ali ibn al-Sindi from Safwan from Ishaq ibn Ammar from Abu Abdillah
{a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “It is proper for the imam (of prayer) that his prayer be
according to the weakest among those behind him.” (meaning that the prayer leader
keep the prayer of suitable length according to those following him)
AND ITS RULINGS
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.390 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.274 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1262 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.420

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنِ الْعَبَّاسِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللّهِ بْنِ ٱلْمُغِيرَةِ عَنِ اِبْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَ قَالَ: «صَلَّى رَسُولُ اللهِ صَلَّى اللّهُ عَلَيْهِ
وَ آلِهِ الظَّهْرَ وَ الْعَصْرَ فَخَفّفَ الصَّلاةَ فِي الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ فَلَمَّا اِنْصَرَفَ قَالَ لَهُ النَّاسُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَحَدَثَ فِي الصَّلاةِ
شَيْءٌ قَالَ «وَ مَا ذَاكَ» قَالُوا خَفَّفْتَ فِي الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ الْأَخِيرَتَيْنِ فَقَالَ لَهُمْ «أَ مَا سَمِعْتُمْ صُرَاخَ الصَّبِيَّ»».
english_text:
From him, from al-Abbas from Abdillah ibn al-Mughirah from Ibn Sinan from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “The Messenger of Allah {SWT}, performed the noon (Dhuhr) and
afternoon (Asr) prayers and shortened the prayer in the last two rak‘ahs.
When Prophet {saws} finished, the people said to Him {saws}:
‘O Messenger of Allah {SWT}, has something occurred in the prayer?’
Prophet {saws} said: “And what is that?”
They said: “You shortened the last two rak‘ahs.”
So Prophet {saws} said to them: “Did you not hear the cry of the child?’”
source: Abu al-Qasim Prophet Muhammad ibn Abdullah {saws}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.6 p.48 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.274 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1261 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.419 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.21 p.480

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
عنه عن علي بن السندي عن حماد بن عيسى عن معاوية ابن وهب قال : سألت ابا عبد اللّٰه ع عن الرجل يدرك
آخر صلاة الامام وهي أول صلاة الرجل فلا يمهله حتى يقرأ فيقضي القراءة في آخر صلاته؟ قال : نعم.
٨٦٢٥٥
english_text:
From him, from Ali ibn al-Sindi from Hammad ibn Isa from Muawiyah ibn Wahb who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, about a man who catches the end of the prayer of the imam
(of prayer), while it is the beginning of the man's own prayer.
And the imam (of prayer) does not give him time to recite,
Should he make up the recitation at the end of his prayer?
Imam {a.s} said: “Yes”.
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.275

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمِّدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى الْخَثُعَمِيِّ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّجِيمِ الْقَصِيرِ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا
جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ يَقُولُ: «إِذَا كَانَ الرَجُلُ لاَ تَعْرِفُهُ يَؤُمُّ النَّاسَ فَقَرَأ الْقُرْآنَ فَلا تَقْرَأْ وَ اِعْتَدَ بِصَلاتِهِ».
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Saeed from al-Qasim ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Khath'ami from Abd al-
Rahim al-Qasir who said:
I heard Abu Ja’far {a.s}, peace be upon him, say: “If a man, whose background you do
not know, leads the people in prayer and he recites the Quran, then do not recite (for
yourselves), and count the prayer as valid.”
AND ITS RULINGS
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.275 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1185 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.85 p.33

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَحْمَدَ عَنِ الْعَمْرَكِيَّ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ مُوسَى بْنَ جَعْفَدٍ
عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلاَمُ عَنِ الْقِيَامِ خَلْفَ الْإِمَامِ فِي الصَّفَّ مَا حَدُّهُ قَالَ «إِقَامَةُ مَا اِسْتَطَعْتَ فَإِذَا قَعَدْتَ فَضَاقَ ٱلْمَكَانُ
فَتَقَدَّمُ أَوْ تَأْخَرُ فَلاَ بَأْسَ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Muhammad ibn Ahmad from al-Amraki from Ali ibn Ja’far who said:
(Ali ibn Ja’far said) “I asked Imam Musa ibn Ja’far {a.s}, peace be upon them both, about
standing behind the imam (of prayer) in the row, what is its limit?”
Imam {a.s} said: “Stand as much as you are able, and if you sit and the space becomes
tight, then move forward or backward, there is no problem.”
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.275 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1197 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.190 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.422

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي هَاشِمِ عَنْ سَالِمِ أَبِي خَدِيجَةَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ
قَالَ: «إِذَا كُنْتَ إِمَامَ قَوْمٍ فَعَلَيْكَ أَنْ تَقْرَأَ فِي الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ الْأَوْلَتَيْنِ وَ عَلَى الَّذِينَ خَلْفَكَ أَنْ يَقُولُوا سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَ
الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ وَ لا إِلَهَ إِلَّ اللَّهُ وَ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ وَ هُمْ قِيَامٌ فَإِذَا كَانَ فِي الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ الْأَخِيرَتَيْنِ فَعَلَى الَّذِينَ خَلْفَكَ أَنْ يَقْرَءُوا
فَاتِحَةَ اَلْكِتَابِ وَ عَلَى الْإِمَامِ التَّسْبِيحُ مِثْلَ مَا يُسَبِّحُ الْقَوْمُ فِي الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ الْأَخِيرَتَيْنِ».
english_text:
From him, from Muhammad ibn Isa from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Hashim from Salim Abu Khadijah from Abu
Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “If you are the imam (of prayer) of a group, then it is upon you
to recite in the first two rak‘ahs, and upon those behind you to say:
‘SubhanAllah, wal-hamdu lillah, wa la ilaha illa Allah, wa Allahu Akbar’ while they are
standing.
Then, in the last two rak‘ahs, it is upon those behind you to recite the ‘Fatihat al-Kitab’
(Surah al-Fatihah), and upon the imam (of prayer) is the ‘tasbih’ in the same way that
the people say in the last two rak‘ahs.”
AND ITS RULINGS
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.275 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1204 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.126 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.362 • Mustadrak Al-Wasa’il, Vol.6 p.479

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لأَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ مَنْ
لاَ أَقْتَدِي بِهِ فِي الصَّلاَةِ قَالَ «أُفْرُغْ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَفْرُغَ فَإِنَّكَ فِي حِصَارٍ فَإِنْ فَرَغَ قَبْلَكَ فَاقْطَعِ الْقِرَاءَةَ وَ اِرْكَعْ مَعَهُ».
english_text:
From him, from Yaqub ibn Yazid from Ibn Abi Umayr from Ibn Muskan from Abu Basir who said:
I said to Abu Ja’far {a.s}, peace be upon him: “(When praying) behind someone I do not
follow in prayer, what should I do?”
Imam {a.s} said: “Finish (your recitation) before he finishes, for you are in confinement
(hisar). If he finishes before you, then cut off your recitation and bow with him.”
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.275 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1210 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.367

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ عَنْ سَيْفِ بْنِ عَمِيرَةَ عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرٍ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ : «إِذَا
صَلَّيْتَ بِقَوْمٍ فَاقْعُذْ بَعْدَ مَا تُسَلَّمُ هُنَيْئَةً».
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn al-Hakam from Sayf ibn Umayrah from Abu Bakr who said:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: “When you lead a group in prayer, then sit
for a short while after you give the taslim.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.275 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1266 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.434

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
وَ بِهَذَا الْإِسْنَادِ عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرٍ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لَهُ إِنِّي أُصَلِّي بِقَوْمِ فَقَالَ «تُسَلَّمُ وَاحِدَةً وَ لا تَلْتَفِتْ قُلِ ٱلسَلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ أَيْهَا
اَلنَّبِي وَ رَحْمَةُ اللّهِ وَ بَرَكَاتُهُ السَّلَاَمُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَ لَا تَقْرَأْ فِي الْفَجْرِ شَيْئاً مِنْ آلِ حم».
english_text:
And with this chain of transmission, from Abu Bakr who said:
I said to Imam al-Sadiq {a.s}: “I lead a group in prayer.”
Imam {a.s} said, “You give one taslim and do not turn your head. Say:
‘Peace be upon you, O’ Prophet, and the mercy of Allah {SWT} and His blessings. Peace
be upon you all.’
And do not recite anything from ‘Alif Lam Mim Ha Mim’ in the dawn (Fajr) prayer.”
(meaning Huroof al-Muqatta'at that appear at the beginning of 29 Surahs of the Quran)
AND ITS RULINGS
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.276 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1265

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمِّدٍ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ آلْجَهْمِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ الرَّضَا عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ
يُصَلِّي بِالْقَوْمِ فِي مَكَانٍ ضَيّقٍ وَ يَكُونُ بَيْنَهُمْ وَ بَيْنَهُ سِثْرٌ يَجُوزُ أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ بِهِمْ قَالَ « نَعَمْ».
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal from al-Hasan ibn al-Jahm who said:
I asked Imam al-Ridha {a.s}, peace be upon him, about a man who leads a group in
prayer in a narrow place and there is a curtain between him and them. Does it suffice
for him to lead them in prayer?
Imam {a.s} said: “Yes.”
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Ali ibn Musa al-Ridha {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.276 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.408

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ عَنْ سُلَيْمِ ٱلْفَرَّاءِ عَنْ دَاوُدَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلاَمُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ يَكُونُ مُؤَذّنَ
مَسْجِدٍ فِي الْمِصْرِ وَ إِمَامَهُ فَإِذَا كَانَ يَوْمُ الْجُمُعَةِ صَلَّى الْعَصْرَ فِي وَقْتِهَا كَيْفَ يَصْنَعُ بِمَسْجِدِهِ قَالَ «صَلِّ ٱلْعَصْرَ
فِي وَقْتِهَا فَإِذَا كَانَ ذَلِكَ الْوَقْتُ الْذِي يُؤَذِّنْ فِيهِ أَهْلُ الْمِصْرِ فَأَذِّنْ وَ صَلَّ بِهِمْ فِي الْوَقْتِ اَلْذِي يُصَلِّي بِهِمْ فِيهِ أَهْلُ
مصرِكَ».
english_text:
From him, from Ali ibn al-Hakam from Sulaym al-Farra’ from Dawud who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, about a man who is the muezzin of a
mosque in a city and also its imam (of prayer). So when Friday comes, he performs the
afternoon (Asr) prayer at its proper time, What should he do about his mosque?
Imam {a.s} said: “Pray the afternoon (Asr) prayer at its proper time. Then, when that time
comes, in which the people of the city give the call to prayer, you too give the adhan
and lead them in prayer at the time in which the people of your city pray.”
AND ITS RULINGS
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.276 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1214 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.402

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنِ الْبَرْقِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي طَالِبِ عَبْدِ اللّهِ بْنِ الصِّلْتِ وَ الْعَبَّاسِ بْنِ مَعْرُوفِ كُلَّهِمْ عَنْ بَكْرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ الْأَزْدِيّ قَالَ قَالَ
أَبُو عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ : «إِنَّي لَأكْرَهُ لِلْمُؤْمِنِ أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ خَلْفَ ٱلْإِمَامِ فِي صَلاَةٍ لا يُجْهَرُ فِيهَا بِالْقِرَاءَةِ فَيَقُومُ كَأَنَّهُ
حِمَار» قَالَ قُلْتُ جُعِلْتُ فِدَاكَ فَيَصْنَعُ مَا ذَا قَالَ «يُسَبِّحُ».
english_text:
From him, from al-Barqi from Abu Talib Abdillah ibn al-Salt and al-Abbas ibn Ma'ruf all from Bakr ibn
Muhammad al-Azdi who said:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: “Indeed, I dislike for the believer to pray
behind the imam (of prayer) in a prayer in which the recitation is not recited aloud, and
he stands (mute) as if he were a donkey.”
He (al-Azdi) said: “I asked, ‘May I be your ransom, then what should he do?’”
Imam {a.s} said: “He should glorify (say tasbih).”
(meaning ‘SubhanAllah, wal-hamdu lillah, wa la ilaha illa Allah, wa Allahu Akbar’)
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Qurb Al-Isnad, Vol.1 p.37 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.392 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.276 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1205 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.360 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.85 p.79

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي نَصْرٍ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ شَيْبَةَ قَالَ: كَتَّبْتُ إِلَى أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ أَسْأَلُهُ عَنِ
الصَّلَاةٍ خَلْفَ مَنْ يَتَوَلَّى أَمِيرَ الْمُوْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ وَ هُوَ يَرَى الْمَسْحَ عَلَى الْخُفِّيْنِ أَوْ خَلْفَ مَنْ يُحَرِّمُ الْمَسْحَ وَ
هُوَ يَمْسَحُ فَكَتَبَ «إِنْ جَامَعَكَ وَ إِيَّاهُمْ مَوْضِعْ فَلَمْ تَجِدْ بُدَاَ مِنَ الصَّلاَةِ فَأَذّنْ لِنَفْسِكَ وَ أَقِمْ فَإِنْ سَبَقَكَ إلَى ٱلْقِرَاءَةِ
فَسَبِّح».
english_text:
From him, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr from Ibrahim ibn Shaybah who said:
I wrote to Abu Ja’far {a.s}, peace be upon him, asking Imam {a.s} about praying behind
someone who shows allegiance to the Commander of the Faithful {a.s}, peace be upon
him, yet believes in wiping over the leather socks, or behind someone who forbids
wiping, yet he himself wipes.
Imam {a.s} wrote: “If you and they are gathered in one place and you have no choice but
to pray, then give the adhan for yourself and the iqamah. If he begins the recitation
before you, then do tasbih (glorify Allah {SWT}).”
AND ITS RULINGS
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Jawad {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.276 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1185 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.363 • Awalim Al-Uloom, Vol.23 p.313 • Awalim Al-Uloom, Vol.23 p.403

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدٌ عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ إسْمَاعِيلَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ الرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ ٱلسِّلاَمُ : عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يُقَارِفُ الذَّنْبَ نُصَلِّي خَلْفَهُ أَمْ لا قَالَ
«لاَ تُصَلِّ».
english_text:
Muhammad from Sa’ad ibn Isma'il from his father from al-Ridha {a.s}, peace be upon him:
Imam al-Ridha {a.s} was asked regarding a man who commits sin, should we pray
behind him or not?
Imam {a.s} said: “Do not pray (behind him).”
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Ali ibn Musa al-Ridha {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.277

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
عَنَهُ عَنِ الْبَرْقِيّ عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ الْمُثَنَّى الْخَطِيبِ عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَمَّارِ قَالَ: قَالَ لِي أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ «يَا
إسحَاقُ أَثْصَلِّي مَعَهُمْ فِي المَسْجِدِ» قُلْتُ نَعَمْ قَالَ «صَلَ مَعَهُمْ فَإِنّ ٱلْمُصَلِّي مَعَهُمْ فِي الصّفَ الأَوَّلِ كَالشَّاهِرِ
سَيْفَهُ فِي سَبِيلِ اللهِ».
english_text:
From him, from al-Barqi from Ja’far ibn al-Muthanna al-Khatib from Ishaq ibn Ammar who said:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said to me: “O Ishaq, do you pray with them (the
opponents) in the mosque?”
I said: “Yes.”
Imam {a.s} said: “Pray with them, for the one who prays with them in the first row is like
one who draws his sword in the way of Allah {SWT}.”
(meaning to have Shia presence in communal religious spaces is a form of jihad)
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.277 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1217 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.301

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ بْنِ يَقْطِينٍ عَنْ أَخِيهِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ يَقْطِينٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا الْحَسَنِ
عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ عَنِ الرَّجْلِ يَزْكَعُ مَعَ ٱلْإِمَامِ يَقْتَدِي بِهِ ثُمَّ يَرْفَعُ رَأْسَهُ قَبْلَ الْإِمَامِ قَالَ «يُعِيدُ رُكُوعَهُ مَعَهُ».
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Yaqtin from his brother al-Husayn from Ali ibn Yaqtin who
said:
I asked Abu al-Hasan {a.s}, peace be upon him, about a man who bows with the imam
(of prayer), following him, then raises his head before the imam (of prayer).
Imam {a.s} said: “He must repeat his bowing with him.”
AND ITS RULINGS
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.277 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1254 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.391

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
أَبِي الْحَسَنِ الرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ فِي رَجُلٍ كَانّ خَلْفَ إِمَامِ يَأْتَمُ بِهِ
عَنْهُ عَنِ الْبَرْقِيِّ عَنِ اِبْنِ فَضَالِ قَالَ: كَتَبْتُ إِلَى
فَرَكَعَ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَرْكَعَ الْإِمَامُ وَ هُوَ يَظُنُّ أَنَّ ٱلْإِمَامَ قَدْ رَكَعَ فَلَمَّا رَكَعَ رَآهُ لَمْ يَرْكَغ فَرَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ ثُمَّ أَعَادَ الرُّكُوعَ مَعَ
الْإِمَامِ أَيُفْسِدُ عَلَيْهِ ذَلِكَ صَلاتَهُ أَمْ تَجُوزُ تِلْكَ الرَّكْعَةُ فَكَتَبَ «يُتِمُّ صَلاَتَهُ وَ لا يُفْسِدُ مَا صَنَّعَ صَلاَتَهُ».
english_text:
From him, from al-Barqi from Ibn Faddal who said:
I wrote to Abu al-Hasan al-Ridha {a.s}, peace be upon him, regarding a man who was
behind an imam (of prayer), following him, and he bowed before the imam (of prayer)
thinking that the imam (of prayer) had bowed.
When he bowed, he saw that the imam (of prayer) had not bowed, so he raised his
head, then repeated the bowing with the imam (of prayer). Does this invalidate his
prayer, or is that rak‘ah valid?
Imam {a.s} wrote: “He completes his prayer, and what he did does not invalidate his
prayer.”
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Ali ibn Musa al-Ridha {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.277 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.280 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1254 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.391

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text: عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سَهْلٍ عَنِ الرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: «الْإِمَامُ يَتَحَمَّلُ أَوْهَامَ مَنْ خَلْفَهُ إِلا تَكْبِيرَةَ الإِفْتِتَاحِ».
english_text:
From him, from Muhammad ibn Sahl from Imam al-Ridha {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Ridha {a.s} said: “The imam (of prayer) bears the mistakes (or forgetfulness) of
those behind him, except for the opening takbir (takbirat al-ihram).”
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Ali ibn Musa al-Ridha {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.277 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1252

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ وَهْبٍ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اللهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ أَيَضْمَنُ الْإِمَامُ
صَلاةً الْفَرِيضَةِ فَإِنَّ هَوْلاءِ يَزْعُمُونَ أَنَّهُ يَضْمَنْ فَقَالَ «لا يَضْمَنُ أَيِّ شَيْءٍ يَضْمَنُ إلاَّ أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ بِهِمْ جُنُباً أَوْ عَلَى
غَيْرِ طُهْرٍ».
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Saeed from Hammad ibn Isa from Muawiyah ibn Wahb who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him: “Does the imam (of prayer) bear
responsibility for the obligatory prayer? For these people claim that he does.”
Imam {a.s} said: “He does not bear responsibility, what is it that he would bear
responsibility for? Except if he were to lead them in prayer while in a state of janabah
or without purity?”
AND ITS RULINGS
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.277 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1252 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.373 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.85 p.251

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
سَعدْ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللّهِ بْنِ بُكَيْرٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِي
جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «لا بَأْسَ بِأَنْ تُصَلِّيَ خَلْفَ النَّاصِبِ وَ لاَ تَقْرَأَ خَلْفَهُ فِيمَا يَجْهَرُ فِيهِ فَإِنَّ قِرَاءَتَهُ تُجْزِيكَ
إِذَا سَمِعْتَهَا».
قال محمد بن الحسن : هذا الخبر محمول على حال التقية ويحتمل ان يكون أراد لا تقرأ قراءة تجهر فيها كما يجهر الامام
، وإنما يجوز له أن يقرأ فيما بينه وبين نفسه.
english_text:
Sa’ad from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Husayn ibn Saeed from al-Qasim ibn Urwah from Abdillah ibn
Bukayr from Zurarah from Abu Ja’far {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Baqir {a.s} said: “There is no harm in praying behind a ‘nasib’ (known enemy of
the Ahlulbayt {a.s}), and do not recite behind him in that which is recited aloud, for his
recitation suffices you, if you hear it.”
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
commentary:
Muhammad ibn al-Hasan said: “This report is to be understood in the context of
taqiyyah (dissimulation), and it is possible that what Imam {a.s} meant was:
‘do not recite in a manner that is aloud, as the imam (of prayer) recites aloud, but
rather it is permissible for him to recite silently to himself’.”
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.278 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1209 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.369

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
سعد عن احمد عن موسى بن القاسم وابي قتادة عن علي ابن جعفر عن اخيه عليه السلام قال : سألته عن
المرأة تؤم النساء ما حد رفع صوتها بالقراءة والتكبير؟ فقال : قدر ما تسمع.
english_text:
Sa’ad from Ahmad from Musa ibn al-Qasim and Abu Qatadah from Ali ibn Ja’far from his brother {a.s}, peace
be upon him, who said:
I asked Imam al-Kadhim {a.s} about a woman who leads other women in prayer, what is
the limit of how loud her voice should be in recitation and takbir?
Imam {a.s} said: “As much as she can hear herself.”
AND ITS RULINGS
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.278

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدِ عَنْ مُصَدِّقِ بْنِ صَدَقَةَ عَنْ عَمَّارِ السَابَاطِيّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يَنْسَى وَ هُوَ خَلْفَ الْإِمَامِ أَنْ يُسَبَّحَ فِي السُّجُودِ أَوْ فِي الرُّكُوعِ أَوْ يَنْسَى أَنْ يَقُولَ
بَيْنَ السَّجْدَنَيْنِ شَيْئاً فَقَالَ «لَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ شَيْءٌ».
english_text:
From him, from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan, from Amr ibn Sa'id, from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah, from Ammar al-
Sabati, from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} about a man who forgets while he is behind the imam (of
prayer), to say the tasbih in prostration or in bowing, or he forgets to say anything
between the two prostrations.
Imam {a.s} said: “There is nothing upon him.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.405 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.278 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1253 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.240 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.85 p.249

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُصَدِّقِ بْنِ صَدَقَةً عَنْ عَمَّارِ السَّابَاطِيَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ سَهَا خَلْفَ إِمَامِ بَعْدَ مَا اِفْتَتَحَ الصَّلاَةَ فَلَمْ يَقْلْ شَيْئاً وَ لَمْ يُكَبِّرْ وَ لَمْ يُسَبِّحْ وَ لَمْ
يَتَشَهَدْ حَثَّى يُسَلَّمَ فَقَالَ «جَازَتْ صَلاَتُهُ وَ لَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ إِذَا سَهَا خَلْفَ ٱلْإِمَامِ سَجْدَنَا السَّهْوِ لِأَنَّ الْإِمَامَ ضَامِنْ لِصَلاَةٍ
مَنْ خَلْفَهُ».
english_text:
From him, from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan, from Amr ibn Sa'id, from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah, from Ammar al-
Sabati, from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} about a man who was inattentive behind an imam (of prayer)
after he had initiated the prayer, and he did not say anything, nor did he say the takbir,
nor the tasbih, nor the tashahhud, until the imam (of prayer) concluded with the
salam.
Imam {a.s} said: “His prayer is valid, and if he was inattentive behind the imam (of
prayer), there is no obligation upon him to perform the two prostrations of
forgetfulness (sajdata al-sahw), because the imam (of prayer) is responsible for the
prayer of those behind him.”
AND ITS RULINGS
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.406 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.278 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.439 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1253 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.240 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.85 p.249

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ وَ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَخِيهِ مُوسَى بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِمَا
السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يُصَلِّي خَلْفَ الْإِمَامِ لَا يَدْرِي كَمْ صَلَّى أ عَلَيْهِ سَهُوْ قَالَ «لا)».
english_text:
From him, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Musa ibn al-Qasim and Abu Qatadah, from Ali ibn Ja’far, from
his brother Imam Musa ibn Ja’far {a.s}, peace be upon them both, who said:
I asked Imam al-Khadim {a.s} about a man who is praying behind the imam (of prayer)
and does not know how many units he has prayed, does forgetfulness apply to him?
Imam {a.s} said: “No.”
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}
references: Masa’il Ali Ibn Ja’far, Vol.1 p.256 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.350 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.279 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1001 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1252 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.239 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.85 p.239

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ
قَالَ: قُلْتُ لَهُ أَ يَضْمَنُ الْإِمَامُ الصَّلاَةَ قَالَ «لا لَيْسَ بِضَامِنِ».
قال محمد بن الحسن: لا ينافي هذا الخبر ما قدمناه من أن الامام ضامن لان الذي يضمن الامام القراءة فقط ، فأما سائر
ذلك فليس عليه ضمان يدل على ذلك ما رواه :
english_text:
From him, from Yaqub ibn Yazid, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Abdullah ibn Muskan, from Abu Basir,
from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
I said to Imam al-Sadiq {a.s}: “Does the imam (of prayer) guarantee the prayer?”
Imam {a.s} said: “No, he is not a guarantor.”
AND ITS RULINGS
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
commentary:
Muhammad ibn al-Hasan said: “This report does not contradict what we have
presented earlier regarding the imam (of prayer) being a guarantor, because what the
imam (of prayer) guarantees is only the recitation (al-qira'ah);
as for the rest of the prayer, there is no guarantee upon him.”
This is indicated by what has been narrated:
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.406 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.279 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1251 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.353 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.85 p.252

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ بَشِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ : أَنَّهُ سَأَلَهُ رَجُلٌ عَنِ الْقِرَاءَةِ خَلْفَ الْإِمَامِ فَقَالَ «لا إِنَّ الْإِمَامَ
ضَامِنْ لِلْقِرَاءَةٍ وَ لَيْسَ يَضْمَنُ الْإِمَامُ صَلَاَةَ الَّذِينَ خَلْفَهُ وَ إِنَّمَا يَضْمَنُ الْقِرَاءَةَ».
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Bashir from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him:
A man asked Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} about recitation behind the imam (of prayer).
Imam {a.s} said: “No. Indeed, the imam (of prayer) is a guarantor for the recitation, and
the imam (of prayer) does not guarantee the prayer of those behind him; he only
guarantees the recitation.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.378 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.279 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.440 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1251 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.353 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.354 • Al-Fusul Al- Muhimmah, Vol.2 p.122 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.85 p.252

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
سَعْدٌ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللّهِ الْحَلَبِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «إِذَا صَلَّيْتَ صَلاَةً وَ أَنْتَ فِي ٱلْمَسْجِدِ وَ أَقِيمَتِ الصَّلاَةُ فَإِنْ شِئُتَ فَاخْرُجْ وَ إِنْ شِئْتَ فَصَلَّ مَعَهُمْ وَ
اجعلها تَسبِيحا».
english_text:
Sa’ad from Abu Ja’far, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad ibn Uthman, from Ubaydullah al-
Halabi, from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “If you have prayed a prayer while you are in the mosque and
the congregational prayer is established, then if you wish, you may leave, and if you
wish, pray with them and make it tasbih (supererogatory prayer).”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.407 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.279 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1250 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.242 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.402 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.80 p.372

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
الحسين بن سعيد عن ابن ابي عمير عن سلمة صاحب السابري عن إسحاق بن عمار قال : قلت لابي عبد الله
عليه السلام تقام الصلاة وقد صليت فقال صل واجعلها لما فات.
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Ibn Abi Umayr from Salamah, the companion of al-Sabiri, from Ishaq ibn Ammar,
who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him: “The prayer is established while I have
already prayed.”
Imam {a.s} said: “Pray (the established prayer), and count it for what you have missed.”
AND ITS RULINGS
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.280

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
سعد عن ابي جعفر عن الحسن بن علي بن فضال قال : كتبت إلى الرضا عليه السلام في الرجل كان خلف الامام
يأتم به فركع قبل ان يركع الامام وهو يظن ان الامام قد ركع فلما رآه لم يركع رفع رأسه ثم أعاد الركوع مع
الامام أيفسد ذلك صلاته أم تجوز له الركعة؟ فكتب : يتم صلاته ولا يفسد ما صنع صلاته.
english_text:
Sa’ad from Abu Ja’far from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal, who said:
I wrote to Imam al-Ridha {a.s}, peace be upon him, regarding a man who was behind the
imam (of prayer), following him, and he bowed before the imam (of prayer), thinking
that the imam (of prayer) had bowed.
Then, when he saw that the imam (of prayer) had not bowed, he raised his head and
then repeated the bowing with the imam (of prayer). Does this invalidate his prayer, or
is the rak’ah valid for him?
Imam {a.s} wrote: “He completes his prayer, and what he did does not invalidate his
prayer.”
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Ali ibn Musa al-Ridha {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.280

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ حُكَيْمِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ بْنِ فَضَالٍ عَنْ أَبِي الْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لَهُ أَسْجُدُ مَعَ
اَلْإِمَامٍ وَ أَرْفَعُ رَأْسِي قَبْلَهُ فَأُعِيدُ الصَّلاَةَ قَالَ «أَعِدْ وَ أُسْجُذْ».
english_text:
From him, from Mu'awiyah ibn Hakim, from Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Faddal, from Abu al-Hasan {a.s}, peace be
upon him, who said:
I said to Imam {a.s}: “I prostrate with the imam (of prayer) and I raise my head before
him, should I repeat the prayer?”
Imam {a.s} said: “Repeat (the prayer) and prostrate.”
AND ITS RULINGS
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s} & Abu al-Hasan Imam Ali ibn Musa al-Ridha {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.280 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1254 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.391

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ عَنْ زُرْعَةً عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ قَالَ قَالَ: «لا يَضُرُّكَ أَنْ تَتَأَخِّرَ
وَرَاءَكَ إذَا وَجَدْتَ ضِيقاً فِي الصَّفَّ فَتَتَأْخَرُ إِلَى الصَّفَّ ٱلَّذِي خَلْفَكَ وَ إِنْ كُنْتَ فِي صَفَّ فَأَرَدْتَ أَنْ تَتَقَدَّمَ قُدَّامَكَ
فَلا بَأْسَ أَنْ تَمْشِيَ إِلَيْهِ».
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from al-Hasan from Zur'ah from Sama'ah from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “It does not harm you to move back behind you if you find
crowding in the row, so you move back to the row that is behind you.
And if you are in a row and you wish to move forward to the row in front of you, then
there is no harm in walking to it.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.280 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1197 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.422

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ أَبَانِ بْنِ عُثُمَانَ عَنِ الْفُضَيْلِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: «أَتِمُوا الصُّفُوفَ إِذَا
وَجَدْثُمْ خَلَلاً وَ لا يَضُرُكَ أَنْ تَتَأَخَرَ إِذَا وَجَدْتَ ضِيقاً فِي الصَّفّ وَ تَمْشِيَ مُنْحَرِفاً حَتَّى ثَتِمَّ ٱلصَّفَّ».
english_text:
From him, from Fadalah, from Aban ibn Uthman, from al-Fudayl ibn Yasar, from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “Complete the rows when you find a gap, and it does not harm
you to fall back if you find tightness in the row, and to walk at an angle until you
complete the row.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.280 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1197 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.422

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text: أَحْمَدُ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنِ الْحَلَبِيّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ الَّه عَلَيهِ السَّلاَمُ : مِثلَهُ
english_text:
Ahmad from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad, from al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah {a.s},
peace be upon him: The same.
AND ITS RULINGS
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.280 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1197 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.422

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
سَعدٌ عَنْ أَيُّوبَ بْنِ نُوحِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْفُضَيْلِ عَنْ أَبِي الصَّبَّاحِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسِّلاَمُ عَنِ الرَّجْلِ
يَقُومُ فِي الصَّفَّ وَحْدَهُ فَقَالَ «لا بَأسَ إِنَّمَا يَبْدُو وَاحِداً بَعْدَ وَاحِدٍ».
english_text:
Sa’ad from Ayyub ibn Nuh, from Muhammad ibn al-Fudayl, from Abu al-Sabbah, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, about a man who stands alone in the row.
Imam {a.s} said: “There is no harm; they (the rows) only appear one after another.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.280 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1190 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.406

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
الحسين بن سعيد عن حماد بن عيسى عن معاوية ابن وهب قال : رأيت ابا عبد اللّٰه عليه السلام يوما وقد دخل
المسجد الحرام لصلاة العصر فلما كان دون الصفوف ركعوا فركع ثم سجد السجدتين ثم قام فمضى حتى
لحق بالصفوف،
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Hammad ibn Isa from Mu'awiyah ibn Wahb, who said:
I saw Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, one day when He {a.s} entered the ‘Sacred
Mosque’ for the Asr prayer.
When Imam {a.s} was short of reaching the rows, the people bowed, so He {a.s} bowed,
then performed the two prostrations, then stood and continued until He {a.s} joined the
rows (of the congregation).
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.281

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
سَعْدٌ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنِ الْحَكَمِ بْنِ مِسْكِينٍ عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ
أَنْخَلُ الْمَسْجِدَ وَ قَدْ رَكَعَ الْإِمَامُ فَأَرْكَعُ بِرُكُوعِهِ وَ أَنَا وَحْدِي وَ أَسْجُدُ فَإِذَا رَفَعْتُ رَأْسِي فَأَيَّ شَيْءِ أَصْنَعُ فَقَالَ
«قُمْ فَاذْهَبْ إِلَيْهِمْ فَإِنْ كَانُوا قِيَاماْ فَقُمْ مَعَهُمْ وَ إِنْ كَانُوا جُلُوسا فَاجْلِسْ مَعَهُمْ».
english_text:
Sa’ad from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from al-Hakam ibn Miskin from Ishaq ibn Ammar, who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him: “I enter the mosque and the imam (of
prayer) has already bowed, so I bow with his bowing while I am alone (away from the
congregation), and I prostrate. When I raise my head, what should I do?”
Imam {a.s} said: “Stand and go to them (to join the congregation); if they are standing,
then stand with them, and if they are sitting, then sit with them.”
AND ITS RULINGS
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.394 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.281 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1196 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.386

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ سَلَمَةً عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ سَمَاعَةً عَنْ عَمِّهِ عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ آبَائِهِ عَلَيْهِمُ السِّلاَمُ
أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ قَالَ: «مَنْ صَلَّى بِقَوْمٍ فَاخْتَصَّ نَفْسَهُ بِالدُّعَاءِ فَقَدْ خَانَهُمْ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya from Salamah from Sulayman ibn Sama'ah from his uncle from Imam
Ja’far {a.s}, from his father {a.s}, from his forefathers, peace be upon them:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “The Messenger of Allah {SWT}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his
family, said: ‘Whoever leads a group in prayer and singles himself out in supplication
has betrayed them.’”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Abu al-Qasim Prophet Muhammad ibn Abdullah {saws}
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.400 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.281 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1264 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.106 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.425

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
عنه عن ايوب بن نوح عن العباس بن عامر عن الحسين ابن المختار وداود بن الحصين قال : سئل عن رجل
فاتته ركعة من المغرب مع الامام وأدرك الثنتين فهي الاولى له والثانية للقوم يتشهد فيها؟ قال : نعم قلت :
والثانية أيضا قال : نعم ، قلت كلهن : قال : نعم فانما هو بركة.
english_text:
From him, from Ayyub ibn Nuh, from al-Abbas ibn Amir, from al-Husayn ibn al-Mukhtar and Dawud ibn al-
Husayn, who said:
Imam {a.s} was asked about a man who missed one rak‘ah of Maghrib with the imam (of
prayer) and caught the remaining two rak’ahs. Are those two (rak’ahs) considered his
first, while they are the second and third for the group? And does he recite tashahhud
in them?
Imam {a.s} said: “Yes”.
I asked: “And the second one also?”
Imam {a.s} said: “Yes”.
I asked: “All of them?”
Imam {a.s} said: “Yes, for it is a blessing.”
AND ITS RULINGS
source: Implicit (Muzmar)
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.281 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1178 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.324

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ إسْحَاقَ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْحَمِيدِ عَنْ أَبِي الْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ قَالَ: «لا
يُصَلِّي بِالنَّاسٍ مَنْ فِي وَجْهِهِ آثَارٌ».
english_text:
From him, from Ishaq, by Abdurrahman ibn Hammad, by Ibrahim ibn Abd al-Hamid, by Abu al-Hasan {a.s}:
Imam al-Kadhim {a.s} said “One who has marks on his face, should not lead the people
in prayer.” (meaning referring to leprosy or vitiligo)
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.281 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1178 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.324

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُصَدِّقٍ بْنِ صَدَقَةَ عَنْ عَمَّارِ السَّابَاطِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سُئِلَ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يُؤَذِّنُ وَ يُقِيمُ لِيُصَلَّيَ وَحْدَهُ فَيَجِيءُ رَجُلٌ آخَرُ فَيَقُولُ لَهُ نُصَلَّي جَمَاعَةٌ هَلْ يَجُوزُ
أَنْ يُصَلِّيَا بِذَلِكَ الْأَذَانِ وَ الْإِقَامَةِ قَالَ «لا وَ لَكِنْ يُؤَذِّنُ وَ يُقِيمُ».
english_text:
From him, from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan, from Amr ibn Sa'id, from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah, from Ammar al-
Sabati, from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} was asked about a man who gives the adhan and the iqamah to pray
alone, then another man comes and says to him, ‘Let us pray in congregation.’
Is it permissible for them to pray with that same adhan and iqamah?
Imam {a.s} said: “No, rather he should give the adhan and the iqamah again.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.394 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.282 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.605 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.432

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللهِ عَنِ الرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ ٱَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ الْإِمَامِ يُصَلَّي
فِي مَوْضِعٍ وَ الَّذِينَ خَلْفَهُ يُصَلُونَ فِي مَوْضِعِ أَسْفَلَ مِنْهُ أَوْ يُصَلِّي فِي مَوْضِعِ وَ الَّذِينَ خَلْفَهُ فِي مَوْضِعٍ أَرْفَعَ مِنْهُ
فَقَالَ «يَكُونُ مَكَانُهُمْ مُسْتَوِياً» قَالَ قُلْتُ فَيُصَلِّي وَحْدَهُ فَيَكُونُ مَوْضِعُ سُجُودِهِ أَسْفَلَ مِنْ مَقَامِهِ فَقَالَ «إِذَا كَانَ
وَحَدَهُ فَلاً بَأْسَ».
english_text:
From him, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Safwan, from Muhammad ibn Abdillah, from al-Ridha {a.s}, said:
I asked Imam al-Ridha {a.s} about an imam (of prayer) who is praying in a place, and
those behind him are praying in a place lower than his, or he is praying in a place and
those behind him are in a place higher than his.
Imam {a.s} said: “Their place should be level.”
I said: “What if he is prays alone and his prostration is lower than where he stands”
Imam {a.s} said: “If he is alone, then there is no harm.”
AND ITS RULINGS
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Ali ibn Musa al-Ridha {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.282 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1193

Chapter Title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُصَدِّقٍ بْنِ صَدَفَةً عَنْ عَمَّارٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ:
سُئِلَ عَنِ الرَّجْلِ يَوْمُ بِقَوْمِ هَلْ يَجُوزُ لَهُ أَنْ يَتَوَشَّحَ قَالَ «لا لا يُصَلِّي الرَّجُلُ بِقَوْمٍ وَ هُوَ مُتَوَشَّحْ فَوْقَ ثِيَابِهِ وَ إِنْ
كَانَتْ عَلَيْهِ ثِيَابٌ كَثِيرَةٌ لِأَنْ ٱلْإِمَامَ لا تَجُوزُ لَهُ الصَّلاَةُ وَ هُوَ مُتَوَشَحْ» وَ عَنِ الرَّجْلِ أَدْرَكَ ٱلْإِمَامَ جِينَ سَلَّمَ قَالَ
«عَلَيْهِ أَنْ يُؤَذِّنَ وَ يُقِيمَ وَ يَفْتَتِحَ الصِّلاةَ».
english_text:
From him, from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan, from Amr ibn Sa'id, from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah, from Ammar, from
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} was asked about a man who leads a group in prayer, is it permissible
for him to wear a sash (yatasashah)?
Imam {a.s} said: “No. A man must not lead a group in prayer while he is wearing a sash
over his clothes, even if he has many clothes on, because it is not permissible for the
imam (of prayer) to pray while wearing a sash.”
And (Imam {a.s} was asked) regarding a man who catches the imam (of prayer) just as
