مَسْجِداً فِي بَيْتِكَ فَإِذَا خِفْتَ شَيْئاً فَالْبَسْ ثَوْبَيْنِ غَلِيظَيْنِ مِنْ أَغْلَظِ ثِيَابِكَ فَصَلّ فِيهِمَا ثُمَّ أُجْثُ عَلَى رُكْبَتَيْكَ
فَاصْرُخ إِلَى اللّهِ عَزّ وَ جَلَّ وَ سَلْهُ الْجَنَّةَ وَ تَعَوَّذْ بِاللَّهِ مِنْ شَرِّ الّذِي تَخَافُهُ وَ إِيَّاكَ أَنْ يَسْمَعَ اللّهُ مِنْكَ كَلِمَةَ بَغْيٍ وَ
إِنْ أَعْجَبَثكَ نَفْسَكَ وَ عَشِيرَتَكَ».
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad from Mu‘alla ibn Muhammad from al-Washsha’ from Aban from Hariz from Abu
Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “Establish a place of prayer in your house, and if you fear
something, then wear two thick garments from the thickest of your clothes, and pray
in them. Then kneel on your knees and cry out to Allah {SWT}, Mighty and Majestic, and
ask Him {AZJ} for Paradise, and seek refuge with Allah {SWT} from the evil of what you fear.
And beware lest Allah {SWT} hears from you a single word of transgression (baghy), even
if your soul and your clan please you.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.480 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.314 • Al-Wafi, Vol.9 p.1435 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.138

arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ عَنْ رَجُلٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: «مَنْ أَرَادَ أَنْ
يُحْبَلَ لَهُ فَلْيُصَلَّ رَكْعَتَيْنِ بَعْدَ الْجُمُعَةِ يُطِيلُ فِيهِمَا الرُّكُوعَ وَ السُّجُودَ ثُمَّ يَقُولُ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِمَا سَأَلَكَ بِهِ
زَكَرِيًّا إِذْ قَالَ «رَبِّ لا تَذَرْنِي قَرْداً وَ أَنْتَ خَيْرُ الْوَارِثِينَ» اللَّهُمَّ هَبْ لِي «ذُرِّيَّةً طَيّبَةً إِنَّكَ سَمِيعُ الدُّعاءِ» اَللَّهُمَّ
بِاسْمِكَ اِسْتَحْلَلْتُهَا وَ بِأَمَانَتِكَ أَخَذْتُهَا فَإِنْ قَضَيْتَ فِي رَجِمِهَا وَلَداً فَاجْعَلْهُ غَلَاماً وَ لا تَجْعَلْ لِلشَّيْطَانِ فِيهِ نَصِيباً
وَلا شِركاً ».
٣٢ - باب الصلاة على الاموات
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn al-Hakam from a man from Muhammad ibn Muslim from Abu Ja’far {a.s},
peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Baqir {a.s} said: “Whoever desires that conception (pregnancy) be granted to
him, let him pray two units of prayer after Jumu‘ah (Friday prayer), prolonging the
bowing (ruku‘) and the prostration (sujud) in them. Then let him say:
‘O’ Allah {SWT}, I ask You {AZJ} by what Zakariyya {a.s} asked You {AZJ} when he said: ‘My Lord,
do not leave me alone, and You are the best of inheritors’. (Surah Al Anbiya 21:89)
O’ Allah {SWT}, grant me ‘good offspring; indeed, You are the Hearer of supplication’.
(Surah Aal Imran 3:38)
O’ Allah {SWT}, by Your name I have made her lawful, and by Your trust I have taken her
(as a wife), so if You decree in her womb a child, then make him a boy, and do not make
for Satan any share or partnership in him’.”
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.482 • Al-Kafi, Vol.6 p.8 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.315 • Al-Wafi, Vol.23 p.1304 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.144 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.21 p.370 • Tafsir Nur Al-Thaqalayn, Vol.3 p.456 • Tafsir Kanz Al-Daqaiq, Vol.3 p.87 • Tafsir Kanz Al-Daqaiq, Vol.8 p.467

arabic_text:
اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ كُلَيْبِ الْأَسَدِيِّ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ عَنِ التَّكْبِيرِ عَلَى الْمَيَّتِ
فَقَالَ بِيَدِهِ خَمْساً قُلْتُ فَكَيْفَ أَقُولُ إِذَا صَلَّيْتُ عَلَيْهِ قَالَ تَقُولُ » اللَّهُمَ عَبْدُكَ إِحْتَاجَ إِلَى رَحْمَتِكَ وَ أَنْتَ غَنِيٌ عَنْ
عَذَابِهِ اللَّهُمَّ إِنْ كَانَ مُحْسِناً فَزِدْ فِي إِحْسَانِهِ وَ إِنْ كَانَ مُسِيئاً فَاغْفِزْ لَهُ ».
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa’id from Fadalah from Kulayb al-Asadi said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, about the takbir (declaration of ‘Allahu
Akbar’) over the deceased.
Imam {a.s} gestured with his hand five times.
I asked: “Then what should I say when I pray over him?”
Imam {a.s} said: “You say; ‘O’ Allah {SWT}, Your servant has become in need of Your mercy,
and You are free of any need to punish him.
O’ Allah {SWT}, if he was a doer of good, then increase his good deeds, and if he was a
wrongdoer, then forgive him’.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.315 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.454 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.3 p.64

arabic_text: عَنْهُ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْن سِنَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: «التَّكْبِيرُ عَلَى الْمَيَّتِ خَمْسُ تَكْبِيرَاتٍ».
english_text:
From him, from Fadalah, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “The takbir over the deceased is five takbirs.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.315 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.315 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.474 • Al- Istibsar, Vol.1 p.474 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.439 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.439 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.3 p.74 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.3 p.75

arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ أَبِي حَمْرَةَ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السِّلَاَمُ قَالَ: «كَبَّرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ
صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ خَمْساً».
english_text:
From him, from al-Qasim ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn Abi Hamzah, from Abu Basir, from Abu Ja’far {a.s}:
Imam al-Baqir {a.s} said: “The Messenger of Allah {SWT}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his
family, pronounced five takbirs (over the deceased).”
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s} & Abu al-Qasim Prophet Muhammad ibn Abdullah {saws}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.315 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.474 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.439 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.3 p.75

arabic_text:
سعد بن عبد اللّه عن ابراهيم بن مهزيار عن اخيه علي عن حماد بن محمد عن شعيب عن ابي بصير عن ابي
عبد اللّه عليه السلام قال : التكبير على الميت خمس تكبيرات.
english_text:
Sa’ad ibn Abdullah from Ibrahim ibn Mahziyar from his brother Ali from Hammad ibn Muhammad from
Shu‘ayb from Abu Basir from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “The takbir over the deceased is five takbirs.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.315

arabic_text:
عَلِيْ بْنُ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ عَلِيَّ بْنِ الصَّلْتِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللّهِ بْنِ الصَّلْتِ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ عَنِ اِبْنِ
بُكَيْرٍ عَنْ قُدَامَةَ بْنِ زَائِدَةَ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ يَقُولُ: «إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ صَلَّى
عَلَى اِبْنِهِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ فَكَبَّرَ عَلَيْهِ خَمْسا».
english_text:
Ali ibn al-Husayn from Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Ali ibn al-Salt from Abdullah ibn al-Salt from al-Hasan ibn
Ali from Ibn Bukayr from Qudamah ibn Zaydah who said:
I heard Abu Ja’far {a.s}, peace be upon him, say:
“Indeed, the Messenger of Allah {SWT}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his family, prayed
(Salat Al Mayyit) over his son Ibrahim {a.s}, peace be upon him, and He {saws} pronounced
five takbirs over him.”
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s} & Abu al-Qasim Prophet Muhammad ibn Abdullah {saws}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.316 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.474 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.439 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.3 p.75 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.3 p.98

arabic_text:
عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الصَّلْتِ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ أَبِي وَلاَّدٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ عَنِ التَّكْبِيرِ عَلَى
الْمَيِّتِ فَقَالَ «خَمْساً».
english_text:
Abdullah ibn al-Salt from al-Hasan ibn Mahbub from Abu Walad who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, about the takbirs over the deceased.
Imam {a.s} said: “Five (takbirs).”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.316 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.474 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.474 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.439 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.440 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.3 p.75 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.3 p.75

arabic_text:
فَأَمَا مَا رَوَاهُ أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ خَالِدِ الْبَرْقِيّ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ النَّضْرِ الْخَزَّازِ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ شِمْرٍ
عَنْ جَابِرٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ عَنِ التَّكْبِيرِ عَلَى الْجِنَازَةِ هَلْ فِيهِ شَيْءٌ مُوَقَّتْ أَمْ لا فَقَالَ «لا كَبَّرَ
رَسُوْلُ اللهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ أَحَدَ عَشَرَ وَ تِسْعاً وَ سَبْعاً وَ خَمْساً وَ سِتّاً وَ أَرْبَعاً».
قال محمد بن الحسن : ما تضمن هذا الخبر من زيادة التكبير على الخمس مرات متروك بالاجماع ، ويجوز ان يكون
عليه السلام أخبر عن فعل النبي ص بذلك لانه كان يكبر على جنازة واحدة أو اثنتين فكان يجاء بجنازة اخرى فيبتدئ من
حيث انتهى خمس تكبيرات فإذا اضيف إلى ما كان كبر زاد على الخمس تكبيرات، وذلك جايز على ما سنبينه فيما بعد إن
شاء الله تعالى ، وأما ما يتضمن من الاربع تكبيرات فمحمول على التقية لانه مذهب المخالفين ، أو يكون أخبر عن فعل
النبي صلى اللّٰه عليه وآله مع المنافقين والمتهمين بالاسلام لانه عليه السلام كذا كان يفعل ، والذي يدل على ذلك ما رواه:
english_text:
As for what was narrated by Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa from Muhammad ibn Khalid al-Barqi from Ahmad
ibn al-Nadr al-Khazzaz from ‘Amr ibn Shimr from Jabir, who said:
I asked Abu Ja’far {a.s}, peace be upon him, about the takbir over the funeral, is there
something fixed (in number) in it or not?
Imam {a.s} said: “No. The Messenger of Allah {SWT}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his
family, pronounced eleven, nine, seven, five, six, and four takbirs (over the
deceased).”
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s} & Abu al-Qasim Prophet Muhammad ibn Abdullah {saws}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.316

arabic_text:
الحسين بن سعيد عن محمد بن ابي عمير عن حماد بن عثمان وهشام بن سالم عن ابي عبد اللّٰه عليه السلام
قال: كان رسول اللّه صلى اللّٰه عليه وآله يكبر على قوم خمسا وعلى آخرين أربعا فإذا كبر على رجل أربعا اتهم.
english_text:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa’id from Muhammad ibn Abi ‘Umayr from Hammad ibn Uthman and Hisham ibn Salim from
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “The Messenger of Allah {SWT}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his
family, used to pronounce five takbirs (of Salat Al Mayyit) over some people and four
over others. So if He {saws} pronounced four takbirs over a man, he would be regarded
with suspicion.” (meaning it was commanded to Prophet {saws} to recite four takbir over
the deceased hypocrites)
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.317

arabic_text:
عَلِي بْنُ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللّهِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ مَهْزِيَارَ عَنْ أَخِيهِ عَلِيَّ عَنْ إسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ هَمّامِ عَنْ أَبِي
اَلْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ : «صَلَّى رَسُولُ اللّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ عَلَى جِنَازَةٍ فَكَبَّرَ
عَلَيْهِ خَمْساً وَ صَلَّى عَلَى آَخَرَ فَكَبَّرَ عَلَيْهِ أَرْبَعاً فَأَمَّا الَّذِي كَبَّرَ عَلَيْهِ خَمْساً فَحَمِدَ اللَّهَ وَ مَجْدَهُ فِي التَّكْبِيرَةِ ٱلْأُولَى
وَدَعَا فِي الثَانِيَةٍ لِلنَّبِيِّ وَ دَعَا فِي الثَالِثَةِ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنَاتِ وَ دَعَا فِي ٱلرَّابِعَةِ لِلْمَيَّتِ وَ اِنْصَرَفَ فِي الْخَامِسَةِ
وَ أَمَّا الَّذِي كَبَّرَ عَلَيْهِ أَرْبَعاً فَحَمِدَ اللَّهَ وَ مَجَدَهُ فِي التَّكْبِيرَةِ الْأُولَى وَ دَعَا لِنَفْسِهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ وَ أَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ
عَلَيهِمُ السَّلاَمُ فِي الثَّانِيَةِ وَ دَعَا لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَ الْمُؤْمِنَاتِ فِي الثَالِثَةِ وَ اِنْصَرَفَ فِي الرَّابِعَةِ فَلَمْ يَدْعُ لَهُ لِأَنَّهُ كَانَ
مُنَافِقاً».
english_text:
Ali ibn al-Husayn from Abdullah ibn Ja’far from Ibrahim ibn Mahziyar from his brother Ali from Isma’il ibn
Hammam from Abu al-Hasan {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said that Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him,
said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “The Messenger of Allah {SWT}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his
family, prayed over a funeral and pronounced five takbirs over it, and He {saws} prayed
over another and pronounced four takbirs over it.
As for the one over whom Prophet {saws} pronounced five takbirs;
He {saws} praised Allah {SWT} and glorified Him {AZJ} in the first takbir,
And in the second, He {saws} supplicated for the Prophet {saws} (himself),
And in the third, He {saws} supplicated for the believing men and believing women,
And in the fourth, He {saws} supplicated for the deceased,
And He {saws} concluded in the fifth.
As for the one over whom Prophet {saws} pronounced four takbirs;
He {saws} praised Allah {SWT} and glorified Him {AZJ} in the first takbir,
And in the second, He {saws} supplicated for the himself, may Allah {SWT} bless him and
his family, and for his household, peace be upon them,
And in the third, He {saws} supplicated for the believing men and believing women,
And He {saws} concluded in the fourth and He {saws} did not supplicate for him, because
he was a hypocrite.”
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Ali ibn Musa al-Ridha {a.s} & Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al- Sadiq {a.s} & Abu al-Qasim Prophet Muhammad ibn Abdullah {saws}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.317 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.475 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.440 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.3 p.64

arabic_text:
عَلِيْ بْنُ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ إِذْرِيسَ عَنْ مُحَمّدِ بْنِ سَالِمِ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ النَّضْرِ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ شِمْرٍ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِجَعْفَدٍ
بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ جُعِلْتُ فِدَاكَ إِنَّا نَتَحَدَّثُ بِالْعِرَاقِ أَنَّ عَلِيّاً عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ صَلَّى عَلَى سَهْلِ بْنِ حُتَيْفٍ فَكَبَّرَ
عَلَيْهِ سِتّاً ثُمَّ اِلْتَفَتَ إِلَى مَنْ كَانَ خَلْفَهُ فَقَالَ «إِنَّهُ كَانَ بَدْرِيّا» قَالَ فَقَالَ جَعْفَرْ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ «إِنَّهُ لَمْ يَكُنْ كَذَا وَ
لَكِنَّهُ صَلَّى عَلَيْهِ خَمْساً ثُمَّ رَفَعَهُ وَ مَشَى بِهِ سَاعَةً ثُمَّ وَضَعَهُ فَكَبَّرَ عَلَيْهِ خَمْساً فَفَعَلَ ذَلِكَ خَمْسَ مَرَّاتٍ حَتَّى كَبَّرَ
عَلَيْهِ خَمْساْ وَ عِشرِينَ تَكْبِيرَةً».
ويحتمل أن يكون المراد بالخبر إذا كان أهل الميت يريدون ان يكبروا عليه اربعا فيتركون مع اختيارهم ، يدل على ذلك ما
رواه :
english_text:
Ali ibn al-Husayn from Ahmad ibn Idris from Muhammad ibn Salim from Ahmad ibn al-Nadr from ‘Amr ibn
Shimr who said:
I said to Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad {a.s}, peace be upon him:
“May I be your ransom, we speak in Iraq that Imam Ali {a.s}, peace be upon him, prayed
over Sahl ibn Hunayf and pronounced six takbirs over him, then turned to those who
were behind him and said:
‘Indeed, he was a Badri (a participant in the Battle of Badr)’.”
He (‘Amr ibn Shimr) said: “So Imam Ja’far {a.s}, peace be upon him, said:
‘It was not so, but Imam Ali {a.s} prayed over him with five takbirs, then lifted him and
walked with him for a while, then placed him down and pronounced five takbirs over
him (again),
And Imam {a.s} did that five times, until He {a.s} had pronounced over him twenty-five
takbirs.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Amir al-Mu’minin Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib al-Murtadha {a.s}
commentary:
And it is possible that what is meant by the report is: “If the family of the deceased
wishes that four takbirs be pronounced over him, then they may leave it (at four) by
their choice.” What indicates this is that which was narrated:
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.317 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.476 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.441 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.3 p.87

arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمِّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ مُحَمِّدِ بْنِ إسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ بَزِيعِ عَنْ مُحَمّدِ بْنِ عُذَافِرٍ عَنْ عُقْبَةَ عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ قَالَ: سُئِلَ
جَعْفَرٌ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ عَنِ ٱلتَّكْبِيرِ عَلَى الْجَنَائِزِ فَقَالَ «ذَاكَ إِلَى أَهْلِ الْمَيَّتِ مَا شَاءُوا كَبَّرُوا» فَقِيلَ إِنَّهُمْ يُكَبَّرُونَ أَرْبَعاً
فَقَالَ «ذَاكَ إلَيْهِمْ» ثُمَّ قَالَ «أَ مَا بَلَفَكُمْ أَنْ رَجْلاً صَلّى عَلَيْهِ عَلِيْ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَلاَمُ فَكَبَّرَ عَلَيْهِ خَمْساً حَتَّى صَلّى عَلَيْهِ
خَمْسَ صَلَوَاتُ يُكَبَّرُ فِي كُلّ صَلاةٍ حَمْسَ تَكْبِيرَاتٍ» قَالَ «ثُمَّ قَالَ («إِنَّهُ بَدْرِيٌّ عَقَبِيْ أُحْدِيٍّ وَ كَانَ مِنَ النُقَبَاءِ آلَّذِينَ
إِخْتَارَهُم - رَسُولُ اللهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ مِنَ الإِثْنَي عَشَرَ فَكَانَتْ لَهُ خَمْسُ مَنَاقِبَ » فَصَلَّى عَلَيْهِ لِكُلِّ مَنْقَبَةٍ
صَلاةً».
ويحتمل ان يكون أراد عليه السلام بقوله، أربعا ما يقرأ بين التكبيرات لان التكبيرة الخامسة ليس بعدها دعاء وإنما ينصرف
بها عن الجنازة، يدل على ذلك ما رواه:
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa from Muhammad ibn Isma’il ibn Bazi‘ from Muhammad ibn ‘Udhafir from
‘Uqbah from Imam Ja’far {a.s}, who said:
Imam Ja’far {a.s}, peace be upon him, was asked about the takbir over the funerals.
Imam {a.s} said: “That is up to the family of the deceased whatever they wish, they may
pronounce in takbirs.”
It was said to Imam {a.s}: “They (chose to) pronounce four takbirs.”
Imam {a.s} said: “That is up to them.”
Then Imam {a.s} said: “Has it (a report)not reached you that a man was prayed over by
Imam Ali {a.s}, peace be upon him, and Imam {a.s} pronounced five takbirs over him until
he prayed over him five prayers, pronouncing five takbirs in each (Salat Al Mayyit)
prayer?”
He (Uqbah) said: “Then Imam {a.s} said:
‘Indeed, he was a Badri, ‘Uqabi, Uhudi, and he was among the naqib (leaders) whom
the Messenger of Allah {SWT}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his family, chose from among
the twelve, so he had five virtues’.
Therefore, Imam Ali {a.s} prayed over him; one (Salat Al Mayyit) prayer for each virtue.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Amir al-Mu’minin Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib al-Murtadha {a.s}
commentary:
And it is possible that Imam {a.s}, peace be upon him, intended by his saying “four”,
what is recited between the takbirs, because there is no supplication after the fifth
takbir. Rather, with it (fifth takbir), the (Salat Al Mayyit) prayer over the deceased is
concluded. This is indicated by what was narrated:
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.318 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.441 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.3 p.86

arabic_text:
عَلِيُ بْنُ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ مُحَمِّدِ بْنِ أَحْمَدَ الْكُوفِيِّ وَ لَقَبْهُ حَمْدَانُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ
مُحَمَّدٍ بْنِ أَبِي حَمْرَةَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ قَالَ: كُنْتُ عِنْدَ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ جَالِساً فَدَخَلَ
رَجُلٌ فَسَأَلَهُ عَنِ التَّكْبِيرِ عَلَى الْجَنَائِزِ فَقَالَ «خَمْسُ تَكْبِيرَاتٍ» ثُمَّ دَخَلَ آخَرُ فَسَأَلَهُ عَنِ الصَّلاَةِ عَلَى ٱلْجَنَائِزِ فَقَالَ
لَهُ «أَربَعُ صَلَوَاتُ» فَقَالَ الْأَوَّلُ جُعِلْتُ فِدَاكَ سَأَلْتُكَ فَقُلْتَ خَمْساً وَ سَأَلَكَ هَذَا فَقُلْتَ أَرْبَعاً فَقَالَ «إِنَّكَ سَأَلْتَنِي عَنِ
التَكْبِيرِ وَ سَأَلَنِي هَذَا عَنِ الصَّلاةِ» ثُمَّ قَالَ «إِنْهَا خَمْسُ تَكْبِيرَاتِ بَيْنَهُنَّ أَرْبَعُ صَلَوَاتُ» ثُمَّ بَسَطَ كَفّهُ فَقَالَ « إِنَّهُنَّ
خَمْسُ تَكْبِيرَاتٍ بَيْنَهُنَّ أَرْبَعُ صَلَوَانٌ».
english_text:
Ali ibn al-Husayn from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Muhammad ibn Ahmad al-Kufi, whose nickname was
Hamdan, from Muhammad ibn Abdullah from Muhammad ibn Abi Hamzah from Muhammad ibn Yazid from
Abu Basir who said:
I was sitting with Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, when a man entered and asked
Imam {a.s} about the (amount of) takbir over the funerals.
Imam {a.s} said: “Five takbirs.”
Then another man entered and asked Imam {a.s} about the prayer over the funerals.
Imam {a.s} said to him: “Four prayers.”
So the first man said: “May I be your ransom, I asked you and you said five (takbirs),
and this one asked you and you said four (takbirs).”
Imam {a.s} said: “You asked me about the takbirs, and this one asked me about the
prayers.”
Then Imam {a.s} said: “They are five takbirs, between them are four prayers.”
Then Imam {a.s} opened his palm and said: “Indeed, they are five takbirs, between them
are four prayers.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.318 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.476 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.441 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.3 p.75

arabic_text:
عَلِيْ بْنُ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ عُبَيْسِ بْنِ هِشَامِ عَنِ ٱلْحَسَنِ بْنِ أَحْمَدَ ٱلْمِثْقَرِيَّ
عَنْ يُونُسَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلاَمُ قَالَ قَالَ: «الصَّلاةُ عَلَى الْجَنَائِزِ التَكْبِيرَةُ اَلْأُولَى اِسْتِفْتَاحُ الصَّلاةِ وَ
الثَانِيَةُ يَشهَدُ أُنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلَّ اللَّهُ وَ أَنَّ مُحَمَّداً رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ وَ الثَالِثَةُ الصَّلَاَةُ عَلَى اَلنَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ
عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ وَ عَلَى أَهْلٍ بَيْتِهِ وَ الثَّنَاءُ عَلَى اللَّهِ وَ الرَّابِعَةُ لَهُ وَ اَلْخَامِسَةُ يُسَلَّمُ وَ يَقِفُ مِقْدَارَ مَا بَيْنَ التَّكْبِيرَتَيْنِ وَ
لاَ يَبْرَحُ حَتَّى يُحْمَلَ السَّرِيرُ مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ».
english_text:
Ali ibn al-Husayn from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from ‘Ubayys ibn Hisham
from al-Hasan ibn Ahmad al-Minqari from Yunus from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “The prayer over the funerals;
the first takbir is the opening of the prayer,
the second is to bear witness that there is ‘No God but Allah {SWT}’ and that ‘(Prophet)
Muhammad {saws} is the Messenger of Allah {SWT}’, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his
family,
the third is the prayer upon the Prophet {saws}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his family,
and upon his household, and praise of Allah {SWT},
the fourth is for (prayer for) him (the deceased),
and the fifth is the salutation,
And he (imam of prayer) stands for the amount of time between two takbirs and does
not leave until the bier is lifted from in front of him (imam of prayer).”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.318 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.456 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.3 p.65

arabic_text:
فَأَمَّا مَا رَوَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ الْقُمَّيِّ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَيْمُونِ ٱلْقَدَّاحِ
عَن جَغْفَرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ : «أَنَّ عَلِيّاً عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ كَانَ إِذَا صَلَّى عَلَى مَيَّتٍ يَقْرَأْ بِفَاتِحَةِ اَلْكِتَابِ وَ يُصَلِّي عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى
اللّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ ».
فالوجه في هذا الخبر ما قدمناه من التقية لانا قد دللنا على ان الصلاة على الميت لا قراءة فيها بفاتحة الكتاب ، وهذا
الخبر والذي تقدم موافق لبعض العامة على ما قدمنا القول فيه فلا ينبغي أن يكون عليه العمل.
english_text:
As for what was narrated by Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya from Ja’far ibn Muhammad from ‘Ubaydullah
al-Qummi from Abdullah ibn Maymun al-Qaddah from Imam Ja’far {a.s}, from his father {a.s}:
Imam al-Baqir {a.s} said: “Indeed, Imam Ali {a.s}, peace be upon him, when He {a.s} prayed
over a deceased person, He {a.s} would recite the ‘Fatihati al-Kitab’ (Surah al-Fatiha)
and send blessings upon the Prophet {saws}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his family.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Amir al-Mu’minin Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib al-Murtadha {a.s}
commentary:
The proper interpretation of this report is what we have previously stated regarding
taqiyyah (dissimulation), because we have already demonstrated that the prayer over
the deceased does not include the recitation of the ‘Fatihat al-Kitab’ (Surah al-
Fatihah).
And this report, as well as the one that preceded it, agrees with the view of some of the
general public (‘ammah, non-Shia) as we have previously explained, so it should not
be acted upon.
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.319 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.477 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.447 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.3 p.89

arabic_text:
سهل بن زياد عن احمد بن محمد بن ابي نصر عن موسى بن بكر عن ابي الحسن عليه السلام قال : إذا صليت
على المرأة فقم عند رأسها ، وأذا صليت على الرجل فقم عند صدره.
english_text:
Sahl ibn Ziyad from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr from Musa ibn Bakr from Abu al-Hasan {a.s}:
Imam {a.s} said: “When you pray (Salat Al Mayyit) over a woman, stand at her head; and
when you pray (Salat Al Mayyit) over a man, stand at his chest.”
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.319

arabic_text:
عَلِيُّ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ زَكَرِيًا عَنْ أَبِيهِ كَرِيَّا بْنِ مُوسَى عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللّهِ الْقُمَّيَّ قَالَ:
سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يُصَلِّي عَلَى جِنَازَةٍ وَحْدَهُ قَالَ «نَعَمْ» قُلْتُ فَاثنَانِ يُصَلَّيَانٍ عَلَيْهَا قَالَ
«نَعَمْ وَ لَكِنْ يَقُومُ ٱلْآخَرُ خَلْفَ ٱَلْآخَرِ وَ لاَ يَقُومُ بِجَنْبِهِ».
english_text:
Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Yahya ibn Zakariyya, from his father Zakariyya ibn Musa, from al-Qasim
ibn Ubaydullah al-Qummi, said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s} about a man who prays over a funeral alone.
Imam {a.s} said: “Yes (it is allowed).”
I asked: “And what if two pray over it?”
Imam {a.s} said: “Yes (it is allowed), but the other should stand behind the one leading,
and not stand beside him.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.176 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.166 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.319 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.424 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.3 p.120

arabic_text:
عَلِيٌّ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ النَّوْفَلِيَّ عَنِ السَّكُونِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلِّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ :
«خَيْرُ الصُّفُوفِ فِي الصَّلاَةِ الْمُقَدَّمُ وَ خَيْرُ ٱلصُّفُوفِ فِي الْجَنَائِزِ الْمُؤَخَّرُ» قِيلَ يَا رَسُولَ اللهِ وَ لِمَ قَالَ «صَارَ سُتْرَةً
لِلنِّسَاءِ» ».
english_text:
Ali, from his father, from al-Nawfali, from al-Sakuni, from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “The Prophet, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his family, said:
‘The best of the rows in prayer is the front one, and the best of the rows in funerals is
the last one.’
It was asked: “O Messenger of Allah {SWT}, and why is that?”
Prophet {saws} said: “Because it becomes a screen (barrier), for the women.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Abu al-Qasim Prophet Muhammad ibn Abdullah {saws}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.176 • ‘Ilal Al-Shara’i’, Vol.1 p.306 • Al-Ash’athiyat, Vol.1 p.33 • Tahdib Al- Ahkam, Vol.3 p.319 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.425 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.3 p.121 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.78 p.387 • Mustadrak Al-Wasa’il, Vol.2 p.283

arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ أَبَانِ بْنِ عُثُمَانَ عَنِ ٱلْفَضْلِ بْنِ عَبْدِ ٱلْمَلِكِ قَالَ:
سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ هَلْ يُصَلَّى عَلَى الْمَيِّتِ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ قَالَ «نَعَمْ».
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Fadalah, from Aban ibn Uthman, from al-
Fadl ibn Abd al-Malik, said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him: “Is it permitted to pray over the deceased
in the mosque?”
Imam {a.s} said: “Yes.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.320 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.325 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.473 • Al- Wafi, Vol.24 p.411 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.3 p.122

arabic_text:
سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنِ الْعَلاَءِ بْنِ رَزِينٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ عَنْ أَحَدِهِمَا
عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلاَمُ : مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ.
٢٧ ٥٥٨
english_text:
Sa’ad ibn Abdillah, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from
al-Ala ibn Razin, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from one of the two Imams {a.s}, peace
be upon them: The same as that.
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.320 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.325 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.473 • Al- Wafi, Vol.24 p.411 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.3 p.122

arabic_text:
سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ إسْحَاقَ شَعِرٍ عَنْ هَارُونَ بْنِ حَمْرَةَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلامُ قَالَ: «إِذَا دَخَلَ وَقْتُ صَلَاَةٍ مَكْتُوبَةِ فَابْدَأُ بِهَا قَبْلَ الصَّلَاَةِ عَلَى الْمَيِّتِ إِلَّ أَنْ يَكُونَ مَبْطُونا أَوْ نُفَسَاءَ أَوْ
نَحْوَ ذَلِكَ».
english_text:
Sa’ad ibn Abdillah, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Yazid ibn Ishaq Sha'ir, from Harun ibn Hamzah,
from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “When the time of an obligatory prayer enters, begin with it
before the prayer over the deceased, unless the deceased had abdominal illness
(mabtun) or was a woman in postpartum bleeding (nufasa) or something like that.”
(meaning to hurry and pray Salat Al Mayyit and bury such deceased with such cases)
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.320 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.414 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.3 p.123

arabic_text:
عَلِيْ بْنُ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ إِدْرِيسَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سَالِمِ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ النَّضْرِ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ شِمْرٍ عَنْ جَابِرٍ قَالَ:
قُلْتُ لأَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ إِذَا حَضَرْتُ الصَّلاَةَ عَلَى الْجِنَازَةِ فِي وَقْتٍ مَكْتُوبَةٍ فَبِأَيِّهَا أَبْدَأَ فَقَالَ «عَجَّلِ ٱلْمَيَّتَ
إِلَى قَبْرِهِ إِلَّ أَنْ تَخَافَ أَنْ يَفُوتَ وَقْتُ ٱلْفَرِيضَةِ وَ لا تَنْتَظِرْ بِالصَّلاَةِ عَلَى الْجَنَائِزِ طُلُوعَ الشَّمْسِ وَ لا غُرُوبَهَا».
english_text:
Ali ibn al-Husayn, from Ahmad ibn Idris, from Muhammad ibn Salim, from Ahmad ibn al-Nadr, from Amr ibn
Shimr, from Jabir, said:
I said to Abu Ja’far {a.s}, peace be upon him: “If I am present for the funeral prayer at the
time of an obligatory prayer, which one should I begin with?”
Imam {a.s} said: “Hasten the deceased to his grave, unless you fear that the time for the
obligatory prayer will pass. And do not delay the prayer over the deceased until the
rising of the sun or its setting.” (meaning to hasten to bury the deceased, as possible)
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.320 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.469 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.413 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.2 p.473 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.3 p.124 • Al-Fusul Al-Muhimmah, Vol.2 p.33

arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ الْبَجَلِيِّ وَ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ الْقُمِّيَّ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَجِيهِ مُوسَى
بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ صَلاَةِ الْجَنَائِزِ إِذَا اِحْمَرَّتِ الشَّمْسُ أَيَصْلُحُ أَوْ لا قَالَ «لاَ صَلاَةً فِي وَقْتِ
صَلاَةٍ» وَ قَالَ «إِذَا وَجَبَتِ الشَمْسُ فَصَلَ ٱلْمَغْرِبَ ثُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى الْجَنَائِزِ».
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Musa ibn al-Qasim al-Bajali and Abu Qatadah al-Qummi, from Ali ibn
Ja’far, from his brother Musa ibn Ja’far, peace be upon them, said:
I asked Imam al-Kadhim {a.s} about the funeral prayer if the sun has turned red, does it
become valid or not?
Imam {a.s} said: “There is no prayer during the time of (another) prayer.”
And Imam {a.s} said: “When the sun sets, then perform the Maghrib prayer, then perform
the prayer over the funeral.”
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}
references: Masa’il Ali Ibn Ja’far, Vol.1 p.178 • Qurb Al-Isnad, Vol.1 p.218 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.320 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.414 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.3 p.124 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.78 p.386 • Mustadrak Al- Wasa’il, Vol.2 p.277 • Mustadrak Al-Wasa’il, Vol.2 p.283

arabic_text:
حُمَيْدُ بْنُ زِيَادٍ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سَمَاعَةً عَنْ غَيْرٍ وَاحِدٍ عَنْ أَبَانٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ
اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ هَلْ يَمْنَعُكَ شَيْءُ مِنْ هَذِهِ السَّاعَاتِ عَنِ الصَّلَاَةِ عَلَى الْجَنَائِزِ فَقَالَ «لا».
english_text:
Humayd ibn Ziyad, from al-Hasan ibn Muhammad ibn Sama'ah, from more than one person, from Aban,
from Muhammad ibn Muslim, said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him: “Do any of these hours prevent you from
praying over the funerals?”
Imam {a.s} said, “No.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.180 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.321 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.469 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.413 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.3 p.109

arabic_text:
أبو علي الاشعري عن محمد بن عبد الجبار عن صفوان بن يحيى عن العلا بن رزين عن محمد بن مسلم عن ابي
جعفر عليه السلام قال : يصلى على الجنازة في كل ساعة ، انها ليست بصلاة ركوع ولا سجود ، وإنما تكره
الصلاة عند طلوع الشمس وعند غروبها التي فيها الخشوع والركوع والسجود لانها تغرب بين قرني شيطان
وتطلع بين قرني شيطان.
english_text:
Abu Ali al-Ash'ari, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Jabbar, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from al-Ala ibn Razin, from
Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja’far {a.s}, peace be upon him, said:
Imam al-Baqir {a.s} said: “The funeral prayer is performed at any hour, for it is not a
prayer of bowing (ruku') or prostration (sujud). Rather, what is disliked is the prayer at
sunrise and at sunset the one that contains humility (khushu), bowing (rukuh), and
prostration (sujud) because sun sets between the horns of a devil and it rises between
the horns of a devil.”
(meaning metaphorical warning not to imitate non-Islamic or pagan rituals as they
used to do)
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.321

arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْن مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عُثُمَانَ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ الْحَلَبِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ:
«لاَ بَأُسَ بِالصَّلاةِ عَلَى الْجَنَائِزِ جِينَ تَغِيبُ الشَّمْسُ وَ جِينَ تَطْلُعُ إِنَّمَا هُوَ اِسْتِغْفَارٌ».
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad ibn Uthman, from Ubaydullah al-Halabi, from
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “There is no harm in performing the funeral prayer when the
sun sets and when it rises; it is merely a seeking of forgiveness.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Fiqh Al-Ridha, Vol.1 p.186 • Da’a’im Al-Islam, Vol.1 p.235 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.321 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.470 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.413 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.3 p.108

arabic_text:
فَأَمَّا مَا رَوَاهُ الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ ٱلْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَبَانٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ
عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «تُكْرَهُ الصَّلاةُ عَلَى الْجَنَائِزِ حِينَ تَصْفَرُّ الشَّمْسُ وَ جِينَ تَطْلُعُ».
فهذا الخبر صريح بالكراهية دون الحظر، ويمكن ان يكون وجه الكراهية في ذلك انه مذهب بعض العامة فخرج مخرج
التقية.
english_text:
As for what was narrated by al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from al-Qasim ibn Muhammad from Aban from Abd al-
Rahman ibn Abi Abdillah from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “It is disliked to perform the funeral prayer when the sun turns
yellow and when it rises.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
commentary:
This report is explicit in indicating dislike (karahah) rather than prohibition (hurmah),
and it is possible that the reason for the dislike in this matter is that it is the view of
some of the general public (al-‘ammah), so it was expressed in the form of taqiyyah
(dissimulation).
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.321

arabic_text:
سَهَلُ بْنُ زِيَادٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي نَصْرٍ عَنِ الْعَلاَءِ بْنِ رَزِينٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ
قَالَ: سَأَلْثُهُ كَيْفَ يُصَلَّى عَلَى الرِّجَالِ وَ النَّسَاءِ فَقَالَ «يُوضَعُ الرِّجَالُ مِمَّا يَلِي الرِّجَالَ وَ النَّسَاءُ خَلْفَ ٱلرِّجَالِ».
english_text:
Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, from al-Ala ibn Razin, from Muhammad ibn
Muslim, from Abu Ja’far {a.s}, peace be upon him, said:
I asked Imam al-Baqir {a.s}: “How is the funeral prayer performed over men and
women?” (meaning the congregation)
Imam {a.s} said: “The men are placed in the front where the men stand, and the women
are placed behind the men.”
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.174 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.321 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.471 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.429 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.3 p.127

arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ طَلْحَةَ بْنِ زَيْدِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «كَانَ إِذَا صَلَّى عَلَى ٱلْمَرْأَةِ وَ ٱلرَّجْلِ
قَدْمَ ٱلْمَرْأَةَ وَ أَخَرَ الرَّجُلَ فَإِذَا صَلَّى عَلَى الْعَبْدِ وَ الْحُرِّ قَدَّمَ ٱلْعَبْدَ وَ أَخَرَ الْحُرِّ وَ إِذَا صَلَّى عَلَى الصِّغِيرِ وَ ٱلْكَبِيرِ
قَدَّمَ الصَّغِيرَ وَ أَخِّرَ الْكَبِيرَ».
english_text:
From him, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Talhah ibn Zayd, from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him,
who said:
When Imam {a.s} performed the funeral prayer over a woman and a man (together), He
{a.s} would place the woman in front (of the man) and the man behind (meaning closest
to the imam of prayer).
And when Imam {a.s} performed the funeral prayer over a slave and a free man
(together), he would place the slave in front (of the free man) and the free man behind
(meaning closest to the imam of prayer).
And when Imam {a.s} performed the funeral prayer over a child and an elder (together),
He {a.s} would place the child in front (of the elder) and the elder behind (meaning
closest to the imam of prayer).”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.175 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.169 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.322 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.471 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.430 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.3 p.126

arabic_text:
حُمَيْدُ بْنُ زِيَادٍ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سَمَاعَةَ عَنْ غَيْرِ وَاحِدٍ عَنْ أَبَانِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي عَبْدِ
اللَّهِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلاَمُ عَنْ جَنَائِزِ الرِّجَالِ وَ النِّسَاءِ إِذَا اِجْتَمَعَتْ فَقَالَ «تُقَدَّمُ الرِّجَالُ فِي كِتَابٍ
عَلِيِّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ ».
english_text:
Humayd ibn Ziyad, from al-Hasan ibn Muhammad ibn Sama'ah, from more than one person, from Aban ibn
Uthman, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Abdillah, said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, about the funerals of men and women,
when they are gathered (prayed upon) together.
Imam {a.s} said: “The men are placed in front, this is in the ‘Book of Ali {a.s}’, peace be
upon him.”
(meaning the women bier is placed, then the man, who will be closest to the imam of
prayer)
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Amir al-Mu’minin Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib al-Murtadha {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.175 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.322 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.472 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.430 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.3 p.126

arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ ٱلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُصَدِّقٍ بْنِ صَدَقَةَ عَنْ عَمَّارِ بْنِ مُوسَى عَنْ
أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ : فِي الرَّجُلِ يُصَلِّي عَلَى مَيَّتَيْنِ أَوْ ثَلاَثَةِ مَوْتَى كَيْفَ يُصَلِّي عَلَيْهِمْ قَالَ «إِنْ كَانَ ثَلاَثَةً
أَوِ اِثْنَيْنِ أَوْ عَشَرَةً أَوْ أَكْثَرَ مِنْ ذَلِكَ فَلْيُصَلَّ عَلَيْهِمْ صَلاةً وَاحِدَةً يُكَبِّرُ عَلَيْهِمْ خَمْسَ تَكْبِيرَاتٍ كَمَا يُصَلِّي عَلَى مَيَّتٍ
وَاجِدٍ وَ قَدْ صَلَّى عَلَيْهِمْ جَمِيعاً يَضَعُ مَيَّتاً وَاحِداً ثُمَّ يَجْعَلُ الْآخَرَ إِلَى أَلْيَةِ الْأَوَّلِ ثُمَّ يَجْعَلُ رَأْسَ الثَّالِتِ إِلَى أَلْيَةِ
اَلثَّانِي شِبْهَ الْمَدْرَجِ حَتَّى يَفْرُغَ مِنْهُمْ كُلَهِمْ مَا كَانُوا فَإِذَا سَوَّاهُمْ هَكَذَا قَامَ فِي الْوَسَطِ فَكَبَّرَ خَمْسَ تَكْبِيرَاتٍ يَفْعَلُ
كَمَا يَفْعَلُ إِذَا صَلَّى عَلَى مَيَّتٍ وَاجِدِ سُيْلَ فَإِنْ كَانُوا مَوْتَى رِجَالاً وَ نِسَاءَ» قَالَ «يَبْدَأُ بِالرِّجَالِ فَيَجْعَلُ رَأْسَ الثَّانِي
إِلَى أَلْيَةِ الْأَوَّلِ حَتَّى يَفْرُغَ مِنَ ٱلرِّجَالِ كُلَّهِمْ ثُمَّ يَجْعَلُ رَأْسَ الْمَرْأَةِ إِلَى أُلْيَةِ الرَّجُلِ ٱلْأَخِيرِ ثُمَّ يَجْعَلُ رَأْسَ ٱلْمَرْأَةِ
اَلْأُخْرَى إِلَى رَأْسِ الْمَرْأَةِ الْأَولَى حَتَّى يَفْرُغَ مِنْهُمْ كُلَّهِمْ فَإِذَا سَوَّى هَكَذَا قَامَ فِي الْوَسَطِ وَسَطِ الرِّجَالِ فَكَبَّرَ وَ
صَلِّى عَلَيْهِمْ كَمَا يُصَلِّي عَلَى مَيَّتٍ وَاجِدٍ» سُبِلَ عَنْ مَيَّتِ صُلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ فَلَمَّا سَلَّمَ الْإِمَامُ فَإِذَا الْمَيَّتُ مَقْلُوبٌ رِجْلَيْهِ
إلَى مَوْضِعٍ رَأْسِهِ قَالَ «يُسَوّى وَ تُعَادُ الصَّلاَةُ عَلَيْهِ وَ إِنْ كَانَ قَدْ حُمِلَ مَا لَمْ يُدْفَنْ فَإِنْ كَانَ قَدْ دُفِنَ فَقَدْ مَضَتِ
الصَّلَاَةُ وَلاَ يُصَّلَّى عَلَيْهِ وَ هُوَ مَدْفُونٌ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad, from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ali, from Amr ibn Sa’id, from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah,
from Ammar ibn Musa, from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} was asked regarding a man who performs the funeral prayer over
two or three deceased persons (together), how should he pray over them?
Imam {a.s} said: “If they are three, or two, or ten, or more than that, let him perform one
prayer over them.
He (leader of prayer) should pronounce five takbirs over them, just as he does for a
single deceased person. He has thus prayed over all of them.
He should place one deceased person, then place the next one at the buttocks (Aliyah)
of the first, then place the head of the third at the buttocks (aliyah) of the second, in a
stepped arrangement (shibh al-madrar) until he finishes arranging all of them,
however many they may be.
Once he has arranged them like this, he should stand in the middle and pronounce
five takbirs, doing just as he would when praying over a single deceased person.”
Imam {a.s} was asked, “And if they are deceased men and women?”
Imam {a.s} said: “He begins with the men, placing the head of the second at the buttocks
(Aliyah) of the first, until he finishes with all the men.
Then he places the head of the woman at the buttocks (Aliyah) of the last man.
Then he places the head of the next woman at the head of the first woman, until he
finishes arranging all of them.
Once he has arranged them in this way, he stands in the middle, in the center of the
men, and pronounces the takbirs and performs the prayer over them just as he does
when praying over a single deceased person.”
Imam {a.s} was asked about a deceased person over whom the funeral prayer was
performed, and after the imam (of prayer) had given the taslim, it was discovered that
the deceased was turned around, with his feet where his head should have been.
Imam {a.s} said: “He should be straightened, and the prayer should be repeated over
him. And if he had been carried away but not yet buried, then it is to be repeated.
But if he has already been buried, then the prayer has passed and is not to be repeated
while he is buried.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.174 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.322 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.431

arabic_text:
أَبُو عَلِيَّ الْأَشعَرِيُّ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْجَبَّارِ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنِ الْعَلاَءِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ عَنْ أَحَدِهِمَا
عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ ٱلرِّجَالِ وَ النَّسَاءِ كَيْفَ يُصَلَّى عَلَيْهِمْ قَالَ «الرَّجُلُ أَمَامَ النَّسَاءِ مِمَّا يَلِي ٱلْإِمَامَ يَصُفُ
بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَى أَثَّرٍ بَعْضِ».
english_text:
Abu Ali al-Ash'ari, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Jabbar, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from al-Ala, from
Muhammad ibn Muslim, from one of the two Imams {a.s}, peace be upon them, said:
I asked Imam {a.s} about (Salat Al Mayyit) men and women (together), how is the funeral
prayer performed over them?
Imam {a.s} said: “The man is placed in front of the women, in the position closest to the
imam (of prayer), and they are lined up, one following another.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.175 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.323 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.471 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.429 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.3 p.124

arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ وَ الْحَلَبِيَّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: فِي
الرّجُلٍ وَ الْمَرْأَةِ كَيْفَ يُصَلَّى عَلَيْهِمَا فَقَالَ «يُجْعَلُ الرَّجُلُ وَ الْمَرْأَةُ وَ يَكُونُ الرّجُلُ مِمَّا يَلِي الْإِمَامَ».
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad, from Zurarah and al-Halabi:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} was asked regarding a man and a woman (together), how is the
funeral prayer performed over them?
Imam {a.s} said: “The man and the woman are placed together, and the man is
positioned closest to the imam (of prayer).” (meaning Infront of the imam of prayer)
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.323 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.471 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.431 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.3 p.128

arabic_text:
عَلِيُ بْنُ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللّهِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ مَهْزِيَارَ عَنْ أَخِيهِ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَهْزِيَارَ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ
فَضَّالٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ بُكَيْرٍ عَنْ بَعْضِ أَصْحَابِهِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلامُ: فِي جَنَائِزِ ٱلرِّجَالِ وَ الصِّبْيَانِ وَ النَّسَاءِ قَالَ
«تُوضَعُ النَّسَاءُ مِمَّا يَلِي الْقِبْلَةَ وَ الصِّبْيَانُ دُونَهُنَّ وَ الرِّجَالُ دُونَ ذَلِكَ وَ يَقُومُ الْإِمَامُ مِمَّا يَلِي الرِّجَالَ».
english_text:
Ali ibn al-Husayn, from Abdillah ibn Ja’far, from Ibrahim ibn Mahziyar, from his brother Ali ibn Mahziyar, from
al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal, from Ibn Bukayr, from some of his companions, from Abu Abdillah {a.s}:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} was asked regarding the funerals of men, children, and women.
Imam {a.s} said: “The women are placed closest to the qiblah (furthest from the imam
of prayer), the children below them, and the men below that, and the imam (of prayer)
stands closest to the men.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.175 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.323 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.472 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.429 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.3 p.125

arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ عَلِيَّ بْنِ الصَّلْتِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الصَّلْتِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عُثُمَانَ عَنْ
عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ اَلْحَلَبِيِّ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ وَ الْمَرْأَةِ يُصَلَّى عَلَيْهِمَا قَالَ « يَكُونُ الرَّجُلُ بَيْنَ يَدَي الْمَرْأَةِ مِمَّا يَلِي الْقِبْلَةَ
فَيَكُونُ رَأْسُ ٱلْمَرْأَةِ عِنْدَ وَرِكَي الرَّجُلِ مِمَّا يَلِي يَسَارَهُ وَ يَكُونُ رَأْسُهَا أَيْضاً مِمَّا يَلِي يَسَارَ الْإِمَامِ وَ رَأْسُ الرَّجُلِ
بِمَا يَلِي يَمِينَ الْإِمَامِ».
قال محمد بن الحسن : ما تضمن هذه الاخبار من ترتيب الجنائز محمول على الاستحباب دون الوجوب لانه لو لم ترتب
لكانت الصلاة ماضية، لكن الافضل ما ذكرناه ، والذي يدل على ما قلناه ما رواه:
english_text:
From him, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Ali ibn al-Salt, from Abdillah ibn al-Salt, from Ibn Abi Umayr,
from Hammad ibn Uthman, from Ubaydullah al-Halabi, who said:
I asked Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} about a man and a woman, over whom the funeral prayer is
performed (together).
Imam {a.s} said: “The man is placed in front of the woman, closest to the qiblah, so that
the woman's head is at the level of the man's thighs, on his left side. And her head is
also on the left side of the imam (of prayer), while the man's head is on the right side
of the imam (of prayer).”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
commentary:
Muhammad ibn al-Hasan said: “What is contained in these reports regarding the
arrangement of the funerals is to be understood as recommended (mustahabb) rather
than obligatory (wajib), because if they were not arranged in that manner, the prayer
would still be valid. However, the preferred (afdal) practice is what we have
mentioned.”
And what indicates what we have said is that which was narrated:
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.323 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.472 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.431 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.3 p.127

arabic_text:
عَلِي بْنُ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ وَ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ بَزِبعٍ عَنْ
هِشَامٍ بْنِ سَالِمِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «لا بَأْسَ بِأَنْ يُقَدَّمَ الرَّجُلُ وَ تُؤَخِّرَ الْمَرْأَةُ وَ تُقَدَّمَ الْمَرْأَةُ وَ
يُؤَخِّرَ الرَّجُلُ يَعْنِي فِي الصَّلَاَةِ عَلَى الْمَيِّتِ».
english_text:
Ali ibn al-Husayn, from Sa’ad ibn Abdillah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn al-Hakam and
Muhammad ibn Isma'il ibn Bazi', from Hisham ibn Salim, from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “There is no harm if the man is placed in front, and the woman
behind,
Or the woman is placed in front, and the man behind”
(meaning in the funeral prayer over the deceased).
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.324 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.473 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.432 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.3 p.126

arabic_text:
عَلِيّ بْنُ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ مُوسَى الْخَشَابِ عَنْ غِيَاتِ بْنِ كَلُوبِ بْنِ فَيْهَسِ الْبَجَلِيِّ
عَنْ إسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَ صَلَّى عَلَى جِنَازَةٍ فَلَمَّا فَرَغَ جَاءَ قَوْمٌ
فَقَالُوا يَا رَسُولُ فَاتَثْنَا الصَّلاَةُ عَلَيْهَا فَقَالَ صَ «إِنَّ ٱلْجِنَازَةَ لاَ يُصَلَّى عَلَيْهَا مَرَّتَيْنِ أُدْعُوا لَهُ وَ قُولُوا خَيْراً» ».
قال محمد بن الحسن : هذا الخبر محمول على ضرب من الكراهية لا نا قد بينا فعل أمير المؤمنين ع مع سهل بن حنيف،
وانه صلى عليه ع خمس مرات كلما فرغ من خمس تكبيرات جاء قوم فأعاد ثانيا خمس مرات ، ويؤكد ذلك ما رواه:
english_text:
Ali ibn al-Husayn, from Sa’ad ibn Abdillah, from al-Hasan ibn Musa al-Khashshab, from Ghiyath ibn Kallub
ibn Fayhas al-Bajali, from Ishaq ibn Ammar, from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “Indeed, the Messenger of Allah {SWT}, may Allah {SWT} bless him
and his family, performed the funeral prayer over a deceased person.
When Prophet {saws} finished, a group of people came and said;
‘O Messenger of Allah {SWT}, we missed the prayer over him.’
So the Messenger of Allah {SWT}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his family, said:
‘A funeral is not prayed over twice. Supplicate for him and say good things’.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Abu al-Qasim Prophet Muhammad ibn Abdullah {saws}
commentary:
Muhammad ibn al-Hasan said: “This report is to be understood as indicating a form of
dislike (karahah), not prohibition, for we have already clarified the action of the
Commander of the Faithful {a.s}, peace be upon him, with Sahl ibn Hunayf that Imam Ali
{a.s}, peace be upon him, prayed over him five times.
Every time He {a.s} completed five takbirs, a group would come, and He {a.s} would repeat
the prayer five times.” What confirms this is that which was narrated:
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.324 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.484 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.3 p.87

arabic_text:
عَلِي بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنِ الْحَلَبِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: «كَبَّرَ أَمِيرُ
الْمُوْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ عَلَى سَهْلِ بْنِ حُنَيْفٍ وَ كَانَ بَدْرِيّاً خَمْسَ تَكْبِيرَاتٍ ثُمَّ مَشَى سَاعَةً ثُمَّ وَضَعَهُ وَ كَبَّرَ عَلَيْهِ
خَمْساً أخرَى يَصْنَعُ ذَلِكَ حَتَّى كَبَّرَ عَلَيْهِ خَمْساً وَ عِشرِينَ تَكْبِيرَةً».
english_text:
Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad, from al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah {a.s}:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “The Commander of the Faithful, peace be upon him,
performed five takbirs over Sahl ibn Hunayf, who had participated in Badr.
Then Imam Ali {a.s} walked for a while (with his bier), then placed him down and
performed another five takbirs over him.
He {a.s} continued doing this until he had pronounced twenty-five takbirs over him.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Amir al-Mu’minin Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib al-Murtadha {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.186 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.325 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.484 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.439 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.3 p.80

arabic_text:
عَلِيْ بْنُ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ إِذْرِيسَ عَنْ مُحَمِّدِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ النَّضْرِ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سِمْرٍ عَنْ جَابِرٍ عَنْ
أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لَهُ أَرَأَيْتَ إِنْ فَاتَثْنِي تَكْبِيرَةٌ أَوْ أَكْثَرُ قَالَ «تَقْضِي مَا فَاتَكَ» قُلْتُ أَسْتَقْبِلُ الْقِبْلَةَ
قَالَ «بَلَى وَ أَنْتَ تَتْبَعُ الْجَنَازَةَ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ خَرَجَ عَلَى جِنَازَةِ اِمْرَأَةٍ مِنْ بَنِي النَّجَارِ فَصَلَّى
عَلَيْهَا فَوَجَدَ الْحَفَرَةَ لَمْ يُمَكّنُوا فَوَضَعُوا الْجَنَازَةَ فَلَمْ يَجِى قَوْمٌ إِلّا قَالَ لَهُمْ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ «صَلُوا عَلَيْهَا»».
english_text:
Ali ibn al-Husayn, from Ahmad ibn Idris, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Ahmad ibn al-Nadr, from Amr ibn
Shimr, from Jabir, from Abu Ja’far {a.s}, peace be upon him, said:
I said to Imam al-Baqir {a.s}: “What do you say if I miss a takbir or more (of Salat Al
Mayyit)?”
Imam {a.s} said: “Make up what you missed.”
Iasked: “Should I face the qiblah?”
Imam {a.s} said: “Yes, while you are following the funeral. Indeed, the Messenger of
Allah {SWT}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his family, went out for the funeral of a woman
from Banu Najjar and prayed over her.
Then Prophet {saws} found the grave had not yet been prepared, so they placed the bier
down. And whenever a group came, He {saws}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his family,
would say to them; ‘Pray over her’.”
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s} & Abu al-Qasim Prophet Muhammad ibn Abdullah {saws}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.325 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.484 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.471

arabic_text:
علي بن الحسين عن سعد بن عبد اللّٰه عن احمد بن محمد ابن عيسى عن الحسين بن سعيد عن فضالة عن ابان
عن الفضل بن عبد الملك قال : سألت ابا عبد اللّه عليه السلام هل يصلى على الميت في المسجد؟ قال : نعم.
english_text:
Ali ibn al-Husayn, from Sa’ad ibn Abdillah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id,
from Fadalah, from Aban, from al-Fadl ibn Abd al-Malik, said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him: “Is it permitted to perform the funeral
prayer over the deceased in the mosque?”
Imam {a.s} said: “Yes.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.325

arabic_text:
عنه عن محمد بن يحيى عن محمد بن الحسين عن محمد بن سنان عن العلا بن رزين عن محمد بن مسلم عن
أحدهما عليه السلام مثل ذلك.
english_text:
From him, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from
Muhammad ibn Sinan, from al-Ala ibn Razin, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from one
of the two Imams {a.s}, peace be upon them: The same as that.
source: Implicit (Muzmar)
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.325

arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمِّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ مُحَمّدِ بْنِ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمِّدِ بْنِ أَبِي نَصْرٍ عَنْ دَاوُدَ بْنِ الْحُصَيْنِ عَنْ فَضْلٍ
الْبَقْبَاقٍ قَالَ: سَأَلتُهُ عَنِ الْمَيَّتِ هَلْ يُصَلَّى عَلَيْهِ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ قَالَ «نَعَمْ».
قال محمد بن الحسن : هذه الاخبار محمولة على ضرب من الرخصة وعند الضرورة لان الافضل ان يصلى على الجنازة في
مواضعها المرسومة بذلك ، والذي يدل على ذلك ما رواه:
english_text:
From him, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn
Abi Nasr, from Dawud ibn al-Husayn, from Fadl al-Baqbaq, who said:
I asked Imam {a.s} about the deceased, whether the funeral prayer (Salat Al Mayyit) may
be performed over him in the mosque.
Imam {a.s} said: “Yes.”
source: Implicit (Muzmar)
commentary:
Muhammad ibn al-Hasan said: “These reports are to be understood as conveying a
kind of concession (rukhsah) and for cases of necessity, because the preferable
(afdhal) practice is that the funeral prayer be performed in the designated places for
it.” What indicates this is that which was narrated:
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.325 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.412

arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ طَلْحَةَ عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ عِيسَى بْنِ
أَحْمَدَ الْعَلَوِيِّ قَالَ: كُنْتُ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ وَ قَدْ جِيءَ بِجَنَازَةِ فَأَرَدْتُ أَنْ أَصَلِّيَ عَلَيْهَا فَجَاءَ أَبُو الْحَسَنِ الْأَوَّلُ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلاَمُ فَوَضَعَ مِرْفَقَهُ فِي صَدْرِي فَجَعَلَ يَدْفَعُنِي حَتَّى أَخْرَجَنِي مِنَ الْمَسْجِدِ ثُمَّ قَالَ «يَا أَبَا بَكْرٍ إِنَّ ٱلْجَنَائِزَ لا
يُصَلَّى عَلَيْهَا فِي الْمَسَاجِدِ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Ya'qub, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Musa ibn
Talhah, from Abu Bakr ibn Isa ibn Ahmad al-Alawi, said:
I was in the mosque and a funeral (bier) was brought in, and I intended to pray over it.
Then Abu al-Hasan al-Awwal {a.s} (the First), peace be upon him, came and placed his
elbow against my chest and began to push me until he drove me out of the mosque.
Then Imam {a.s} said: “O’ Abu Bakr (ibn Isa), funeral prayers are not to be performed in
mosques.”
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.182 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.326 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.473 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.3 p.123

arabic_text:
سَهْلُ بنُ زِيَادٍ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ عُقْبَةَ عَنِ اِمْرَأَةِ الْحَسَنِ الصَّيْقَلِ عَنِ ٱلْحَسَنِ الصَّيْقَلِ عَنْ
أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: سُيِلَ كَيْفَ تُصَلِّي النَّسَاءُ عَلَى الْجِنَازَةِ إِذَا لَمْ يَكُنْ مَعَهُنَّ رَجُلٌ قَالَ «يَصْفُفْنَ جَمِيعاً
فَلاَ تَتَقَدَّمُهُنَّ اِمْرَأةٌ».
english_text:
Sahl ibn Ziyad, from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal, from Ali ibn Uqbah, from the wife of al-Hasan al-Sayqal,
from al-Hasan al-Sayqal, from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} was asked: “How do women perform the funeral prayer if there is no
man with them?”
Imam {a.s} said: “They all stand in a row, and no woman advances in front of the others.”
(meaning the women leading the prayer stands in the middle of the front row)
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.179 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.326 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.3 p.117

arabic_text:
أَبُو عَلِيَّ الْأَشعَرِيُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سَالِمِ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ النَّضْرِ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ شِمْرٍ عَنْ جَابِرٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلَاَمُ
قَالَ: «إِذَا لَمْ يَحْضُرِ الرَّجُلُ تَقَدَّمَتِ اِمْرَأَةٌ وَسَطَهُنَّ وَ قَامَ ٱلنَّسَاءُ عَنْ يَمِينِهَا وَ شِمَالِهَا وَ هِيَ وَسَطُهُنَّ تُكَبَّرُ حَتَّى
تَفْرُغَ مِنَ الصَّلاةِ».
english_text:
Abu Ali al-Ash'ari, from Muhammad ibn Salim, from Ahmad ibn al-Nadr, from Amr ibn Shimr, from Jabir, from
Abu Ja’far {a.s}, peace be upon him, said:
Imam al-Baqir {a.s} said: “If no man is present, a woman steps forward to the center of
them (in the same row), and the women stand to her right and to her left, and she is in
their midst. She pronounces the takbirs until she completes the prayer.”
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.179 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.166 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.326 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.425 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.3 p.118 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.337

arabic_text:
علي بن الحسن بن فضال عن عبد الرحمن بن ابى نجران عن حماد بن عيسى عن حريز عن زرارة عن ابي جعفر
عليه السلام قال : قلت له المرأة تؤم النساء؟ قال لا إلا على الميت إذا لم يكن له أحد أولى منها تقوم وسطهن
في الصف معهن فتكبر ويكبرن.
english_text:
Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Faddal, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Najran, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Hurayz, from
Zurarah, from Abu Ja’far {a.s}, peace be upon him, said:
I said to Imam al-Baqir {a.s}: “May a woman lead other women in prayer?”
Imam {a.s} said, “No, except over a deceased person (Salat Al Mayyit), if there is no one
more entitled than her.
She stands in the middle of them in the (same) row with them, pronounces the takbirs,
and they pronounce the takbirs.”
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.327

arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى عَنِ الْعَمْرَكِيِّ بْنِ عَلِيَّ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ عَنْ أَخِيهِ مُوسَى بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلَاَمُ
قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ قَوْمِ كَبَّرُوا عَلَى جِنَارَةٍ تَكْبِيرَةً أَو اِثْنَتَيْنِ وَ وُضِعَتْ مَعَهَا أُخْرَى كَيْفَ يَصْنَعُونَ قَالَ «إِنْ شَاءُوا
تَرَكُوا الْأُولَى حَتَّى يَفْرُغُوا مِنَ التَّكْبِيرِ عَلَى الْأَخِيرَةِ وَ إِنْ شَاءُوا رَفَعُوا الْأُولَى فَأَتَمُوا مَا بَقِيَ عَلَى الْأَخِيرَةِ كُلُّ
ذَلِكَ لا بَأْسَ بِهِ».
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Yahya, from al-‘Amraki ibn Ali, from Ali ibn Ja’far {a.s}, peace be upon him, from his brother
Imam Musa ibn Ja’far {a.s}, peace be upon them, said:
I asked Imam al-Kadhim {a.s} about a group who had pronounced one or two takbirs over
a funeral, and then another body was brought and placed with it, what should they do?
Imam {a.s} said: “If they wish, they may leave the first one (at its place) until they finish
the takbirs over the second. And if they wish, they may remove the first (bier) and
complete the remaining takbirs over the second (bier). All of that is permissible and
there is no harm in it.”
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}
references: Masa’il Ali Ibn Ja’far, Vol.1 p.211 • Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.190 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.327 • Al- Wafi, Vol.24 p.467 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.3 p.129 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.78 p.363

arabic_text:
عَلِيْ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِي هَاشِمِ الْجَعْفَرِيِّ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ الرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ عَنِ ٱلْمَصْلُوبِ فَقَالَ «أَمَا عَلِمْتَ أَنَّ جَدِّي
عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ صَلَّى عَلَى عَمِّهِ» قُلْتُ أَعْلَمُ ذَلِكَ وَ لَكِنِّي لا أَفْهَمُهُ مُبَيَّناً قَالَ «أَبَيِّنُهُ لَكَ إِنْ كَانَ وَجْهُ ٱلْمَصْلُوبِ إِلَى
اَلْقِبْلَةِ فَقُمْ عَلَى مَنكِبِهِ الْأَيْمَنِ وَ إِنْ كَانَ قَفَاهُ إِلَى الْقِبْلَةِ فَقُمْ عَلَى مَنْكِبِهِ الْأَيْسَرِ فَإِنَّ بَيْنَ الْمَشِرِقِ وَ الْمَغْرِبِ قِبْلَةً
فَإِنْ كَانَ مَنْكِبُهُ الْأَيْسَرُ إِلَى الْقِبْلَةِ فَقُمْ عَلَى مَنْكِبِهِ الْأَيْمَنِ وَ إِنْ كَانَ مَنْكِبُهُ الْأَيْمَنُ عَلَى الْقِبْلَةِ فَقُمْ عَلَى مَنْكِبِهِ
اَلْأَيْسَرِ وَ كَيْفَ كَانَ مُنُحَرِفَاً فَلَا تُزَايِلَنَّ مَنَاكِبَهُ وَ لَيَكُنْ وَجْهُكَ إِلَى مَا بَيْنَ الْمَشِرِقِ وَ الْمَغْرِبِ وَ لَا تَسْتَقْبِلَهُ وَ لا
نَسْتَدْبِرُهُ الْبَتَّةَ» قَالَ أَبُو هَاشِمِ وَ قَدْ فَهِمْتُ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ فَهِمْتُ وَ اللَّهِ.
english_text:
Ali ibn Ibrahim, from Abu Hashim al-Ja’fari, said:
I asked Imam al-Ridha {a.s}, peace be upon him, about the crucified (person).
Imam {a.s} said: “Do you not know that my grandfather {a.s}, peace be upon him, prayed
over his uncle?”
I asked: “I know that, but I do not understand it clearly.”
Imam {a.s} said: “I will clarify it for you. If the face of the crucified is toward the qiblah,
then stand at his right shoulder. And if his back is toward the qiblah, then stand at his
left shoulder. Indeed, between the east and the west is a qiblah.
So if his left shoulder is toward the qiblah, then stand at his right shoulder. And if his
right shoulder is toward the qiblah, then stand at his left shoulder.
And however he is turned, do not separate yourself from his shoulders, and let your
face be toward what lies between the east and the west (Qiblah). Do not face him
directly, and do not turn your back to him at all.”
Abu Hashim said: “And I have understood, if Allah {SWT} wills. I have understood, by
Allah {SWT}”.
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Ali ibn Musa al-Ridha {a.s} & Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al- Sadiq {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.215 • Uyun Al-Akhbar, Vol.1 p.255 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.327 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.485 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.3 p.130 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.79 p.3

arabic_text:
احمد بن محمد بن عيسى عن احمد بن محمد بن ابي نصر عن مروان عن عمار بن موسى قال : قلت لابي عبد
الله عليه السلام ما تقول في قوم كانوا في سفر لهم يمشون على ساحل البحر فإذا هم برجل ميت عريان قد
لفظه البحر وهم عراة وليس عليهم إلا ازار كيف يصلون عليه وهو عريان وليس معهم فضل ثوب يكفنونه؟
قال : يحفر له ويوضع في لحده ويوضع اللبن على عورته فيستر عورته باللبن وبالحجر ثم يصلى عليه ثم
يدفن ، قلت : فلا يصلى عليه إذا دفن؟ فقال : لا يصلى على الميت بعد ما يدفن ، ولا يصلى عليه وهو عريان
حتى توارى عورته.
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr from Marwan from Ammar ibn
Musa, who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him: “What do you say about a group of
people who were on a journey, walking along the seashore, and suddenly they came
upon a dead naked man whom the sea had cast out. However, they themselves were
naked, wearing nothing but loincloths. How should they pray over him (Salat Al Mayyit)
while he is naked and they do not have an extra cloth to shroud him in?
Imam {a.s} said: “A grave should be dug for him and he should be placed in his lahd (side
niche of the grave), and bricks (libn) should be placed over his private parts to cover
his private parts, with the bricks and with stones.
Then the prayer (Salat Al Mayyit) should be performed over him, then he should be
buried.”
I asked: “Should the prayer not be performed over him after he is buried?”
Imam {a.s} said: “The prayer (Salat Al Mayyit) is not performed over the dead after he is
buried, and it is not performed over him while he is naked, until his private parts are
concealed.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.328

arabic_text:
سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ عَنْ رَجُلٍ مِنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْجَزِيرَةِ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي الْحَسَنِ
اَلرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَوْمٌ كُسِرَ بِهِمْ فِي بَحْرٍ فَخَرَجُوا يَمْشُونَ عَلَى الشَّطَ فَإِذَا هُمْ بِرَجُلٍ مَيِّتٍ عُرْيَانٍ وَ اَلْقَوْمُ لَيْسَ
عَلَيْهِمْ إِلاَّ مَنَادِيلُ مُتَزِرِينَ بِهَا وَ لَيْسَ عَلَيْهِمْ فَضْلُ ثَوْبِ يُوَارُونَ الرَّجُلَ فَكَيْفَ يُصَلُونَ عَلَيْهِ وَ هُوَ عُرْيَانْ فَقَالَ
«إِذَا لَمْ يَقْدِرُوا عَلَى ثَوْبٍ يُوَارُونَ بِهِ عَوْرَتَهُ فَلْيَحْفِرُوا قَبْرَهُ وَ يَضَعُوهُ فِي لَحْدِهِ يُوَارُونَ عَوْرَتَهُ بِلَبِنٍ أَوْ أَحْجَارٍ
أَوْ بِتُرَابٍ ثُمّ يُصَلُونَ عَلَيْهِ ثُمّ يُوَارُونَهُ فِي قَبْرِهِ» قُلْتُ وَ لا يُصَلُونَ عَلَيْهِ وَ هُوَ مَدْفُونْ بَعْدَ مَا يُدْفَنُ قَالَ «لا لَوْ
جَازَ ذَلِكَ لِأَحَدٍ لَجَازَ لِرَسُولِ اللهِ صَلَّى اللّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ فَلاَ يُصَلَّى عَلَى ٱلْمَدْفُونِ وَلا عَلَى الْعُرْيَانِ».
english_text:
Sa’ad ibn Abdillah from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from Muhammad ibn Aslam from a man from the people
of al-Jazirah who said:
I said to Abu al-Hasan Imam al-Ridha {a.s}: “A group was shipwrecked in the sea, and
they came out walking along the shore, and suddenly they came upon a dead man;
naked. However, the group had nothing on them except towels which they had
wrapped around their waists, and they did not have any extra cloth to cover (shroud)
the man. So how should they pray over him while he is naked?”
Imam {a.s} said: “If they are not able to find a cloth with which to cover his private parts,
then they should dig his grave and place him in its lahd (grave niche), and cover his
private parts with bricks (libn), or stones, or with soil.
Then they should perform the prayer (Salat Al Mayyit) over him, then they should bury
him in his grave.”
I asked: “Should they not pray over him while he is buried, after he has been buried?”
Imam {a.s} said: “No. If that had been permissible for anyone, it would have been
permissible for the Messenger of Allah {SWT}. So the prayer is not performed over
someone already buried, nor over someone who is naked.”
source: Abu al-Hasan Imam Ali ibn Musa al-Ridha {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.328 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.488 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.3 p.132

arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمْدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ النَّضْرِ بْنِ سُوَيْدٍ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ سَالِمِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لَهُ شَارِبُ الْخَمْرِ وَ ٱلزَّانِي وَ السَّارِقُ يُصَلَّى عَلَيْهِمْ إِذَا مَاتُوا فَقَالَ «نَعَمْ».
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from al-Nadr ibn Suwayd from Hisham ibn Salim:
I said to Imam al-Sadiq {a.s}: “The one who drinks wine, the adulterer, and the thief,
should the funeral prayer (Salat Al Mayyit) be performed over them when they die?”
Imam {a.s} said: “Yes.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.166 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.328 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.468 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.481 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.3 p.132

arabic_text:
سَعْدٌ عَنْ أَيُوبَ بْنِ نُوحِ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ مِهْرَمِ عَنْ طَلْحَةَ بْنِ رَيْدِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَنْ
أَبِيهِ عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «صَلِّ عَلَى مَنْ مَاتَ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْقِبْلَةِ وَ حِسَابُهُ عَلَى اللَّهِ».
english_text:
Sa’ad from Ayyub ibn Nuh from al-Hasan ibn Mahbub from Ibrahim ibn Mihzam from Talhah ibn Zayd from
Abu Abdillah {a.s} from his father {a.s}, peace be upon them both, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “Pray over whoever dies from the people of the Qiblah, and his
reckoning is upon Allah (SWT}.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al- Baqir {a.s}
references: Al-Amali (Lil-Saduq), Vol.1 p.217 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.328 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.468 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.481 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.3 p.133 • Al-Fusul Al-Muhimmah, Vol.2 p.41 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.78 p.345

arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ أَبِي هَمّامٍ إسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ هَمّامٍ عَنْ مُحَمّدِ بْنِ سَعِيدِ عَنْ غَزْوَانَ عَنِ
السَّكُونِيِّ عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ آبَائِهِ عَلَيْهِمُ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللّهِ صَلَّى اللّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ : «صَلُوا عَلَى
اَلْمَرْجُومِ مِنْ أَمَّتِي وَ عَلَى الْقَتَّالِ نَفْسَهُ مِنْ أَمَّتِي لا تَدَعُوا أَحَداً مِنْ أَمَّتِي بِلاَ صَلاةٍ».
english_text:
From him, from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal from Abu Hammam Isma'il ibn Hammam from
Muhammad ibn Sa'id from Ghazwan from al-Sakuni from Imam Ja’far {a.s}, from his father {a.s}, from his
forefathers, peace be upon them, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “The Messenger of Allah {SWT}, peace be upon him and his
family, said: ‘Pray over the one who was stoned to death (rajm) from my nation, and
over the one who killed himself (suicide) from my nation.
Do not leave anyone from my nation without the funeral prayer.’”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Abu al-Qasim Prophet Muhammad ibn Abdullah {saws}
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.166 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.328 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.468 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.481 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.3 p.133 • Al-Fusul Al-Muhimmah, Vol.2 p.41

arabic_text:
سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنِ النَّضْرِ بْنِ سُوَيْدِ عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ مَادَ ٱلْقَلاَنِسِيَّ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يَأْكُلُهُ السَّبْعُ أَو الطَّيْرُ فَتَبْقَى عِظَامُهُ بِغَيْرِ لَحْمِ كَيْفَ يُصْنَعُ بِهِ قَالَ «يُغَسَّلُ وَ يُكَفَّنُ
وَ يُصَلِّى عَلَيْهِ وَ يُدْفَنُ فَإِذَا كَانَ الْمَيَّتُ نِصْفَيْنِ صُلِّيَ عَلَى النَّصْفِ الّذِي فِيهِ قَلْبُهُ».
english_text:
Sa’ad ibn Abdillah from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from al-Nadr ibn Suwayd from Khalid ibn Madd al-
Qalanisi from Abu Ja’far {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Imam al-Baqir {a.s} about a man who is eaten by a wild beast or a bird, and only
his bones remain, without flesh. What should be done with him?
Imam {a.s} said: “He should be washed, shrouded, prayed over, and buried. And if the
deceased is in two halves, the prayer (Salat Al Mayyit) should be performed over the
half that contains his heart.”
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Masa’il Ali Ibn Ja’far, Vol.1 p.212 • Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.212 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.1 p.336 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.329 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.489 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.3 p.136

arabic_text: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى عَنِ الْعَمْرَكِيّ الْبُوفَكِيّ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَخِيهِ مُوسَى بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِمَا السَلاَمُ : مِثلَ ذَلِكَ.
english_text:
Muhammad ibn Yahya from al-Amraki al-Bufaki from Ali ibn Ja’far from his brother
Imam Musa ibn Ja’far {a.s}, peace be upon them both: the same as that.
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Masa’il Ali Ibn Ja’far, Vol.1 p.212 • Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.212 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.1 p.336 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.329 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.489 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.3 p.136

arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنِ الْعَبَّاسِ بْنِ مَعْرُوفٍ عَنْ طَلْحَةَ بْنِ زَيْدِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلاَمُ أُنَّهُ
قَالَ: «لا يُصَلَّى عَلَى عُضْوِ رَجُلٍ مِنْ رِجْلِ أَوْ يَدِ أَوْ رَأْسِ مُنْفَرِداً فَإِذَا كَانَ ٱلْبَدَنُ فَصَلَ عَلَيْهِ وَ إِنْ كَانَ نَاقِصاً مِنَ
الرَّأْسِ وَ الْيَدِ وَ الرِّجْلِ».
english_text:
From him, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa from al-Abbas ibn Ma'ruf from Talhah ibn Zayd:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “The funeral prayer is not performed over a limb of a man,
whether a leg, or a hand, or a head, when it is separate (from the body).
But if the body is present, then pray over it, even if it is missing the head, the hand, and
the leg.” (meaning the body containing the heart)
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.329 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.491 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.3 p.136

arabic_text:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ الْعَبَّاسِ بْنِ مَعْرُوفٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي الْجَرّاحِ طَلْحَةَ بْنِ زَيْدِ عَنِ الْفَضْلِ بْنِ عُثمَانَ
اَلْأَعْوَرِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ : فِي الرَّجُلِ يُقْتَلُ فَيُوجَدُ رَأْسُهُ فِي قَبِيلَةٍ قَالَ «دِيَتُهُ عَلَى مَنْ وُجِدَ فِي
قَبِيلَتِهِ صَدْرُهُ وَ يَدَاهُ وَ الصَّلاَةُ عَلَيْهِ».
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Abbas ibn Ma'ruf from Muhammad ibn Sinan from Abu al-Jarrah Talhah ibn
Zayd from al-Fadl ibn Uthman al-A‘war from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} was asked regarding a man who is killed and his head is found in
one tribe (away from the body).
Imam {a.s} said: “His blood money (diyah) is upon the tribe in which his chest and his
hands are found, and the funeral prayer is performed over him.” (meaning the place
where the chest is found)
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.329

arabic_text:
سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ عَنِ السِّنْدِيَّ بْنِ الرَّبِيعِ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ أَبِي نَصْرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ جَمِيلٍ
بْنِ دَرَّاجٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: «إِذَا قُتِلَ قَتِيلٌ فَلَمْ يُوجَدْ إِلَّ لَحْمٌ بِلاَ عَظْمِ لَمْ
يُصَلّ عَلَيْهِ فَإِنْ وُجِدَ عَظْمٌ بِلاَ لَحْمِ صُلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ».
english_text:
Sa’ad ibn Abdillah from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from al-Sindi ibn al-Rabi' from Ali ibn Ahmad ibn Abi Nasr
from his father from Jamil ibn Darraj from Muhammad ibn Muslim from Abu Ja’far {a.s}, peace be upon him:
Imam al-Baqir {a.s} said: “If a person is killed and only flesh, without bone, is found. Then
the funeral prayer is not performed over him. But if bone is found without flesh, the
funeral prayer is performed over him.”
source: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.212 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.1 p.336 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.329 • Al- Wafi, Vol.24 p.490 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.3 p.136

arabic_text:
عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمِّدِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ مُوسَى الْخَشَّابِ عَنْ غِيَاتِ بْنِ كَلُوبِ الْبَجَلِيِّ عَنْ إسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ عَنْ
أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ : «أَنَّ عَلِيّاً عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ وَجَدَ قِطَعاً مِنْ مَيَّتِ فَجُمِعَتْ ثُمَّ صَلَّى عَلَيْهَا ثُمَّ دُفِنَتْ)).
english_text:
From him, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from al-Hasan ibn Musa al-Khasshab from Ghiyath ibn Kallub al-
Bajali from Ishaq ibn Ammar from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “Indeed, Imam Ali {a.s}, peace be upon him, found parts of a
dead body, so they were gathered, then He {a.s} performed the funeral prayer over them,
then they were buried.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Amir al-Mu’minin Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib al-Murtadha {a.s}
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.167 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.1 p.337 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.329 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.492 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.3 p.135

arabic_text:
أحمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ عَنْ خَلَفٍ بْنِ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ سِنَانِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «لَمَّا مَاتَ آدَمُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ فَبَلَغَ إِلَى الصَّلاَةِ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالَ هِبَةُ اللَّهِ لِجَبْرَئِيلَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ تَقَدَّمْ يَا رَسُولَ
اللَّهِ فَصَلَّ عَلَى نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ فَقَالَ جَبْرَئِيلُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ أَمَرَنَا بِالسُّجُودِ لأَبِيكَ قَلَسْنَا نَتَقَدَّمُ عَلَى أُبْرَارِ وُلْدِهِ وَ
أَنْتَ مِنْ أَبَرِّهِمْ فَتَقَدَّمَ فَكَبَّرَ عَلَيْهِ خَمْساً عِدَّةَ الصَّلاَةِ الَّتِي فَرَضَهَا اللّهُ عَلَى أَمّةِ مُحَمِّدٍ وَ هِيَ السُّنَّةُ الْجَارِيَةُ فِي
وُلْدِهِ إلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ».
english_text:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa from Muhammad ibn Khalid from Khalaf ibn Hammad from Abdillah ibn
Sinan from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “When Adam {a.s}, peace be upon him, died and the time came
to pray over him, Hibatullah (his son) said to Jibra'il {a.s}, peace be upon him: 'Step
forward, O’ Messenger (angel) of Allah {SWT}, and perform the prayer over the Prophet of
Allah {SWT}.'
So Jibra'il {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: “Indeed, Allah {SWT} commanded us to prostrate
to your father (Adam {a.s}), so we do not go ahead of the righteous among his children,
and you are among the most righteous of them.”
So Hibatullah stepped forward and said takbir over him (Adam {a.s}) five times, equal to
the number of the prayers which Allah {SWT} has made obligatory upon the nation of
(Prophet) Muhammad {saws}, and this became the ongoing sunnah among his children
(Children of Adam {a.s}) until the Day of Resurrection.”
source: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.163 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.330 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.416 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.3 p.76 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.11 p.260

arabic_text:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدِ الْمَدَائِنِيّ عَنْ مُصَدَّقِ بْنِ صَدَقَةَ عَنْ
عَمَّارِ بْنِ مُوسَى السَّابَاطِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَألْتُهُ عَنِ الصَّلاَةِ عَلَى الْمَيَّتِ فَقَالَ «تُكَبِّرُ ثُمَّ تَقُولُ
«إِنَّا لِلهِ وَ إِنَّا إِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُونَ» «إِنَّ اللهَ وَ مَلائِكَتَهُ يُصَلُونَ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ يَا أَيُهَا آلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا صَلُوا عَلَيْهِ وَ سَلَّمُوا تَسْلِيما»
اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ بَارِك عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ وَ بَارَكْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَ آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ
إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدِ وَ عَلَى أَئِمَّةِ الْمُسْلِمِينَ اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ عَلَى إِمَامِ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ اللَّهُمَّ
عَبْدُكَ فُلانْ وَ أَنْتَ أَعْلَمُ بِهِ اللَّهُمَّ الْحِقْهُ بِنَبِيِّهِ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ وَ اِفْسَحْ لَهُ فِي قَبْرِهِ وَ نَوِّرْ لَهُ فِيهِ وَ
صَعَّدْ رُوحَهُ وَ لَقَّنْهُ حَجَّتَهُ وَ اِجْعَلْ مَا عِنْدَكَ خَيْراً لَهُ وَ اِرْجِعْهُ إِلَى خَيْرٍ مِمَّا كَانَ فِيهِ اللَّهُمَّ عِنْدَكَ نَحْتَسِبُهُ فَلاَ
تَحْرِمْنَا أَجْرَهُ وَ لا تَفْتِنَّا بَعْدَهُ اللَّهُمَّ عَفْوَكَ عَفْوَكَ تَقُولُ هَذَا كُلّهُ فِي التَّكْبِيرَةِ الْأُولَى ثُمَّ تَكَبَّرُ الثَّانِيَةَ وَ تَقُولُ اللَّهُمَّ
عَبْدُكَ فُلاَنٌ اللَّهُمَّ أَلْحِقْهُ بِنَبِيِّهِ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ وَ اِفْسَحْ لَهُ فِي قَبْرِهِ وَ نَوِّرْ لَهُ فِيهِ وَ صَعَدْ رُوحَهُ وَ لَقَّنْهُ
حُجَتَهُ وَ اِجْعَلْ مَا عِنْدَكَ خَيْراً لَهُ وَ اِرْجِعَهُ إِلَى خَيْرٍ مِمَّا كَانَ فِيهِ اللَّهُمَّ عِنْدَكَ نَحْتَسِبُهُ فَلا تَحْرِمْنَا أَجْرَهُ وَ لا تَفْتِنَّا
بَعْدَهُ اَللَّهُمَّ عَفْوَكَ اللَّهُمَّ عَفْوَكَ تَقُولُ هَذَا فِي الثَّانِيَةِ وَ الثَالِثَةِ وَ الرَّابِعَةِ فَإِذَا كَبَّرْتَ الْخَامِسَةَ فَقُلِ اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى
مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدِ اللّهُمَّ اِغْفِرْ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَ الْمُؤْمِنَاتِ اَللَّهُمَّ أُلَّف بَيْنَ قُلُوبِهِمْ وَ تَوَفَّنِي عَلَى مِلَّةٍ رَسُولِكَ اَللَّهُمَّ «اِغْفِزْ
لَنَا وَ لِإِخْوَانِنَا الَّذِينَ سَبَقُونًا بِالْإِيمَانِ وَ لا تَجْعَلْ فِي قُلُوبِنَا غِلاَّ لِلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا رَبَّنا إِنَّكَ رَؤُفٌ رَجِيمٌ» اللَّهُمَّ عَفْوَكَ
اللَّهُمّ عَفْوَكَ وَ تُسَلَّمُ».
